games.name: 点击地牢 Tap Dungeon
games.short_description: 像素風異世界Roguelike地牢冒險！5種職業自由搭配技能與道具，在隨機生成的致命地牢中展開回合制戰鬥。對抗哥布林、獸人與亡靈，收集神器，挑戰隱藏Boss。死亡即新生，無數Build等你征服。成為拯救王國的英雄！

games.name: Zad Archery
games.short_description: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this expanding incremental game.

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.short_description: 《重裝武力：破碎宇宙》是一款 1-5 人合作 roguelite 第一人稱射擊遊戲。穿越不斷改變的世界、累積瘋狂的增益效果、透過調整器改變規則、並獵殺狂駭的致命部隊。轟轟烈烈地倒下，更轟轟烈烈地歸來。

games.name: Pickle Pete
games.short_description: A roguelite bullet heaven where you dodge and auto-shoot through waves of enemies. Build devastating weapon, gear and mutation combinations with deep synergies. Face over 30 unique bosses across diverse biomes in this challenging arena shooter.

games.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
games.short_description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

games.name: Eslabong
games.short_description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

games.name: 地牢大出血
games.short_description: 在這款由《Nidhogg》創作團隊精心推出的 2D 平台自動射擊遊戲中，聆聽超讚原聲帶並獵殺成群怪物。收集鮮血、黃金和骨頭來提升自己的力量。你能在地牢大出血中存活下來嗎？

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.short_description: 你是納飛利使者：一名由人類與天使混血鍛造而成的戰士，擁有超自然力量，誓言以此守護人類。獨自奮戰或與好友並肩作戰，在無情的近身格鬥中殲滅惡魔，挑戰殘暴的頭目。覺醒吧，暴戾之人。預言等待你來實現。

games.name: 胡鬧撞球 Ultrapool
games.short_description: 酒吧永不打烊，撞球隨時開局！Ultrapool 是一款色彩繽紛的 Roguelike 撞球遊戲，在這裡，你可使用各種擁有瘋狂效果的奇特小球，在球桌上創造各種不可思議的瞬間！精心挑選屬於你的完美組合，挑戰最離譜最極限的 Trick Shot

games.name: 奪寶青蛙 Loot Frog
games.short_description: 奪寶青蛙（Loot Frog）是一款增量型動作 彈幕地獄 遊戲，玩家需要打破花瓶、收集寶石，並與邪惡教派作戰。升級裝備、解鎖新技能、探索多樣化的生物群落，並在越來越混亂的戰鬥中不斷深入。

games.name: 末世：我有一辆房车
games.short_description: Reborn seven days before the apocalypse. Make a fortune, hoard supplies, build the ultimate RV, and live comfortably while the world falls apart. A story-rich survival management game with cards, farming, crafting and roguelite progression.

games.name: Drunken: 酩酊俠盜與報廢吸血鬼
games.short_description: 嗜酒成性的盜賊·莉塔與末日吸血鬼·恩度的歡樂大冒險！你能夠在陷阱與怪物的襲擊下潛入迷宮最深層，得到令人垂涎的極品美酒嗎？

games.name: 餵龍高手
games.short_description: 《餵龍高手》是一款在二十年間餵食一頭巨龍的骰子roguelike遊戲。擲出骰子，取得食材，建造島嶼，搭配上荒誕不經的各種食譜，讓分數不斷飆升。但若有一餐不慎，你就會成為桌上美味，滿「盤」皆輸。

games.name: PengPong 彈企鵝
games.short_description: 《彈企鵝 PengPong》是一款彈幕射擊 Roguelike 遊戲。只不過，我們又往裡面加了點彈珠台物理和豪賭之類的……變數。

games.name: Hell Deck
games.short_description: 《Hell Deck》是一款以黑暗扭曲世界觀為背景的暗黑Roguelike牌組塔防遊戲。這裡的戰場是一座活生生且狂暴的殘酷生態系，而生存的代價，只能用血肉來償還。將你的角色推入侵蝕與犧牲的輪迴之中，建立起詭異的食物鏈，擊退神聖軍團的入侵！

games.name: 魔女工廠
games.short_description: 30分鐘內必須還清欠款！一部手忙腳亂的工廠建設遊戲。 背著一屁股債的你必須依靠契約戰勝規則，設法達成離譜的生產指標。

games.name: Gunk
games.short_description: Gunk is an endless rouge-lite wave survival game.  Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your skills to increase your chance of survival, and save the world from the Gunk invasion.  Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity.  Can you save us all?

games.name: Survival Log
games.short_description: 《生存日誌》是一款以殭屍末日為題材的囤貨生存模擬遊戲。 你將扮演一名預知殭屍危機爆發的普通人，善用重生優勢，在災難來臨前瘋狂囤積物資、補強住處。遊戲聚焦策略規劃與資源管理，帶來獨特的「囤貨避難」沉浸式體驗。每一次死亡都會化為下一次輪迴的經驗，讓你不斷優化計畫、突破極限——這一次，一定要活下去！

games.name: 魔女庭園
games.short_description: 《魔女庭園》是款可愛又刺激的Rogue類型遊戲。主角「絲爾」正因為那些不聽話的魔女而頭痛不已，助她一臂之力，拯救「庭園」吧！

games.name: 群侠传：幸存者
games.short_description: 《群侠传：幸存者》是一款武侠题材的幸存者类动作肉鸽游戏。在 20 波江湖围攻中走位闪避、修炼武学秘籍，掌握内功、外功，搜刮奇物。105 门武学、233 件道具、7 大派系近50种敌人，利用同门武学触发的共鸣效果与修炼升级获得的额外加成，滚起你的构筑雪球，造就一代宗师。

games.name: Nimbit Frontier
games.short_description: In this cozy creature collector, your creatures aren't for battling. Restore lost species, build habitats around their needs, teach them the skills to thrive, and release them into the wild. Explore town life and dive into shifting roguelite dungeons to discover the next Nimbit.

games.name: Ironsand
games.short_description: Ironsand 是一款合作泰坦狩獵 FPS roguelite 遊戲，背景設定在一個沙漠星球上，強大的裝備和團隊協作至關重要

games.name: 梦境回响 DreamEcho
games.short_description: 《夢境迴響》是一款以刷寶與局外成長為主的非典型俯視角 RogueLite ARPG 遊戲；玩家可以在【夢境】世界的探險中，獲得各式各樣的【概念】來進行近乎完全自由的組合式戰鬥

games.name: Feed The Pit
games.short_description: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

games.name: Slayblade
games.short_description: 打造您的專屬爆鬥陀螺，成為街頭霸主！收集超過 60 款部件，將它們的能量合而為一，在這款療癒的 Roguelite 遊戲中碾壓對手！踏著滑板穿梭於活力十足的 Y2K 城市，贏取現金並升級裝備，朝著巔峰邁進。不過小心了，如果您在對戰中死掉，在現實也會隨之死掉。

games.name: 磐石守衛
games.short_description: 矮人開戰！Stonewards 是一款支援 1–4 人合作的第一人稱 roguelite 防禦遊戲。帶領一隊倔強的矮人從你的大本營出發，援助附近的王國，深入地下採集資源，打造強大的升級，並堅守防線，抵禦無情的怪物進攻。

games.name: The Adventurers
games.short_description: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

games.name: Internet Survivor Survivors
games.short_description: 芙蘭醬成為實況主，在網路上大暴走！？東方Project二次創作・俯勘視角Roguelite動作遊戲！收集讚數和金幣來強化武器！觀眾人數就是是你的生命！打倒大量逼近的敵人！無論怎樣都要活下去～！

games.name: Repterra
games.short_description: Repterra is a base-building survival RTS set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Manage your colony while battling massive dino hordes. Breed and ride your own dinos, unlock permanent upgrades, and fight to reclaim the world for humanity.

games.name: GRAIN ROT
games.short_description: 在一切可能隨時點燃、灼熱的荒原中，想辦法撤離人員、大舉建造的驚駭合作遊戲。與好友一同遁入變幻莫測的遺跡，趁著腐朽者步步逼近前取出不同的家具，並搜索精彩的戰利品。從惡劣的情況中活著回歸營地，接著重建牢固的前哨，以確保能在下一次出征中有更高的勝率。

games.name: Pot's On!
games.short_description: 慘敗於魔女手下，醒來後竟成了廚房裡的一口鍋！擊敗美得異常的魔物少女，將取得的素材塞進狹小的鍋中，組成強力協同效果。協同效果越強，MSG就會掉得越多、越快，並縮短道具冷卻時間。攀登高塔，奪回身體吧！這是一款背包構築自動戰鬥Roguelite遊戲。

games.name: The One Fish
games.short_description: An online co-op game for 1-6 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.short_description: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe... just maybe, save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Flowers and Deities
games.short_description: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods

games.name: 暗星鐵律 Pax Autocratica
games.short_description: 建立一座偉大的鐵律殖民地，然後親自率領士兵衝入 Roguelite 戰場。塑造公民的恐懼、忠誠、羈絆與仇怨。俘虜敵人，將他們改造成真正的信徒。犧牲弱者，供養強者。掌握絕對權力，讓所有生命都屈從於你的意志。立即加入願望單！

games.name: 掠宝旅团
games.short_description: Lootbound 是一款黑暗奇幻世界中的戰術類 roguelite 遊戲，包含回合制戰鬥、戰利品管理和 D&D 元素。與危險的敵人戰鬥，收集史詩戰利品，招募盟友並帶領他們踏上冒險之路。

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.short_description: Echoes of Mystralia is an action-heavy spellcrafting ARPG roguelite, where rapid combat meets deep customization. Craft your own spells, unlock new combinations, fight epic bosses, and discover a narrative-rich world that never plays the same twice.

games.name: Scratch the Ticket
games.short_description: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.name: Flock of the Seraphim
games.short_description: 使用持槍修女與天使驅逐惡魔大軍！在這款類Survivors的彈幕天堂中，收集並保留擁有獨特武器、屬性與能力的天使，打造神級Build，抵禦敵人的波次！你的信仰足夠支撐下去嗎？

games.name: Zoominoes
games.short_description: 在數字不斷攀升的 roguelike 牌組製作遊戲中，打造你的終極動物園。尋找強大的神話動物，用點心強化牠們，甚至操控棋盤本身。用瘋狂連擊賺取百萬（甚至更多）分，徹底讓遊戲分數爆表！

games.name: 秘境獵人
games.short_description: 在《秘境獵人》中用重火力碾壓煉獄怪潮！叫上兄弟深入黑暗秘境，滿畫面光柱亮起、神裝塞滿倉庫，在連場血戰中成為傳奇特工組。融合海量天賦與戰術刻印，打造專屬流派的完美閉環！觸發全螢幕彈射的超載電弧清屏，傾瀉無限裂變的爆破彈幕，將深淵怪潮轟成血肉碎末，享受暗金光束撕裂黑暗的瞬間吧！

games.name: 不義轉生
games.short_description: 《不義轉生》是一款將放置成長與橫版清版動作融為一體的2D像素風遊戲。你是主人的爪牙，唯一的使命就是殺戮與收割。撕碎擋路的一切敵人，榨取他們的鮮血、白骨和骨髓，用死亡餵養自己的力量。每一次倒下都是重生的起點，每一次重生都比上一次更加兇殘。

games.name: 我是洞洞王 Hole is Mine
games.short_description: 《我是洞洞王》是一款「群體管理」+「增量冒險」遊戲，帶領小洞丁們深入被詛咒的洞窟，剷除汙穢，強化升級，發現洞窟內隱藏的秘密，不斷壯大村莊，300+升級與500+裝備組合，用超凡力量武裝你的小洞丁，體驗停不下來的增量式成長！

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.short_description: 你破產了，砸碎存錢罐，《賬單必須繳付》。一款短小精悍的主動式放置遊戲。賺錢、升級，擺脫債務！

games.name: Here Comes The Swarm
games.short_description: Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button! Create your strategy, build, manage, and defend your settlements at your own pace. Take the fight to the hive mind and lead expeditions to deliver a deadly blow and eradicate your foes. Will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

games.name: Cult of PiN
games.short_description: 發射、推撞、橫掃千軍！在這款結合了 Roguelike 與牌組構建的彈珠遊戲中大顯身手。從 100 多種升級中進行選擇，打造破壞平衡的強力組合，在被詛咒的球桌上殺出一條血路。完成任務以觸發爆炸性的特殊攻擊，逐個擊破彈射器，拆解整張球桌。

games.name: DUNGEON SLASHER
games.short_description: 探索滿是敵人的地圖，摧毀擋路的所有一切！使用各式各樣的角色、神器與技能組合通過地下城的考驗！

games.name: 放血醫師
games.short_description: 《放血醫師》是一款克蘇魯題材的中世紀卡牌構築遊戲。打造你的專屬卡組，影響村民的各項狀態，保護他們免受邪靈的侵蝕。作為回報，借助村民們獨特的構築能力，強化你的治療手段。願你那些可疑的療法能派上用場！

games.name: 報告長官，獸人有點多
games.short_description: 《報告長官，獸人有點多》是一款增量型塔防遊戲，你將面對數量壓倒性的獸人大軍。用滿滿的子彈、炸彈和雷射來好好招呼牠們吧！

games.name: Sephiria
games.short_description: Save Bunnyville from a doomed fate: a top-down action/RPG roguelite from the makers of Dungreed. Explore the depths of the tower, collect and upgrade artifacts, and defeat hordes of demons to keep your village safe.

games.name: Limitless Survivor
games.short_description: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

games.name: 功夫牌
games.short_description: 【DICE CON 年度最佳國創桌遊】桌面上的功夫對決！《功夫牌》用卡牌演繹中華武學的博大精深：玩法融合撲克、麻將精髓，會玩撲克麻將，一看就懂；見招拆招，後發制人，越玩越深。選擇門派，構築神功，爭奪天下第一！

games.name: Medic: Pacific War
games.short_description: Become a Medic - a true war hero. Survive the brutality of the Pacific Front as bombs rain from above and bullets shred the air. You’re the last chance for your wounded allies. Every decision you make could turn the tide of battle - but none will be easy.

games.name: 風暴怕死隊
games.short_description: 《風暴怕死隊》是一款Roguelite彈幕射擊遊戲。一場魔女之災突然來臨，混沌的魔力化作了風暴之牆，巨大海浪與風暴將主島圍住，沒有任何東西可以穿過它。在風暴之牆內，混沌魔力的侵蝕正在擴散，生靈正在逐漸腐化為怪物。身為獵魔人的你需要想盡一切辦法逃離這座已經變成人間地獄的小島。

games.name: Drone Sector
games.short_description: Drone Sector is a futuristic gunship game. Provide close air support by firing variety of weapons at the enemies and guide your allied troops via commands. Keep your troops alive, complete objectives, collect resources and recruit engineers. Research better weaponry for the gunship and the troops.

games.name: Zombiehood
games.short_description: 一款風格獨特卻又殘酷無情的跑酷射擊類Roguelite遊戲：搜刮武器、裝備與神器，解鎖強大的升級項目，並在機生成生態區中一路殺出重圍，搭配機智的對話與爆發力十足的爽快戰鬥。

games.name: Pathogenic
games.short_description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

games.name: Void Miner – Incremental Asteroids Roguelite
games.short_description: 爆破。收集。升級。重複。 虛空礦工是一款復古風格的隨機挑戰彈幕射擊遊戲：操控飛船並管理自動砲塔，摧毀無盡的隕石場。躲避、射擊並收集，在快速的破壞與進階循環中前進。

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.short_description: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

games.name: Channel 4 Midnight
games.short_description: A bite-sized psychological horror game about a wayward soul who seeks transformation through a sinister ritual.

games.name: castle idler
games.short_description: castle idler is a short, relaxing incremental tower defense game with no waves. upgrade towers, collect coins, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades to defend your castle.

games.name: 背包地牢
games.short_description: 《背包地牢》是一款獨特的像素風背包管理 Roguelike 遊戲。在這裡，你的背包不僅是儲物空間，更是戰鬥的核心——物品的擺放位置、相鄰關係和觸發機制，決定了你在地牢探險中的生死存亡。這不是傳統的角色扮演遊戲，而是一場關於空間規劃與策略組合的智力挑戰。

games.name: 你的痛櫃可以種出女孩嗎？
games.short_description: 玩家將扮演一個穿越到微縮世界中的救世主，在戰鬥和歷練中解救花朵們，一邊保護她們，一邊呵護她們，在危機四伏的幻想世界中，開啟新的後宮生活。

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.short_description: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned – enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: Decktamer
games.short_description: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

games.name: 執政官之魂
games.short_description: 在2D骰子構建Roguelike遊戲《執政官之魂》，你可以替換效果獨特的骰面、符文和骰體，打造出所向披靡的骰子。解鎖豐富法術、配搭強力連攜，一路擊敗絕世勁敵，徹底攻克執政官宮殿。

games.name: The wild darkness
games.short_description: Explore a survival-roguelike RPG set in an unknown and bizarre world. To withstand its many dangers, you'll need to gain new knowledge, scavenge for food, and acquire useful items. Craft, build, and learn your way through a crucial adventure to uncover the world's secrets.

games.name: Worlds Upon The Wind
games.short_description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

games.name: Cataclysm: The Last Generation
games.short_description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike set in modern-day New England. Scavenge tools to craft an arsenal capable of dealing with the ever-evolving hordes of zombies, mutants, aliens, and robots in one of the deepest survival sims around.

games.name: LUCKROT
games.short_description: Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.

games.name: 肉鴿領地：守衛方格
games.short_description: 《肉鴿領地：守衛方格》是一款融合塔防與Roguelike成長的中世紀奇幻遊戲。 在方格世界中建造防禦、管理資源，抵禦不斷進化的敵人。

games.name: 舊日鐵鍋燉主理人
games.short_description: 在《舊日鐵鍋燉主理人》裡拿大鍋亂燉一切吧！你將擔任這間鐵鍋燉的主廚，站在傳說中的宇宙大鐵鍋前，為那些來自宇宙深處的食客燉煮奇異的美食…… 各式食材不斷被放入鍋中，於鐵鍋內瘋狂碰撞、融合，引發難以名狀的詭異反應。

games.name: Don't Let It Starve
games.short_description: A horror roguelike bento-builder. You're trapped in an underground kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster. Gamble with your life, assemble meals, and master your multipliers. Whatever you do, Don't Let it Starve.

games.name: Montabi
games.short_description: 在這款集馴服、收集與對戰於一身的生物收集Roguelike卡牌遊戲中，以獨特的「萌太寶貝」打造最強的隊伍，駕馭牠們的超酷招式、利用牠們的戰略優勢，透過回合制對戰系統拯救這座城市！

games.name: 天臨混元
games.short_description: 上界天人俯瞰眾生,視凡人如螻蟻棋子。而你,一個本不該存在於天命棋譜上的人,將踏入這片仙俠大地,以戰棋之策穿過勢力紛爭與秘境險局。 遊戲重培養構築,海量BD組合帶來燒腦策略深度。 搶先體驗版提供30+小時內容,持續更新至正式版。

games.name: No Mana, Just Dice
games.short_description: 「法力歸零，負債百億。能指望的只有那顆被騙得來的骰子！」 《No Mana, Just Dice》是一款回合制戰術 Roguelike 遊戲，講述了一位身負巨債的吊車尾魔女的生存記。別說施展魔法了，她膽小如鼠，連走一步路都需要靠骰子決定。請助她一臂之力，策略性地將骰子分配給移動和攻擊，扭轉天生厄運，找到那個能實現願望的傳說卷軸！

games.name: Rift Wizard 3
games.short_description: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

games.name: 2 Fights in 2 Tight Spaces
games.short_description: Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves… and this time it’s with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.short_description: 大群敌人即将到来，但你已经做好了战斗准备！召集你的队伍并决定他们的各种增强，以找到对付成千上万不死生物最有效的组合。努力生存，然后进化。然后在这个看似简单但令人上瘾的反转弹雨游戏中打破所有限制。

games.name: 輪回的瓦爾基里
games.short_description: 在《輪回的瓦爾基裡》中，駕駛你的飛船穿梭於無垠宇宙，迎戰無盡敵軍，收集和升級裝備，追尋史詩級戰利品，精進你的技能，掌握強大天賦。在與邪惡勢力的鬥爭中，你將不斷成長，變得更強大，直到能夠扭轉命運，拯救世界！

games.name: Trials Survivors
games.short_description: 在星座主宰設下的試煉中奮戰無盡怪潮！ 升級技能、收集遺物，以正宗肉鴿風格打造超強構築！ 重拾「砍殺」與「彈幕天堂」的幻想魅力。 你能在這款怪物密度爆表的生存類肉鴿遊戲中存活下來嗎？

games.name: 城門血戰
games.short_description: 在這款Rogue動作塔防遊戲之中，世界危在旦夕，魔族步步緊逼，貝爾拉克城門是你和守軍的最後防線。選擇你的英雄，招募追隨者，構建防線，並在戰鬥中獲取資源不斷強化你與隨從，抵抗源源不斷的敵軍和末日Boss！

games.name: Lucky Shot
games.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

games.name: Spellmasons
games.short_description: 《Spellmasons》是一款充滿魔法色彩的戰術類roguelike遊戲，玩家可以自定義自己的魔法。你可以選擇單人遊玩，或是在線上與朋友組隊，並探索深奧的魔法系統，在這裡，巧妙的組合會帶來讓人滿意的強大效果！

games.name: Hellbrella
games.short_description: Put on your raincoat and destroy hordes of demons in Hell. Use 5 insane umbrellas in an aerial roguelite hack and slash of pure chaos!

games.name: Cinderia
games.short_description: Cinderia 是一款極致爽快的 Rogue-lite 動作遊戲！自由組合你所看到的一切——技能、連招、被動、裝備——打造專屬於你的獨特戰鬥風格。黑暗籠罩大地，廢墟之中仍有微光閃爍。

games.name: 生死深潛：雨之子民
games.short_description: 每一次下潛都是致命的賭注。 潛入受詛咒的深淵之中，否則就要面對死亡，直面異界恐怖怪物，揭開黑雨之謎。 搜刮資源，升級裝備，招募夥伴，做好犧牲的準備。 快前去拯救你的營地吧……洪潮即將來臨。

games.name: Starforged Legacy
games.short_description: Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 100+ strategy-defining upgrades, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars or die trying!

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.short_description: Build devastating weapons on the fly in this blend of movement shooter and roguelike action. Sprint, slide, and dash to plunder high-tech vaults. Stack gun upgrades, abilities, and grenades for wild synergies as you survive a spreading infestation.

games.name: 鷹派大統領
games.short_description: 好評如潮的《時空叛客》製作組最新力作！在這款動作肉鴿遊戲中，你將挑戰邪惡的現任總統！白天，建設基地、爭取選票；夜晚，化身西裝暴徒，深入敵後，擊潰犯罪組織，拯救毛茸茸的外星生物。隨心搭配數十種異能與武器，在千變萬化的關卡中構築你的專屬流派！

games.name: 斷神
games.short_description: 《断神》是一款融合了轮回肉鸽与纵向战术的回合制策略RPG。在被泰坦巨兽蹂躏的黑暗奇幻世界中，数位身负神秘印记的英雄将踏上一条注定反复死亡、反复归来的弑神之路。每一次倒下，都是一次新的开始——圣物、技能、同伴，以及你做出的每一个选择，都将在轮回中沉淀为力量，直到你足够强大，斩断神明对这片土地的掌控。

games.name: 穿霧列車 Fogpiercer
games.short_description: 在這款科幻 Roguelike 卡牌遊戲中，你將駕駛列車，利用各式佈陣、連鎖反應與環境，於濃霧中搏命戰鬥。

games.name: Unemployment Simulator 2018
games.short_description: Social welfare survival horror based on real events. Endure emotional pain and societal pressure. Stay entertained. Survive the routine and become the hero of your studio apartment—battle inner demons, hide skeletons in the closet, and most importantly… keep the bathroom clean.

games.name: 非凡仙途
games.short_description: 天命已现，等你来战！独特的碰撞战斗玩法，轻操作、重策略——胜负取决于战前的排兵布阵。你可以自由搭配神将阵容，激活强力羁绊组合，体验从强力击退流到法师爆发流的千变玩法。 齐天大圣、哪吒、关羽、诸葛亮、共工等神话历史名人齐聚。通过多维养成打造神兵、唤醒神器、抓捕山海异兽，全方位提升战力。深入万象幻境探险，或在斗法大会中与天下英杰一决高下。 《非凡仙途》融合中国古典名著与上古传说，既适合休闲放置，也能满足策略钻研的深度需求。即刻踏上仙途，书写你的神话战纪！

games.name: Frog Climb
games.short_description: 🐸Free-To-Play🐸 Stop following someone else's route. Create your own way to the top by building your own path 🐸 Frog Climb is a stylized co-op climbing adventure where you must escape from terrariums 🐸 Level up, gain powerful upgrades, and prove that no wall is too high for a frog with a plan 🐸

games.name: Hive Blight
games.short_description: Hive Blight is a roguelite autobattler where you lead a team of insect warriors against a corrupting Fungal Threat. Build powerful synergies, uncover the source of the plague, and destroy it to save your world!

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.short_description: 身兼無畏的冒險家和精明的商人，體驗雙重身分的生活！涉足生機勃勃的地區，入手貴重戰利品，擊潰強大惡敵。壯大商店，修補武器和各式裝備，在世外荒地的無序聚落成為傳奇人物。

games.name: 掘地求狗
games.short_description: 在這款合作遊戲中勇闖繁複的洞穴，一路往下、挖掘、引爆炸藥，找回走失的愛犬。 途中充滿陷阱和危險，還要面對奪命於無形的重力。和朋友扶持互助，同時當心腳下步伐。 你願意縱身跳下未知地底，拯救狗狗夥伴嗎？

games.name: Hell Maiden
games.short_description: 這是款以但丁《神曲》為靈感的群敵生存牌組構築遊戲：穿越地獄深淵，擊敗最凶暴的惡魔，殺出一條通往天堂的血路。

games.name: Legacy of Defense
games.short_description: 成為保護幻想世界的英雄，阻止怪物入侵！《Legacy of Defense》結合了防禦和卡牌構建元素。構建你的卡組，使用強大的技能，獲取經驗，升級，清除關卡，並擊敗最終Boss。準備好測試你的策略和運氣了嗎？

games.name: Coin Tavern
games.short_description: 《硬幣酒館》可不是間普通的酒館！在這款 roguelike 遊戲中，你將運用各式各樣趣味獨特的硬幣，組建專屬於你的硬幣牌組。在隨機生成的對戰關卡裡，累積硬幣、精進戰略、精簡牌組、解鎖隱藏寶物，還能使出超狂的連招 Combo！

games.name: Whack-A-Monster
games.short_description: Whack-A-Monster。一款關於敲擊、猛砸、飛濺與狠狠「BONK」怪物的增量遊戲。透過技能樹升級並解鎖新武器，消滅這個世界上的所有邪惡。

games.name: 釋厄傳
games.short_description: 《釋厄傳》是一款主打【後西遊都市怪談】的牌組構築式Roguelike！在這個神佛異化的詭異世界裡，利用逆天科技強化牌組，為卡牌打上專屬詞條。搭配 1000+ 海量卡牌與 300+ 法寶，構築屬於你的極致爽局！

games.name: 疊疊高城 Pile Up!
games.short_description: 《疊疊高城》是策略建築遊戲，你必須建造房子，滿足人民的生活所需，並透過不同的方法在小島上管理有危險的建築物。雖然玩起來很休閒，但可別掉以輕心，在你太過放鬆的時候，一不小心就有可能摧毀一切。

games.name: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
games.short_description: 英雄連隊3：Final Stand提供全新的獨立持久戰體驗，無論是獨自一人奔赴前線，還是與好友並肩作戰，都能讓你立刻體驗最純粹的戰鬥快感。

games.name: Serpent's Gaze
games.short_description: 《Serpent’s Gaze》是一款驚險刺激的第三人稱動作遊戲，支援 1 至 4 名玩家合作揭開遠古沙漠深藏的秘密，同時還需面對強悍的敵人及無情的首領。

games.name: 奉魔
games.short_description: "Worship Demon" is a fast 2D survivor with anime xianxia art and dazzling effects. Play a demonic cultivator, explore secret realms, ruins, and seek spells. Survive, beat boss, master Dao, and grow stronger. Each run unlocks new Arts, bonds, talents—forge your own immortal path.

games.name: Tears of Metal
games.short_description: Fight solo or up to 4-player co-op to reclaim your island alongside your Scottish battalion. On each campaign, gain new powerful upgrades, rally your forces, and stop the invader as they carve into the Mother Stone to harvest its power.

games.name: Bonehold
games.short_description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

games.name: 卡牌王國
games.short_description: 你將在這片領土上打造你的終極卡牌王國。從簡陋的小村莊開始，逐步發展成兼顧防禦與進攻的強大王國。手中的卡牌是你發展的重要途徑。構建你的牌組，合理規劃資源，繁榮你的王國。但和平不是一成不變的，你將不斷面臨敵人猛烈的進攻，應對各種各樣的隨機事件，保衛你的人民！

games.name: Delivery & Beyond
games.short_description: No packages? No problem! Break in. Scrap everything. Deliver... A chaotic online co-op game for up to 5 players (or 15 if you really want to)!

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.short_description: 在最多四人玩家的合作遊戲中，組成一支搜尋神祕寶藏的探險者小隊。在這片受詛咒的叢林中，處處危機四伏且恐怖的生物會改變現實。保持清晰的思緒，並趁著叢林吞噬你之前將其馴服……

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.short_description: 在 《Enter the Chronosphere》 這款回合制彈幕地獄與roguelike要素的遊戲中，當你移動時，一切才會隨之運作。每個時空球牢皆由程序生成，內部包含防衛者與被吞噬世界的生態系。闖入其中，找到異域武器與裝備，智取敵對的外星生物，一路戰鬥直到核心。

games.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
games.short_description: 《命運之手：人各有命》是一款黑暗奇幻風格的彈幕天堂自動射擊遊戲，你的牌組構築能力將決定生死。抵禦無盡怪潮，打造強力流派，釋放毀滅性攻擊，逃離第十三道門外的虛空世界，在混沌中崛起！

games.name: 地獄黑傑克 Black Jacket
games.short_description: 一款以二十一點規則為核心的卡牌構築遊戲。 在冥界與徘徊的亡魂對局二十一點，打造你的牌組、覺醒卡牌、蒐集神器，與背負過往的靈魂一決勝負。 揭開彼此糾纏的過去，贏取靈魂硬幣，賄賂擺渡人——逃離這場永無止境的惡夢。

games.name: Welcome to the Game III
games.short_description: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

games.name: Prologue: Go Wayback!
games.short_description: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent survival roguelike where every journey is unique. Traverse a new wilderness that is generated for you every time you play. Chart your path, overcome the elements, and write your own story of exploration.

games.name: Katanaut
games.short_description: 《Katanaut》是一款節奏明快的動作Roguelike遊戲，融合行雲流水般的戰鬥與宇宙恐怖元素。揮刀斬擊、靈巧閃避，施展強大技能殺出一條血路。唯有隨境應變、在夾縫中求生，並深入幽暗深處，方能揭開那最深沉的黑暗祕密。

games.name: Blood Vial
games.short_description: BLOOD VIAL is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.

games.name: TypInc.
games.short_description: Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game. Type the paragraphs presented to you and maintain your streak to survive and win the game.

games.name: KAZ
games.short_description: Dopamine-fueled minimalist grid-based game that pushes the boundaries of psychedelic visuals and fast reaction time. KAZ is an action roguelike arcade game where choice of items, buffs, and maluses allows you to unlock cool visuals and themes while showing everybody your skill on the leaderboards

games.name: Genome Guardian 2
games.short_description: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: EXE.CUTOR
games.short_description: EXE.CUTOR is a game where you place data blocks to complete lines. Acquire various equipment and enhance your data blocks to build stronger lines and defeat virus hosts infesting cyberspace!

games.name: 劫后公司
games.short_description: 殭屍末日後，你能重建文明嗎？Plague Inc. 創作者帶來融合策略模擬、生存城市建造與「迷你 4X」的獨特體驗。建立末日後定居點、收集資源並塑造社會，帶領人類走出黑暗。

games.name: Siegeturtle
games.short_description: 升級你的海龜，招募獨角獸、巨魷魚、水獺等可愛動物，在這款放置類肉鴿自動戰鬥遊戲中橫掃一波又一波的敵人！每次都能游得更遠，解鎖新的技能，隨著實力增強，一步步靠近家園。

games.name: 忘卻前夜
games.short_description: 《忘卻前夜》是一款克蘇魯題材改編的Roguelite卡牌構築遊戲。你可以構建靈活而豐富的專屬牌組，自由選擇爬塔或是對戰，與瘋狂邊緣的人形武器一起，在迷霧地圖與詭異事件之間，調查這世界正在死去的真相。

games.name: Soulbound: Online
games.short_description: Soulbound is a pixel-art action roguelite with an MMORPG overworld. Run fast-paced bullet-heaven dungeons solo or in 3-player co-op, raid bosses, craft gear from your loot, and build out your personal base. Join thousands of players in the quest to explore, trade, and build a new world.

games.name: Turnbound - 武裝博弈
games.short_description: 刀槍棍棒在手，披掛兜鍪加身，十八般武藝盡出；符文層層疊疊，聖物各司其職，傳奇英雄列陣在旁，勝負盡在你的一次次擺放之間。在這裡武器、護甲、站位交織成一套嚴密的戰鬥體系，你的策略與巧思才是致勝關鍵。挑選一位英雄，統御你的武裝，踏入這場自走棋博弈吧！

games.name: The Greenening
games.short_description: 展開短暫但充實的漸進式旅程，探索並喚醒一個被遺忘的世界。沖掉塵埃，探索暗藏起來的祕密，升級多功能澆水能力，培育屬於你的溫馨太空花園。

games.name: Dungeon Divers
games.short_description: Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed roguelike puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash.

games.name: The Backrooms Deluxe 2
games.short_description: A roguelite multiplayer Backrooms game that bases itself on The Backrooms Deluxe's levels and expands on the mechanics, levels, networking and enemy AI.

games.name: 黑夜輪迴 Re:Night
games.short_description: 《黑夜輪迴》是一款將戰棋與肉鴿卡牌深度融合的策略遊戲。在每一次冒險中，逐步構築自己的牌組，規劃豐富的戰棋戰術，體驗任意三名角色交織而成的多種流派。來這座小鎮，親手終結黑夜的輪迴，讓晨光重現大地！

games.name: 摸猫猫
games.short_description: 《摸猫猫》是一款彈幕射擊遊戲，透過撫摸可愛的貓咪來釋放強大攻擊！在一波又一波敵人的挑戰中，利用食物、道具與武器，將你的喵咪培養成無比強大的存在！

games.name: Dawg Game
games.short_description: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure about what Maksim does off-stream. Step into the life of a streamer: handle important tasks, take care of yourself, and try to finally go live!

games.name: CRACKED
games.short_description: 基於物理的法師亂鬥！在《CRACKED》中，玻璃頭法師們於混亂的 1v1 到 4v4 戰鬥中展開對決。挑選離譜升級，釋放狂野法術，在這款 3D Roguelike PvP 競技場中粉碎對手。

games.name: 魔女：終末旅途
games.short_description: 深淵已然腐壞，象徵終焉的魔女們將在奧爾德林甦醒。她們是姿態萬千的末路之花，而你，將執掌每位魔女的命運軌跡，以卡組構築無限可能。創造屬於你獨一無二的卡牌，自訂魔女們的日程，在策略交鋒的戰場中，體驗每一次博弈與戰鬥。

games.name: Silly Survivors
games.short_description: Silly Survivors - a casual roguelike where you play as an adorable furry fox, armed with… a flashlight! Survive waves of suspiciously silly ghosts who keep trying to get close (and pull some kind of silly stuff). Light is your main weapon.

games.name: 隱名三國
games.short_description: 三國戰略遊戲該有的一切，這裏都有。但武將化名的玩法，只有這裏有！玩點不一樣的三國戰略模擬遊戲！如果三國群英都隱去了真名與數值。你還能認出誰是諸葛亮嗎？

games.name: Descenders Next
games.short_description: 整裝待發，征服高山！《Descenders Next》是屬於極限運動的終極冒險。蜿蜒的高聳雪峰、崎嶇的泥濘賽道、數不勝數的公園地形……準備好了嗎？快來和朋友們共同成為新一代下坡競速王者！

games.name: Granvir
games.short_description: Granvir 是一款第三人稱動作肉鴿機甲建造遊戲，支援合作多人模式。玩家需要在戰場上搜尋零件，用來替換和升級你的 Granvir 及武器。駕駛你的 Granvir，在戰鬥之間管理戰役，尋找最優裝備並保持補給，在游擊戰中堅持作戰。

games.name: 永恆圍城：無盡紀元
games.short_description: 退路已盡。守護巴斯提昂，對抗邪惡獸群、奪回失落力量、重建遠古遺跡，臨機應變調整戰術來扭轉重圍之勢。在這款結合英雄策略與輕度Rogue要素的遊戲當中，可以單人遊玩，或最多三人合作遊玩，打造屬於你的戰鬥風格。

games.name: Wireworks
games.short_description: Design your defenses, build your module board, and manage your wires. Combine signals and create synergies to empower your weapons and survive in this base-defense roguelike auto-battler.

games.name: Final War: Frozen Defense
games.short_description: Strategy Tower Defense, RTS Battles on the World Map

games.name: 生存代碼
games.short_description: 當代碼邏輯成為決定生死的終極武器，你能否生存到最後？你可以利用超過 300 種不同的模塊自定義專屬技能，在隨機生成的虛擬戰場中，用代碼構築防線、撕裂敵人、解鎖無限可能！從新手到編程大師，每個人都能在這場賽博狂歡中創造屬於自己的生存代碼！

games.name: 沙灘防線：殭屍來襲
games.short_description: 指揮士兵，抵擋一波又一波的殭屍攻擊！ 一款輕鬆策略的 回合制即時策略 遊戲，融合 彈幕射擊 與 背包like 玩法。 在有限的背包格子中合理搭配士兵，形成最強火力陣容。 挑戰多個 難度等級，不斷解鎖與升級士兵，擊退屍潮，守衛最後的海島防線。 適合喜歡 塔防、倖存者like 和輕度 Roguelite 的玩家，每局10-15分鐘，輕鬆又上頭！

games.name: 踢踢地牢
games.short_description: Roguelike 遊戲與足球的結合！探索這個奇特的像素畫地下世界，在每一個充滿危險生物站點生存，並在每一場遭遇戰之後升級你的致命球組。建立組合效應，整合升級晶片到你的球組，然後再次出擊！最後一站會有什麼在等你？

games.name: 飢餓怪物 (Hungry Horrors)
games.short_description: 飢餓怪物（Hungry Horrors）是一款受英國與愛爾蘭民間傳說啟發的卡牌冒險遊戲。它結合了卡組構築與烹飪，並融入敘事與永久性的類 Roguelite 成長系統。你不是去殺死傳奇怪物，而是餵飽牠們，滿足牠們的口味，否則你就會成為下一道菜。

games.name: DROP - System Breach
games.short_description: Welcome to DROP, a fast-paced action-strategy hacking simulator. Ready to hack your way to fame and fortune while avoiding getting caught? Use stealth and cunning to maneuver between the ongoing power struggle of corporations and factions to control the fragmented networks in the city.

games.name: InKing
games.short_description: is a fast-paced 2D top-down action game. Players take on the role of an ink bottle warrior on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way, prove that ink and pen are the best tools, and become the King of Tools.

games.name: 魔幻機甲
games.short_description: 在《魔幻機甲》化身为奇幻機甲，於 PSX 復古美學與叢林氛圍配樂之中，展開一場暢快的單人倖存者挑戰！直面一波波強敵，自由解鎖武器、搭配特性與技能，打造專屬於你的戰鬥 Combo，在 20 分鐘的速爽闖關體驗裡，迸發絕佳戰力，擊潰所有來襲的敵人！

games.name: Dead Weight
games.short_description: Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

games.name: Duncrush
games.short_description: Duncrush是一款點擊RPG，通過點擊消滅怪物並攻略各種地下城。收集金幣、武器、盾牌和飾品，強化你的角色，並通過技能樹打造專屬策略。挑戰更強大的敵人，征服各種地下城吧！

games.name: Quasimorph
games.short_description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based cyberpunk RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

games.name: TerraTech Legion
games.short_description: TerraTech Legion, a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Build the ultimate battle vehicle block by block and survive waves of robotic foes, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

games.name: Outhold
games.short_description: 《Outhold》是一款短小且具策略性的增量遊戲，結合了塔防策略與深度元進程。於龐大的技能樹中闢出道路，解鎖強力升級，守護你的據點對抗無盡敵潮。

games.name: Gambonanza
games.short_description: Gambonanza is a tactical roguelike that sets chess pieces on a tiny board. Forget traditional chess and embrace the chaos of breaking the balance! Spend your money on rule-bending upgrades, board tiles and pieces. Experiment with illegal combinations and face off against iconic bosses!

games.name: Knights End
games.short_description: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?

games.name: Bullet Bunny
games.short_description: Bullet Bunny is a twin-stick shooter with rogue-like elements. Fend off an onslaught of enemies, level up, and create unique builds every run while trying to survive 500 seconds!

games.name: Titanium Court
games.short_description: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

games.name: 我的英雄旅團
games.short_description: 在艾爾法爾這片劍與魔法的奇幻大陸上，你將扮演一名探索者，組建並發展自己的公會，帶領成員接取任務、挑戰副本、鍛造裝備、參與競技，逐步揭開九大聖地的秘密。遊戲融合了策略養成、Roguelike元素，公會競技團戰等多種要素，不容錯過

games.name: 忍者龜：史林特的命運
games.short_description: 踏上一場 Roguelike 冒險，釋放忍者龜力量，救出被腳族俘虜的史林特！精通忍技，進行刺激好玩的合作遊戲，征服紐約市各大著名景點。

games.name: Super Cabbage Kabumi
games.short_description: The roguelike all about bonking cabbages! Make incredible builds with a vast array of items, wield powerful weapons, change the game entirely with pets, fight fantastical bosses, and so much more!

games.name: 聖火守望者：共築防線
games.short_description: 迎擊鋪天蓋地的敵潮，築起鋼鐵防線！在《聖火守望者：共築防線》滿屏怪物的圍攻下，一邊瘋狂輸出，一邊即時建造塔樓、圍牆與防禦設施。搜刮隨機神器，強化武器與英雄配置，死守競技場中央的信標——只要信標未滅，戰鬥永不停歇！支持單人遊玩，亦可2-4人熱血聯機。

games.name: 墜落：金屬女僕救世錄
games.short_description: 你將在這個程式生成的創新挖礦生存肉鴿遊戲裡，自由挖礦、收集補給、策略性地建造移動基地，打造專屬砲塔和工具，抵禦危機重重的地下生態環境中不斷來襲的神秘生物，抵達地心，重塑世界並揭露真相！記住，你必須運用你的智慧和策略，才能在這片危險的地下環境中存活！

games.name: Archons
games.short_description: Archons是一款Roguelite/生存遊戲，你將控制兩個角色，Archons。用不同的武器升級他們，以消滅成群的寄生蟲和巨型頭目。自定義升級以打造獨特的遊戲風格。

games.name: Inventorix
games.short_description: 《INVENTORIX 天財方陣》是一款結合庫存管理與卡牌構築的 Roguelike 賺錢遊戲。你必須巧妙排列物品，結合外星人的技能，創造天文數字的財富，償還神秘的太空債務！

games.name: 雷霆戰車：鋼鐵防線
games.short_description: 一款末世廢土策略射擊，融合背包like、彈幕射擊與戰車養成的輕鬆策略遊戲！ 駕駛戰車，闖蕩末世廢土！《雷霆戰車：鋼鐵防線》是一款輕鬆策略的掛機射擊遊戲，融合彈幕射擊與背包like玩法。你將駕駛戰車穿越後現代廢土，挑戰20個難度等級，收集武器碎片，解鎖13種特色武器（機槍、噴火槍、火箭、重炮、電擊塔、激光炮等），在有限的格子中合理搭配，打造最強火力陣容。打不過？沒關係！積累資源、抽取裝備、購買金幣，輕鬆掛機也能變強。策略搭配+爽快彈幕+休閒掛機，一場屬於戰車愛好者的末世冒險等你開啟！

games.name: Entropy Survivors
games.short_description: 《Entropy Survivors》是一款子彈天堂的 Roguelike 遊戲，你將同時操控強大的機甲和神槍手太空青蛙這兩個角色。遊戲中擁有各種可客製化的強大武器及充滿創意的能力供你使用。快來開啟單人模式或 2-4 人線上合作模式，拯救宇宙吧！

games.name: Coal LLC
games.short_description: Fill your quota or die. Mine increasingly absurd amounts of coal using some dubious, but effective, mining techniques. Or relax and mine at your own pace in peaceful mode.

games.name: SULFUR
games.short_description: SULFUR is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

games.name: Dark Light: Survivor
games.short_description: Dark Light: Survivor is a dark sci-fi action roguelike with ARPG loot and third-person shooter combat. Switch anytime between top-down view and TPS aiming as you build weapons, skills, and classes across brutal multiverse runs.

games.name: 地府有點忙
games.short_description: 《地府有點忙》是一款荒誕又上頭的動作肉鴿遊戲。你是個小有點道行的幽界鬼差，本該風光無限，誰知冥司生變，為保住飯碗，你只得一頭扎進陰曹地府，在群魔圍獵中殺出重圍。自由搭配技能與命石，化身無情的惡魂收割機；於無盡輪迴中抽絲剝繭，可一個更大的驚天陰謀，正悄然浮出水面……

games.name: 神之軍火
games.short_description: 裝備整齊，你將伴隨著金屬樂在這款俯視角 Rougelite 射擊遊戲中開啟一場史詩級的地獄之戰！最多同時裝備五種武器，通過升級與融合追求極致的火力，打造所向披靡的組合。快來化身神的正義，拯救瀕臨混亂的世界！

games.name: 零秒
games.short_description: 你是否曾想像過將時間停止是什麼感覺？《零秒》是一款融合時間策略的 Roguelike 刷寶遊戲。在極限戰局中，凍結時間、穿梭彈幕、狂飆數值。運用停止時間的能力高效戰鬥，衝向巔峰！

games.name: Kritter: Defend Together
games.short_description: 探索、搜刮，并迅速返回防御你的飞船，抵御成群的外星人。支持单人或最多4人合作，在这款节奏紧张的动作类Roguelite游戏中一局比一局更强，并融合塔防元素。

games.name: Ostranauts
games.short_description: 《星際漂流者》是一款黑色風格的硬核太空模擬遊戲。精心規劃太空飛船上的生活策略，謹記每個決定背後的代價。在飛船殘骸中搜尋與探索寶藏。設計和打造屬於你的飛船。僱傭船員來協助你，不過，千萬別忘了——唯有死亡和稅收無可避免。

games.name: Stellar Orphans
games.short_description: "Explore 'Stellar Orphans', a captivating deck-building game where every choice determines the fate of your crew lost in infinite space. Forge alliances, manage resources, and resolve crises to guide your 'Stellar Orphans' to survival. Ready to defy the stars?"

games.name: Pirate Ships
games.short_description: Pirate Ships是一款主打造船与战斗的PvP游戏。 揚帆啟航，踏上海盜的冒險旅程！與其他玩家一同探索浩瀚海域，對抗怪物、海盜與竊賊，成為統御七海的傳奇海盜王。

games.name: DRAPLINE
games.short_description: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

games.name: Graveyard Gunslingers
games.short_description: 在彈幕地獄式的幽靈迷宮競技場中射殺成群的殭屍。白天，收集資源，解鎖地圖區域，並準備迎接即將到來的夜晚。通過組合角色、武器，以及探索龐大的能力樹來打造獨特的策略。

games.name: Scritchy Scratchy
games.short_description: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

games.name: Eternal Afternoon
games.short_description: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.

games.name: Balantica
games.short_description: Safely guide the twins to the altar. The path to the altar branches into multiple routes, each filled with trials and unexpected events awaiting the twins. As their companion, you will choose their path, build a deck of cards to give hope and overcome increasingly challenging trials.

games.name: Hold The Mine
games.short_description: 在這款創新的類Rogue生存遊戲，你可以探索與防守礦坑，對抗一波波來襲的怪物！蒐集與管理資源，解鎖具備獨特效果的建築、派遣驍勇英雄來守護陣地，讓礦坑在旭日升起前不被怪物攻破。

games.name: The Red Lantern
games.short_description: The Red Lantern is a narrative, dog sledding game about survival. You play as the Musher who, along with her team of 5 sled dogs, must find her way home. Care for your dogs, discover their stories, and learn how to navigate the unknowns of the Alaskan wilderness and prepare for your new life.

games.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
games.short_description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

games.name: Right and Down
games.short_description: 兩個按鍵就能玩的肉鴿（Roguelike）卡牌遊戲：《Right and Down》！選擇你的英雄，探索隨機生成的卡牌地牢, 收集強力神器以獲得新技能，並對抗強大的敵人！你能到達第50層嗎?

games.name: Conquest Dark
games.short_description: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.

games.name: 失落國度：絕境求生
games.short_description: 《Stolen Realm Survivors》是一款多人合作的生存類自動射擊線上遊戲。對抗大量凶猛的敵人、探索古代遺跡、融合獨特的技能樹，並解鎖強大的升級，保住自己的小命。徹底駕馭 Stolen Realm 的力量和魔法吧。獨自暢玩，或是呼朋引伴，對抗無情的敵方爪牙！

games.name: Pawns of War
games.short_description: Dark parallel world in which humanity has destroyed itself. And only small colonies have survived the last centuries holding on to power at the expense of the totalitarian regime of government. You were thrown here after your death, is this how you were given a second chance?

games.name: Abyss The Forgotten Past: Prologue
games.short_description: Play as Leonnor who sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past and his world, things are not always what they seem! Learn special abilities, battle monsters and encounter celestial beings as you explore this beautifically crafted pixel world. This prologue starts a epic journey...

games.name: Pip My Dice
games.short_description: Pip My Dice is a Yahtzee Roguelike experience. Score enough to make it to the next level, customize your dice to score more and collect relics to create unlimited combos! Collect money through the rounds to buy new dice, relics, and customizers to upgrade your dice. Enjoy a different run every time!

games.name: Incrempire
games.short_description: Defend. Upgrade. Dominate. A relaxing incremental base-defense game, packed with powerful skills and a deep skill tree.

games.name: Deep Snake
games.short_description: 非歐幾何貪吃蛇，你可以永遠深入虛空... ...如果你夠厲害，還能登上每日排行榜。

games.name: 絕妄戰記
games.short_description: 《絕妄戰記》是一款極致爽快的下落式Rougelike卡牌遊戲。你被困在一場致命的遊戲中，一旦失敗就會淪為虛妄女神的玩偶。你擁有無限輪迴的能力，能否到達命運的終局？

games.name: 868-BACK
games.short_description: 868-BACK is a computer-hacking strategy roguelike game where your mission is to dismantle capitalism one server at a time! Use hacking powers to fight enemies, steal the servers' data, and face increasingly nasty situations before being disconnected (again!) by the richest corporations on earth.

games.name: Rogue Factory
games.short_description: The AUTOMATION bullet heaven! Build your custom spellcasting factory and tear through endless waves of monsters. Unlock 20+ characters and 100+ golden totems to craft broken roguelite synergies and survive the swarm! Build, automate, autocast, OBLITERATE!

games.name: AFTERBLAST
games.short_description: AFTERBLAST 是一款具有挑戰性的 FPS Rogue-lite 動作遊戲。你可以單人遊玩或與夥伴一起合作。遊戲具有動態的隨機生成地牢玩法。獲取強大的能力與武器，尋找拯救星球的方法。挺身對抗眾神並擊敗成群的怪物。

games.name: 爱、互聯網、殺人魔法
games.short_description: 《爱、互聯網、殺人魔法》是一款Roguelike養成遊戲。你將作為某個因謀殺去世的主播的經紀人，通過人工智能技術在互聯網世界「復活」她。成為獨一無二的互聯網生物，獲得越來越多的愛，來揭露所謂「謀殺」的真相。

games.name: Gobby McGobblenutz Presents: The Art of the Dad Joke: Chapter 1
games.short_description: Gobby McGobblenutz is just your run of the mill Goblin trying to make some friends in a dark, lonely world... Will you be his friend? Or will his cringe-inducing jokes push you too far over the edge? Come find out on The Art of the Dad Joke!

games.name: 潘朵拉的玩具盒
games.short_description: 《潘朵拉的玩具盒》是一款快節奏、高耐玩度的上帝模擬沙盒遊戲。化身埃庇米修斯，在隨機生成的像素大陸上創造並引導人類文明的發展。見證從聚落到城邦的演變，抵禦異教徒的侵擾，傳播自己的信仰，打造輝煌的文明。

games.name: 我不是魔王
games.short_description: 《我不是魔王》是一款Roguelike彈幕射擊遊戲。遊戲時，你將扮演被魔王附身的冒險者，在旅途中激烈對戰，消滅鋪天蓋地的敵人。不同遊戲機制組合會產生奇妙的化學反應，而每一局的戰鬥體驗也將完全不同！拯救“同胞”？消滅“異類”？是善？是惡？僅在一念之間...

games.name: 金屬雷霆 (Metal Thunder)
games.short_description: 在高刺激的動作遊戲中指揮傳奇炮艇！在瞬息萬變的任務中，以毀滅性的火力與叛軍交火。升級您的武器庫、適應動態挑戰，並在無情的敵人浪潮中生存。每次行動都會提供新的戰術和混亂，讓您稱霸天空。

games.name: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss
games.short_description: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss is a small scale, mechanics driven CRPG/Roguelike in a retro, monochromatic style, that takes place in the underworld of H.P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands.

games.name: Cartapli : Fold Quest
games.short_description: 《Cartapli: fold Quest》是一款結合了策略 Roguelike 與獨特摺紙解謎的回合制戰鬥遊戲。親手摺疊紙張改變位置，消滅所有敵人！

games.name: Remains
games.short_description: 《Remains》是一款結合了平臺跳躍、2D 射擊和類 Rogue 遊戲玩法，並融入 RPG 元素的硬核遊戲。在末日後的世界中旅行，探索各個角落，與當地人交流並幫助他們，升級自身，並使用豐富的武器與魔法武裝自己，與敵人戰鬥。

games.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
games.short_description: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

games.name: Celtic Heroes
games.short_description: Enter Dal Riata, a world inspired by Celtic mythology. Choose your class, build your character, complete quests, join a clan, and take on bosses and raids with other players in this classic open-world MMORPG.

games.name: 黃金礦工:經典版
games.short_description: 《黃金礦工：經典版》是一款經典的街機採礦遊戲，挖掘黃金，收集寶藏，躲避危險，在多種模式與關卡中升級裝備。

games.name: Pluto
games.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cast elemental spells, outwit monstrous foes, and escape prison on your way to your niece’s birthday party.

games.name: Feastopia
games.short_description: Feastopia is a Rogue-lite culinary city-builder, inspired by Against the Storm. Forge a pact with an adorable deity and build a thriving foodie metropolis in a bountiful land. With randomized maps and events, unlock hundreds of wondrous abilities, experience a unique adventure every time you play.

games.name: ODDCORE
games.short_description: You have only 5 minutes to stylishly explode your way through the hordes of corrupted entities in a retro FPS, roguelike liminal-nightmare... and Timmee is here to help!

games.name: Iron Mandate
games.short_description: A steampunk roguelike with a unique fighting mechanic. Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne.

games.name: ARSONATE
games.short_description: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

games.name: Sculplings
games.short_description: A creature-collecting roguelike where every monster is sculpted in real clay and brought to life! Collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion!

games.name: 符文之骰
games.short_description: 短時戰術構築。投擲骰子，創造魔法連鎖反應。從具有獨特技能的不同英雄職業中選擇。在骰子、聖物和符文之間建立協同效應，擊敗挑戰性Boss。

games.name: Frostrain 2
games.short_description: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.short_description: 踏上一場危機重重的血戰之旅：在子彈狂飆的末日夢魘中搜刮、射爆、輾壓屍潮。從站點殺到站點，為巴士補充燃料，逃出生天。將新戰利品完美塞進背包格，享受那瞬間的物品欄管理快感吧。

games.name: The Ember Guardian
games.short_description: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

games.name: Malys
games.short_description: Expose, endure and expel evil from innocents on your hunt through a corrupted city. As Noah, former priest turned demon-hunter, you'll perform exorcisms, forge precarious alliances and strengthen your deck of arcane tricks in this unholy roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: 佩布爾騎士
games.short_description: 喂，王國正在被真菌侵蝕……就這樣放任不管了嗎？ 搖上四個好友。是時候組成五人小隊，一起將真菌大軍碾過去了。 ……沒朋友？沒事，當個孤狼玩家也可以。AI兄弟會罩著你的。

games.name: Pronoun Palace
games.short_description: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

games.name: WAR RATS: The Rat em Up
games.short_description: The rats told me to make this game. Run and gun alongside your troops in the Great Rat War against the vile TechnoRat armies. Recruit units, build structures, collect gear and upgrade your weapons to turn the tide of battle in your favor. The TechnoRat is all consuming!

games.name: 紡織者之詠
games.short_description: 在命運交錯之地中，以少女之聲為織軸，編織屬於你的命運。 精美細膩的角色立繪、充滿魄力的戰鬥演出，以及自由度極高的構築玩法，讓每一次冒險都能誕生截然不同的戰術與體驗。 踏入這個危險的渦源之地，打造專屬於你的最強牌組吧。

games.name: 萬物皆可蟹：動物演化Roguelite遊戲 | Everything is Crab
games.short_description: 動物演化Roguelite遊戲 狩獵、逃亡、覓食，並在生生不息的生態圈中發展成長。有超過125種進化及專精選項，讓你在每回合中挑選、創造各種獨特的組合。為了生存，適應環境來打破蟹化理論……又或者是在嘗試的過程中，被達爾文宣告淘汰！

games.name: Last Group Out
games.short_description: Team up, gear up, and make it out alive in this 2D co-op extraction shooter.

games.name: 輪迴保險公司 R.I.P.
games.short_description: 歡迎入職輪迴保險公司！這是一款融合了暗黑式打寶與類倖存者割草的俯視角Roguelite射擊爽作。作為公司專員，你要面對同屏海量殭屍潮，利用主神科技和傳奇槍械把它們超度成渣，賺取業績，打造你的無限OP流派。下班打卡，再死再厲！

games.name: HELLBREAK
games.short_description: HELLBREAK is a fast-paced roguelite, survivor-like FPS where you fight through escalating waves in brutal arenas in Hell. Build powerful loadouts, earn favor from demon lords to unlock new gear, and climb the leaderboards for your salvation.

games.name: Drifter Star: Evolution
games.short_description: 從一粒星塵，到吞噬萬物的宇宙主宰。在這款前所未有的宇宙吞噬進化遊戲中，您將親歷從小隕石到龐大星系的生命週期。每一次吞噬，都是一次成長；每一次進化，都是一次抉擇。宇宙的終極奧秘，正等待您來揭開。

games.name: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't
games.short_description: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

games.name: Utopia Must Fall
games.short_description: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.

games.name: Aestheta
games.short_description: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!

games.name: Dr. COG
games.short_description: Dr. Cog 是一款使用齒輪建構牌組的 Roguelike 遊戲。操作記憶恢復機器，轉動齒輪，發現和增強它們，並建立協同效應。限時內完成記憶恢復，恢復委託人失去的記憶，到達最終章。

games.name: The First Million
games.short_description: An incremental deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make THE FIRST MILLION — and then many more!

games.name: Backrooms Society
games.short_description: Backrooms Society is a 1-8 player co-op horror game. Make your way through unique levels of the backrooms while trying to survive and avoid mysterious entities. Scavenge each level for gear and resources, bring it back to The Hub where you can sell valuables and buy/craft new gear.

games.name: SkyShard: City Battler
games.short_description: City Building Auto Battler! Build your kingdom with powerful weapons, walls, houses, and endless synergies, then battle other players in asynchronous multiplayer, or overcome various solo challenges.

games.name: 你懂的钻头 You Know The Drill
games.short_description: 一款令人放鬆的漸進式採礦遊戲，玩家需在地下挖掘以採集礦石。收集資源並用來升級鑽頭，進而深入地底！

games.name: 菜園無雙
games.short_description: 真正的「割草」爽游！在這款快節奏的增量遊戲中，體驗最純粹的解壓快感。每局僅需十幾秒，從手動揮砍到機械化收割，利用技能構築收割流派。每一次開局都是指數級的變強，享受滿屏作物瞬間灰飛煙滅的視覺盛宴，追求數值爆炸的極致樂趣！

games.name: 無盡礦山
games.short_description: 全自動暴擊勇者正在殺穿整座礦山！成爲超強狐狸勇者爆殺魔物，無需繁瑣死板的微操，只需輕鬆指引方向，打怪升級，奪取寶藏，享受傷害成倍飆升的極致快感！更能全自動戰鬥開採，全屏暴擊，金幣暴漲！在這場永無止境的遠征中，用無限成長的數值征服整座礦洞！

games.name: Death or Glory
games.short_description: Death or Glory: the ultimate duelling card game! Explore exciting realms that are the proving grounds for heavenly warriors, mighty beasts, powerful mechs, and more. Build your champion deck in a roguelike adventure mode and score ranks in intense battles against fellow champions!

games.name: 波斯王子之重生者
games.short_description: 在这款充满挑战的快节奏肉鸽游戏中，每一次死亡都是改写命运、拯救波斯的独特机会——不成功，便成仁。掌握特技般的流畅战斗和跑酷技巧，探索你的王国，弥补自己犯下的错误！

games.name: Power Fantasy
games.short_description: Survive hordes of blood hungry enemies and hope for the best upgrades while you level up! Power Fantasy is a fresh rogue-survivors-like with unique heroes and tons of customization.

games.name: Trolddom
games.short_description: An old-school 2D fantasy open world MMORPG featuring character progression, classes, monsters, quests, guilds, dungeons, epic loot, achievements, procedural world generation, player-versus-player combat, and much more.

games.name: Tabletop Tavern
games.short_description: 招募一支狂野的戰士軍團，在混亂的桌上戰場上指揮你的傭兵。憑藉無限構築、殘酷抉擇與無盡重玩價值，Tabletop Tavern 是為 roguelike 愛好者打造的 RTS。

games.name: Ampersat
games.short_description: A shooty, slashy, RPG-y game mixing retro and modern sensibilities. A blend of influences from Gauntlet & Smash TV to Zelda & Angband, Ampersat is a handcrafted adventure but with appeal to Roguelite fans. Battle ASCII creatures in colorful areas & free letters to return language to the village!

games.name: 國王的新牌
games.short_description: 聽著！朕乃這四海之內的無上霸主，特此頒布此诏令，召集天下前來體驗朕的偉大統治！這不僅是壹款遊戲，更是朕展示王權與戰爭藝術的絕佳舞台，戰場既是吾輩之牌局，朕才是永遠的贏家！爾等若不速速加入，便是對朕威嚴的公然挑釁，後果自負——朕可不介意派出壹支“小型圍攻隊”拜訪爾等陋室！

games.name: Tankenstein
games.short_description: Tankenstein is a 3rd person ARPG where the player controls a dishevelled tank in a post apocalyptic wasteland looking for new parts to survive and upgrade itself. All of the other tanks in the scrapyard have the same goal, which makes them hostile in this survival of the fittest arena.

games.name: 自走騎士團
games.short_description: 《自走騎士團》是一款創新PVP自走棋競技遊戲！在3x3的微型戰場中，您將招募擁有獨特技能的像素騎士，透過智慧佈局與角色升級打造無敵陣容，找到屬於自己的戰術流派！記住，每場戰鬥都是千變萬化的策略考驗！快來加入這場策略博弈的盛宴吧！

games.name: Cropdeck
games.short_description: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome.

games.name: 死域 Rogue
games.short_description: 《死域 Rogue》是一款以太空為背景的類Rogue第一人稱射擊遊戲。衝破成群的敵對機器，組合強力增幅和元素打造你的專屬構築，並在每一局中不斷變強——無論是單人還是合作模式。

games.name: Prime Monster
games.short_description: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Beyond Words
games.short_description: 由一手打造《GoldenEye》與《TimeSplitters》的頂尖團隊傾力巨獻，《Beyond Words》這款遊戲可說是重新定義了遊戲類型，它巧妙融合了Roguelike策略元素與文字構築玩法。玩家在遊戲中能打造威力強大的連招組合、解鎖各式升級，一步步征服這項每一步都得靠逐字拼寫才能贏得勝利的超燃挑戰！

games.name: White Knuckle
games.short_description: White Knuckle is a first-person roguelite speed-climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will bring you out from under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Dogpile
games.short_description: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.short_description: The future is in flames, overrun by ruthless machines—but you’re built to fight back. Roboquest VR is a lightning-fast roguelite FPS where speed, firepower, and reflexes are your best weapons. Adapt, survive, and reboot the future!

games.name: 不寐之境:女巫與魔咒
games.short_description: 與一頂被詛咒的帽子，踏入一場類銀河戰士惡魔城 × Roguelite玩法的奇幻冒險。你可以巧妙運用多種魔法，驅使附身的敵人清剿障礙，一路向地底深處前進！將戰利品帶回村莊，建設新設施、經營你的生活據點、強化自身能力，一切都能幫助你迎接下一次挑戰！遊戲支持最多4人連線。

games.name: Idle Dice 2
games.short_description: Roll Dice, Draw Cards, Get Points

games.name: 元素與構築
games.short_description: 《元素與構築》是一款2D俯視角遊戲，在不同元素的技能中組成你的專屬流派，在隨機生成式的關卡中使用建築獎勵來搭建自己獨一無二的迷宮，在一波波怪物潮水中努力生存下去，獲得勝利

games.name: 红蓝抉择
games.short_description: 紅色還是藍色？你的選擇決定生死

games.name: Lhama Clicker Prologue
games.short_description: Lhama Clicker is a clicker game about reproduce an infinitly amount of lhamas, to increase your production to ridiculous numbers

games.name: Achilles: Survivor
games.short_description: 成千上萬的敵人 只有一個幸存者 在這款以希臘神話為背景的快節奏彈幕遊戲中 你將如同半神般戰鬥 佈署致命防禦 並在每一局戰鬥後不斷變強

games.name: Odinfall
games.short_description: Ragnarok was just the beginning… of the end! Odinfall is a Viking-themed, rogue-lite, twin-stick shooter. Blast your way through procedurally generated levels, upgrade your character, modify your weapons and take down robotic Norse gods to earn your freedom!

games.name: Nekomancy
games.short_description: Nekomancy is a Magic roguelite looter shooter! Craft spells and vanquish evil creatures! Grab their loot and craft better spells! Make progress in the skill tree! Only the best synergies pass the test!

games.name: Morbid Metal
games.short_description: 你可在這款快節奏斬殺 Rogue-Lite 遊戲的戰鬥中即時變形為多位強力角色、串聯威力強大的招式，撕裂一波波致命機器與殘酷頭目。

games.name: Kitty Survivors: Rogues of Catmere
games.short_description: Kitty Survivors is a funny action rogue-lite game where you slay hordes of creatures, create overpowered builds, use elemental skills and craft stupid weapons. Join a growing guild of misfits with a thirst for milk, hired to protect the Kingdom of Catmere!

games.name: 落逃之地 LORT
games.short_description: 《落逃之地 LORT》是一款支援1–8人聯機的動作Roguelite遊戲。和朋友組隊，在這片被詛咒的奇幻世界裡一路戰鬥、搜刮、堆疊離譜道具……從刮痧菜雞直到秒天秒地！逃生路上、別忘了拉兄弟一把。

games.name: Desktop Defender
games.short_description: 一款在你做其他事情時，靜靜運行於螢幕角落的放置型自動戰鬥遊戲。

games.name: Nunholy
games.short_description: 在一個被吸血鬼肆虐的世界中，一群擁有自己故事的修女來到了獵人公會。她們準備好運用任何力量——即使是惡魔的力量——來擊敗敵人。在這條危險的旅途中，等待她們的命運會是什麼？

games.name: Restaurats
games.short_description: 與鼠夥伴一起經營中世紀餐廳！烹飪、把食物丟向客人，成為傳說中的鼠廚！

games.name: 風暴馭使
games.short_description: 在最後關頭閃避敵人的攻擊，觸發致命又不長眼的陷阱，打造獨一無二的風暴馭使！勇敢面對危險的元素風暴吧！與朋友組隊，享受令人振奮的合作體驗。做好準備，你的操作技巧將面臨殘酷的挑戰。

games.name: 東方華心傳 - Touhou Blooming Soul
games.short_description: 這是一款爽快的ACT橫版過關遊戲，以東方Project的人物“秦心”為主角，在幻想鄉的舞臺盡情探索和擊敗敵人，並且帶有輕度的Rogue-lite要素。遊戲中有隨機道具、技能和地圖等豐富要素，讓玩家能夠不拘一格的遊玩遊戲，每一局都能夠獲得一些不同的體驗。

games.name: Freefall '95
games.short_description: 在這款快節奏的街機冒險中，串連誇張特技連段、閃避致命殘骸，並挑戰超高分數。賺取硬幣、升級能力、收集稀有物品，並在這架註定墜毀的 1995 年航班上揭開一段瘋狂的時間扭曲故事

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
games.short_description: This is a "Mysterious Dungeon" style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your "Friends" and go on a new adventure!

games.name: Titans of the Past
games.short_description: A deep party-based RPG. Crawl dungeons. Battle monsters with your weapons, spells, abilities. Utilize the 'time flows as you move' system to make decisions. Loot, level up, craft, develop your town. Unlock new classes and races, spells, items - to make a party able survive the hardest challenges.

games.name: Ultros
games.short_description: 《ULTROS》是一款迷幻風的銀河戰士惡魔城遊戲。主角醒來後發現自己受困在孕育著遠古惡魔的宇宙搖籃「封印之棺」上。玩家必須在黑洞的無限輪迴之中探索封印之棺，與當中的居民交流，進而發掘自己的使命……

games.name: 《超能連結：星火戰旗》
games.short_description: 夥同一群獲救的機器人好夥伴來建立一個充滿光明未來的新世界！在這款色彩繽紛的動作角色扮演遊戲中，獨自面對或多人合作挑戰敵人不斷襲來的攻勢，接著回到家園利用敵人的零件來打造出一個生氣蓬勃的城鎮。集結你的隊員，在每一次的全新冒險中成長茁壯！

games.name: 闲置神话
games.short_description: 挂爆电费，休闲摸鱼，偷懒耍滑！现代修真为皮；刷宝养成为骨；擦边玩梗为神。宅度与中二度突破天际，在游戏库内随时出击杀掉那些无聊的时间。其将为放置游戏中最离谱的奇葩；其名为 闲 置 神 话 ！

games.name: Clock Rogue
games.short_description: 《Clock Rogue》是一款考驗玩家時間感的Roguelike遊戲。來打造專屬於你的時鐘，保護刺蝟不受侵害吧！

games.name: Runehaven
games.short_description: Runehaven is an atmospheric roguelike dungeon crawler with an immersive magic system where you craft your own spells. Explore a mysterious procedurally generated world.

games.name: Rising Hell - Prologue
games.short_description: 歡迎來到地獄的第一層！你需要不斷地突破這個深淵，往上衝刺，在這個垂直的rogue-lite煉獄之中不斷地與嗜血惡魔戰鬥，最終突破地獄之巔……

games.name: Cards of Cthulhu
games.short_description: CARDS OF CTHULHU is the Roguelike Card RPG full of madness. Experience the unique combination of strategic deck-building with fast-paced combat and face-off parody monsters from horror B movies.

games.name: Spaceship Looter
games.short_description: Spaceship Looter is an action roguelike game, where mercenaries of all stripes rob drifting schooner, lost transtport ships and abandoned military cruisers - all what is filled with tons of valuable loot and hidden in the deep space.

games.name: Desktop Nard: Dice Idle
games.short_description: Idle Dice roll automatically for you, unleashing skills and farming rare loot in the corner of your desktop, with tons of content and loot types.

games.name: Blood And Zombies
games.short_description: 血、內臟、肉。人類正在對可怕的殭屍末日發動全面戰爭。在這款第一人稱波浪防禦射擊遊戲中，帶領人類最致命的四名倖存者之一對抗部落。給你的槍裝上子彈，架起砲塔，磨練你的技能，也許你就能撐過這個夜晚。

games.name: ROGUE FLIGHT
games.short_description: 一款發想自知名動畫，讓人緊張刺激的太空戰鬥街機遊戲。

games.name: TTV2
games.short_description: TTV2 is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame, sequel to Trip to Vinelands.

games.name: >SYS//PURGE_
games.short_description: >SYS//PURGE_ is a free, fast-paced FPS inspired by 90's classics, with roguelike elements. Collect items, stay alive and descend deeper into the facility. You take control of an LN-X unit, a glitch breaks you out of the Overseer's control. Make it burn.

games.name: Moonlighter
games.short_description: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

games.name: Skull Horde
games.short_description: Skull Horde is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer. Find powerful loot and create overpowered builds. Summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

games.name: 斷指默示錄
games.short_description: 呵呵……歡迎來到我的遊輪！在這裡，骰子落下，你的手指、你的生命，將成為我娛樂的籌碼。每一次下注，都是在與死亡親密接觸。聰明點，用你的智慧和冷血拼命求生——否則，你只會成為我血色遊艇上的又一個祭品。來吧，讓我看看你能撐多久，看你掙扎的樣子，真是太有趣了……

games.name: 酋長的野望
games.short_description: Kaya’s Prophecy is a unique card based village builder! establish your village, gather resources, and craft tools and buildings in a vibrant world. Explore and combat various challenges and other groups in this colourful, deck-builder while appeasing your god to earn his favour.

games.name: 歡迎光臨 Beastro
games.short_description: Beastro《歡迎光臨》！這款迷人的奇幻冒險結合了美食與魔法。並非所有英雄都揮舞長劍，有些人手持湯匙和鍋杓；而拯救世界的旅程，有時就從一頓美味佳餚展開。

games.name: FROGGY HATES SNOW
games.short_description: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door — or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: 萌物求生 / Twilight Survivors
games.short_description: 結合了rogue-lite元素與萌萌藝術風格的限時倖存遊戲！世界已陷落黑暗，你是唯一的希望！倖存到黎明，或是在嘗試的過程中反復死亡？別擔心，你可以在過程中收集金幣等來強化自己！

games.name: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike
games.short_description: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience. Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!

games.name: Repel The Rifts
games.short_description: Repel the Rifts is a roguelite tower defense game where you lead a commander through an alien world, uncovering new terrain each wave, drafting powerful upgrades, and constructing defenses to hold back the chaos.

games.name: DISORDER
games.short_description: 在這款全 3D 日誌式地牢爬行遊戲中逃離百貨公司並尋找隱藏的真相。

games.name: Stellar Witch
games.short_description: 《Stellar Witch》是一款結合背包管理與網格閃避動作的遊戲,玩家將成為掌控星辰力量的魔法師,展開成為大魔導師的旅程. 透過戰鬥收集金幣,購買星座並策略性地配置它們. 善用星座的能力與相互間的協同效果,對抗愈發強大的敵人.

games.name: ADIOS Amigos: Galactic Explorers
games.short_description: Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Experience the perils and intrigue of space exploration with 1-4 players.

games.name: Firehawk: FPV Drone Shooter
games.short_description: Firehawk是戰術FPV無人機模擬器。攜帶武器庫飛向天空，對抗無窮無盡的敵人，擁有真實的無人機物理和控制系統。無論你是新手還是在測試飛行技能，這都是體驗FPV飛行刺激感的最有趣方式

games.name: Alquiem
games.short_description: Alquiem is a new Medieval RPG made by a solo-dev in which you will be able to gain strength through numerous classes and talent trees, professions and equipment to face the creatures that inhabit the lands of Odenzur.

games.name: Borıng.
games.short_description: The best worst game on Steam.

games.name: NO-SKIN
games.short_description: Horror Roguelike characterized by an experimental artstyle and storytelling, strategic gameplay and deep mysteries

games.name: Power of Ten
games.short_description: Fly a star-fighter against a bloodthirsty armada. Gather weapons, resources, and upgrades to help you push back the relentless assault while protecting the galaxies' civilians!

games.name: 讚美死者
games.short_description: 《讚美死者》是一款類Rogue自走棋遊戲，您可以在遊戲中使用死去村民和怪物的器官來製造僵 屍隨從。利用您的僵屍打敗一波波來犯的惡魔，同時收穫資源來改良並升級您的村莊。

games.name: The Deadseat
games.short_description: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.

games.name: 33不朽灵魂
games.short_description: 33不朽灵魂 是 33 名玩家合作進行的動作類 Roguelike 遊戲。直衝闖關、單人陷陣或合作禦敵，與不斷來襲的怪物戰鬥，擊敗龐大的首領，並且在每一局遊戲中都變得更加強大。使用遊戲中的表情動作來和反抗軍同伴相互協調、合力出擊，共同面對神之怒。

games.name: Project Entropy
games.short_description: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy- an ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with battles in space. In this immersive MMO experience, you will command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets.

games.name: 深淵之潮
games.short_description: 在《深淵之潮》中選擇你的裝備，擊退遠古文明中的腐敗居民，駕馭神聖力量——這是一款節奏明快、支援 1 至 4 名玩家的第一人稱射擊和 Roguelite 深海龐克風格冒險遊戲。

games.name: Killer Bean
games.short_description: You are Killer Bean, a rogue assassin coffee bean, who takes out the trash in this world, one bullet at a time. This is a first person / third person action roguelike.

games.name: Skogdal
games.short_description: A deckbuilding adventure card game set in a rustic Norwegian town during the 90's. Recruit followers, draft cards and build powerful combos. Explore a hand-crafted world across multiple runs and uncover an unsettling mystery…

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.short_description: 低買高賣，甚至瘋狂放空整個宇宙的嬰兒！這款結合惡搞與金融操作的街機風股票模擬遊戲，舞台正是來自《Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator》的混亂世界。

games.name: 夏日彼方 beyond
games.short_description: ——世界的終末之夏，少女的漂泊之旅。在這部視覺小說當中，你將以對話的方式與生活在末日世界的少女一起生存。

games.name: SWORN
games.short_description: 《SWORN》這款類Rogue動作遊戲可供1至4名玩家合作遊玩。玩家將探索墮落國度卡美洛，這裡由腐敗的亞瑟王與他麾下的圓桌騎士統御，待你收復疆土。

games.name: ELbab
games.short_description: ELbab is a pixel-art roguelite set in an endless library. Choose tiles to progress through dungeon-like paths and enjoy a build-crafting experience similar to ARPG planning tools. All battles are automated, letting you relax with coffee, videos, or even other games while refining your build.

games.name: Hordes of Hunger
games.short_description: 出自《Blood West》創作者之手，在這款 3D 動作倖存者類型遊戲中，踏上屠殺怪物之路。操控 Mirah，避免活死人毀了你的家園，使用各式強大武器與技能，在不斷逼近的屍群之中，救出所有人。

games.name: 航海奇聞2：傳承
games.short_description: 《航海奇聞2：傳承》是一款Roguelike卡牌遊戲。化身海盜，招募同伴，啟航冒險。透過建構強力卡組和巧妙策略，在變幻莫測的海域中殺出重圍，並登頂榮耀競技場，成為聲名遠揚的那位船長！

games.name: Dark Hunting Ground
games.short_description: 獵殺漆黑獵場中蜂擁而至的怪物，收集戰利品，自由打造您的專屬構築，並爭取成為最強的獵人！

games.name: My Slime Garden
games.short_description: Raise, nurture, and breed adorable slimes in a relaxing adventure where each slime is unique! Mix traits to create new slime companions and explore endless islands filled with secrets and surprises. Your perfect slime squad is waiting for you. How far can you take them?

games.name: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
games.short_description: The epitome of a modern traditional roguelike: with turn-based play and a RPG-like skill progression system, it hearkens back to some of the major aspects of this genre. This game has an incredible depth, with a deep inventory system, vehicles and boats, NPCs with their own stories, and more.

games.name: BAPBAP
games.short_description: Join BAPBAP, the Roguelike Party game where no two matches are ever the same. Round up your homies, pick a character, and build a giga-unfair build that'll make them hate you - then do it all over again!

games.name: Jet Kave Adventure
games.short_description: Jetpack through the prehistoric world in this Stone-Fiction adventure platformer. Enjoy challenging boss fights, flying over pitfalls, smashing through walls, knocking out enemies, and manipulating objects as you halt the alien threat once and for all.

games.name: Greedventory
games.short_description: Greedventory is a gorgeous pixel-art linear action RPG experience, where the only thing between you and an embarrassingly swift death is your mouse. Strike, parry, and cast powerful spells on your enemies, loot ancient treasures, explore a brutal realm, and become the hero you never wanted to be!

games.name: 午休戰術
games.short_description: 《午休戰術》是一款設定在混亂超市後場的策略型自動對戰卡牌遊戲。選拔卡牌、精算隊伍的極限配置、打造超乎想像的協同效果，接著與其他玩家進行非同步對戰。對戰節奏緊湊，過程沒有時限，組合千變萬化，重開隨心所欲，闖出屬於自己的上分之路。

games.name: Nightmare Frontier
games.short_description: Behold! The first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of Scavengers into a devastated West Coast City of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab the loot you can carry and get out. Alive.

games.name: 玩命特攻
games.short_description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!

games.name: Arcane Trigger
games.short_description: Arcane Trigger is a bullet-building roguelike where every shot is crafted before it's fired. Forge over 220 bullets, shape their effects with 150+ magical seals, and master infinite synergies in this endlessly replayable strategic shooter.

games.name: 背包闖江湖
games.short_description: 《背包闖江湖》是一款武俠題材的背包管理自走棋遊戲，在每局遊戲中，可從多個初始門派選擇其一進入江湖，與其他數十名異步匹配的玩家在同一個世界中，選擇行動路線，成長與對戰，最終在華山之巔進行終極決勝。

games.name: 星塵戰線 Breachway
games.short_description: 在這款科幻Roguelike牌組構築遊戲中探索星系，升級船艦與船員管理是生存的關鍵。最佳化資源生產，投入激烈的回合制戰鬥，在尋找信號的同時應對不斷進化的威脅。

games.name: 失物招領模擬器
games.short_description: 失物招领處有人丟什麼？各種物品都有人遺失，什麼遊戲機、筆記本、「最高機密」還是裝著炸彈的公文包。作為管理員，你需要及時將物品交還，但如果不喜歡顧客的態度，也可以選擇拿走自己賣掉。你是管理員，你說了算。

games.name: 尸姬之梦
games.short_description: 卡牌，战斗！有人惊醒了沉睡的尸姬……也许，这个世界需要为尸姬大人的起床气付出一点代价……在《尸姬之梦》中，你将扮演被惊醒的尸姬大人，尝试各种奇奇妙妙的构筑组合，发现各种强力的，奇怪的对手，然后把他们全，都，打趴下！

games.name: 東方魔女夜市 - Touhou Witch's Night Market
games.short_description: Marisa has lost all her fortune in 'Kappachinko', now she must fight other residents in Gensokyo to repay the debt she owes Reimu! Collect various items and skills, build your construct strategically, then head towards powerful opponents! She may even encounter a mysterious being in the end…

games.name: Minesweeper: Collector
games.short_description: Tired of boring common square levels? Finally there is a brand new minesweeper with different game modes! Each level is a part of collection. Complete collections to obtain keys and gain access for more episodes. Achieve higher levels to unlock new items, chests, pets and much more!

games.name: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
games.short_description: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.

games.name: It Has My Face
games.short_description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

games.name: Dungeon Raid: Zero Floor
games.short_description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

games.name: 白夜夢
games.short_description: 少女在午夜的街頭裡追尋著逃走的貓咪。《白夜夢》是一款卡牌策略Rougelite遊戲。遊戲通過簡單的翻牌機制與趣味豐富的Build組合，巧妙地模擬了這短暫又漫長的一夜。

games.name: 三國志BOND
games.short_description: 「集結群雄，以智略決勝天下！」 混亂戰局，誰能推演 「最佳解」？唯有你的智略！ 從隨機百餘名武將中組建最強陣容，洞悉戰局，決勝沙場。 短期決戰的卡牌構築型肉鴿軍勢大戰，等你挑戰。

games.name: Bingle Bingle
games.short_description: 《瘋狂輪盤》是一款超帶勁的「輪盤構築」策略遊戲！在這裡，你可以DIY專屬自己的輪盤，把各種小球、籌碼分配、代幣、槽位和徽章玩轉組合，觸發讓人腎上腺素狂飆的超強Buff！狠狠賺它個幾百萬、幾千萬籌碼，贏下這場賭場對決吧！

games.name: 戒指裏的老爺爺
games.short_description: 修爲高强的仙人老爺爺（你）遭遇了史上最大危機！失去肉身的你將元神躲進一枚戒指當中，開始了在仙罡大陸顛沛流離的冒險。撿到你的人可能是嫉惡如仇的正派人士，可能是心無旁騖的修煉狂人，也可能是熱血上腦的一介莽夫.......該如何與他們相處，才能讓自己從困境中脫離呢？

games.name: Skillshot City
games.short_description: Loot, shoot, cast and drive in this chaotic PvP Roguelite. Level up fast, draft wild skills, and create crazy combos on the fly. Explore a GTA-style battle royale with no queues or downtime as you prepare to win the final fight. Play solos, duos or trios with friends and climb the ranks!

games.name: Timber Rush
games.short_description: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

games.name: 幽深密室：復活
games.short_description: 召集隊伍並打造卡組。殺死敵人並保護盟友。明智地打出你的牌，或許能在下降至《幽深密室：復活》深處的危險過程中倖存下來。

games.name: Arcadegeddon
games.short_description: 快來和最多三位好友一起遊玩這款不斷進化的多人合作射擊遊戲。探索多個生物群落、體驗小遊戲、找到隱藏寶箱，並擊敗多種敵人和頭目。

games.name: 武林生存
games.short_description: 《武林生存》是一款在限定時間內對抗不斷湧來的敵人並求生的生存Roguelite遊戲。探索正在滅亡的世界，獲得武功、裝備和特性，蛻變為武林的英雄。

games.name: Clockwork Cleanup
games.short_description: Clockwork cleanup is a auto-battler game where your actions are dictated by tiles of various shapes placed in a grid. Defeat waves of enemies to save the factory!

games.name: Squiggle Football
games.short_description: Squiggle Football is a deck-building football management roguelike, where you create a team and form powerful combinations of players, coaches, tactics and culture. Recruit, trade & innovate through nail-biting matches to reach & conquer the National League. Inspired by Australian Rules Football.

games.name: Everlasting Flowers - Where there is a will, there is a way
games.short_description: 來自sprite（《戀愛與選舉與巧克力》《蒼之彼方的四重奏》）的最新獻禮，為大家呈現一段催人淚下的動人故事

games.name: 心門守衛
games.short_description: 《心門守衛》是緊湊刺激的Roguelike遊戲，你必須討伐造主「混沌」，奪回遭竊的時間之心，在源源不絕的敵襲中殺出一條血路。你可以獨自闖蕩異星，也能與4位玩家並肩作戰。快來成為下一位心門守衛吧！

games.name: Overlooting
games.short_description: Adapt your strategy to a skill tree that changes every run, combine pieces of equipment to form powerful synergies and create a game-changing build capable of defeating the bosses that will try to stop you. In this Inventory Management Roguelike two games never feel the same!

games.name: 寶卡太空龍
games.short_description: Takara Cards is a unique tactical deck-builder RPG about chasing space dragons in a sci-fi fantasy universe. Create your deck as you explore sectors, fighting your way in deep puzzly combat. Every decision you make affects your Ship and Character: Each new adventure offers new surprises!

games.name: Stirring Abyss
games.short_description: Stirring Abyss is an indie tactical squad-based game with strong RPG elements in which you uncover the ancient mysteries of the depths depicted in the classic vein of Lovecraftian horror.

games.name: Echoes of Red
games.short_description: ECHOES OF RED 是一款節奏快速的 Roguelite 射擊遊戲，你可以同時攜帶無限武器，對抗源源不絕且愈發強大的敵人，打造屬於你的完美自訂配置。殲滅數以萬計膽敢挑戰你的敵人，讓他們為與你為敵而後悔莫及。

games.name: Steve's Warehouse: Physics. Roguelike. Chaos.
games.short_description: Steve's Warehouse is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects, combine them but don't make any falls!

games.name: Sweet Surrender VR
games.short_description: Sweet Surrender is a fast-paced roguelike VR shooter. Fight your way up a dystopian megatower, filled to the brim with tyrant machines hell-bent on destroying the last of humanity. Build your arsenal of weapons, upgrades, and explosives to take down the machine overlords.

games.name: Moonsigil Atlas
games.short_description: 不用能量的Roguelike牌組構築遊戲—靠實際空間來出牌！將卡牌拼湊在一起、操控卡牌形狀，並組出破壞遊戲平衡的誇張Combo！

games.name: The Last Man Survivor
games.short_description: 《最後的倖存者》是一個陰暗畫風的roguelike(肉鴿)題材遊戲，你在此遊戲內需要與很多的敵人作戰，同時需要殺死強大的BOSS，提升自己的能力，解鎖新角色，並探尋最後倖存者背後的秘密

games.name: Rise of the Slime
games.short_description: Be the hero that no-one saw coming. Help Slime defy the odds by playing insanely powerful cards in this charming, relaxing and strategic deckbuilding adventure.

games.name: Haste
games.short_description: Run fast, soar through the air, and master your landings as you speed through procedural worlds to outrun the end of the universe, by yourself and with friends!

games.name: Witchfire
games.short_description: 《Witchfire》是一款黑暗奇幻風格的第一人稱角色扮演射擊遊戲，你將扮演一名罪孽深重之徒，一名獵巫人，為尋救贖而開始自己最後的任務。

games.name: 除靈事務所
games.short_description: 女鬼養成+卡牌構築+祖瑪三消！《除靈事務所》是一款以驚悚爲樂的新奇Rougelike遊戲。鬼怪復甦，人間如獄，而你將作爲除靈高手，探索女鬼聚集之地，用諸多道法收服惡靈，從詭異的事件中存活下來，就可以 —— 開啓後宮！

games.name: Rogue Command
games.short_description: 真正的經典 RTS，融合 Roguelite 構築。以子彈時間般的精準度指揮單位。空投基地，集結軍隊。每一場，都是全新的武器庫。打造能打破遊戲的構築。或被遊戲打破。

games.name: Holder of Place
games.short_description: Holder of Place is a Roguelike Auto-Battler Card game. Recruit different follower cards, arrange them, watch them fight ever-stronger enemies. Along the way, unfold a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, and visit exotic locations.

games.name: 列車安全搜查官梨奈
games.short_description: 在這款肉鴿X模擬玩法的遊戲裡，你將扮演擁有超能力的特殊調查員梨奈，在列車中打擊犯罪、降低犯罪率。透過升級並組合各種技能來先發制人吧！同時也能為梨奈換不同的衣服，享受各種造型帶來的樂趣。

games.name: Rogue Point
games.short_description: 歡迎來到《Rogue Point》！這款4人合作射擊遊戲的核心同樣是四個字：團隊合作。攜手完成艱鉅的任務，實現不斷演進變化的目標，並取得強大升級。事前制定策略，中途視情況隨機調整，最終征服各種萬難。這就是小隊活到最後的生存法則。

games.name: 靈動世界
games.short_description: 《靈動世界(Vivid World)》延續了大獲好評的前作《靈動騎士(Vivid Knight)》，是款全新的「組隊式類Rogue」遊戲！ 本作品之背景為惡魔統治的「冥界」。 請善加運用主角「雷姆利亞」的新型寶石術，挑戰充滿未知的地下城。

games.name: Transliminal: Beyond The Backrooms
games.short_description: An unsettling rogue-lite survival horror adventure. Iconic levels reshape around you. Classic and original entities lurk as greater beings bid for your favor. Collect relics and strange items. Grow stronger. Survive, escape, or claim more uncertain fates. Fall in. Get lost. Go beyond The Backrooms.

games.name: CiniCross
games.short_description: CiniCross is a dark fantasy roguelite where nonogram puzzles meet dungeon crawling. Solve increasingly complex puzzles, choose your path through a branching dungeon, and bend the rules using powerful artifacts. Each room is a puzzle. Each boss, a deadly challenge.

games.name: 魔書射爆
games.short_description: 魔書射爆是一款以一本書為主角的塔防肉鴿遊戲，你魂穿異世界附身於魔書，《母豬的產後護理》《陰陽學》《聖經》曾經你耳熟能詳的書籍帶給你與眾不同的魔法，搭配不同的學院，學習九大天啟魔法，來一場酣淋漓的魔法對你與眾不同的魔法，搭配不同的學院，學習九大天啟魔法，來一場酣淋漓的魔法對轟！

games.name: Neon Village
games.short_description: 本作是一款融合了「卡组建构型Roguelike」与「三消拼图」的游戏。 收集个性丰富的居民，激发爆炸性的协同效应，让你的村庄在霓虹光芒中发展！

games.name: Skigill
games.short_description: Fight! Collect! Explore! Experiment! Survive! Master the SKIGILL, a large skill tree spanning the entire battleground, to power your character and survive waves of enemies. Unlock upgrades, weapons, and characters in a meta sigil after each game, and maybe you'll see the end!

games.name: 哥布林維克：竊賊大亨
games.short_description: 夜晚潛行盜寶，白天吹牛賣貨。 體驗狡詐哥布林的雙面人生：在危機四伏的地宮中偷取魔王秘寶，再用天花亂墜的話術把寶物高價賣給冤大頭。招募雇員，擴張店鋪，在多方勢力間左右逢源。從負債纍纍的貧窮哥布林，一路逆襲成呼風喚雨的黑金大亨！

games.name: Pair A Dice
games.short_description: Pair A Dice is a Co-Op Dice Roller where you harness the power of magic dice to create enemies, craft items, and defeat bosses!

games.name: Bella Wants Blood
games.short_description: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.

games.name: WTF Do You Know?
games.short_description: We just have one question for you... "WTF Do You Know?" I think it might be time for us to find out...

games.name: UBERMOSH:BLACK
games.short_description: UBERMOSH:BLACK is the second volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH. Cut bullets with your sword, shoot with heavy guns and splatter enemies with a rage fueled psionic wave.

games.name: HordeCore
games.short_description: HordeCore is a kick-ass side-scrolling shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Play alone, or as a team - and destroy, survive, craft, and explore!

games.name: SealChain: Call of Blood
games.short_description: 咒印鏈接是一款類Roguelike遊戲，道具之間可相互連結形成連鎖反應，也可擺放成特定陣型形成咒印，獲得特殊效果。

games.name: Fida Puti Samurai
games.short_description: A Retro-FPS "virtual happy place", jeopardized with a naughty bug. Traverse this action-oriented roguelite blasting waifus to uncover dirty secrets on a personal computer!

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.short_description: A Robinson Crusoe–inspired roguelike survival adventure set in the 17th century. Shipwrecked on a ruthless tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.

games.name: 娜娜小築
games.short_description: 在這喧囂忙碌的時代，回到屬於你的小築，精緻、典雅。似是當年午後的那個清新世界。在這裡，你可以隨心所欲地佈置每個角落，養上一二寵物作伴，邀請三兩好友共賞悠然時光。 讓Nano在你的桌面，靜靜陪伴你每一個日常。

games.name: Bronana
games.short_description: Bronana is a thrilling and hilarious survival roguelike. Embody the spirit of a fearless banana warrior to take down waves of vicious snack monsters. Through a rich variety of random events, grow stronger, evolve abilities, and face off against challenging bosses to save the homeland.

games.name: 巨石島
games.short_description: 帶領巨石小人們圍繞神秘方塊建立不斷繁榮的部落。收集資源、構築技能、維持成長循環，在越來越誇張的特效與數值洪流中，將整個系統推向失控。

games.name: Dark Scrolls
games.short_description: 《黑暗卷軸》是一款奇幻風格的平台動作遊戲，完美結合了彈幕射擊的刺激快感與 Roguelite 的成長機制，充滿獨特魅力、高難度挑戰與各種隱藏祕密。

games.name: 沙盒勇者：序章
games.short_description: 白天採礦剥羊毛，中午蓋塔招傭兵，晚上守家坑魔王！極簡風沙盒生存遊戲，輕鬆上手、百玩不膩，準備好前排入住《沙盒勇者》精神時光屋吧！

games.name: 第九聖詩
