games.short_description: 組合寶石，打出連段！ 遊玩Roguelite寶石策略遊戲《第九聖詩》，體驗爽快的益智風格連段戰鬥。 你將化身為祕密結社「第九聖詩」的特務來迎戰強敵！ 巧妙利用策略，構築出寶石出招順序，掌握打出大量連段的關鍵！

games.name: 晶靈小隊
games.short_description: 組成一支兇萌的元素生物小隊，迎戰蜂擁而至的敵潮！晶靈羈絆解鎖連攜技能，遠古聖物助你強力構築！橫掃多個生態地圖，拯救你的家園！

games.name: Slot & Dungeons
games.short_description: 這是一款適合單人玩的卡組建築遊戲遊戲，敵人和道具在地板上的位置會根據插槽的不同而改變。 沿途的敵人和征服所需的資源會以 「符號 」的形式納入插槽中。 在發展角色的同時收集符號，以增強插槽中的內容並征服地牢！

games.name: Space Gladiators: The Hole
games.short_description: 有想過成為太空馬鈴薯嗎? 機會來了!外星鬥士是個2D手繪魂類游戲。操控不同俘虜逃出星球監獄，擊敗上百隻外星人並重獲自由!

games.name: TTV3
games.short_description: TTV3 is the third volume of the retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands

games.name: THYSIASTERY
games.short_description: THYSIASTERY is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

games.name: Stories from the Outbreak
games.short_description: Stories from the Outbreak is a turn-based roguelike zombie RPG. Lead a group of survivors from the doomed city of Riga towards a ferry sailing across the North Sea. Scavenge for supplies, battle the undead, decide the fate of your team. What are you willing to sacrifice in order to survive?

games.name: 無盡礦工
games.short_description: An incremental mining adventure where you must dig into the earth to recover essence for your sacred Evertree. Mine, drill, and blast your way to the deepest depths, discovering rare artifacts and recruiting more kin to your cause along the way. Dig. Upgrade. Repeat.

games.name: Grind Survivors
games.short_description: 一款節奏快速的 roguelike 動作遊戲，惡魔獵人將在其中迎戰源源不絕的地獄生物。

games.name: Knights of Braveland
games.short_description: Knights of Braveland是一款配有故事生成機制的合作橫版闖關動作遊戲。您將披荊斬棘，邁向最終勝利。若有好友並肩，快樂更將加倍。

games.name: Hero Siege
games.short_description: Hero Siege is a fast paced Pixel Art ARPG featuring an expansive roster of unique classes, deep build experimentation, and a player driven economy.

games.name: Kromlech
games.short_description: Kromlech is an action-adventure RPG with rogue-lite elements, set in a dark fantasy world of swords and sorcery. Play as an adventurer whose quest for glory and gold takes an unexpected turn when he finds himself at the center of a world-ending calamity.

games.name: Wheelchair Wizards
games.short_description: Wheelchair Wizards is a 2-8 player party game where you battle your friends while upgrading your wizard.

games.name: Vellum
games.short_description: Write on! Defend the books in Vellum, a co-op, literary roguelike! Harness class-defining colors, master an inspired spellbook, and influence the growth of your enemy! As a group or solo, you'll craft plot-twisting builds to rewrite the rules in Ink!

games.name: 血之詩：月之蝕
games.short_description: Blood Poem: Eclipse of the Moon is a 2D Rogue Lite hyper-speed action-adventure game. In the game, you play as the heroine code-named Ishtar, also known as "Moon" exploring a post-apocalyptic world. Your mission is to defeat beautiful bosses and bring them back to your lab.

games.name: Trakonius
games.short_description: In the merciless sands of the arena, a gladiator is forced to fight for survival. Trakonius defies Mars, the God of War, in this Action Roguelike experience! Face gladiators, mythological creatures, and deadly challenges across four brutal arenas. The truth can only be revealed through combat!

games.name: Guidus Zero
games.short_description: 《Guidus Zero》是一款roguelike即時動作遊戲。快來探索大陸上出現的未知天坑「傷痕」，尋找神秘精靈與寶箱，並擊退被黑暗侵蝕的敵人與強大的BOSS；挑戰通關至「傷痕」的最底層，找尋災難的源頭！

games.name: City Defense Z
games.short_description: City Defense Z combines base-building and base defense in a roguelite progression loop. Build by day, defend by night, and face a growing zombie threat. Every defeat unlocks permanent upgrades, helping you rebuild smarter and push further each time. See how many days you can last.

games.name: The Fortress
games.short_description: 黑暗奇幻回合制地城探索。選擇職業，探索被詛咒的房間，擲骰戰鬥並收集戰利品。面對強敵與抉擇，擊敗首領，努力逃脫……或墜入黑暗。

games.name: From Glory To Goo
games.short_description: From Glory To Goo is a Sci-Fi survival RTS set on an alien world. Serve as humanity's bulwark by establishing a colony and supporting your colonists still in orbit. But beware, for The Goo, a relentless and shape-shifting force approaches from all sides, even above and below.

games.name: BALL x PIT
games.short_description: 《BALL x PIT》是一款打磚塊、融合球、基地建設 roguelite 生存遊戲。使用彈跳球擊敗成群的敵人，並收集坑洞中的財寶來擴展你的家園、生產資源並招募獨特英雄。

games.name: Sausage Hunter
games.short_description: 幫助持有爆能槍的小貓抓住魔法香腸！在這款令人興奮的平台遊戲中，克服障礙，解決難題，並與敵人戰鬥，遊戲具有手繪圖形和愉悅的音樂。

games.name: Touhou Lensed Night Sky, Kaseigai
games.short_description: "I want you to go to the moon."

games.name: Primordialis
games.short_description: Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.

games.name: Scavenger SV-4
games.short_description: Scavenger SV-4 is a highly replayable atmospheric first-person science fiction game. Part simulator, part roguelike, it has elements of action, combat, resource management, and a dash of horror. It is not quite like any game you have played before.

games.name: Wantless : Solace at World’s End
games.short_description: In this dystopic sci-fi Tactical RPG, save your patients from themselves. Craft your skills among millions of combinations, heal the mind and face ever growing nightmares in 10mn runs. Will you overcome the insidious being chasing you across minds?

games.name: Maze Mice
games.short_description: 《Maze Mice》是一款子彈地獄 Roguelite 遊戲，時間只會在你移動時流動。收集豆子、升級、選擇強化，並避開貓咪。一切都按照你的節奏進行。

games.name: Banzai Escape
games.short_description: Banzai Universe Prologue. Starring Rokiahi as P.A.S.K.A.L special agent.

games.name: 荒域奇谭
games.short_description: Legends of Wastelands is an idle RPG where you shape your hero’s growth. Choose among six classes, master 100+ skills, and combine talents and gems for unique synergies. Idle for rewards or dive into boss fights and shifting wastelands, with pets and gear adding endless build variety.

games.name: We Gotta Go
games.short_description: 《WE GOTTA GO》是一款合作恐怖喜劇遊戲，保證讓你嚇破膽——字面意義上的。組隊前往鬼宅中唯一的廁所，在腸胃背叛你之前趕到。搜刮物品、抵禦鬼魂、共同穿越詛咒走廊，展開一場絕望的追尋，只為獲得那份甜蜜的解脫。

games.name: 卡片魔王：只剩個頭！
games.short_description: 化身復活的魔王，踏上復仇與重建之路。一款無需任何反應力的動作 Roguelite 遊戲，即使是操作苦主也能享受躲避戰鬥與策略構建的快感！

games.name: House
games.short_description: Try to survive through the night in a house that's trying its best to kill you and your family.

games.name: Die in the Dungeon
games.short_description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

games.name: 尋日之旅
games.short_description: 這款瘋狂無比的輕度 Rogue 遊戲考驗玩家的戰術策略，你能否戰勝變幻莫測的命運？選擇一名英雄，直抵隨機地下城最深處。世事無情，你必須做出選擇、承擔後果……

games.name: 指尖疾速：打字狂潮
games.short_description: 簡介：讓每一個敲擊出的詞語化為你的武器！《指尖疾速：打字狂潮》是一款融合單人彈幕射擊與Roguelike元素的生存遊戲，在極簡風格的戰場上，你將透過疾速打字來擊敗蜂擁而至的敵人——打字的速度、武器的選擇，以及精準的判斷力，將是你存活的關鍵！

games.name: Wander Stars
games.short_description: 在這款酷炫動漫風回合制的日式風格RPG中，透過組合詞語來釋放強大的力量！ 收集超過 200 個詞語，贏得戰鬥並獲得Pep Ups，成為一名氣合大師。 與昔日的對手成為今日的夥伴，揭開隱藏在黑暗裏的祕密。在這場橫跨宇宙的瘋狂競賽中，尋找吧！Wanderstar的地圖碎片！

games.name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
games.short_description: Bendy: Lone Wolf® tests your ability to survive against ever increasing odds. Monsters and obstacles emerge from every direction as you journey into the rubberhose halls of the world's most evil animation studio, set during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival®. Every day is a challenge.

games.name: 妖刀退魔忍
games.short_description: Ninjasoul is a platform action game that combines roguelite with Galaxy warrior demon city. Kunoichi, Tachibana Yachiyo unexpectedly awakened the ability of "death backtracking". She will find the truth in the land that used to be her hometown in the fight and death again and again.

games.name: 怪物對決自走棋
games.short_description: 在《怪物對決》中召集你的怪物小隊，迎戰對手吧！在這款背包管理自走棋遊戲中，你需要不斷收集、組合、排列，打造堅不可摧的隊伍。記住你不是一個人在戰鬥，召集同種族怪物會有強力增益，怪物之間則會有特殊融合進化，不斷發掘更多可能，打造你的終極隊伍。

games.name: 龍女：烈焰之令
games.short_description: 《The Dragoness》結合了魔法門類型的探索、城市建造和回合制策略戰鬥，另外加入了 Roguelite 元素。在遭受戰火肆虐的世界中進行戰鬥、戮力前進並發展各種技能。組建你的野獸大軍，蒐集資源擴建城市。

games.name: KUNKUN Defender 2
games.short_description: 《KUNKUN守衛者2》是一款結合FPS與塔防的混合遊戲，玩家需在病毒感染區中抵禦一波波殭屍，堅守陣地直到直升機前來救援。

games.name: 疊疊樂公國 (Drop Duchy)
games.short_description: 在這款令人耳目一新的混合Roguelite遊戲中，一塊一塊建造你的公國。透過掉落的方塊收集資源，招兵買馬對抗帝國，用方塊構建國土，走向勝利之路！

games.name: 賞金亂鬥：頭號通緝
games.short_description: 歡迎來到「獵人天堂」，加入這場星際牛仔的狂歡！《賞金亂鬥》是一款支援 1-4 人連線的快節奏動作 Roguelite 射擊遊戲。利用獨特「繩索」在戰鬥中輾轉騰挪，與隊友合力圍捕強敵。但當威脅消除，真正的較量才剛剛開始……

games.name: 遊靈 Rogue Spirit
games.short_description: 《Rogue Spirit》是一款具有輕度潛行元素的 3D roguelite 動作遊戲。你將扮演米德拉王國的幽靈王子，附身敵軍角色吸取對方的獨特技能，勝戰破壞故土的邪惡勢力。

games.name: Arcane Vale
games.short_description: Arcane Vale is an action packed open-world RPG. Embark on an adventure to discover a long-lost treasure in a vast and dangerous world.

games.name: 极乐不羡仙
games.short_description: 玩家将扮演一个被宗门背叛的修仙者，废除修为后和师妹重新双修追求极乐大道，再向原宗门复仇和救回其他的几个师妹，并揭露一切的真相。

games.name: Valor of Man
games.short_description: Forge your party. Master your fate. In this turn-based roguelite RPG, lead four heroes through a fractured realm of danger and destiny. Build synergies, unlock powerful abilities, and face ever-shifting challenges in an epic battle for survival. No journey is ever the same.

games.name: 死環: 二次沖擊
games.short_description: 《死環：二次衝擊》是一款以機甲爲核心，融合輕度肉鴿元素的戰棋遊戲。作爲星甲中隊“獅鷲”的指揮官，你需要帶領麾下的星甲與駕駛員們抵禦變異巨獸的威脅，揭開死環背後隱藏的祕密。

games.name: Soulforge Lost Path
games.short_description: In ’Soulforge Lost Path ‘, become a legendary hunter slaughtering endless Corrupted Souls. Scavenge Sacred Remains to forge Exorcist Artefacts, manage limited inventory strategically, and uncover the world's festering corruption truth.

games.name: FUMES
games.short_description: 為你的載具裝備致命武器，並在這款節奏明快的單人／線上合作載具戰鬥遊戲中馳騁於無盡荒原。收集你的汽車升級，以融化這個奇異世界中的敵人和老闆。復古氣息。復古車。復古玩法！

games.name: Super Raft Boat VR
games.short_description: A VR rogue-lite shooter where you must survive waves of sea creatures while building your Super Raft Boat. Can you reach the Final Island?

games.name: Vampire Hunters
games.short_description: 要獵殺吸血鬼，你需要槍。很多槍支。將你的槍堆疊成荒謬的、誇張的建築，消滅成群的不死生物。在這款 Roguelite 倖存者FPS 中釋放您的火力並在混亂中生存下來。

games.name: Gah!
games.short_description: 在隨機生成的關卡中戰鬥——從陰森的地牢到未來的太空站。選擇 13 位獨特角色，擊碎敵人、收集戰利品、挑戰致命首領，並回到可成長的村莊中心獲得永久升級。惡魔注視著。天使等待著。而你，要戰鬥。

games.name: 美好家園與地下城
games.short_description: 在幻想的世界裏冒險・採集・建造城鎮・過上夢想中的慢生活，是這款RPG遊戲的主打特色！在體驗RPG內容的同時，還可以享受到其他豐富多彩的要素！些許的好奇心便能帶你領略這款獨一無二的日式RPG遊戲。一起來探索吧！！！

games.name: Super Mutant Alien Assault
games.short_description: 与死神共舞！在这款残酷刺激的街机平台射击游戏中，随机进入房间，利用各种各样的可解锁武器、炸药、特殊技能和防御技巧，将入侵你的太空货船的变种外星怪物赶尽杀绝。

games.name: Stickman Trenches
games.short_description: 《Stickman Trenches》是一款即時戰略遊戲，你需要管理你的士兵和武器，並在 Stick World War 1 的殘酷戰壕中構建你的防綫。

games.name: 咖啡星礦工 Astro Prospector
games.short_description: 咖啡星礦工（Astro Prospector）是一款可單手遊玩的彈幕增量遊戲，你將駕駛一艘飛船，深入太空開採咖啡星，並且……好吧這不重要，你只需要知道遊戲一旦啟動，你就會進入欲罷不能，再來一局的狀態！

games.name: Dice A Million
games.short_description: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.

games.name: Battle Suit Aces
games.short_description: 《Battle Suit Aces》是一款戰術牌組構築遊戲，既可以體驗巧妙的 Roguelite 玩法，也可以暢玩充滿溫情時刻、宇宙冒險和魅力角色的史詩級戰役。

games.name: Flick Shot Rogues
games.short_description: Plan, Aim, Shoot! FLICK SHOT ROGUES blends the tactile satisfaction of flicking stuff across a table with the strategic depth of your favourite turnbased roguelikes. Chain together ridiculous combos, unlock characters, items and skills to conquer the island!

games.name: SWAPMEAT
games.short_description: Rip through hostile alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts mid-combat, and adapt faster than your enemies. Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers, like triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching turkey heads. Steal, swap, survive.

games.name: Supercat Survivors
games.short_description: 喵！這是一款集策略與趣味於一身的類倖存者遊戲，你將帶領一群可愛治癒的超級貓，體驗暢快刺激的戰鬥、深度搭配的策略，以及無盡怪物的挑戰。隨著戰鬥的深入，超級貓們將不斷成長，透過升級和解鎖新道具，變得更加強大！

games.name: 妖談2：九尾異聞
games.short_description: 擊敗風神與雷神索爾後，紘和夥伴們在祖父家中過著了平靜的生活。 某天，三尾感應到來自遠方的神秘召喚。追蹤能量之後，他們發現召喚竟來自她的本體——傳說中的九尾妖狐。 為了找出真相並伸出援手，紘一行人踏上了全新的冒險旅程。

games.name: Lord of the Dark Castle
games.short_description: Lord of the Dark Castle is a casual turn-based retro style roguelike dungeon crawler with elements of strategy. Randomized levels, lots of skills without dependencies and lots of spells to cast. Challenging Monster AI - play it smart or die. Remember: Death is Permanent!

games.name: Wizardry Variants Daphne
games.short_description: "-百年一度，奈落開啟-　3D地下城RPG 絕望之門，如今再度敞開。 在引誘所有人走向破滅的迷宮裡， 那些被魅惑的戰士們，一個接著一個倒下。 旅人啊， 汝將在無盡襲來的危機中沉淪， 體會冒險的刺激，貪婪地追逐勝利吧。 -Wizardry Variants Daphne- 盡情感受危機與驚險。"

games.name: スペルトナエル
games.short_description: Embark on a 20-day adventure with Two, a reclusive girl. Cast spells in real time using a Japanese kana chart in this innovative new system. Master a vast variety of spells—and break the world! A mystery-driven, hardcore deck-building roguelike with kana-based spellcasting, and bullet-hell action!

games.name: Lucky Tower Ultimate
games.short_description: Escape from an incredibly dangerous, randomly generated tower in a slapstick, roguelite adventure that looks like a cartoon and feels like a joke. Slashy slashy!

games.name: UBERMOSH Vol.3
games.short_description: The third volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH.

games.name: Dicefolk
games.short_description: 操控魔法骰子、組織強力奇美拉隊伍去阻止神秘魔物的暴虐吧！這是一個考驗戰術和技巧的輕度Rogue遊戲：身為一名奇美拉召喚師，你的職責就是招募各種奇妙的怪獸來創造屬於你的完美隊伍，透過獨特的骰子機制，指揮隊伍走向勝利。

games.name: Nordhold
games.short_description: 在這款融合了 Roguelite 機制和回合建造策略的塔防遊戲中建造並守護一座城市。選擇你的英雄、善用搭配的防禦塔升級並在程序生成的環境中參與壯觀的戰鬥。

games.name: Trip to Vinelands
games.short_description: Trip to Vinelands is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame.

games.name: 浣熊推幣機
games.short_description: 《浣熊推幣機》是一款讓人多巴胺狂飆、欲罷不能的萌系推幣機遊戲！將經典街機推幣機的混亂樂趣，與肉鴿卡組構建元素巧妙融合。組合各種特殊硬幣與強力道具，觸發爽度爆表的加乘效果。準備好被金幣淹沒，踏上這場停不下來的多巴胺派對吧～！

games.name: 毀滅協議
games.short_description: 把火熱槍管插入怪物咽喉！你獨自醒來，深空戰艦滿是扭曲的怪物與血跡。沒有援軍，只有戰鬥本能和一把槍。金屬通道在腳下顫動，怪物的嘶吼從四面八方襲來。開火、轟殺、前進——這是猛男獨屬的修羅戰場！體驗DOOM式暴力美學與肉鴿的完美融合，每一次通關都是對你意志的碾壓。深空無光，唯有槍火點亮你的命運！

games.name: Unclean Water
games.short_description: Unclean Water is an FPS roguelike action game where you must escape the sewers of Marlene. Defeat Night Moss assassins using precise strikes, defense, smashes, and shield bashes to exploit enemy openings. Unlock a variety of furniture and items to turn your endless challenges into ultimate success.

games.name: Museum Mystery: Deckbuilding Card Game
games.short_description: Museum Mystery 是卡牌构建和故事冒险的完美结合。成为博物馆的保安，平息活化的展品。探索不同时代的展厅，与艺术品对抗，打造属于自己的文物牌组，探寻所有的秘密！

games.name: 沙行者 (Sandwalkers)
games.short_description: 《Sandwalkers》是一款回合制類Rogue探索遊戲。組建你的團隊，走過形形色色、環境嚴峻的地方，面對多不勝數的險境，逐漸瞭解這個世界，最終救活母樹烏瑪瑪。

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.short_description: 用 12 號口徑霰彈槍玩俄羅斯輪盤。四人進入。一人離開。用你的性命賭一把運氣。祝你好運。

games.name: UBERMOSH:WRAITH
games.short_description: UBERMOSH:WRAITH is the fourth volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH.

games.name: Zorbus
games.short_description: Zorbus is a fantasy-themed, tile-based, turn-based, traditional roguelike game.

games.name: Dark Lord
games.short_description: 在《Dark Lord》中釋放你的力量，這是一款充滿策略、冒險和諷刺智慧的roguelike角色扮演遊戲。用鐵腕統治你不斷壯大的王國，加固要塞，還要避免被你的顧問從背後暗算！

games.name: THE SPIRIT LIFT
games.short_description: A retro horror deckbuilder roguelike set in a haunted hotel in the 1990s. Choose your teens, explore and fight! If you die rewind the night!

games.name: 水星潮
games.short_description: 《水星潮》是一款由卡牌推動的Roguelike角色扮演遊戲。你將扮演一名迷失於失落森林中的旅人。通過招募隊友、收集資源、合成物品、探索世界、擊敗敵人最終找到自己的歸途，或是揭開這個世界的秘密。

games.name: Gloomgrave
games.short_description: Gloomgrave is a roguelike turn-based dungeon crawler where you will explore, loot, and fight your way through the ever-shifting dungeon to defeat the evil that lies below.

games.name: Underboard
games.short_description: 戰術隨機冒險自動戰鬥，兼具主動和被動玩法風格。組建團隊，在充滿怪物的地圖中探索，構建協同效應，裝備物品並施放法術來支持你的團隊，在戰鬥中幫助他們逃離 Underboard。

games.name: NBA THE RUN
games.short_description: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

games.name: 戰魂銘人
games.short_description: 一款“拳拳到肉、箭箭穿心”的動作Roguelike遊戲。在這裡，你可以選擇多種角色、挑戰豐富關卡、通過技能與道具搭配打出獨特套路，體驗暢爽肆意的地牢砍殺！

games.name: Sword of the Necromancer
games.short_description: Help Tama to save Koko using the powers of the forbidden Sword of the Necromancer. Turn your foes into allies and reach the depths of the Necromancer's dungeon. Defeat the guardians to gain enough soul power to bring Koko back from the dead, no matter the cost.

games.name: Mewgenics
games.short_description: 透過策略培育打造最強貓咪軍團，並派牠們踏入充滿變化與挑戰的回合制冒險。在這款由《The Binding of Isaac》與《The End Is Nigh》作者打造的輕度Rogue戰術遊戲中，配置技能、收集道具、操控不同世代的基因，制定你的終極陣容。

games.name: ANIWARS: Call of the Void
games.short_description: ANIWARS is a challenging turn-based strategy roguelike. Assemble your squad, collect powerful items, conquer territory and dominate the enemy!

games.name: Blue Prince
games.short_description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

games.name: 迷魅狩獵
games.short_description: 一款玩家合作的生存恐怖遊戲。當詛咒之雨降臨時，會出現能完美模仿隊友的「擬態者（Mimesis）」，帶來前所未有的緊張與恐懼。

games.name: Poly TD / 波利塔防
games.short_description: 以肉鴿元素重新詮釋魔獸「隨機防守」的經典情懷。召喚獨特英雄，透過合成進化為更強大的存在。從聖女貞德、關羽到洛夫克拉夫特——超越時空的傳說英雄悉數登場！面對源源不斷的敵襲，證明你的最強陣容。

games.name: 失落城堡2
games.short_description: 失落城堡2是一款2D卡通橫版Rogue-Lite遊戲。探尋豐富寶物道具強化自己，精通各類武器玩出花樣，挑戰強大魔物展現實力。新的冒險正召喚著寶藏獵人們！

games.name: Stash: A Card Looter
games.short_description: Embark on a unique drafting adventure with an endless array of randomized cards inspired by classical ARPG-Loot. Transform your one-of-a-kind loot into powerful battle tactics! Take on enemy squads drafted by real players in a post-human world teeming with beasty conflicts.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.short_description: 深入《霓虹深淵2》美麗且危險的賽博神話世界！本作支援最多4人聯機遊玩，並將更多樣的戰鬥風格以及無窮無盡的道具協同效果。享受腎上腺素飆升的瞬間，探索每一場令人難忘的冒險吧！

games.name: Star Birds
games.short_description: 《Star Birds》是一款小行星基地建造與資源管理遊戲，風格活潑歡樂。玩家將探索並挖掘無數小行星、建造生產網路，引導你的星辰群鳥遨遊宇宙，在星際開疆闢土！

games.name: Limbus Company
games.short_description: As the Executive Manager of Limbus Company, lead your group of twelve Sinners, venture into the buried facilities of Lobotomy Corporation, and lay claim on the Golden Boughs.

games.name: QUICKERFLAK
games.short_description: QUICKERFLAK is an experimental fast-paced time-attack top-down combat retro-hardcore minigame, that can be finished in a minute.

games.name: Summum Aeterna
games.short_description: Summum Aeterna is a fast-paced Roguelite inspired by the Metroidvania Aeterna Noctis. Create your own worlds, challenges, difficulty and influences in each new run. Die, learn, become stronger, and achieve victory. Death is inevitable, but glory is only for the chosen.

games.name: 無限的迷宮城
games.short_description: 美少女 × 高達機甲，魔物殲滅戰迷宮正式開啟！成為具裝戰姬在無限變化的地牢中刷寶、升級、集結隨從。完美彈反、極限閃避、華麗連段，用浮游炮與雷射正面突破！在危機中不斷變強。每一次勝利都會解鎖新的技能和戰鬥方式，讓你的冒險之心持續燃燒，勇氣與笑容會伴隨你一路衝破所有難關，走向迷宮更深處的未知吧！

games.name: Nautical Survival
games.short_description: Captain an armed sea vessel to fight off hordes of oceanic terrors! Navigate between outposts to upgrade your boat, equip powerful weapons, manage your economy and hire crew members to your aid in this unique take on the survivors-like formula.

games.name: 超級滑刃戰士
games.short_description: 你被奪走了大部分的操作手段，每一次的輪迴中，滑動滑鼠去消滅怪物、破解知識鎖謎題、探索隱藏小路！在有限時間內到更遠的地方，發現世界的真相。

games.name: House of Necrosis
games.short_description: A turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.

games.name: 絕對魔權
games.short_description: 進入由Dotemu出品的原創Roguelite清版動作遊戲《絕對魔權》，化身塔拉姆大陸的流亡英雄，投身一場驚心動魄的戰鬥，從太陽王阿茲拉的手中奪回魔法。

games.name: Minos - 牛頭人迷陣
games.short_description: 《Minos - 牛頭人迷陣》是一款迷宮建造 roguelite，你將在其中扮演傳說中的牛頭人，且必須保護你的庇護所並抵禦嗜血的冒險家。不斷重新設計致命的迷宮、設置陷阱並讓那些有勇無謀的蠢貨成為你的下一個手下亡魂。

games.name: 蠕行的恐懼：克蘇魯選集
games.short_description: 這是我來到印斯茅斯的第十天，這裡的居民有些不對勁，在我和他們聊天時，有人會突然跪地禱告，禱告詞也很奇怪。比如，讚美克蘇魯，榮耀歸於古神等。我感覺我距離真相似乎越來越近了，但是我感覺越發不安。今天早上，我耳邊傳來了奇怪的囈語，聲音的來源似乎是從大海深處傳來，我想我可能聽錯了吧。今天的日記先寫到這裡，讚美克蘇魯，願古神保佑我。

games.name: 滾彈吧殭屍 Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes
games.short_description: 《滾彈吧殭屍》是經典彈珠、殭屍防禦與類 Rogue 風格的終極混搭！在成群殭屍與史詩級魔王戰中射擊、猛推再粉碎，一路前進。選擇你的英雄，成為彈珠巫師的時候到了！

games.name: Hollow Survivors
games.short_description: 在這款Rogue-Like迷宮探索遊戲中，殺出重圍、一路砍殺，突破無數可怕怪物的圍攻，勇闖高塔之巔。多種武器與升級選項任你選擇，拯救高塔的命運掌握在你手中。

games.name: Din's Legacy
games.short_description: Din's Legacy is an action RPG with mutating characters, set in a dynamic, evolving, fantasy world for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

games.name: Cursed to Golf
games.short_description: 《Cursed to Golf》是一款類高爾夫冒險遊戲，每一桿都至關重要。玩家的任務是衝出高爾夫煉獄，並成為高爾夫傳奇。遊戲中充滿了瘋狂的危險，超自然的強化能力以及無窮的可玩性。你將活著回到人間，還是會陷入……永遠打高爾夫的詛咒！ ？

games.name: Seed Hunter 猎源
games.short_description: Seed Hunter is a 2D Platformer with Roguelite element. You’re the alien finding the missing source around universe, but you get into some trouble on the planet of Earth.

games.name: Slay the Spire 2
games.short_description: 經典 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲回歸！在《殺戮尖塔 2》中打造獨一無二的牌組、遭遇奇異生物，並發掘蘊含強大力量的遺物！

games.name: LONE RUIN
games.short_description: 在這款非常值得重複遊玩的roguelike雙搖桿射擊遊戲中勇闖古老的魔法廢墟，去找尋其中的古代力量。優化法術，構築出終極組合來擊敗扭曲的畸形怪物，並朝著孤寂廢墟的更深處前進探索。

games.name: Only Climb: Better Together
games.short_description: Tired of sitting on the ground? Take a sky-high journey with your friends in Only Climb: Better Together! Touch the clouds with your own hands and find out what's behind them, but remember, there are no easy paths…

games.name: Sun Down Survivors
games.short_description: 《Sun Down》是一款有特色的 roguelike 倖存者類型遊戲。在跑步期間和跑步之間升級你的能力，你可以製作砲塔，收集做好戰鬥準備的寵物，併購買商店升級，以在四個變化的季節中生存成群的敵人。

games.name: Baldi's Basics Plus
games.short_description: Baldi's Basics® Plus is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

games.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
games.short_description: Umamusume: Pretty Derby, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!

games.name: Gem Defender: Soyjak Survivors
games.short_description: Follow Chud on his fight against Dr Soystein's 'jak army in this spine-tingling survival shooter. NOW FEATURING BADLANDSCHUGS

games.name: 鼠了也要吃
games.short_description: 這款街機遊戲節奏迅速又熱鬧，實現你的終極負鼠夢。在單人或本地合作模式中盡可能大吃特吃，但要小心：千萬別被人抓到！

games.name: 九王 9 Kings
games.short_description: 《九王》是一款快節奏的王國建造遊戲，玩家將建設王國，在戰場上與強大的敵方國王決一死戰。組合出打破成規的牌組，成為萬王之王！

games.name: Dyping Escape：生死敲定
games.short_description: 我想和你玩一場打字遊戲——《Dyping Escape：生死敲定》是一款簡單的打字遊戲，你只需要遵循「眼球」的指示，打出要求的句子即可。然而你所打出的內容，都會化作現實施加在你的身上。千萬別打出自己無法破解的指令，導致將電腦弄壞之類的後果。

games.name: Luck & Loot
games.short_description: Luck & Loot is a dice-building roguelike where you’ll craft and customize powerful dice, collect game-changing relics, and battle corrupted foes in brutal, turn-based combat across procedurally generated dungeons. Victory is earned in this unforgiving fight for survival.

games.name: Stackflow
games.short_description: Stackflow is a hypnotically addictive strategic roguelike about the pure pleasure of fitting pieces perfectly. Discover unique blocks, create satisfying connections, and trigger explosive combos that release pure dopamine.

games.name: 沙盒勇者
games.short_description: 白天採礦薅羊毛，中午蓋塔招傭兵，晚上守家坑魔王！極簡風沙盒生存遊戲，輕鬆上手、百玩不膩，準備好前排入住《沙盒勇者》精神時光屋吧！

games.name: 角鬥士血域 - Bloodgrounds
games.short_description: 《角鬥士血域》融合了戰術回合制戰鬥、策略經營、角色扮演以及輕度 Rogue 元素。你從殘酷的競技場深坑中殺出一條血路，如今成了富有的贊助人，現在你將招募、訓練並指揮一支強悍的角鬥士隊伍，帶領他們邁向榮耀，或是死亡。

games.name: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons
games.short_description: MISTROGUE 是一款「不可思議迷宮」風格的即時動作JRPG。故事背景設定在「活的地下城」中。玩家需要利用他們自行組合的最強技能構建，使用「迷宮石」隨意開闢出道路，以應對不斷湧來的陷阱和成群怪物。

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.short_description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE 是一款主打科幻矮人、外星異形以及漸進式生成的洞穴，可以 1 至 4 人同時遊玩的多人合作第一人稱射擊兼動作 Roguelite 遊戲。加入矮人菁英中的奪還者部隊，並從遭到大量致命的地核異種侵襲且危機四伏的採礦設施裡殺出一條血路。巖岩與頑石！

games.name: シューターズ レディ！
games.short_description: 「青春 x スポーツシューティング」がコンセプトの アーケードスタイルFPSゲームです。連続した部屋を素早く駆け抜け 点在するターゲットを倒しましょう。素早く 精密に 連続して倒すことが出来れば より高得点が狙えます。

games.name: 魔王將至 He is Coming
games.short_description: 在世界被遺忘的一角，黑暗勢力崛起—魔王即將再次回歸。運用聰明才智，尋找強力道具，在這款 Roguelite RPG 自走棋遊戲中面對即將降臨的災厄吧。

games.name: Champions of Breakfast
games.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter breakfast-hell.

games.name: Gnomes and Knights
games.short_description: Gnome hunting reaches a new level! Become a mighty knight and plunge into the world of dark fantasy without leaving your home.

games.name: 我在地府打麻将 - Demonic Mahjong
games.short_description: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!

games.name: Barony
games.short_description: Barony is the premier first-person roguelike with cooperative play! Adventure alone, or gather a party with iconic and unusual RPG classes to face off against the brutal dungeons. Test your resourcefulness, wits, and friendships, on your quest to lift the evil lich's curse!

games.name: Insider Trading
games.short_description: 《Insider Trading》是一款 roguelike 牌組製作遊戲，你將在其中掌控市場。搭配特效、操縱股市並做出精明的交易，否則你可能會輸得一塌糊塗。

games.name: UnderMine 2
games.short_description: Delve into the dangerous, ever-shifting labyrinth that is the Undermine. Discover, craft, and combine hundreds of unique items. Pair them with an ever-expanding roster of distinct playable characters for a new run every time! Grab a partner and uncover UnderMine 2's secrets together in local co-op.

games.name: 重裝嵐影:重生
games.short_description: 這是一款十分爽快的上帝視角roguelike射擊遊戲，玩家將駕駛機甲，探索異星邊境，享受「血腥大地（Crimsonland）+吸血鬼倖存者（Vampire Survivors）」的無盡殺戮！

games.name: BEERCRUSH
games.short_description: Enter the world of John Beer in this psychotic, fast-paced roguelike where you drink beer to stay alive! Dash as fast as you can through unique and crazy worlds to break the vicious cycle. So what are you waiting for!? LIVE LIFE. EVERY GOLDEN MINUTE OF IT!

games.name: Slaughter Horse 2
games.short_description: Use deduction, murder and trust your luck to eliminate the town council and rule over the helpless cartoon horses in a twisted strategy RPG.

games.name: They Don't Sleep
games.short_description: Eat, sleep, and shoot zombies in this survival simulator with roguelite elements. Battle to survive until you die and do it all over again. Level up your skills and keep your child alive as you fight to escape your wintry hell.

games.name: 超增稅都市
games.short_description: 全新遊戲體驗！？融合城市建設與 Roguelite 要素的《超增稅都市》。 從隨機抽出的設施清單中選擇喜歡的項目來建造吧！ 組合方式千變萬化！

games.name: 激射超新星
games.short_description: 在《激射超新星》中，你將利用各種高科技組件，搭建一個獨一無二的環形堡壘。每一個道具與組件的選擇都將決定你的生存策略和戰鬥風格。解鎖全新的組件，嘗試不同的組件配合，將會產生截然不同的化學反應。化身無情的彈幕機器，碾碎四面八方如潮水般來犯的敵群吧！

games.name: Ambition: A Minuet in Power
games.short_description: 18th century Paris - a city of love, lies and revolution. You are a woman of fashion trying to survive the political turmoil. Date a cast of unforgettable characters. Amass the wealth and respect you deserve. Engage in gossip that can alter the course of history, or lead you to the guillotine.

games.name: Still Not Dead
games.short_description: Still Not Dead is a challenging roguelite FPS that merges the fast satisfying gunplay of Doom with open stages, insane weaponry, tactical choice and being pursued by death itself. The unique blessing and curse system, plus unlockable skill skulls set the game apart from everything else.

games.name: Stick It to the Stickman
games.short_description: Stick it to the Stickman是一款物理格鬥遊戲，玩家得迎戰大量紅火柴人，當上主管。挑選數百種不重複招式，建構出完美戰鬥機器，在大企業裡殺出一條血路登頂。

games.name: Void War
games.short_description: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

games.name: Mycopunk — 真菌龐克
games.short_description: 在這款高度自訂、以任務為核心的掠奪射擊遊戲中，與成群結隊的真菌外星人交戰，殺出一條血路。數百種精心製作的升級、四人合作模式，還有一名有趣的蜚蠊角色，令人愛不釋手！

games.name: 深入矩陣
games.short_description: 在這款數碼龐克牌組構築類ROGUE遊戲成為絕世黑客；探索危險的末來世界，對抗邪惡的大企業。組裝、升級由強大程式構成的牌組，解鎖PERK和技能；憑著你的數碼地獄將敵人打得落花流水！潛入網絡世界吧！

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.short_description: 《Star Trek:Voyager - Across the Unknown》是一款劇情導向的生存策略遊戲，這艘經典星艦的命運掌握在你手中。親自掌舵，管理星艦和資源，並做出艱難決策。你能帶星艦和船員回到家園嗎？

games.name: Hero's Quest
games.short_description: Simple Roguelite RPG game with incremental progress

games.name: 地下城騎士團
games.short_description: 享受以奇幻世界為背景的派對制 Roguelike 橫向捲軸動作遊戲吧！每一輪使用獲得的金幣購買隊友、技能與裝備，不斷成長。透過玩家、種族與裝備之間產生的強大協同效果，瞬間擊敗巨大的怪物！

games.name: Conquest Tactics : Realm of Sin
games.short_description: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin is a dark-fantasy roguelite tactics game. Command your army and engage in turn-based battles on a hex-based board as you advance step by step to conquer a land shrouded in sin. Your choices carry weight: will you restore order… or allow eternal darkness to reign?

games.name: 矮人防線
games.short_description: 這一次，「塔 」們是矮人！《矮人防線》是一款容易上手，但深度十足的塔防遊戲。你需要合理布局你的矮人部隊，應對哥布林變幻莫測的進攻路線，布置陷阱，操控地形，與源源不斷來襲的哥布林展開殊死搏鬥。探索資源與遺物的聯動組合，堅守防線到最後一刻！

games.name: VOIN
games.short_description: 《VOIN》是一款由獨立開發者製作的第一人稱割草遊戲。在快節奏的戰鬥中擊敗千軍萬馬。探索充滿祕密且危機四伏的黑暗奇幻世界。發現強大的武器和裝備，在以淨化破碎之世界為目的的冒險中迎戰兇惡的首領。

games.name: Elin
games.short_description: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?

games.name: LOOTPLOT
games.short_description: Re-arrange items, discover synergies, bend the rules, and break the game! LOOTPLOT is a points-based, inventory builder Roguelite centered around items, which all have a unique twist.

games.name: Dungeon Dreams 2
games.short_description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

games.name: FISH FEAR ME
games.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.

games.name: Dungeon Warfare 3
games.short_description: 保衛您的神秘領地，抵禦無盡湧來的冒險者浪潮。重建失落的領域，打造毀滅性的防禦設施，並在這場終極塔防挑戰中迎接無休止的敵人進攻！

games.name: Champion Shift
games.short_description: Unleash mighty Champions in this thrilling co-op bullet heaven. Shift into battle, create builds with unique abilities, and battle endless enemies to stop the Dominion's path of conquest. Rev through high octane missions, conquer epic bosses, and become an absolute legend!

games.name: A Valley Without Wind 2
games.short_description: A modern take on the 16-bit era, A Valley Without Wind 2 blends a variety of mechanics across multiple genres, seamlessly bringing together the best qualities of old-school platform-shooters and turn-based strategy games.

games.name: 最終兵器鼠鼠
games.short_description: 飼養很像倉鼠的殲滅兵器【餅餅】，守護國家的末日國土防衛遊戲。摸摸鼠鼠，飼養鼠鼠，打倒逼近的敵軍，在這個溫柔的末日世界戰到最後吧。

games.name: Dice In You
games.short_description: A roguelike deck builder with dice. Fuse dice to create your own powerful custom dice, and aim for even higher scores!

games.name: Wedding Witch
games.short_description: 這裡有一個想嫁給你的女巫。她決定尋找魅魔的魔水來誘惑你。但是，充滿惡魔的迷宮森林擋住了她的去路…她能否找到魅魔的魔水，並擁有一個幸福的婚禮嗎？

games.name: Deadland Garden
games.short_description: Lin was a fledgling young detective. While investigating a girl disappearance case, she accidentally strayed into the Fallen Apartment. should she defeat dangerous enemies to find the truth, or sacrifice her body in exchange for more information? Everything is waiting for you to uncover...

games.name: 哥布林壽司
games.short_description: 哥布林當壽司師傅？為什麼不行！但要快，房租幾分鐘後就到期了！升級餐廳、菜單和食材，為你的哥布林同伴端上洞穴裡能找到的最棒、最昂貴的壽司！

games.name: Born Again
games.short_description: Hack-n-slash your way through the evil brewing in the Outer Realm! Stop the ominous Overlords in their tracks, but tread lightly, for every corner hosts a monster in waiting!

games.name: 靈能哨衛 : 無限 Psionic Sentry : Infinite
games.short_description: "靈能哨衛:無限"是一款第三人稱的美少女動作射擊Rougelike， 爽快但任何玩家都能上手的反擊系統是遊戲操作的核心， 在戰鬥中觀察敵人的弱點將其破除則是遊戲策略的重點。

games.name: Castle of no Escape 2
games.short_description: Explore 6 x 6 x 6 = 216 rooms of randomly generated hazards and enemies while collecting the necessary artefacts. Hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards — the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner.

games.name: Dino Path Trail
games.short_description: 在恐龍從未滅絕的蠻荒西部中求生存。 橫越致命的生態區域，對抗掠食者、亡命之徒與殘酷環境，踏上拯救被綁架妹妹的驚險之旅。 狩獵，或成為獵物——在這款冷酷無情的生存 Roguelike 遊戲中創造你的傳奇。

games.name: 彈珠地獄洛坎塔
games.short_description: 《彈珠地獄洛坎塔》是一款結合了Roguelike和彈珠玩法的RPG遊戲。你將扮演一名對抗財閥的反抗者，使用手中的彈珠，消滅潮水般的敵人，收集資源，不斷強化你的彈珠，拯救這個地獄中的世界！

games.name: CloverPit
games.short_description: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

games.name: 籠子
games.short_description: 籠子是一款合作恐怖遊戲，講述了在一個試圖吃掉你的籠子電梯中向下行進的故事。餵養電梯，避開陷阱和怪物，深入下降。

games.name: Buriedbornes - Dungeon RPG
games.short_description: 最古老不祥的預言如今變成了現實。 這是屬於「已死之物-Buriedbornes-」之間沒有結束沒有救贖的戰爭。

games.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track (一起開火車2：汽笛重鳴)
games.short_description: 《Unrailed》帶著更多手忙腳亂的鐵路協作挑戰回來了！在充滿了繽紛生態系與頭目的新世界選擇自己的道路吧。你可以永久升級角色與火車，甚至還可以分享自己製作的關卡，只要別讓你的火車脫軌就行了！

games.name: Ballionaire
games.short_description: BALLIONAIRE is a fast-paced, kinetic roguelike where strategy meets physics to create outrageous wealth! Find and exploit game-breaking synergies as you theorycraft your way to victory. Welcome to the autobonker genre!

games.name: 幽室鬼牌（Deck of Haunts）
games.short_description: 《幽室鬼牌》（Deck of Haunts）邀請你成為一棟惡意滿滿的鬼屋。引誘敵人走進你的詛咒大廳、操控他們的恐懼、汲取精魂，壯大你的力量。使用戰術打造你的宅邸，擴張你的暗黑影響力，將你的房屋變成一幢懾人卻逃不出的夢魘。

games.name: Swords and Sandals 3 Redux
games.short_description: A legend returns! The beloved classic Swords and Sandals 3 is back, re-forged in glory! Step back into the Gladiae Ultratus once more and prepare to take on the greatest gladiators in all Brandor. It's the hardest, most metal gladiator game ever made.

games.name: Heading Out
games.short_description: Flee your fear and carve your story. Blaze a trail across mythic American highways, where choices twist your tale and danger’s always in the rearview mirror. With roguelike routes, limited resources, and breakneck chases, this isn’t just a drive—it’s your legend in the making.

games.name: Superhero Simulator
games.short_description: Superhero Simulator is an open-world superhero game where you fight villains and save lives! But being a hero isn’t free! You’ll need to work, pay rent, and survive. Can you handle both sides of the superhero life?

games.name: 進擊羔羊傳說
games.short_description: 在假先知之境裡創立屬於自己的聖教，冒險深入多種神祕地區，建立忠誠追隨者的林地根據地，傳播你的真言，成為一個真正的聖教。

games.name: Auto Rogue
games.short_description: A roguelike where you automate combat. Combine skills and conditions to find your own optimal solution! No complicated controls at all!! Sit back with a coffee and watch the beautiful battles you've crafted unfold! Utilize a variety of skills, conditions, and relics to craft the ultimate build!

games.name: 故障星系 Galactic Glitch
games.short_description: 《故障星系》是一款以物理為核心的Roguelike射擊遊戲！抓起巨石，接住導彈，撕裂你的敵人——然後將它們作為彈藥使用！獲取新能力，解鎖新路徑，發掘秘密。從豐富的武器和能力中打造你的專屬構建，打破模擬世界的束縛！

games.name: Warriors of the Nile 2
games.short_description: Warriors of the Nile 2 is a fast-paced Roguelite strategy game. This time our Warriors are equipped with a more unique combat style. Freely choose the adventure route, use the skill tablets to strengthen characters, lead your squad to repel the Roman legion.

games.name: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.short_description: 在科幻生存類 Roguelite 遊戲《Let Them Come: Onslaught》中，撐過外星部落的無情攻勢。追求完美的構築與不斷擴增的技能武庫，是你成功的關鍵。

games.name: Feed the Deep
games.short_description: A lovecraftian roguelike. Dive into procedurally generated undersea caves. Collect gold, upgrade your equipment, and Feed the Deep.

games.name: 弈戰征途
games.short_description: 招募傭兵，融合特性，創造無限協同效應。踏上神秘的中世紀旅程，迎戰強敵與勇猛首領。簡單回合制規則亦暗藏深邃策略。組建終極小隊，主宰棋局，揭開龍珠的秘密。

games.name: Swordship
games.short_description: 「Swordship」是一款具備未來色彩、玩家必須透過閃電般快速的躲避以避免攻擊的遊戲。這款遊戲顛覆了以往傳統街機射擊遊戲，你可以透過閃躲、迂迴以及穿過敵軍的猛烈攻擊，來扭轉戰局與殲滅敵人。

games.name: 矮人軍團自走棋
games.short_description: 建立你的矮人軍團，消滅成噸的獸人吧！本作有着十分爽快的戰鬥體驗，並將RPG成長、Roguelike冒險和自走棋策略進行了巧妙融合，讓遊戲既有着輕快的節奏又擁有着豐富的策略深度，實乃上班摸魚、下班解壓的神器！

games.name: 惡魔牌
games.short_description: 《惡魔牌》是一款以多種撲克遊戲為靈感的卡牌策略 Roguelike 肉鴿遊戲。你將扮演末日酒館裡一位身懷絕技的牌手，透過搭配各種惡魔籌碼、顛覆出牌規則，與全球各地玩家一較牌技高下，最終登上巔峰，成為最強牌手！

games.name: Machick
games.short_description: 打敗高度武裝的反魔法蛙軍隊，解救森林免於毀滅。《魔法森林》是一款休閒遊戲，您可以打造自己的魔杖，消滅敵人，收集經驗，並選擇升級來繼續旅程。

games.name: 魔塔地牢
games.short_description: Randomly generated Magic Tower dungeons A strategy-based fixed-value Roguelike RPG

games.name: Arcane Rush
games.short_description: ARCANE RUSH: Epic Card Battles. Clash, strategize, dominate!

games.name: Conglomerate 451
games.short_description: Conglomerate 451 is a grid-based, dungeon crawling first-person RPG with roguelike elements set in a cyberpunk world.

games.name: Godstrike
games.short_description: Godstrike is a twin-stick shooter where time is your health and currency. Face off against ruthless bosses in tense, 1v1 showdowns as Talaal, the last Herald.

games.name: The Void Rains Upon Her Heart
games.short_description: Help her heart battle tough bosses in this Boss Rush, Bullet-hell with rogue-like elements. Fight through several randomly chosen boss battles leading up to a final battle. Each defeated monster will give her random gifts that power up her heart. Don't let her heart break!

games.name: PUMPKIN PANIC
games.short_description: COME TO THIS COZY FARM! Plant crops, take care of the plants, go fishing, or whatever you prefer, but have a good time! But be carefull, they say that strange things are happening in the area...

games.name: 我的牌更好！
games.short_description: 在這款充滿樂趣的Roguelike卡牌遊戲裡，成為遊戲場中最酷的小孩。用可愛的貼紙親手製作每張卡牌，在充滿驚奇的卡牌拉鋸戰中讓對手驚嘆不已！

games.name: Tower Factory
games.short_description: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

games.name: 超級幻想王國 Super Fantasy Kingdom
games.short_description: 快遊玩這款 Roguelite 類型的城市建造遊戲，重建你的王國，並探索生動的奇幻世界吧。在收成、建造、採礦、烹飪、熬煮和種植的過程中，還要運用獨特的守護者團隊，擊敗成群入侵的怪物。但若你的守護者們陣亡了，就要做好一切都將夷為平地的心理準備！

games.name: Fantasy Survivors
games.short_description: A rogue-lite where you fight thousands of creatures, unlocking characters and equipment, to challenge deeper levels. Team up with friends or go solo; all drops are instanced so you don't have to share. Satisfying gameplay combined with smart choices make one-more-run a no-brainer.

games.name: 再來一張
games.short_description: 《再來一張》是一款以撲克牌為基礎的肉鴿卡牌遊戲，你將穿越一家酒館，與各種各樣的人決鬥，不斷構建自己的牌組。但遊戲中不只有撲克牌，還有獨特功能的塔羅牌，節日賀卡，藏在袖子裡的A......從超過200張卡牌中構建自己的牌組，參與各種隨機事件，每一局都有不同的體驗。

games.name: 亡靈巫師2
games.short_description: 就像被黑魔法復活的死人一樣，死靈法師模擬器回來了！給予殭屍飛越群山和涉水渡河的能力，夜間探索完全生成的世界，白天擊退敵人部落。開展全新生命。

games.name: Three Kingdom: The Journey
games.short_description: Craft a legendary deck and lead your troops to protect the Kingdom for the glory of the Han Dynasty in this fast-paced deck-building strategy roguelike. The Kingdom is on the verge of disaster against the Yellow Turbans rebellion, and only you – and your skills as a general – stand in their way!

games.name: 棄種：叮叮與聖劍
games.short_description: 一部可以戰鬥的視覺小說。遊戲通過3個身份截然不同的人物視角，揭開了發生在赫爾大陸上的一場驚天陰謀，講述了一個黑暗但又不失希望的壯麗故事。在這個巨大的狩獵場中，你拼盡全力掙扎求存，然而到頭來，掌控你命運的卻另有其人。做出你的選擇，擁抱世界，或… 拋棄世界

games.name: 潛水員戴夫 DAVE THE DIVER
games.short_description: 歡迎來到以神祕藍洞為背景的海洋冒險遊戲【潛水員戴夫 DAVE THE DIVER】。 白天在美麗的海裡捕魚，晚上經營壽司店賺錢吧。 與各具特色的同伴故事一起展開的深海謎團，神祕又新奇的樂趣正在等著你！

games.name: KUNKUN Defender
games.short_description: KUNKUN Defender 是一款FPS + 塔防游戏，玩家需要在爆发病毒的不同地區抵抗僵尸入侵，直到直升機前來救援。

games.name: Bone To Gather
games.short_description: 「Bone To Gather" 是一款建立協同效應的動作 roguelike 遊戲。與一隊決心向魔王復仇的弱小骷髏踏上史詩般的旅程。招募具有獨特協同作用的骷髏頭來組成強大的團隊，並在通往最後決戰的途中與怪物戰鬥。

games.name: Withering Rooms
games.short_description: 「一款 2.5D 恐怖動作 RPG，遊戲舞台是一棟每天晚上都會不斷變化的維多利亞式豪宅。」

games.name: Slots & Daggers
games.short_description: A retro mini-roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

games.name: Bad North: Jotunn Edition
games.short_description: Bad North 是一款讓人着迷卻又殘暴的實時戰術 Roguelite 游戲。帶領您荒蕪島國裏生無可戀的子民抵抗維京入侵者。指揮您的臣民利用各島嶼的獨特地理優勢取得策略性優勢。一切都危在旦夕：失敗，就將眼睜睜看著你子民的血染紅土地。

games.name: Rogue
games.short_description: Experience the commercial port of the game that spawned a thousand 'Rogue-likes'. Venture into the Dungeons of Doom in search of the legendary Amulet of Yendor, and hopefully escape with your life! Randomly generated dungeons await you, full of nasty monsters, insidious traps, and glittering loot.

games.name: Dice Have No Eyes
games.short_description: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

games.name: Rogue Monster Rush
games.short_description: A unique Tower Defense game featuring Monster Collecting and Roguelike mechanics. Hatch, upgrade, and command a party of monster defenders, while unleashing player spells, to defend your base from the hordes of invading robots.

games.name: 夢之形
games.short_description: 《夢之形》是一款結合MOBA風格的動作Rogue-like遊戲。踏上夢境世界的冒險，編輯英雄的記憶，親自創造你想要的冠軍。你可以獨自面對所有困難，或者與朋友一起在最多四人的合作遊戲中遊玩。

games.name: NETHER HEROES
games.short_description: Immerse yourself in Nether Heroes, an intense action-platform roguelike game. Conquer challenging dungeons, face menacing creatures, and defeat powerful bosses on your epic adventure.

games.name: Battle Talent
games.short_description: Battle Talent is a challenging physics-based rogue-lite sword-fighting game, and now includes multiplayer mode, team up with friends to defeat enemies! You can create your own fighting style in a mega seamless procedural dungeon. With over 80 enemy variants, 100 weapons, and 60 perks.

games.name: 骰子阿瓦隆
games.short_description: 這是亞瑟王傳說中的神秘世界，在這場充滿魔法與冒險的旅程中，能決定妳能走多遠的是妳手中的股子和妳高超的策略。《股子阿瓦隆》是壹款充滿策略與快感的Roguelike股子構築遊戲，在遊戲中，妳投擲魔法的股子，打出強力的壹擊，令敵人落敗而逃。而妳將在壹次次的戰鬥與前進中完成妳的史詩任務。

games.name: 選技大亂鬥
games.short_description: 經典火爆的電子鬥蛐蛐來了，這是一款免費的多人PVP策略遊戲，融入了類Rogue和自走棋元素。玩家需要為自動戰鬥的英雄搭配合適的寶物和技能，最終擊敗所有玩家奪得冠軍。

games.name: Hangtime!
games.short_description: Hangtime! is a high-stakes volleyball roguelite where every rally hits like a boss fight. Chain explosive abilities, shut down evolving teams, and spike your way to the top — or lose it all in one play.

games.name: 黃昏特工小隊
games.short_description: 在鋼鐵與霓虹中，點燃最後的希望！ 《黃昏特務小隊》是一款回合製地牢探索類遊戲，在霓虹交織的未來，巨頭公司如同新的超級大國統治世界。你將指揮一支身懷絕技的特務小隊，深入企業控制下的高風險區域，掀起一場盛大的復仇，奪回屬於人類的未來！ （精翻中文籌備中！）

games.name: MythForce
games.short_description: MAJOR UPDATE 1.2: SKILL TREES! The wait is over—no better time to jump in than now! Pick your class & tailor your skill tree to match your ideal playstyle. Shake up the experience with Encounter System & Elemental Combos. Stronger, sleeker, and bursting with new thrills—MythForce is ready!

games.name: 迷你空管 Mini Airways
games.short_description: 迷你空管是一款極簡主義風格的實時管理遊戲。你將扮演一名忙碌的空中交通管制員。你需要指揮飛機起飛，引導飛機降落，指揮它們飛往目的地......最重要的是，避免相撞事故！倫敦、東京、上海、華盛頓——在世界各地的機場上，巧用獨特的跑道配置和各色道具，盡可能久地管理空域，展現你高超的指揮技巧。

games.name: Keeper's Toll
games.short_description: Delve into Keeper’s Toll, an action-packed roguelite brimming with challenge and despair. Survive against an onslaught of relentless hordes and grueling bosses with skill-based ARPG gameplay. Embrace the darkness and cleanse these cursed lands.

games.name: Zet Zillions
games.short_description: 《Zet Zillions》是一款劇情走向的類Rogue牌組製作單人遊戲，組合各類卡牌，引爆一顆又一顆星球！

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.short_description: 在這款獨特的 Roguelike 塔防遊戲中，建造並設計地形，同時抵禦外星入侵，保衛你的據點。從 30 位英雄中挑選，挺過敵人一波又一波攻勢，並升級各式破壞性塔樓來守住防線！

games.name: Cursorblade
games.short_description: Cursorblade is a bullet hell game where you play as the cursor, fighting your way through waves of enemies. Combine weapons and items to become more powerful with your own unique builds. Slash, dodge, upgrade, and repeat!

games.name: Outcast Tales: The First Journey
games.short_description: 組建一支個性鮮明、能力出色的小隊，觀看他們之間的關係逐漸展開。在《流浪者傳說：初踏旅程》中，體驗一場偉大冒險的開始。參與深刻的戰術戰鬥，做出艱難的決定，並選擇你自己的冒險——寫下屬於你自己的獨特流浪者傳奇！

games.name: Space Simulation Toolkit
games.short_description: Physics sandbox game that uses a graphics card as a supercomputer. Change the laws of physics, design mechanisms, create A-Life worlds and inhabit them with living beings, experiment with evolution and AI.

games.name: DungeonUp
games.short_description: 《無盡魔塔》是深受經典游戲《魔塔》啟發的隨機地牢解謎游戲。在游戲中，你扮演一個人類游俠，通過收集物品和選擇路徑，從最深的矮人地牢中殺出一條生路。

games.name: 學生時代
games.short_description: 《學生時代》是一款可自由構築的校園人生模擬器。你將在高度還原的中國校園中，從入學一路走到高考，與多個性格鮮明的同學一起成長，互相陪伴。你的養成和選擇，不但會決定你的人生，也會影響到朋友們的未來。

games.name: Bravery and Greed
games.short_description: 《Bravery and Greed》是一款 Roguelite 類型的地牢亂鬥清版動作遊戲，最多支援四名玩家遊玩。遊戲提供四種經典奇幻職業供玩家選擇，玩家將能享受深奧且完善的戰鬥系統，並可透過單機、線上或同時使用這兩種方式，和好友遊玩各式各樣的合作與競爭遊戲模式。不發財，就等死！

games.name: Darkest Dungeon® II
games.short_description: 《黑暗地牢2》是一場有去無回的Roguelike旅行冒險遊戲。組建隊伍，武裝馬車，穿越腐朽的大地，阻止末日浩劫，然而最大的威脅或許正是你的心魔…

games.name: Munchkin Digital
games.short_description: Kill the monsters & grab the loot in the classic card game!

games.name: 蒼色之光與魔劍鍛造師
games.short_description: 「儘管去嘗試吧，向著那煉獄的盡頭……」手執各式各樣的武器，勇闖千變萬化的迷宮，只為找回自己的記憶與這個世界的真相……Roguelike × 鍛造 × 類魂．回合策略制迷宮探索RPG

games.name: StarVaders
games.short_description: 駕駛強大的機甲，擊退外星入侵，在這款結合牌組構築與棋盤戰術的終極作品中奮戰！發掘能夠打破遊戲規則的強力連招、倒轉時間改寫命運，並在這款擁有無限可玩性的 Roguelike 遊戲中守護人類的未來。

games.name: 吸血鬼爬行者: 屠戮地牢的吸血鬼倖存者
games.short_description: 打出毀天滅地的連擊，閃電般地突破魔物多到數不完的地城吧！《Vampire Survivors》的系列新作——《Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard》是一款帶有 Roguelite 元素的休閒回合制牌組構築遊戲。快用你的手牌來發揮你那「超級無敵屌炸天的套路™」吧！

games.name: 登山花牌！　第二合
games.short_description: 我創建了一個任何人都可以玩的紙牌遊戲，它使用紙牌來爬山。為每場比賽選擇一張卡。沿途製作裝備，可以讓攀爬更加舒適。讓我們一起欣賞大山吧！

games.name: 你的老母
games.short_description: 《你的老母》是一款可互動的桌面陪伴體驗。《你的老母》可以讓你感受各種媽媽對孩子們多元、平等和包容的愛。

games.name: Octogeddon
games.short_description: You ARE Octogeddon, a massive mutant octopus with one mission: DESTROY the world! Grow more tentacles and evolve each of them into deadlier and deadlier weapons until you become the ultimate eight-legged killing machine!

games.name: None Shall Intrude: Descent
games.short_description: None Shall Intrude: Descent is a free Prologue version of None Shall Intrude. A roguelite deck-builder with tile-based combat where you become a powerful Raid Boss. Epic battles, intricate strategies, and the ever-present threat of heroic challengers seeking to vanquish your reign.

games.name: Pogostuck: Rage With Your Friends
games.short_description: 沿著彈簧單高蹺爬上一座夢幻的山，並沿途結交朋友。

games.name: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
games.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG in which you will explore a harsh planet teeming with terrifying monsters. Experiment with talent builds for 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment and other characters. Assemble a squad and learn the secrets of the planet Tenebris!

games.name: Buriedbornes2 - Dungeon RPG -
games.short_description: “最古老、最令人憎惡的預言已經成為現實。這對埋葬者來說是無休無止、無情的戰爭，軍隊可以永遠復興。” 期待已久的易於遊玩的回合製地下城角色扮演遊戲系列的續作終於來了！

games.name: Shrimp.io
games.short_description: A Shrimp Based Bullet Heaven. Kill creatures, Level up & pick from 3 upgrades to unalive thousands more.

games.name: Sentinel Girls2:Snezhinka
games.short_description: A fast-paced shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character by purchasing cards and hold the line against waves of hostile mechs as an employee of a private military company.

games.name: Wrongworld
games.short_description: Crash-landed on a surreal, low-poly world filled with freakish inhabitants, choose between permadeath and non-permadeath modes and embark on an epic (and ridiculous) survival adventure. Will you manage to stay alive as you unravel the mysteries of Wrongworld and search for a way home?

games.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
games.short_description: 身為天才鍊精術師的少女「諾亞」與貓「吉帕」，在神祕的古代遺跡中展開大冒險！ 能與40種以上的夥伴們一同拓展出原創連擊組合，且富含多樣化的遊玩要素，不論男女老幼都能輕鬆享受、樂在其中的動作遊戲！

games.name: Rogue Hex
games.short_description: 在 Roguelite 4X 中打好你的牌，征服世界。 探索神秘的土地，對抗野蠻人的侵襲，將你的石器時代帝國發展至星辰大海！

games.name: 法術小隊
games.short_description: 1-4人線上合作生存遊戲。與魔法師朋友擊敗黑暗生物。完成團隊目標，解鎖升級，創造法術協同。有友軍傷害的彈幕地獄中無人安全！快節奏Roguelite動作。

games.name: Darkblade Ascent
games.short_description: Fast paced First-Person Melee Roguelike RPG with randomly generated weapons and upgrades, unlockable new classes and persistent leveling. Hack and slash your way through atmospheric dark fantasy locations, unique monsters and bosses.

games.name: 傳說與戰術自走棋
games.short_description: 《傳說與戰術自走棋》是一款結合了Roguelike和自走棋元素的案頭角色扮演遊戲。 你將遇到許多性格各异的角色，並組建起 强大的怪物小隊，以應對一場場戰鬥，戰鬥是自動進行的，但你的決策始終是勝負的關鍵！

games.name: 縱橫命途
games.short_description: 縱橫命途是一款風格獨特的RPG卡組構築遊戲，以快節奏的策略戰鬥為特色，可收集大量的卡牌並且發揮協同作用。在內容豐富的Roguelite模式和令人耳目一新的交錯式的冒險中帶來該類型的精華。探索、升級、製作新的卡牌並構築出完美的牌組，開闢自己的勝利之路！

games.name: Dark Quest 3
games.short_description: A rogue-lite tabletop that mixes card based exploration with turn based combat. Create your party, draw adventure cards, roll dice and fight monsters to defeat the sorcerer and his magic.

games.name: Incremental Epic Hero 2
games.short_description: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!

games.name: Lethal Dungeon
games.short_description: Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

games.name: Sifu
games.short_description: 《Sifu》是一款寫實風格的第三人稱格鬥遊戲，緊湊的功夫戰鬥系統與電影式的武打動作體驗，將帶領你踏上復仇的征途。

games.name: 蜀末：血月三國
games.short_description: 這是一款有點復古又創新有趣的Roguelike卡牌遊戲。化身蜀將，拿好寶物，收集卡牌。每一局都可以構建出獨一無二的卡牌與寶物組合，打敗你的敵人，改寫歷史！

games.name: Ord.
games.short_description: Ord. tells stories three words at a time.

games.name: Unfair Flips
games.short_description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

games.name: 十三州行動：三國搜打撤
games.short_description: 搜索、交戰、撤離、摸大紅，改天命！在十三州的三國世界中，你將與龍女締結約，穿梭亂世碎片。像素騎砍大地圖下，搜寶打怪、動作群戰、背包管理，每次深入都是豪賭，生死只在一念之間。命運並非注定，拼盡全力，在歷史洪流中書寫屬於你的結局

games.name: 鐵鎚守衛英雄傳2
games.short_description: 這款rogue-lite動作角色扮演遊戲提供很豐富的永久進度。建造你自己的城鎮、升級並裝備你的英雄，最後孤身或和朋友們一起組隊踏入千變萬化的黑暗城堡。

games.name: Space Prison
games.short_description: Survive the galaxy's toughest prison and rise to the top of a space gang! Explore, fight, craft, trade and learn convicts' stories to escape the facility. Space Prison is a turn-based tactical survival game with deep strategy and social RPG elements.

games.name: 荒野槍巫
games.short_description: 《荒野槍巫》是一款線上沙盒生存遊戲，能讓 1 至 4 名玩家在魔法世界中探索充滿危險生物與玄奧謎團的荒野。不論是獨自踏上旅途，或是和朋友同行，玩家都能盡情探索未知，同時收集和製作各種物品，為自己的巫師好好打扮一番。

games.name: 魔女黏糊笔记
games.short_description: 这是一款结合卡牌与骰子的roguelike游戏，通过卡组构筑，在战斗中拼点尽可能无损耗地击败敌人。 魔女缪可苏带着她的笔记来到了一个魔物洞窟面前，你将在这里遇到各种各样的魔物，以及魔物娘！将她们击败，或是被她们击败吧！

games.name: Nebel Geisterjäger ~ 第零羔羊
games.short_description: 一個男主視角的遊戲。玩家需通過各種手段，如心跳監測與監控攝像，獲得情報，避免女友被上司所騷擾。與無良上司之間的互動將根據你的選擇產生變化。遊戲中有5種結局及多次遊玩的支持，你能確保女友加奈的安全嗎？在這個除靈、公司陰謀和個人選擇的現代背景下，這不僅僅是與邪惡的戰鬥，還有與內心欲望的鬥爭。挑戰自己，保護你的情侶關系。

games.name: 汽水俠
games.short_description: 汽水就是拋瓦! 在《汽水俠》中化身超級汽水俠，捏爆汽水罐，用汽水的力量對抗邪惡外星人！在充滿未知的宇宙中，探索神秘星球，蒐集稀有汽水，打造專屬的汽水武器，體驗暢快淋漓的潑水射擊快感！

games.name: Dice Legends
games.short_description: Dice Legends is a roguelike deckbuilder with RPG elements in which you become one of 3 heroes, use unique dice to activate cards, and unleash lethal combos to defeat hordes of enemies. Explore the world, collect epic loot, and uncover the mystery of the Last Human — the mage who changed the world!

games.name: 塔獵手 ~艾爾莎的試煉~
games.short_description: 《魔塔獵人》是壹款融合了roguelike、類銀河戰士惡魔城核心要素，並采用卡通渲染風格來呈現的作品。和Erza壹起去探索那神秘的巨塔吧，消滅變異的魔物，戰勝BOSS，獲得獵人執照，成為最強大的戰鬥少女!

games.name: Wizard of Legend 2
games.short_description: 在這款節奏快速、輕度類《ROGUE》的好評遊戲續作中，面對危險的魔法試煉，最多可提供4人合作遊玩，還有華麗的全新3D視覺效果。掌握新的奧術與元素，實驗各種法術組合，追求不朽，成為傳說巫師！

games.name: Lobotomy Corporation | Monster Management Simulation
games.short_description: A roguelite monster-management simulation inspired by the likes of the SCP Foundation, Cabin in the Woods, and Warehouse 13. Order your employees to perform work with the creatures and watch as it unfolds; harness greater energy, and expand the facility

games.name: Coffee Caravan
games.short_description: 在行動咖啡車展現您的熱情！身為一位老闆，您將透過烹煮咖啡及嘗試各種食譜，一步步地打造您夢想中的行動咖啡館！在這款Roguelite的旅途中，您將遇到各式各樣的顧客，或是逛逛商店看看最新的食譜書及設備。您能克服這一路上的各種挑戰嗎？

games.name: 死亡呼嘯
games.short_description: 精通方格式戰鬥，挑戰死亡。在這開放世界卡牌構築遊戲中，進入陰鬱的靈界。以 160 多張的卡牌打造致命牌組、取得強力圖騰，並在戰術方格戰鬥中擊敗敵人。化身為絕望的獵人 Ro ，努力奮戰，將兒子從生死帷幕中救出。

games.name: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator
games.short_description: 在詭異且不斷演進的宇宙中買賣及交易器官。在這款科幻背景的肢體恐怖兼市場經營遊戲中，深入由跳動的器官構成的外星資本主義，而你可能超乎想像地無法自拔。

games.name: 機兵大亂戰
games.short_description: 《機兵大亂戰》是一款Roguelite動作遊戲，你將操縱人型仿生機器人“動力兵”，以及超重型“機甲”，橫掃如潮水般湧來的敵人。隨著不斷遊玩將會變得越來越強大的動力兵和機甲，均可隨你定製。享受將大量敵人華麗地一掃而空的樂趣吧。

games.name: 黑色童話：夢境倖存者
games.short_description: 這是一款可以全程單手操作的俯視角自動射擊roguelike遊戲。玩家扮演墮入夢境中的鼻諾曹，在夢境中收集各式各樣蘊含禁忌力量的夢卵，以獲取千變萬化進攻與生存的能力。在無盡的夢魘中盡情屠戮那些變異的童話主角們吧！

games.name: 小女巫倖存者
games.short_description: 《小女巫倖存者》是一款魔法肉鴿彈幕射擊遊戲。你將扮演小女巫，召喚並指揮八位獨特的魔法守護使並肩作戰！每位守護使都擁有雙技能，可在裝備槽位中自由切換策略－編織屬於你的魔法奇蹟！透過孵化魔蛋與合成進化可培育出高階守護使！

games.name: 將熄之焰 The Last Flame
games.short_description: 天下英雄盡入彀中！《將熄之焰》是一款主打英雄收集的自走棋遊戲，遊戲世界中散落著擁有各種不同能力的英雄豪傑，你需要招募他們，合理利用不同英雄的各自屬性效果，再搭配合理的戰鬥策略以及帶上強大的武器裝備，方有可能征服四方！

games.name: Ship of Fools
games.short_description: 《Ship of Fools》是一款航海 Roguelite 合作遊戲，玩家將扮演愚人族 (Fools)，他們是唯一傻到敢挑戰海洋的人。由於過去保護著群島的大燈塔毀壞了，一場飽含惡意和腐壞的風暴即將來臨。

games.name: 江城大贏家
games.short_description: 未來世界，金融體系轟然崩塌，舊有的秩序蕩然無存。 【彩票】成為生活物資的來源，【幸運】更是唯一的財富。 你，作為一無所有的打工人，在這個命運天定的世界中，能否憑藉勇氣與智慧，靠著天降的【幸運系統】，從默默無聞的底層登上令人豔羨的財富之巔？

games.name: Forest Heroes
games.short_description: Forest Heroes combines defense gameplay with roguelike deck-building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

games.name: Morsels
games.short_description: 《Morsels》是一款快節奏的輕肉鴿類怪獸收集遊戲，玩家可以隨意切換遊戲角色。在這段驚險刺激的奇妙旅程中，你將在下水道裡奮力突圍，從貓軍團的阻擊中逃出生天。

games.name: Brutal Orchestra
games.short_description: Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into Purgatory finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.

games.name: Cat Bait
games.short_description: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.

games.name: 星界戰士
games.short_description: 《星界戰士》（原名：星座上昇）是一款以現代幻想世界為背景的2D平臺rogue-lite遊戲。作為4個性格迥異的英雄之一，你必須設法從花園逃離，這個大花園是一座由12個强大且邪惡的boss守護的星界監獄，另稱“十二星宮”。

games.name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
games.short_description: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

games.name: Tangy TD
games.short_description: Strategic tower defense where you play a witch, place class-based towers, equip them with items that grant powerful abilities, combine them, create unique builds & deal ridiculous amounts of damage! Customize your builds with a deep stat system and giant skill tree!

games.name: Ratropolis
games.short_description: 鼠之城邦是壹款使用卡牌來保衛城市，防禦敵人攻擊的遊戲。特別的是，遊戲具有即時戰略的特性，所以為了防禦即將到來的敵人，需要快速的判斷力和爆發力。通過遊戲獲得並使用卡牌來建設您的鼠之城邦吧!

games.name: SOVL: Fantasy Warfare
games.short_description: SOVL is a ruleset for playing fantasy wargames. It can be played with miniatures on a table or digitally on Steam.

games.name: Mortal Glory 2
games.short_description: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike. Find the best recruits, discover powerful item combinations and come up with clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!

games.name: Inkulinati 神筆談兵
games.short_description: 《神筆談兵》是一種源於中世紀手稿的筆墨策略遊戲。在這種手稿中，兔子的屁股可能比狗的劍更致命。成為活用墨水的大師、打造自己的半獸人、擊敗中世紀的強人，並收集特長來釋放隱藏力量。

games.name: Lenna's Inception
games.short_description: The legendary hero is dead, and a strange glitch is spreading across the kingdom. Explore dangerous dungeons, and defeat the eight archangels to restore order to an unraveling world in this epic action-adventure RPG.

games.name: SENTRY
games.short_description: 《SENTRY》是塔坊式第一人稱動作遊戲，玩家需要守衛自己的太空船，抵禦外星人入侵。除了要在危險的太空中規劃逃生路線，還必須在太空船上活用各種陷阱、炮台和破壞環境來迎戰敵人。

games.name: Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood
games.short_description: Slash and survive a typical workday as Dracula's overworked and underappreciated servant! You'll have a bloody good time as you rampage through New Orleans to find fresh victims for your narcissistic boss.

games.name: 不思议迷宫
games.short_description: Embark on a free, exciting roguelike adventure with Gumballs & Dungeons! Collect and find hundreds of Gumballs, all with their own unique abilities, and create a synergistic team to tackle procedurally generated dungeons, discovering secrets and a trove of easter eggs as you explore!

games.name: Harbinger
games.short_description: Blast, slide, and tear through waves of monsters in Harbinger's retro-inspired combat, a free boomer shooter bringing '90s combat into the modern era. Fight through waves of enemies in brutal arenas and regroup at the tavern to upgrade your arsenal.

games.name: 銀河灰暗角落
games.short_description: 《銀河灰暗角落》是一款公司外勤題材的太空策略肉鴿：你將帶著私人艦隊出勤，透過戰鬥與抉擇為己謀利。打撈物資、擴大艦隊、改裝武器，滾起戰力。 打不過就撤並不丟臉——但損耗扣款會寫進賬單；在銀河的灰暗角落，人是死是活，只看成本。

games.name: 無盡星火 (Star Fire: Eternal Cycle)
games.short_description: 這是一款橫板闖關+肉鴿元素的動作遊戲！兼具爽快打擊感與策略構築深度！ 每一次冒險都是全新的開始！ 你，準備好迎接挑戰了嗎？

games.name: Void Scrappers
games.short_description: 將成群的外星飛船轟炸成垃圾。通過搜集廢料升級你的飛船，讓其擁有不可阻擋的毀滅性力量。解鎖新的角色和武器，並且在關卡之間升級你的飛船屬性。

games.name: SWARMRIDERS
games.short_description: SWARMRIDERS is a FREE "endless runner"+"twin stick shooter" ARCADE mashup. A "machine gun swarm surfing minigame" made as a bonus content for the UBERMOSH community.

games.name: Antivirus PROTOCOL
games.short_description: Antivirus PROTOCOL 是一款關於消滅病毒的增量遊戲。學習並適應，收集數據，升級自己，消滅已經佔領世界的病毒。

games.name: Increlution
games.short_description: Survive the ever increasing pressure of time for as long as you can! A minimalistic incremental game about time management that takes inspiration from roguelite games, with a focus on meta-progression. Every generation has a better chance at survival, because previous lives influence its instincts

games.name: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
games.short_description: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

games.name: 魔塔少女
games.short_description: 《魔塔少女》是一款融合了爬塔和Roguelike的美少女自走棋遊戲。玩家將招募各式各樣的隨從，搭配不同的流派和陣容，去往數個未知的關卡，和實力強勁的敵人戰鬥，養成自己的冒險團陣容。和美少女同伴一起，踏上前往黑神塔的危險旅途。

games.name: Sword of the Necromancer - Prologue
games.short_description: Help Tama to save Koko using the powers of the forbidden Sword of the Necromancer. Turn your foes into allies and reach the depths of the Necromancer's dungeon. Defeat the guardians to gain enough soul power to bring Koko back from the dead, no matter the cost.

games.name: AI Roguelite
games.short_description: World's first RPG in which all entities are AI-generated and all game mechanics are AI-directed.

games.name: 黑夜刀鋒：倖存者
games.short_description: 這不是一個人的獵殺。當月蝕降臨，暗夜化為戰場，你是命運選定的吸血鬼新王。在《黑夜刀鋒：倖存者》中，召喚各具魅力的魔仆小弟，編織你的刀鋒獵群。揮動噬血鐮刀，以敵人鮮血，澆灌不朽王座，向黑夜宣告誰才是真正的主宰！

games.name: 死而符生
games.short_description: 《死而符生》是一款將老虎機玩法和牌組構建相結合的Roguelite遊戲。在這片被絕望侵蝕的大地上，你將持有多本符文秘典，操縱符文匹配連接以擊敗敵人。搭配好各類遺物，用驚天動地的大數字碾碎那些腐朽的黑暗爪牙。

games.name: 漫遊祕境 - Into the Emberlands
games.short_description: 勇闖餘燼之地，揭開變化無窮的世界，這裡充滿驚奇的邂逅和神秘生物！拯救在瘴氣中迷路的村民，收集資源，重建村莊，為居民打造安全的避風港。

games.name: The Last Case of Benedict Fox Definitive Edition
games.short_description: Take on the last case of Benedict Fox and dive into a twisted world of secret organizations, forbidden rituals, and cold-blooded murders. Explore the memories of deceased victims as you search for clues and fight demons in this fantastical Lovecraftian Metroidvania.

games.name: Knights in Tight Spaces
games.short_description: 控制環境、集結團隊、構築最佳牌組，在奇幻世界中披荊斬棘，戰勝一眾惡徒和超自然勢力。戰鬥場面流暢瀟灑，淋漓盡致展現你的戰術選擇和卡組構建實力。

games.name: The Doors of Trithius
games.short_description: The Doors of Trithius is an open-world RPG roguelike. Engage in tactical turn-based combat in a living world of warring factions, wandering behemoths, and ancient magic. Level your skills, cook, craft, and explore dungeons. Will you follow the story, or let adventure be your guide?

games.name: Dome Keeper 穹頂守護者
games.short_description: 走進獨樹一格的類Rogue採礦動作遊戲，抵禦一波接一波外星怪物的攻擊。挖掘資源，收集實用裝置並升級裝備，不斷提高你存活下來的可能性。切記，要在穹頂被摧毀前及時趕回來！

games.name: 輪盤英雄
games.short_description: 《輪盤英雄》是一款超休閒的牌組構築類Rouge遊戲。在無法停止的幸運旋轉中，解鎖、構築陣容，巧用策略與隨機性打出驚人的分數。一次次拉杆後，贏得屬於你的爽快勝利。

games.name: 末日电涌 Rogue Voltage
games.short_description: 工程類肉鴿遊戲。透過連接電路構建你的連擊。建造瘋狂的機器來電翻怪物，觸發令人滿足的連鎖反應。發現毀滅性的協同效果，創造超強的構建。

games.name: Conquest of Elysium 5
games.short_description: Conquest of Elysium 5 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

games.name: The King is Watching
games.short_description: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run

games.name: 杀戮之源 / Rising Hell
games.short_description: 讓你腎上腺素迸發的爽快動作和重金屬音樂！《殺戮之源(Rising Hell)》是一個垂直地圖的平臺動作rogue-lite遊戲，撕碎嗜血魔物，衝破變幻莫測的地獄！

games.name: Whimsical Artefacts
games.short_description: A co-op friendslop game with a heavy focus on customization via drawing. Scavenge liminal bunkers and obtain artefacts that may or may not aid you and your friends.

games.name: 魔域之书
games.short_description: 迎接具有獨特機制的Roguelike牌組構築遊戲的挑戰。它由《Faeria》 的開發者和《Magic: The Gathering™》的創造者Richard Garfield打造。組建一支由兩名英雄組成的隊伍，釋放強大的連攜技，並擊敗Roguebook的傳奇！

games.name: Into the Necrovale
games.short_description: Into the Necrovale is an Action RPG in which you collect powerful items that interact with one another. You must be clever with your build if you hope to pierce the mysteries and dangers of the Necrovale, where a thousand generations of miscreants and criminals have been banished.

games.name: 鋼鐵巨像 機甲覺醒
games.short_description: 快節奏俯視角機甲射擊游戲！利用眼花繚亂的操作，在槍林彈雨中殺出一條血路。

games.name: 我是BOSS (Noobs Are Coming)
games.short_description: 你就是最終BOSS！殘酷的協同競技場Roguelike。選擇你的最終BOSS角色，裝備BOSS招式，並組合海量攻擊，打造獨特Build。單人或合作遊玩！

games.name: Subway Exorcist Girl
games.short_description: A subway train plagued by strange occurrences. A part-time exorcist girl arrives to confront the supernatural chaos, with the unknown ahead.

games.name: Rogue Waters
games.short_description: 《Rogue Waters》是一款戰術性回合制的 Rogue-lite 海盜遊戲。扮演卡特船長，指揮您的船隻和船員，透過隨機產生的遭遇戰來尋求復仇。招募、訓練並升級船員，利用強大的海怪參與激烈的海戰和肉搏戰，以取得優勢。

games.name: 牆世界2
games.short_description: 在神秘的世界之牆中，精彩絕倫的冒險仍在繼續。駕駛機械蜘蛛進入巨牆內部：探索神器和技術，升級外骨骼戰衣和蜘蛛，與深處的怪物戰鬥，發現暗藏的真相！

games.name: 苦手傳奇 Nigate Tale
games.short_description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated labyrinthic castle in this rogue-like dungeon crawler, set in a vibrant and colorful anime world. You’re lost in a spiritual realm, but powerful monster girls will help you get back home with new powers and weapons if you bring them the right presents!

games.name: BodyRecords
games.short_description: BodyRecords is a chilling horror experience, blending bodycam immersion,microphone sensitivity to your voice, and eerie spaces. Work together with teammates to solve puzzles, evade lurking horrors, and escape. True cooperative play and unsettling atmosphere make every moment a tense challenge.

games.name: Nubby's Number Factory
games.short_description: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

games.name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
games.short_description: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena.

games.name: Ember Knights
games.short_description: 《Ember Knights》是輕度 Rogue 動作遊戲，由 1 到 4 名玩家扮演傳奇騎士，對抗瘋狂巫師普萊奇斯和他忠貞的惡魔大軍，為宇宙帶來最後一線希望。使用各種武器和技能，透過能夠改變局面的聖物發揮協同效果，並保護宇宙免於普萊奇斯的破壞。

games.name: The Wandering Village
games.short_description: 在漂泊的巨獸背上建設村落，在充滿敵意，卻無比美麗的後啟示錄世界中譜寫牧歌。我們要重建家園，與巨獸相依為命，但面對汙染了整個星球的劇毒植物，我們能否獲得一線生機？

games.name: 最後的咒語
games.short_description: 《最後的咒語》是一款兼具回合制戰棋、基地建設和Roguelite隨機元素的策略RPG遊戲。在夜晚，操控你的英雄小分隊擊退如潮的敵人；在白天，指揮建設城鎮，鞏固防禦工事。末日將至，用你的智慧和力量守衛人類最後的避風港！

games.name: Dungeon Clawler
games.short_description: Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your deck, grab weapons and items from the claw machine to battle enemies, discover powerful perks that create game-changing synergies and unleash crazy combos as you fight your way through the dungeon!

games.name: Dream Quest
games.short_description: Play cards! Kill monsters! Level Up! Dream Quest is a roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the likes of Ascension, Magic: the Gathering, and Shandalar. Explore randomly generated levels as one of 13 classes in short, 30 minute, sessions.

games.name: Jump Space
games.short_description: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

games.name: 黑白之地
games.short_description: 《黑白之地》是一款能給你帶來快節奏體驗的多人彈幕射擊遊戲，在持久的BOSS戰中積累經驗、獲取裝備，與其他玩家並肩作戰，戰勝BOSS！

games.name: Maktala: Slime Lootfest
games.short_description: An incremental game where you kill hordes of slimes and use their loot to become stronger and farm them. Collect powerful loot, master skills, and uncover tons of content.

games.name: Forgotten Mines
games.short_description: Wreak vengeance and retake lost mines from goblins, orcs, skeletons, and demons in this small-scale tactical roguelite RPG. Build the perfect expedition team and turn the underworld red with each challenging, fast-paced run.

games.name: Mega City Force
games.short_description: 一款懷舊風的技巧流Roguelike遊戲。扮演一名硬漢員警，以最直截了當的方式打擊犯罪、維護和平。選擇一名警官，並從海量武器中挑選趁手的武器；靈活運用特殊技能，定義你的戰鬥風格。用強硬的手段對抗敵人和頭目吧。法律不會對奸惡之徒手下留情。

games.name: 風暴之城 Against the Storm
games.short_description: 這是一款暗黑奇幻風格的城市建造遊戲。玩家在遊戲中面對災變的同時，還須擔起重建文明的使命。身為女王的總督，你將帶領人類、海狸、狐狸、蜥蜴與鳥身女妖們開疆拓土，為文明的遺民們建構嶄新的未來。

games.name: UnReal World
games.short_description: The cult classic open-ended wilderness survival roguelike taking place in the ancient North, iron-age Finland. Throughout the years, UnReal World has been praised for its incredible depth, realism, atmos and immersion. Lose yourself in the most intricate, detailed and enchanting iron-age game world.

games.name: A Work of Art
games.short_description: A dark, witty, psychological thriller in the horror genre, A Work of Art presents a 1-2 hour story-driven experience with Visual Novel features and RPG elements. Follow a colorful cast of quirky characters through a twisted tale of beauty and darkness; All to the sound of a Dark Original soundtrack.

games.name: Winnie's Hole
games.short_description: 與小熊維尼一起從體內展開全新冒險！扮演他體內的病毒。捕獲細胞進行突變，構築技能牌組，在連招導向的戰鬥中釋放強大威力。這是一款融合多種類型的Roguelike遊戲，講述黑暗卻迷人的故事。擁抱靈魂深處的不適感——有時我們難免會被視為怪物……

games.name: Hell is Other Demons
games.short_description: Hell is Other Demons is an action-platform shooter, with Roguelite elements. Explore a sprawling, hand-crafted world full of demons, insanely over-the-top boss fights, and a heavy synthwave soundtrack.

games.name: Just Click The Button
games.short_description: In "Just Click The Button," you do indeed, click on a button. The more you click, the more the game evolves. Select new abilities that align with your playstyle. Decide whether to attempt to beat the game after reaching a certain threshold or play indefinitely!

games.name: 永夜之圍
games.short_description: 在這款著重策略元素的類Rogue牌組構築遊戲中，徵募並訓練部隊，在每場電光石火的戰鬥中克敵制勝。暗潮洶湧的城市中須步步為夷，你是否能克服一切凶險，乘載人類的燈火向前邁進？

games.name: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
games.short_description: 背景設定於《龍與地下城》宇宙的合作戰術角色扮演遊戲。開啟一場奇幻桌遊冒險。你的冒險就應依你的步調進行。

games.name: FORCED SHOWDOWN
games.short_description: Deckbuilding empowers this challenging bullet hell adventure! Each character is a unique experience: Choose a deck of unlockable cards to boost you in new ways every battle - "My whirlwind shoots fireballs!?". Battle hordes of brutal foes to become a superstar in C-SAR’s ever-changing game show.

games.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.short_description: 《女巫面紗》是一款 roguelite 風格的策略角色扮演遊戲，採用回合制戰斗並有多條可供選擇的前進路線。本作以《失落的精靈》的世界為舞台，讓玩家可以靈活地組建五人小隊，在提升等級的過程中選取技能，以適應每一場獨一無二的遊戲。願眾神護佑那些智勇雙全的人。

games.name: Rune Coliseum
games.short_description: A deck-building roguelike game with unique semi-real-time combat system. Step into the shoes of an ancient gladiator and do your best to survive in the coliseum. Combine various skills and equipment, develop your own fighting style, and defeat all the enemies to become the next champion!

games.name: Slime 3K: Rise Against Despot
games.short_description: Welcome to Slime 3K, an unhinged roguelite bullet-heaven set in the Despot’s Game universe! Build a deck of crazy weapons, grow stronger and devour hordes of pink puny humans as a murderous jelly blob on a warpath of death, violence and pretzels.

games.name: GODBREAKERS
games.short_description: 透過暴力又流暢的戰鬥系統掌控每一場戰鬥，連續打出強力連擊、在攻擊中途取消動作持續進攻，甚至奪取敵人的技能，反將他們的力量用於對付原本的主人。你也可以與最多三位好友組隊，打造完美隊伍配置，在不同世界中挑戰兇猛殘暴的頭目，攜手擊潰強敵。

games.name: ROUNDS
games.short_description: Rounds is a 1v1 rogue-lite shooter where each round gets more intense. The losing player of each round unlocks clever upgrades to create a better build to counter their opponent.

games.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
games.short_description: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler that's simple to start but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use.

games.name: 溶鉄のマルフーシャ
games.short_description: A high-tempo shooting game with simple controls! Upgrade your character with cards and defend the gates from your enemies.

games.name: Force Reboot
games.short_description: Force Reboot is a fast-paced FPS with rogue-lite elements. Force Reboot is entirely focused on nonstop gameplay. You need to get past all of the rooms as fast as you can.

games.name: UBERMOSH
games.short_description: UBERMOSH is an arcade game about cutting bullets with a sword, in a gun-filled cyberpunk mosh pit.

games.name: 墨境
games.short_description: 《墨境》是一款水墨風動作Roguelite遊戲。在獵殺狐妖的過程中，你意外發現自己只是短篇小說集《墨境》中虛構的角色，只有打敗神秘的書靈，才能獲得真正的自由。黃粱一夢，猝然而醒：「我雖凡塵微末，也當以劍代筆，縱橫天下，快意人生」。

games.name: The Bleakest Keep
games.short_description: The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!

games.name: 鸡械绿洲 (Cluckmech Oasis)
games.short_description: Cluckmech Oasis, a top-down shooting Roguelike tower defense game. Play as the Warcluck and lead your team of animal heroes in a fight for survival. Collect, build and upgrade defenses, and engage in intense battle against waves of plant enemies.

games.name: PANICORE
games.short_description: PANICORE 是一款結合永久死亡、人工智慧怪物和合作體驗的生存恐怖遊戲。試著逃脫，不要被抓到，但要小心：它們不僅聽到你的腳步聲，還聽到你的聲音。

games.name: 六方守護者
games.short_description: 六方守護者是融合了六邊形地塊建造的塔防肉鴿(Roguelite)策略遊戲。建造和升級您的防禦塔，招募軍隊，學習法術，建造奇觀，用六邊形地塊搭建獨特的地形，構建堅不可摧的防線！海量獨特能力和天賦，以及遊戲模式等待您來解鎖！

games.name: 深渊之印
games.short_description: 深淵之印是一款史詩般的海盜冒險遊戲，擁有強烈的敘事性，並混合了廣受好評的銀河惡魔城遊戲與魂系遊戲的驚險元素。以海盜劉琦的身份踏上旅程，探索受詛咒島嶼的奧秘，尋找失蹤的海盜船員！

games.name: 多炮塔神教
games.short_description: 《多炮塔神教》是稍微帶點肉鴿要素的俯視角坦克射擊遊戲，你將作為蘇聯車長指揮各種二戰坦克參加模擬戰。 在戰鬥中，你可以奪取敵車的炮塔來強化自己，並招募形形色色的學生們成為車組員，與你一起贏得勝利。

games.name: CRUEL
games.short_description: A fast run and gun horror shooter with roguelike elements

games.name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
games.short_description: Turnip Boy is back! This time he’s teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

games.name: 生物之湖 - 變種魚釣魚 Lake of Creatures
games.short_description: Difficult action FISHING ROGUELIKE, where you slaughter mutated creatures with weapons that shoot lasers and explosions!!! 💥 Catch fish to buy treasures that MODIFY YOUR BUILD and end up with CRAZY SYNERGIZING ATTACKS that melt those noob enemies

games.name: OneBit Adventure
games.short_description: OneBit Adventure is a casual turn-based roguelike where you adventure as far as possible to level up and battle against rogue monsters. Your primary goal in OneBit Adventure is to survive and loot. Choose from a variety of classes and build the ultimate class.

games.name: The Backrooms: Survival
games.short_description: Survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomized levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity, ensuring a new experience every time. Play alone or with up to TEN friends online! Cross-platform multiplayer with Nintendo Switch.

games.name: Ravenswatch 鸦卫奇旅
games.short_description: 古老童話及傳奇故事的墮落英雄：你正面臨著準備一觸即發的關鍵戰爭，必須對抗噩夢以阻止其入侵及腐化你的世界。由《Curse of the Dead Gods©》創作者所設計的 roguelike 動作遊戲，可單人遊玩或線上合作。

games.name: 軍工放置大亨
games.short_description: 製造武器，製造財富。在這款充滿活力的增量遊戲中，你可以通過創辦軍工複合體企業，盡可能多地賺取金錢。生產多種武器，研究升級方案，操控股票市場，以及遊說政府獲取好處。

games.name: Voidborn
games.short_description: Slay demons and demigods in this fast-paced roguelite FPS. Create devastating weapon builds as you journey through massive dark fantasy environments on your quest to avenge god. Challenge the demigods, face inevitable death, and rise stronger with every rebirth.

games.name: CD 2：陷阱大師
games.short_description: 成為「陷阱大師」——放置致命陷阱，消滅一波波怪異生物，保護你的祭壇！構築一套獨特的「陷阱+技能」卡組，收集寶藏獲取驚喜效果，每場戰鬥守衛不同的基地，直到準備好迎戰無情的Boss。

games.name: Descenders
games.short_description: 《Descenders》是一款以現代山地自行車下坡競速運動為主題的極限運動遊戲，提供諸多隨機產生的地圖，透過真實的操控感，為玩家帶來刺激的賽道體驗。你能帶領車隊走向輝煌，成為下一個傳奇的下坡競速王者 (Descender) 嗎？

games.name: Voids Vigil
games.short_description: Blast through robotic hordes in this arena auto-battler rogue-lite Brotato-like. Use auto-firing weapons and drones, timely dashes and special abilities to reach the Void where a final Conservator awaits convergence. Spend your Cogs wisely within the varied shops to create unique builds!

games.name: Abandoned Archive
games.short_description: Abandoned Archive is a fantasy, spell-casting, rogue-like, featuring a wide variety of relics, a unique spell-upgrading system, with compelling and engaging bosses. Each floor is filled with items and mysteries for the player to uncover; what will you discover in the Abandoned Archive?

games.name: Aethermancer
games.short_description: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins, plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles, and watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

games.name: 村与地下城
games.short_description: 這是一款極致並且硬核的牌組構建Roguelite遊戲。操作簡單，自動戰鬥，一切的核心都是構築策略！海量的卡牌，結合5種元素能量，搭配能力各異的符文，帶來超乎想象的構築空間與策略變化。伴隨著無數的隨機地下城，豐富的遭遇事件，形態各異的敵人等待你的探索與挑戰。

games.name: X Invader: Prologue
games.short_description: Free version of X Invader, an Action Rogue-lite game. Become a master hacker 'X' and hack into the digital world. Use a variety of weapons and hacking add-ons to create your own combat build and wipe out disturbing enemies. Please enjoy the hack and slash action!

games.name: Bloodshed
games.short_description: Bloodshed is a Roguelite Survivors FPS; an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action!

games.name: 卡牌城镇 Cardboard Town
games.short_description: Cardboard Town is a city-building card game. Manage your resources, obtain upgrades, draw your cards and thrive! Random events, quest cards, and game modes make each run different.

games.name: BORE BLASTERS
games.short_description: Blast through rocks with your machine gun drill. Collect rare gems, ores and ancient artefacts, upgrade your ship and unlock new abilities. Uncover the mysteries of the deep and the dangers that lurk below.

games.name: Card Survival: Fantasy Forest
games.short_description: Card Survival: Fantasy Forest is a card-based deep survival simulator and the next installment in the Card Survival Series. Carve yourself a home in a primordial forest that has a will of its own. A day-to-day life simulator in a world where nature reigns with mystery, beauty and sometimes cruelty.

games.name: Wild Bastards
games.short_description: 融合策略和第一人稱射擊元素的遊戲《Wild Bastards》是史詩級策略射擊遊戲《Void Bastards》的精神續作。遊戲中有刺激的戰術式戰鬥、詳細的管理系統以及 roguelike 式的故事模式。裝上馬鞍，帶領銀河系中最臭名昭著的惡棍在宇宙中尋找傳說的家園吧。

games.name: Dynast.io
games.short_description: Dynast.IO is a cool survival game with RPG elements. Build a base, get resources, craft weapons and survive with your friends.

games.name: Pixel Starships 2
games.short_description: First Glimpse on Steam Next: Build, Configure, and Manage every aspect of your own Starship. An FTL-esque game in a MMO setting. Pre bundled with deep strategy, exploration, PVP, market economy, trading, mining. Basically everything a star captain wants to do after a day at the office :)

games.name: Path of Achra
games.short_description: Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

games.name: Desecrators
games.short_description: Desecrators is a retro six-degrees-of-freedom shooter set in a 41st-century galaxy where outlaw hovercraft pilots plunder deep-space installations. Loot destructive weapons and powerful upgrades to take on the ultimate heist: the legendary vaults of the Galactic Treasury.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon®
