games.short_description: 《Darkest Dungeon》是一款關於冒險的心理壓力，且極具挑戰性的哥德風回合制類rogue角色扮演遊戲。招募、訓練並率領一支不完美的英雄團隊，對抗無法想像的恐怖、壓力、飢荒、疾病與進逼的黑暗。當失去所有希望時，你還能讓你的英雄們同心協力嗎？

games.name: 魔導少年 地下迷城
games.short_description: 《妖精的尾巴 地下迷城》是一款操控妖精的尾巴角色來遊玩的Roguelike牌組構築遊戲。收集重現該作品魔法的魔法卡牌，製作專屬牌組，打倒強大的怪物並朝地下城最深處前進吧！

games.name: 揭謎而起!
games.short_description: 《Let’s! Revolution!》是一款配色鮮明的 Roguelite 兼解謎遊戲，你必須阻止一個自戀的國王毀掉自己的世界。翻開磚格揭開隱藏道路，一步一步逼近國王。善用推理避開國王的爪牙，或是透過回合制策略戰鬥打倒所有敵人。

games.name: 環形子彈
games.short_description: Orbital Bullet is a fast paced 360° action-platformer with rogue-lite elements, where all actions take place in a circular pattern. Fight your way through a variety of procedural planets and use body modifications, crafting and heavy weaponry. Kill. Die. Modify.

games.name: 艾爾登法環 黑夜君臨
games.short_description: 《艾爾登法環 黑夜君臨》（ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN）為基於《艾爾登法環》（ELDEN RING）的世界觀， 重新構思遊戲的核心設計，帶給玩家全新體驗的衍生作品。

games.name: 轮回修仙传
games.short_description: 想书写你的龙傲天修仙人生吗？《轮回修仙传》是一款以修仙为题材的多结局多周目轮回式Roguelike人生模拟类游戏。沉浸式体验「我命由我不由天」的逆袭剧本，经历一世又一世的劫难，轮回点化作登仙台阶，结识修仙路上的红颜道侣，合理规划你的修炼和行动，不断突破境界，直到你一拳轰碎这天道约束！

games.name: 航海奇聞
games.short_description: 航海奇聞是一款Roguelike卡牌遊戲，操作十分簡單。快來挑選一位英雄，在回合製的戰鬥系統中，管理好我們的牌庫和子彈數來擊敗敵人！

games.name: UNDER the SAND - a road trip simulator
廢土之歌
games.short_description: 這是一個充滿着廢墟和破敗的廢土世界，你將扮演一名從避難所走出的人類。在這片充斥廢墟的大陸上，近百個區域正在等待着你的發掘。同時你將面臨着無數場戰鬥，請儘可能探索區域，獲取道具資源，構築獨特的戰鬥卡牌來用以生存。死亡也並非是結束，你可以通過一次又一次的探索，最終打造屬於你的美好世界。

games.name: 鬥陣騎士 Knightica
games.short_description: Rogue自走棋×背包管理 || 通過空間規劃打造無敵流派，全自動戰鬥解放雙手！悉心挑選不同的單位，充分發掘軍隊的協同效果，跨越重重挑戰，擊敗各式各樣的危險怪物，最終解救王國。

games.name: 心跳彈珠檯
games.short_description: 這次的彈珠會落到哪裡？在《心跳彈珠檯》這款肉鴿卡牌彈珠檯中，構建你的牌組、購買特別彈珠，疊加增益，為通關創造最大可能——剩下的，就交給命運吧！是驚險通關還是功虧一簣，它自會為你指明方向。神秘莫測的命運之神啊，請眷顧我吧！

games.name: Picayune Dreams
games.short_description: Picayune Dreams is a roguelike blend of bullet heaven horde survival, and bullet hell gameplay. Adrift across the endless void, you must fend off thousands of nightmarish and otherwordly creatures. Uncover a mysterious and surreal story. And don't forget. You mu [TRANSMISSION INTERRUPTED...]

games.name: Voidigo
games.short_description: A vividly animated action roguelite focused on boss hunting. Unleash an array of diverse weapons and powerups to combat the corruption of the Void.

games.name: Tiny Rogues
games.short_description: Tiny Rogues is a challenging fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with rpg elements. Build a new unique character each run and fight one monster-infested room after another! Discover unique weapons, collect magical items and level up to become more and more powerful!

games.name: Monster Train 2
games.short_description: 《怪物列車》將帶著全新部族、全新敵方勢力、全新挑戰、全新模式和更多內容歸來！在大受歡迎的經典三層、垂直玩法 roguelike 卡牌製作模式中保護你的火堆。

games.name: Cozy Space Survivors
games.short_description: A cozy time survival roguelite in space. You steer the shippy while the shooting happens automatically. Meet cute NPCs, solve small quests, and fight quirky enemies with satisfying weapons. A shorter experience for people who don't have much time but love playing (and finishing) games.

games.name: Dice With Death
games.short_description: Dice With Death is a Dicebuilding Roguelike – Unfortunately you have already died. Fortunately, Death is up for some friendly competition. Collect new dice and relics, create damage stacking combos, and even cheat Death himself to emerge victorious.

games.name: The Enchanted Cave 2
games.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of a cave with an endless supply of monsters and loot!

games.name: Pixel Dungeon VR
games.short_description: 融合Dungeons of Eternity和Ancient Dungeon的核心玩法，升級Battle Talent的戰鬥爽感，多人聯機合作地牢遊戲像素地牢帶你進入VR圈的Minecraft，探索未知的世界！史詩級BOSS戰，豐富武器庫，自訂阿凡達...準備好與朋友一起踏上更多激動人心的地下城之旅！

games.name: The Light Brigade
games.short_description: 一個融合了寫實槍戰與光之魔法的Roguelike戰術射擊遊戲。加入光之旅團，穿越記憶碎片，並讓光明照亮黑暗吧。

games.name: Fury Unleashed
games.short_description: 《Fury Unleashed》是一个以连击为驱动的轻度 Roguelike 平台动作游戏 - 每次击杀都会提升连击数。到达特定阈值，你的伤害抗性和治愈力将会生效！在这个游戏里，你甚至可以通过一次前无古人的连击通关游戏。你准备接受这个任务吗？

games.name: Drill Core
games.short_description: 歡迎來到《Drill Core》！在這裡，企業貪婪與策略性星球挖掘緊密結合。鑽探到行星的核心，管理工人、研究尖端科技，同時抵禦外星生物的攻擊。你會選擇優先提升效率，冒著工人安全的風險，還是專注防禦以求生存呢？

games.name: Last Saintess
games.short_description: The offensive of the undead begins. Gather holy power to summon soldiers and strengthen the starlight of Hellendil to defeat the undead. If the undead destroy this place, it will be game over.

games.name: 逃出高塔 Tower Escape
games.short_description: 《逃出高塔》是塔防遊戲，但這次反而由你擔任攻擊方。你將扮演壞人的角色，率領爪牙逃離高塔。招募爪牙建立隊伍，並收集威力強大的寶石和聖物，每次的挑戰闖關過程都不相同。

games.name: Exanima
games.short_description: Explore, fight, survive and unravel mysteries in this unique and unforgiving 3D isometric RPG set in an original dark, low fantasy world. Exanima's exceptional attention to detail and realistic simulation of all things aim to provide a deeply immersive and dynamic gameplay experience.

games.name: Stellar Initiative
games.short_description: Stellar Initiative is a roguelike tower defense game where you land on the planet and use your orbit ship to deliver buildings and support you with fire. Complete missions, install new upgrades, discover powerful artifacts, and find the best strategy!

games.name: 劍與狐尾 (Of Blades & Tails)
games.short_description: 一款回合製角色扮演遊戲，註重操作，但同時鼓勵深思熟慮。 探索居住著不同動物部落的奇妙土地。 跟隨主線劇情發展，或在古代遺跡和神秘地牢中尋找寶藏。 升級你的角色並獲取強大的裝備。

games.name: MULLET MADJACK
games.short_description: "MULLET MADJACK是一款單人快節奏FPS遊戲，可令您置身於經典動漫世界，享受沉浸式遊戲體驗。 強化遊戲角色，打穿遊戲關卡，不斷刷新遊戲記錄，兵貴神速，方能勢如破竹！"

games.name: 東方冰之勇者記
games.short_description: 《东方冰之勇者记》是由「GAMEPULSE 游戏脉冲」开发的东方同人游戏。 在游戏中，玩家需要操控东方人气角色「琪露诺」化身为冰之勇者，踏上对抗邪恶力量、解放幻想乡，并最终拯救珍重之人的旅途。交流群：849555325

games.name: Cobalt Core
games.short_description: 是一款科幻類型roguelike牌組構築作品，具有獨創的單軸移轉戰鬥系統！閃避飛彈、排好你的大砲，把敵人通通轟到天上去……在還來得拯救一切之前，抵達這時間循環的根源吧！

games.name: Spirits Abyss
games.short_description: Spirits Abyss is a roguelite platformer with destructible terrain. Cast into the Abysm you must explore its diverse depths battling phantasmic meanies and plundering its useful treasures to find a way home... but does something nestle beyond the realmic veil of death?

games.name: 鼠鼠登月 Rocket Rats
games.short_description: 《鼠鼠登月》是一款類幸存者遊戲，你將化身為一隻老鼠，在太空中對抗由起司組成的各種天體！消滅一波波來襲的敵人、收集起司、強化裝備，最終征服月球！

games.name: The Consuming Shadow
games.short_description: The Consuming Shadow is a procedural survival horror adventure in which you must explore the land, fight your way through randomly-generated dungeons and try to stay sane in your quest to save the world from the invading Ancients.

games.name: Card-en-Ciel 天穹卡牌錄
games.short_description: 《Card-en-Ciel 天穹卡牌錄》是活用超過300種卡牌及50首歌曲來展開戰鬥的牌組構築型卡牌戰鬥RPG。 玩家將化身解決網路相關事件的電競椅偵探「霓虹」，為了追查在開發中的線上遊戲裡大量出現各種虛構遊戲角色的事件而挺身挑戰迷宮。

games.name: 低魔時代
games.short_description: 在開放式的中世紀奇幻世界裡冒險與戰鬥！培養能力各異的英雄角色，遊歷於星羅棋佈的村莊，城塞，亦或危機四伏的地下城。經典硬核的回合制小隊戰鬥和角色培養系統：視野，戰霧，衝鋒，夾擊，法術，戰技，你可以在“踢門團”式的競技場模式中自由體驗更多有趣的遊戲元素。

games.name: Iris and the Giant
games.short_description: 愛麗絲與巨人是一款融合了CCG、RPG和roguelike等類型的卡牌遊戲。你扮演愛麗絲，她必須勇敢地面對她想像世界中的恐懼。陷入憂鬱和扣人心弦的冒險，充滿可愛的怪物和埋藏的記憶。準備好面對內心的惡魔了嗎？

games.name: 巨人殺手：暗黑之潮
games.short_description: 殺戮無盡敵潮，高舉戰斧直面命運的洗禮！在《巨人殺手：暗黑之潮》中，你將直面如潮水般的敵人，通過無盡的戰鬥鍛造自身，贏得諸神的恩賜。擺脫凡人的束縛，化身為對抗巨人的不朽戰士，在這片不屈的地底世界中書寫屬於你的輝煌傳奇！

games.name: SYNTHETIK 2
games.short_description: SYNTHETIK 2 is a unrelenting tactical-shooter rogue-lite. Play alone or with friends. Loot powerful tech. Experience the next level in gun-play. Upgrade your androids to rival the machine gods!

games.name: 東方異域見聞 ~ Touhou Dystopian
games.short_description: 東方Project全新動作肉鴿同人遊戲！畜生界與靈長園異變突生，踏上未知的旅途，探尋異變真相，書寫屬於你的「東方異域見聞」！

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.short_description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.

games.name: Stacklands
games.short_description: Stacklands是一款建設村莊的遊戲，藉由堆疊卡牌來收集食物、建造設施，以及與其他生物戰鬥。🃏舉例來說，拖曳「村民」卡牌到「莓果灌木」卡牌上面就會製造出「莓果」卡牌，可以讓村民食用並存活。🃏正確地組合卡牌然後擴展你的村莊！

games.name: Megabonk
games.short_description: 粉碎無盡的敵人浪潮，變得超級強大！收集 loot，升級角色，解鎖新角色並 upgrade 武器，打造獨特又瘋狂的 build，同時抵禦怪物大軍！

games.name: Sword Rogue
games.short_description: A simple rogue like action game. Use WASD to move, use the mouse to control the player character's direction, use the left mouse button to attack and right mouse button to use skill. Also supports keyboard only mode, see details in the ingame guide.

games.name: LuckLand
games.short_description: LuckLand is a strategy casual game that combines elements such as card building and Roguelike. To achieve ultimate victory, all you need to do is rotate the chessboard. This game does not include any real world currency gambling or micro trading.

games.name: Death Road to Canada
games.short_description: Control a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, rescue dogs, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies. Randomly generated for a new story and rare events every time you play!

games.name: VOID/BREAKER
games.short_description: 令人血脈噴張的Roguelite第一人稱射擊遊戲 🔴 對抗敵對AI所駕馭的無情機器。 逃離無止盡的循環。 深度槍枝改造，打造出無極限的變種武器。 鍛造致命的協同作用。 破壞環境以開闢生路 /打破系統 /打破循環 /打破束縛

games.name: Dobbel Dungeon
games.short_description: Gather your party, roll your dice and battle across the islands to put an end to a powerful curse once and for all in this roguelike turn-based tactical RPG!

games.name: Lucky Hunter
games.short_description: 《幸運獵人》是一款融合了牌組構建與自走棋元素的 Roguelike 遊戲。棋子會自動打出，玩家將專注於搭配和構建獨特的牌組與聖物，充分發揮棋子間的協同效果，戰勝越來越強大的獵物。

games.name: Pawnbarian
games.short_description: 野蠻戰卒是一個快節奏、益智回合制rougelike遊戲。 像移動象棋一樣打出卡牌來移動你的英雄，並克服各種充滿陰險怪物的地下城！

games.name: 露西的日記
games.short_description: Diary of Lucie is action-roguelite game made with RPG Maker. In addition to simply avoiding the enemy's barrage, strategically use the enemy's bullet to make the battle situation advantageous!

games.name: 獵人之首
games.short_description: 在《獵人之首》中，你將坐鎮指揮中心，通過指令遠端操控一支精銳小隊深入絕境。配置戰術武裝、調整即時指令、抉擇優先任務——你無法微操每一次射擊，卻必須掌控全局的走向。用冷酷的計算換取勝利，一步步揭開這艘廢棄飛船深處令人戰慄的真相。

games.name: Trinity Fusion
games.short_description: 在這個Rogue-Lite動作平台遊戲中，扮演著拯救垂死多元宇宙的使命，掌握你的平行自我！探索黑暗、科幻的世界，參與快節奏、流暢和精確的戰鬥。

games.name: Neon Sundown
games.short_description: Neon Sundown is an extremely challenging arena-shooter that mixes fast-paced action with roguelite elements. Take on increasingly difficult arenas as you unlock new ships, upgrades, synergies, and more! Think you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: Demon Hunt
games.short_description: Battle through demon-infested lands in this fast-paced rogue-lite bullet-heaven. Pick unique weapons with powerful evolutions, and hunt down ancient demons in intense boss fights. Loot, upgrade, and unlock new ways to grow stronger after every hunt!

games.name: Broventure: The Wild Co-op
games.short_description: Broventure = Vampire Survivors + 基地建設 + 合作。與朋友一起組隊，消滅成群的艱苦敵人，收集重要資源，將你的營地轉化為一個解放的避難所。

games.name: Balatro
games.short_description: 撲克牌版的極致Roguelike遊戲！Balatro是一場循環不息的撲克之旅。在這款令人陶醉的卡牌策略遊戲中，你將參與非法牌局，發掘能夠改變局勢的小丑牌，引爆一系列令人血脈噴張、驚嘆連連的連鎖效應。

games.name: Black Gunner Wukong
games.short_description: 黑槍神悟空是一款TPS+ROGUE遊戲，在遊戲中玩家將扮演孫悟空，使用三頭六臂和六把大砲大鬧美軍基地並救出師傅。

games.name: Brotato
games.short_description: 《Brotato》是一款垂直移動的競技場射擊roguelite遊戲，你將作為一顆馬鈴薯，同時裝備多達6種武器來跟成群的異形大戰一場。從各種特性和道具中做選擇，來創建出獨特的構築並生存下來，直到救援的到來。

games.name: 將軍 對決
games.short_description: 《將軍 對決》是一款帶有roguelite和卡組構築元素的回合製戰鬥遊戲，在正確的時間進行移動和攻擊，升級你的行動和卡組，準備好迎擊將軍吧！

games.name: Desktop Survivors 98
games.short_description: Desktop Survivors 98 is a chaotic roguelite dungeon crawler that unfolds right on your Desktop. Your cursor becomes the hero as you explore new rooms, battle relentless waves of enemies, and collect powerful new weapons.

games.name: Froggy's Battle
games.short_description: Froggy's Battle is an action roguelike game set in a loop. Help Froggy the steezy magician skater frog defeat all the baddies squatting her favorite riding spot. Choose your upgrades carefully, become more and more powerful and kickflip yourself through waves of enemies and ferocious bosses!

games.name: 別拽了！烤串師傅
games.short_description: 《別拽了！烤串師傅》是一款可愛又混亂的塔防Roguelike遊戲。在遊戲中化身烤串大師，隨機抽食材、拼調味料，湊出一支好吃又能打的串串小隊，保衛你的烤爐！

games.name: 邊境開拓者
games.short_description: 在《邊境開拓者》中，你將成為王國傑出的開拓者，踏上充滿榮耀與挑戰的征程。在變化多端的關卡中，建立迷你城鎮，抵禦無盡的敵人浪潮。你的城鎮將不斷遭遇敵人的猛烈進攻，構築堅固的基地防禦，用你強大的防禦把敵軍碾壓粉碎！在邊境鑄就你的傳奇，為王國開疆拓土！向下滑，看看這如潮水般的敵人！

games.name: 無雙深淵
games.short_description: 帶領名垂青史、以一擋百的各路英傑，挺身面對千軍萬馬。跨越無數勝敗沙場，力克地獄重重難關。

games.name: 虐殺熔爐
games.short_description: 在《虐殺熔爐》中，為了帶領反抗軍越獄，一場關乎自由的殘酷搏殺即將打響！你準備好迎接血與火的洗禮了嗎？拳拳到肉，火力全開。賽博義體，碾壓一切！痛快淋漓的戰鬥體驗，讓你腎上腺素飆升！在這個殘酷的世界裡，只有鮮血才能換來自由！【本地雙人聯機已上線】

games.name: 千變的迷宮　風來的希煉６　蛇蜷島探險譚
games.short_description: A new adventure for Shiren and Koppa begins!

games.name: 回閃
games.short_description: 《回閃》是一款自由選擇故事發展的策略遊戲。你會扮演一位送貨員，在一個暗流洶湧的城市中度過一個月的時光。在這一個月中你會碰到各種各樣的角色和事件。你需要通過巧妙的選擇，努力在城市中生存下去。根據你的選擇，角色們的命運也會互相交互，並迎來各自的未來。

games.name: Wordatro!
games.short_description: Wordatro! fuses addictive word game with thrilling roguelite strategy! Spell high-scoring words, chain massive combos, and unlock game-changing bonuses. With 50+ unique upgrades and daily challenges, endless linguistic adventures await!

games.name: 嘣境回收戰
games.short_description: 「嘣境回收戰」是一款以換裝DIY、放置為主，同時具備戰鬥、培育和策略玩法的輕度類rogue遊戲，合理配裝無痛高難，千款打扮隨心搭配！

games.name: Pixel Survivors : Roguelike
games.short_description: A rogue-lite game where you must face hundreds of monsters with increasingly difficult bosses that strong enough to take you down. Choose your abilities, build your favorite combat style, become stronger and survive as long as you can!

games.name: Raiders of Blackveil
games.short_description: Join the rebellion against the evil corporation Blackveil in this action-packed roguelite for 1-3 players. Select your MOBA-like champion, collect RPG-style loot and infiltrate Blackveil’s massive factory. Wreak havoc, and smuggle out loot to get INSANELY powerful!

games.name: War of the Three Kingdoms
dev: 杭州游卡网络技术有限公司
pub: 杭州游卡网络技术有限公司

games.name: Cogmind
games.short_description: Cogmind is a sci-fi roguelike epic in which you play a robot building yourself from components found or salvaged from other robots. Explore a living, breathing world through turn-based tactical combat, or sneak, hack, and fly your way to victory.

games.name: 幻想鄉妖怪塔防 ~ Touhou Monster TD
games.short_description: Easy to learn but hard to master, Touhou Monster TD is a unique Tower defense Game. Control your character, level up and unlock tower skills and character talents, use your wisdom to defeat incoming enemies. Travel the Gensokyo, find out why the “Incident” happened this time.

games.name: Crusaders Quest : Mini
games.short_description: 在《克魯賽德戰記 :迷你版》中，與可愛的小夥伴們在電腦螢幕上相遇. 在您工作或學習時 克魯賽德戰記和他們的英雄們將為荷賽拉大陸而戰。取得本遊戲專屬的原創英雄和服裝 並收集熟悉的英雄和服裝，將它們展示在您的電腦螢幕上.

games.name: Forsaken Frontiers
games.short_description: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.

games.name: Shadowveil: Legend of The Five Rings
games.short_description: 一款以《五輪傳奇》宇宙為背景的遊戲，遊戲中結合了策略、roguelite 玩法以及 RPG 式的遊戲進程，將會帶領你踏上一場史詩般的冒險之旅。解鎖強大的卡牌，組建一支武士隊伍，帶領他們進入暗影之地，他們的命運全在你的一念之間。

games.name: 蒙莎麗娜 Mosa Lina
games.short_description: a hostile interpretation of the immersive sim, where nothing is planned, and everything works

games.name: Project Wingman
games.short_description: Project Wingman is a flight action game that lets you take the seat of advanced fighter jets and become a true ace. Fight in various missions and gamemodes ranging from intense aerial dogfights to large scale ground assault in an alternate scorched earth setting.

games.name: 觅长生
games.short_description: 《觅长生》是一款想要还原真实修仙世界的开放世界角色扮演游戏。 在这里，你可以体验到从零开始一步步积攒修为突破境界的逆天修仙之旅，也可以体验到那些充满修仙味的故事和剧情。当然也少不了寻求奇遇、探索秘境，更可以和游戏中的角色互动，与人为善或是杀人夺宝全都由你自己抉择。

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.short_description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

games.name: 背包亂鬥 Backpack Battles
games.short_description: 這是一款 PVP 背包物品管理自動戰鬥遊戲！購買和製作稀有物品，仔細擺放，打造強力組合，使用背包跟其他玩家激烈對戰。

games.name: Boyfriend Dungeon
games.short_description: 和你的刀剑谈恋爱！在这款“约会与砍杀”风格的地城探索游戏中征服武器们的心，养成并提升他们的等级。

games.name: Hollow Survivors: Prologue
games.short_description: 序言只是完整版本中等待您的遊戲玩法的一部分。 在這款類似 Rogue 的地下城爬行遊戲中，與成群的可怕生物戰鬥，一路砍殺，到達塔頂。 從各種升級中進行選擇，解鎖新武器，發現強大的協同作用，並從邪惡的縛魂者手中拯救塔樓。

games.name: 骰號玩家
games.short_description: 《骰號玩家》是一款以骰子為核心的roguelike策略遊戲！你將一次次擲出手中的骰子，尋找能夠改變局勢的機會，運用智略將有限的機會變為無限的可能，突破艱難險阻，發掘出潛藏在陰影裏的秘密……

games.name: 迷走:二律背反
games.short_description: 只要左右滑動，就能做出各種選擇，那麼，請在亞斯特大陸中探索，譜寫出只屬於你的冒險譚吧!

games.name: Deathless. The Hero Quest
games.short_description: In Deathless, elements of a collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy combine seamlessly. Build a unique deck of cards, discover unusual relics, and defeat legendary bosses. No two journeys will ever be the same with endless Path. Crush the Evil and save the world!

games.name: Tap Ninja - Idle game
games.short_description: 消滅敵人，賺取黃金，升級你的村莊，成為忍者大師！

games.name: Gunlocked
games.short_description: A twin stick shooter without the twin stick, Gunlocked is a sci-fi action roguelike about careful positioning and upgrade selection. Manage unique targeting systems across multiple weapons and upgrades, as you battle legions of alien ships, and then do it all over again!

games.name: 异端者 (Heretical)
games.short_description: Die. Adapt. Strike back. Climb Sanctora in this brutal Rogue-lite where every death unlocks powers, heroes, and paths to vengeance.

games.name: Mr. Sun's Hatbox
games.short_description: Mr Sun’s Hatbox is a slapstick, roguelite platformer about getting the job done at all costs. Upgrade your HQ, your team, and your tools so you can take on increasingly dangerous (and ridiculous) missions, wearing hats with amazing (or questionable) potential.

games.name: Paper Planet
games.short_description: Paper Planet is a planet-defender, arcade roguelike with a doodley, Flash-inspired artstyle. Battle through waves of unique enemies and bosses. Combine items with strange and wacky effects for insanely overpowered runs. Play with 1-4 players, for some chaotic co-op fun!

games.name: Dwarven Realms
games.short_description: 面对大群的暴徒并释放混乱的能力，让屏幕充满混乱。潜入所有 3D ARPG 中怪物密度最高的地方，将它们全部消灭。运用史诗般的力量，创造你的建筑，并在动感十足的 ARPG 体验中塑造一个充满无限可能的世界。

games.name: Returnal™
games.short_description: 打破時空迴圈 屢獲殊榮的第三人稱射擊遊戲登陸 PC：於塞勒涅的故事中奮戰求生。迎向 Roguelike 挑戰。 在槍林彈雨中與敵方激烈交戰。與另一名玩家一同闖蕩 Returnal™ 的世界。

games.name: Iron Fisticle
games.short_description: A modern take on the classic arcade arena shooter. Taking inspiration from an entire generation of action games, Iron Fisticle builds on classic titles like Gauntlet and Robotron while adding over 100 collectible items, an RPG style upgrade system and local multiplayer.

games.name: 诸天刷宝录
games.short_description: 【可挂机的位面穿越模拟经营回合制战斗冒险游戏】主角觉醒异能，自由穿越在修仙、历史、武侠、斗气、魔幻、未来等不同的位面。通过战斗收集分布于各个位面的装备、灵兽、角色、秘籍。将稀有珍宝带回现实世界，完成任务、换取资源、购置资产，不断强化自身实力，直至踏破诸天万界！轻松爽游！

games.name: Fabled Lands
games.short_description: Fabled Lands is a challenging old-school narrative RPG set in an open world. Complete quests, fight, trade goods and develop your character. Explore a vast land of adventure: travel across the war-torn kingdom, survive the plains of howling darkness, and escape the Court of Hidden Faces.

games.name: 迷失之徑
games.short_description: 《迷失之徑》是一款結合了空當接龍、彈幕卡牌的策略冒險遊戲。你將扮演風格迥異的冒險家，在隨機生成的迷失世界中展開一場場冒險，像空當接龍一樣翻動卡牌，善用每一次選擇，挑選你的裝備和道具，最終揭開這個迷失世界的真相！

games.name: Rabbit and Steel
games.short_description: RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action roguelike that recreates the essence of high-level MMO raiding in a randomized, simplified, bunny-sized package. Choose your class, gather your rabbit-eared companions and battle your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle!

games.name: 餘燼守衛 Emberward
games.short_description: 《Emberward》是一款著重於迷宮建造與獨特砲塔組合的 Roguelite 塔防遊戲。利用各種形狀的方塊規劃怪物路線，搭配不同砲塔與神器守護脆弱的火源！

games.name: Mimic Logic
games.short_description: "Mimic Logic" is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.

games.name: Hades II
games.short_description: 繼屢獲殊榮的前作，《黑帝斯 II》將再次引領玩家踏入希臘神話的世界。在此款 rogue-like 迷宮探索遊戲中，你能於冥界以外的世界奮勇殺敵、施展巫咒祕術，並殲滅時間泰坦！

games.name: Love Love School Days
games.short_description: The protagonist is trapped in the world of a love game. Can you return to the real world again...? Try to escape while running away from the gal game heroine A love simulation-style survival horror game!

games.name: FALL IN LABYRINTH
games.short_description: 玩家将做为一名冒险者， 在经历了突如其来的夜袭事件并获得【传说中的圣剑】后， 来到了东西帝国的交易要地【维利亚普尔】。 等待玩家的，不仅有能够获得无限道具的奇妙地下城【迷宫】， 还有与性格各异的美女们的邂逅。 在贯穿始终的蛛丝马迹引导下， 围绕迷宫诞生的背景，一场惊天阴谋浮出了水面。

games.name: CHANGE: A Homeless Survival Experience
games.short_description: CHANGE is an award nominated homeless survival experience set in a randomly created city with rogue-like elements. Explore, survive, earn perks, find items & kindness to develop your character & escape to a new life. Over 7 years of development & over 200 updates so far!

games.name: 嗜血印 Bloody Spell
games.short_description: This is a martial arts action role-playing game. The core of the game is battle-oriented, and it combines many fighting elements. If you are a player who pursues blood and is brave enough to challenge the limits, it will definitely inspire your adrenaline and bring you the best combat experience.

games.name: Rabbit Hole
games.short_description: Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D RogueLike-Shooter, made with love for the genre. You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again.

games.name: Windblown
games.short_description: 《死亡細胞》創作團隊全新力作，《風中行者》是節奏飛快的類Rogue動作遊戲，支援1-3人遊玩。在崩毀的世界中暢快衝刺、俯衝與破壞。自由組合裝備配置，發動威力驚人的特殊攻擊，成為對抗大氣旋的最後防線。

games.name: Have a Nice Death
games.short_description: Have a Nice Death is a 2D action roguelike where you play as an overworked Death, whose employees have run rampant, completely throwing off the balance of souls - and his vacation plans. In order to restore order, you'll have to grab your trusty scythe and show your employees who's boss.

games.name: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
games.short_description: 這是一款硬核生存角色扮演遊戲（RPG），擁有非線性的劇情，讓你化身為一位年輕的中世紀士兵，在戰火與冒險中逐步成為那個時代最強大、最受尊敬的騎士。又或者，如果命運不濟，你也可能在百年戰爭的混亂中殞命。

games.name: 貪婪大地
games.short_description: 《貪婪大地》是一款虛幻引擎開發的倖存者類射擊遊戲，你將扮演星際傭兵，在無盡的殺戮中搜集資源，強化自身，消滅數不盡的敵人，征服這顆星球！

games.name: Tyrant's Realm
games.short_description: Tyrant's Realm 是靈感來自經典 PS1 視覺效果的 roguelite 動作冒險遊戲。探索程序產生的黑暗奇幻世界，在危險中戰鬥，每跑一次都會有新的發展。死亡並非終結，因為黑夜還未消逝。

games.name: Cultist Simulator
games.short_description: Seize forbidden treasures. Summon alien gods. Feed on your disciples. Cultist Simulator is a game of apocalypse and yearning. Play as a seeker after unholy mysteries, in a 1920s-themed setting of hidden gods and secret histories.

games.name: Legend of Keepers: Career of a Dungeon Manager
命運英雄
games.short_description: 《命運英雄》是一款將「倖存者」和「角色扮演」兩種元素混合在一起的類Rogue遊戲。在怪物的重重包圍下，你還會遭遇各式的任務或突發事件，你可以招募夥伴或成為孤狼，在這奇幻世界中經歷一場驚險刺激且命運無常的冒險之旅！

games.name: 無用之人：登神長階
games.short_description: 《無用之人：登神長階》 是一款受《背包亂鬥》啟發，使用UE引擎開發的黑暗奇幻風格1v1電子鬥蛐蛐自走棋遊戲。玩家需要通過戰前設置角色戰鬥招式，購買裝備、道具、形成戰鬥中的作戰策略。戰勝對手取得十次勝利，贏下遊戲。

games.name: 拉桿英雄
games.short_description: 《老虎機英雄》是一款Roguelike卡牌構築遊戲，你得旋轉轉盤來決定自己的命運。將強大的符號收集到你的物品欄中，調整並精進你的策略，從失敗中學習以解鎖新的可能性和組合。

games.name: Armoured Commander II
games.short_description: In this roguelike wargame, take command of a tank and its crew in the Second World War, joining one of over 50 campaigns across Europe, North Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific. Fight against over 1300 historically-based unit types, where each day is a struggle for survival.

games.name: Caves of Qud
games.short_description: 《卡德洞窟》是一部深受復古未來主義影響，具有深度模擬，遍布智能植物的科學幻想風格Roguelike史詩。踏入這片異域，鑿穿被重重掩埋的千年文明。

games.name: The Great Rebellion
games.short_description: The Great Rebellion is a cyberpunk 2D sidescrolling run'n'gun roguelite using mouse/twinstick-shooter controls. It features randomly generated levels, multiple difficulty modes (including optional permadeath), a dynamic soundtrack and an upgradeable player character.

games.name: 速速上菜！
games.short_description: 精心規劃你的餐廳，你將一手包辦上菜、設計和裝潢，並隨著遊戲進度逐漸解鎖新的技能和菜色，一步步擴大你的廚藝王國！這是一款融合rougelite元素的經典餐廳模擬遊戲。你可以選擇雇用朋友一同經營——又或者「是自己的餐廳自己來」！

games.name: 時空叛客
games.short_description: 《時空叛客》是一款賽博龐克平台動作遊戲，遊戲中玩家將置身於一個光怪陸離世界之中，在合成波的背景音樂下，踏上穿梭時間與空間的冒險，與千奇百怪的敵人作戰， 在世界徹底陷入的混亂之前拯救一切。

games.name: 猶格索托斯的庭院
games.short_description: 在這款模擬經營+AVG遊戲中，你繼承一座荒廢已久的別墅並欠下黑暗債務。你將招募死神、龍族、斬靈師、人造人等員工開展旅社經營。奇怪的客人將帶著神秘事件到訪。你會通過挖礦，冒險，煉金，經營餐廳等不同策略積攢資產，不斷調整策略，帶領旅社走向不同結局，另，員工可攻略。

games.name: Ancient Dungeon
games.short_description: Ancient Dungeon VR is a fast-paced roguelite dungeon crawler built for VR. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, slash enemies, collect loot, and unlock upgrades in immersive physics-based combat. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

games.name: Atomicrops
games.short_description: 雙搖桿彈幕地獄Roguelite遊戲。你必須種植作物，守衛末日荒土中最後一座農場。培育突變作物、升級武器、追求鎮上居民，並消滅所有意圖入侵農地的突變生物吧！咿哈！

games.name: Neon Chrome
games.short_description: A masterful combination of top-down shooter and endless replayability with procedural levels. Blast your way through walls & enemies with guns and cybernetic abilities. Install perks from cyber chambers and upgrade your character stats after each death. Can you stop the Overseer?

games.name: Going Under
games.short_description: 《Going Under》是一個諷刺意味的地城探險遊戲，探索失敗科技創業公司被詛咒的遺跡。作為反烏托邦城市尼奧卡斯卡迪亞的一位無薪實習生，你將手握辦公垃圾作為武器，穿行於企業園地下標新立異的程序性地城。

games.name: Morphblade
games.short_description: In Morphblade you move around a grid slicing, smashing and bursting waves of nasty red bugs. Each tile you move to transforms you into a different weapon: on a Blades hex you can slice enemies on either side of you, on an Arrow you can launch yourself through two enemies in a row.

games.name: Dicey Dungeons
games.short_description: 當你是一枚骰子時，又要如何與幸運女神為敵呢？

games.name: OVIS LOOP
games.short_description: 《孤羊戰紀》是一款像素風格的橫版動作Roguelite遊戲。透過流暢的像素動畫和技能連擊的玩法，帶給玩家豐富又爽快的遊戲體驗！玩家將扮演一隻手拿科幻巨劍的小綿羊，自訂技能，發展出屬於自己的獨特戰鬥風格，在這個科幻末世的荒涼世界中，勇敢地迎接狼群的挑戰！

games.name: DunHero
games.short_description: DunHero is an Action Roguelike. Choose your class, level up and collect powerful items. Defeat bosses and free the world from evil in unique adventures. Play solo or with friends in up to 4-player co-op.

games.name: Savara
games.short_description: 快來體驗這款豐富多元的Roguelite動作遊戲，參加為戰神榮耀所舉辦的慶典吧。帶上最精良的武器，挑戰最強大的怪物，證明自我價值，在歷史上留名。

games.name: 逃離鴨科夫
games.short_description: 《逃離鴨科夫》是一款鴨子題材PVE俯視角撤離射擊遊戲。你要在鴨科夫的世界裡搜尋物資，建造藏身處，升級裝備，從一無所有到做大做強；面對虎視眈眈的敵鴨，想方設法生存下去——或者逃離。

games.name: God Of Weapons
games.short_description: 快來到《God of Weapons》展開一場驚心動魄的冒險旅程！《God of Weapons》是一款 Roguelike 類型的動作遊戲，為了要取回世界最後的光炬，你必須要朝著卓爾之塔的頂端邁進並迎戰各樓層的怪物。想要奪回塔頂光炬的話，你勢必得集齊多種武器與配備，並巧妙地整理好道具欄位中的裝備。

games.name: Choo Choo Survivor
games.short_description: Drive your train to safety while shooting down endless hordes of zombies blocking your way. Upgrade your weapons and abilities and become absurdly powerful!

games.name: State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
games.short_description: Prepare for bullet hell action and crazy driving! Your town is on fire, anarchy reigns the streets, aliens rampage in the sky! Grab your gun and join the fun!

games.name: 魔域地牢 DungeonTop
games.short_description: 《魔域地牢》是壹款融合了戰棋布陣策略的Rogue-like桌面構建卡牌遊戲，在這款遊戲裏妳不止要面對牌組的構建，每回合棋盤的布陣同樣重要。妳可以選擇不同的英雄和隨從，挑戰隨機生成的地牢，像操縱棋子壹樣進行對戰，擊敗各式各樣的怪物和BOSS，解鎖更多卡牌。

games.name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
Take me, Vitaly
games.short_description: 在每個女人的一生中，總會有一個時刻，她走進了錯誤的門…… 我最後的記憶是夜總會的一個假面舞會派對，和一個帶著白俄羅斯口音的高大健壯男人，他提出要為我買一杯雞尾酒……

games.name: Slice & Dice
games.short_description: Tactical dice-rolling roguelike combat. Take control of 5 heroes, each with their own unique dice. Fight your way through 20 levels of monsters and try to take on the final boss. If you lose a single fight you have to start over so be careful (and lucky!).

games.name: Moonring
games.short_description: A dark-fantasy, turn-based, retro-fusion of classic turn-based RPGs and roguelikes, all presented with a unique neon aesthetic.

games.name: Cube Chaos
games.short_description: Cube Chaos is a complex strategy roguelike about placing units to create giant armies, factories, combos, or self replicating murder crabs, overwhelming and outsmarting your opponents. Build and adapt new strategies each run using a ludicrous variety of units, perks and more.

games.name: DR LIVESEY ROM AND DEATH EDITION
games.short_description: DR LIVESEY: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHA, gentlemen, from now on, rom and death means the same thing for you.

games.name: 東方夜光幻夢 ~ Touhou Endless Dream
games.short_description: 歡迎來到《東方夜光幻夢》，這是壹款包含了Rogue-lite要素的2D動作射擊遊戲，玩家在遊戲中可以使用能力不同的角色，收集並組合各種威力強大的寶物，和瘋狂的敵人和彈幕進行快節奏的對抗。從壹片恐怖的黑暗籠罩中拯救自己和幻想鄉。

games.name: Trizon
games.short_description: Trizon is a roguelike deck-building game. Fuse any two cards together to play crazy combos. The game combines auto-battler mechanics, where creatures attack on their own, with instant-effect spell cards. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, set against a simple and restrained art style.

games.name: 奇妙探险队 Curious Expedition
games.short_description: 《奇妙探險隊》是一款設定在19世紀末期的 roguelike 探險模擬遊戲。為了聲望、科學與財富，同諸多名人一起，踏上福禍難測的冒險，向著無人探索的蠻荒大地進發吧。

games.name: Receiver 2
games.short_description: 《接收者 2》依據軍工廠藍圖與槍匠資源模擬槍械中每一個內部組件的運作。了解各款佩槍的實際操作，包括如何上彈與退彈、排除故障以及操作其安全功能。

games.name: Maniac
games.short_description: 有时候觉得一切都厌倦了吗？渴望改变吗？想要把一切都压在纯粹的混乱和破坏上吗？Manic登场了，这是一个让整个世界对抗你，而你的疯狂制造混乱的游戏！

games.name: Rack and Slay
games.short_description: 這款類 rogue-like 地牢探險遊戲將你變成了一個撞球！ 在隨機產生的關卡中，將怪物球推入洞口或陷阱。 從100多種各不相同的物品中選擇，這些物品具有可疊加的、改變遊戲的效果。 尋找物品組合，打造屬於你自己的協同效應，並自訂自己的遊戲風格。

games.name: Deadlink
games.short_description: Get ready to put a sizable dent in the profits of megacorporations in Deadlink, a guns-blazing cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. Your mission is to conduct covert ops while piloting a humanoid combat shell. And no, "covert" doesn’t mean "quiet."

games.name: Hadean Tactics
games.short_description: 《冥獄戰術》是一款roguelike卡組構築遊戲，融合了自走棋元素，創造了獨一無二的戰略體驗。使用你的卡牌來影響單位的行動，並協助你的英雄擊敗地獄六翼！

games.name: Terraformers
games.short_description: 在這款帶有 Roguelike 元素的回合制殖民地建設與資源經營遊戲中，推進火星的地球化改造，探索星球，建設壯麗城市，讓生命開枝散葉，令紅色星球搖身一變綠色家園！

games.name: We Who Are About To Die
games.short_description: 奮力戰鬥、制定策略，在觀眾面前一一突破競技場的挑戰。以低賤的奴隸身分起家，逐步成為最終冠軍，獲得自由。不成功便成仁。 這是一款角鬥士角色扮演輕度Rogue遊戲，有豐富的生涯管理系統，還有獨特的物理模擬戰鬥系統。在此向各位將死志士致敬！

games.name: 層層夢境
games.short_description: 在夜晚，深入你的潛意識，探尋強大的神器來征服你的噩夢。白天，探索城市紅港區，與之建立關係，開啟你的夢境力量。沉睡, 死亡, 驚醒。如此循環。

games.name: Tower Tactics: Liberation
games.short_description: We fused deck-building roguelikes and tower defenses in a way never seen before - deploy your towers, collect valuable trinkets and cast powerful spells to defend yourself against the Salkoth!

games.name: Kingdom: New Lands
games.short_description: Kingdom: New Lands builds upon the award-winning gameplay and mystery of Kingdom by introducing an abundance of new content to the IGF-nominated title while maintaining the simplicity and depth that legions of monarchs have come to experience and enjoy.

games.name: Soulash 2
games.short_description: Soulash 2 is a sandbox RPG roguelike with a procedurally generated open world, simulated history, skill-based progression system, customizable abilities, material-based crafting, building, trading, and the possibility of total mayhem. Will you save your world or destroy it?

games.name: NIMRODS
games.short_description: 集結無限火力，在這款生存型roguelite射擊遊戲中持續前進。作為槍械製造商的測試部隊，你的任務很簡單：測試最新的槍械技術並搜刮外星行星。收集瘋狂的武器零件，發明能屠殺成千上萬的瘋狂槍械。你可能無法存活，但你的槍械將永存！

games.name: 柏青哥布林 Peglin
games.short_description: 《Peglin》是一款柏青哥式的 Roguelike 遊戲：透過收集各種彈珠並撞擊釘子來對敵人造成傷害。獲取獨特遺物將大幅度改變遊戲規則，使每次遊戲都有不同體驗。小心瞄準，才能在這獨特的回合制 RPG 中存活到最後！

games.name: 我即軍團：替身倖存者
games.short_description: 召喚替身打群架！在享受割草爽快感的同時，合成，昇星，挖礦，鑄造裝備，解鎖新角色，解鎖新配方，解鎖新裝備，發掘全新替身組合，在近乎無盡的可能性中打造屬於自己的戰鬥風格，最終殺出重圍！

games.name: 阿斯加德的陨落
games.short_description: 在類倖存者的 Roguelite 遊戲《Asgard's Fall》中踏上史詩級傳記的冒險。從一群群的怪物中突圍，讓眾神感受你不息的怒火。你的故事會如何發展呢？

games.name: 隔離區-喪尸末日生存
games.short_description: A great catastrophe has come, and you, who are on duty, crash and trapped in a Zed Zone. There are zombies and monsters everywhere, In order to escape, by collecting materials, upgrading skills, building shelters, defeating zombie waves and mysterious mechs, chasing a glimmer of hope.

games.name: 瘋狂手機大亨
games.short_description: 《瘋狂手機大亨》是一款以建立自己的手機帝國為目標的模擬經營遊戲。你將從設計階段開始，自由的打造各類手機，無論是高性價比的平民機，還是性能恐怖的旗艦機，都將幫助你征服市場，賺取財富！從而招募更多員工，進一步擴大公司規模，讓你一步步成為真正的手機大亨。

games.name: Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space
Crab Champions
games.short_description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person roguelike shooter.

games.name: The Test: Reality Check
games.short_description: The Test: Reality Check is one of multiple installments in an ongoing social experiment that can be classified as an atmospheric, psychological-simulation with horror elements. Dive deep into your own psyche to find answers to questions you've kept locked away, hidden from yourself for far too long.

games.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal
games.short_description: Tales of Maj’Eyal is a roguelike RPG, featuring tactical turn-based combat and advanced character building. Play as one of many unique races and classes in the lore-filled world of Eyal, exploring random dungeons, facing challenging battles, and developing characters with your own tailored mix of abilities and powers.

games.name: 修仙故事: 轮回 Cultivation Story: Reincarnation
games.short_description: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation is a top-down pixel art style action roguelike based on cultivation and Chinese mythology.

games.name: 血色鬱嬌遊戲
games.short_description: "陪我玩吧！一直到死為止♡" (CV:夏吉ゆうこ) 在牌組構建Roguelite遊戲《血色鬱嬌遊戲》當中，被綁架的玩家必須每天陪一個郁嬌成性的少女玩一場用鮮血做賭注的投骰子遊戲，並不斷贏到最後。靠改造骰面等賴皮手段克服她提出的刁鑽規則，拚盡全力活到最後吧！

games.name: Quantum Protocol
games.short_description: A deckbuilding card game where it's always your turn. Play as the master hackers of Quantum and take on the most dangerous malware in the world. Every action matters. Make plays, upgrade your deck, and break the enemy board!

games.name: 沉默的蟋蟀
games.short_description: 《沉默的蟋蟀》是一款以鬥蟋蟀為主題的“收集+養成”遊戲。在一個叫做大夏國的地方，四季皆可鬥蟋蟀，人人酷愛鬥蟋蟀，鬥蟋蟀是全民娛樂，更是最重要的產業之一。你可以去衝擊天梯第一，也可以選擇組建自己的蟋蟀戰隊去角逐全國聯賽總冠軍，更可以追求傳說中的無雙蟲王！

games.name: 魔雞馬奇克 2
games.short_description: 魔幻混亂的Roguelike生存遊戲。打造瘋狂魔杖，進化並融合強大魔法，裝備奇葩配件，掌握神聖遺物之力。準備消滅飢餓青蛙群，挑戰強大Boss，體驗獨特不可預測的冒險！

games.name: GTTOD
games.short_description: RISE. FALL. REPEAT. Ascend to the level of the Gods as you battle your way out of a shattered and chaotic dimension in this fast paced parkour FPS rogue-like.

games.name: Backpack Hero
games.short_description: 《背包英雄》是一款Roguelike庫存管理遊戲！收集稀有物品，整理背包排列，消滅攔路敵人！

games.name: Demeo
games.short_description: 探險家們，聯手出擊的時候到了！一股黑暗勢力統治著 RPG 地城探索遊戲《Demeo》的地下世界，你不太可能在這個世界中獨力生存。

games.name: 咔砰！玩具亂鬥屋
games.short_description: 玩具大暴走！在神秘的書桌空間整理、合成海量玩具，DIY構築各色陣容流派的卡通兵團。衝鋒，碰撞，擊飛！開啟一輪輪天馬行空的桌面對決！

games.name: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition
games.short_description: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition was created to be the perfect bitesized roguelike dungeon crawler. Choose your champion and face a relentless crawl through the card-based dungeons, collect items to power your abilities and defeat the gruesome monsters facing you. But keep going FORWARD!

games.name: Infectonator 3: Apocalypse
games.short_description: A campy, crazy pixelart zombie apocalypse arcade sim where you're the bad guy. Drop your virus and spread it across the globe while you unlock a whole horde of bizarre undead to do your bidding.

games.name: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition
games.short_description: In this tactical combat & dungeon crawler mash-up, explore a massive dungeon, full of danger, mystery and secrets. Fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful creatures, with your tank, healer & damage dealers party.

games.name: Zombie Shooter
games.short_description: The human race is in danger again. This time scientists could not cope the imminent threat and became monsters themselves. Crowds of zombie people filled the secret research base. The dreadful contagion is about to spread earth wide. Use the last chance to save the humanity from total annihilation!

games.name: 團本自走棋
games.short_description: 《團本自走棋》是一款50vs50的深度策略自走棋遊戲。核心玩法圍繞著招募英雄、啟用羈絆以及通過飛升系統提升戰力。遊戲豐富的 Roguelite 成長體系和職業專精飛升機制，確保了每一次對局都能帶來新鮮感和獨特的挑戰。玩家可以不斷擴編隊伍，最終目標是組建一支擁有高達 50 名成員的強大無雙戰團，在策略的海洋中乘風破浪。

games.name: Dungeons of Aether
games.short_description: Delve into Dungeons of Aether, a turn-based dungeon crawler set in the Rivals of Aether universe. Control four new heroes as they uncover the mysteries of the Julesvale Caverns in Story Mode or test your mettle in the grueling Challenge Dungeons.

games.name: 挂姬恶魔 IDLE DEVILS
games.short_description: 《掛姬惡魔》是一款休閒策略性放置遊戲，除了豐富的角色、技能、裝備系統外，您還可以自由選擇惡魔進行培養，通過她來征服新的女惡魔，不斷擴大自己的勢力，最終完成魔界救贖，成為真正的魔王。歡迎各位魔王直接加入我們QQ群285229191。

games.name: Dead Age 2: The Zombie Survival RPG
Soulslinger: Envoy of Death
games.short_description: You are a gunslinger in limbo, involved in a gritty war against "The Cartel", a ruthless organization harvesting souls to break free of the shackles of the afterlife. Grow stronger with each new run, gather the essence of lost souls to take on the biggest threats in this rogue-lite FPS!

games.name: Vampire Survivors
games.short_description: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you. Be the bullet hell!

games.name: The Test: Secrets of the Soul 2
games.short_description: You will answer questions that will reveal things deep within. Some will be uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and are you SURE you want the answers you seek? For it is time to once again unlock "Secrets of the Soul..."

games.name: UNDERDOGS
games.short_description: UNDERGROUND MECH FIGHTS! Wrap yourself in 5 tons of metal & go smashing through a dark scene of full-on metal-on-metal violence!

games.name: Dead Estate
games.short_description: Cornered with nowhere else to turn, can you escape the monster-filled mansion? Dead Estate is a gory, fast-paced, challenging roguelike shooter with a heavy emphasis on horror.

games.name: Into the Breach
games.short_description: 控制來自未來的強大機甲，擊敗外星威脅。在這款回合制戰略遊戲中，每一次拯救世界的嘗試，都是隨機生成的全新挑戰。

games.name: Risk of Rain 2
games.short_description: 浴血奮戰，殺出暴戾怪物的重圍，逃離混亂外星球上的劫難。您可孤軍奮戰，也可與好友並肩作戰。 以出人意料的方式合成戰利品，同時精通每個角色，直至您自己成為初次迫降時曾滿心懼怕的恐怖威脅。

games.name: Approaching Infinity
games.short_description: Approaching Infinity is a turn-based space RPG in the spirit of the sci-fi classics, with endless progression and exploration. Fight tactical battles or use diplomacy. Seek powerful artifacts. Quest, mine, trade, and craft. Level up forever or attempt 10 victories in hardcore or adventure mode.

games.name: 種呱得呱 Rana Card
games.short_description: Rana Card is a roguelike deck-builder where you play as a farm manager chasing TimeTech's KPI targets. Draw cards in high-stakes moments, survive Time Explosions, and unlock powerful cards. Build your deck, chart your own path, and face branching events and cataclysmic years on the road to success.

games.name: Army of Ruin
games.short_description: Wreak havoc on countless foes with mighty weapons and deadly spells! Enhance your skills and face even greater dangers! Army of Ruin is an auto-shooter where you become the Bullet Hell.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
games.short_description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR 是一款單機類倖存者放置型射擊遊戲。玩家可裝備 Deep Rock Galactic 中的各種武器對抗無窮無盡的致命外星生物，並挖掘地下寶石解鎖強力的升級。這是一款一名矮人隻身對抗整座哈克瑟斯星球的遊戲！

games.name: The Perfect Tower II
games.short_description: The Perfect Tower II is a mix between an incremental and a tower defense game. Build a town, manage resources and explore a variety of mini-games and tons of upgrades. Fully automate your game and watch numbers going up!

games.name: Poker Quest: Swords and Spades
games.short_description: Poker Quest is a fantasy roguelike where players use a standard 52-card deck to take on fierce enemies in epic battles. Featuring over 20 unique heroes, thousands of items, and deep gameplay that will test even the most experienced players.

games.name: 槍途末路
games.short_description: Guntouchables is an online co-op doomsday roguelite for 1-4 players. You play as a gun-toting group of 'preppers' trying to reclaim the world from an ever-evolving horde of mutants, constantly working to develop new unique ways to kill you.

games.name: 3 Days War
games.short_description: 《三日戰爭》是一款獨特的多人對戰策略戰爭遊戲。融合了RTS+4X的機制規則，讓數十玩家在同一戰場中，合作、對抗、背叛、聯合，進行一場為期三天的即時大戰略競技。指揮官們，用你們的技巧、策略、博弈甚至欺騙，成為最終的勝利者吧！

games.name: 放棄
games.short_description: 《Foregone》是一款流暢快節奏的 2D 動作平台遊戲，充滿了傳奇的戰利品和絢麗的像素美術。收集琳琅满目的強大武器，揭開充滿遺憾與陰謀的精彩故事，一路打敗成群的敵人以拯救卡拉甘。

games.name: Once Upon a Galaxy
games.short_description: ONCE UPON A GALAXY is an easy to learn Card Battler with incredible strategic depth and near infinite fun! Which of your favorite characters from myth and fairy tale will you choose?

games.name: Inscryption
games.short_description: (Inscryption)是一款墨黑色卡片式奧德賽史詩，將roguelike牌組建構、密室逃脫風格的謎題和心理恐怖融合到血腥的冰沙中。更黑暗的是刻在卡片上的秘密…

games.name: Paint the Town Red
games.short_description: Paint the Town Red is a chaotic first person melee combat game set in different locations and time periods. The voxel-based enemies can be punched, bashed, kicked, stabbed and sliced completely dynamically using almost anything that isn't nailed down.

games.name: 卡牌生存：热带岛屿
games.short_description: 《卡牌生存》是一款通过卡牌交互沉浸式还原了野外求生体验的游戏。由于种种意外，你开局被困荒岛，只有依靠自己的智慧和掌握的各种技能才能在这片荒无人烟的区域生存下来。使用和组合各种卡牌来探索区域，收集资源和制造工具。

games.name: Depersonalization
games.short_description: "May all stories find their best endings." "Depersonalization" is an anthology-style game featuring standalone chapters and diverse story genres. We continuously collect and create a wide variety of stories, ultimately housing them in a library that transcends the flow of time.

games.name: 黑书
games.short_description: “Black Book” is a dark RPG Adventure, based on Slavic myths, in which you play as a young sorceress. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures.

games.name: Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles
games.short_description: 《阿斯特賴亞》是一款骰子牌組構築類Rogue遊戲，以骰子取代卡牌來翻轉牌組構築規則，並有獨特的雙重「傷害」系統：淨化與腐敗。建立足夠強大的骰子組合，淨化阿斯特賴亞失控的腐敗並拯救星系。

games.name: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate
games.short_description: Chess, but you replace your entire army with a royal shotgun. A unique strategy roguelike based on the timeless checkboard classic.

games.name: 牆世界
games.short_description: 騎乘巨大機械蜘蛛探索神秘世界之牆：挖掘珍貴資源、升級裝備以擊退大量怪物，以及在襲擊之間發掘異地生物群系。你能夠生還並揭開世界之牆的秘密嗎？

games.name: Genome Guardian
games.short_description: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic roguelite turret shooter with macroscopic depth. Survive 6 modes using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and power-ups on this psychedelic journey to the heart of the abyss. Shmup Mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: Tainted Grail: Conquest
games.short_description: A unique, infinitely replayable, story-driven hybrid between a deck-building Roguelike and an RPG game. Explore the ever-changing maps, fight with deadly enemies, and learn what happened to the cursed island of Avalon.

games.name: Niche - a genetics survival game
games.short_description: 生態位 - 遺傳學生存遊戲是一種基於回合的策略遊戲，結合模擬和遊戲元素。 根據真正的遺傳學來塑造你自己的動物種類。 保持你的物種在所有的可能性，如捕食者，氣候變化和蔓延的疾病。

games.name: Ratatan
games.short_description: 《啦嗒噹》是一款融合了節奏跟橫軸動作，可以最多四人一起合作的Roguelike節奏動作遊戲。有100隻以上的角色一起展開激烈的大亂鬥。伴隨著充滿動態節奏感的BGM一起打敗敵人吧！

games.name: 鐵壁矩陣：軸突塔防
games.short_description: 厭倦了千篇一律的塔防？在《鐵壁矩陣：軸突塔防》中體驗一場新奇之旅！你不再僅僅是防守者，更是創造者。通過搭建平臺、連接道路、設置障礙，打造出獨一無二的防御堡壘， 整个地圖就是你的畫布，來書寫你的傳奇吧！（戰役&生存模式支持雙人聯機，合作模式支持四人聯機！）

games.name: Terracards
games.short_description: 種植，銷售，學習，重複。Terracards是一款策略性的盜賊喜歡的卡牌建構遊戲，您在其中管理自己的農場。您將透過卡片利用動物、作物和結構，每一輪都將它們轉化為有價值的資源和財富。但是要小心 - 如果你的資金耗盡，那麼遊戲就結束了。

games.name: Cyber Shadow
games.short_description: 這世界已被機器人物所佔領。闇影身為其族人唯一的生存者，受絕望委託踏上最後的征程，去揭開世界走向萬劫不復的原因。

games.name: 轮回修仙路
games.short_description: 轮回修仙路是一款开放世界的3D修仙游戏，仙界破碎，化为无尽小世界，其中妖魔横行，正魔大战，仙路崩灭。唯有通过炼丹炼器，强大自己。你能否御剑扫灭妖魔，渡过天劫轮回，逆天成仙！

games.name: Scarlet Tower
games.short_description: Hunt during the day, be hunted during the NIGHT! Scarlet Tower is a gothic horror casual game with roguelike and RPG elements, like talent trees, classes, familiars and more!

games.name: Castle Of Alchemists
games.short_description: 在這款節奏快速的塔防/動作混合型遊戲中保衛你的城堡，並欣賞刻畫入微的像素藝術！扮演經過煉金術強化的戰士貝拉托、放置陷阱、建造防禦塔、製作強力武器，並保衛你的家園！這座城堡的命運全部操之在你手！

games.name: Bloody Walls
games.short_description: The world was plunged into chaos following an accident at a bio-weapon research facility. 100% of the earth's population has been infected. There is an antidote that blocks infection from the airborne strain of the virus, but the effect is temporary.

games.name: 地城魔法風雲
games.short_description: 地城魔法風雲是神秘的地城冒險遊戲，發生在一個魔法就是卡牌，有卡牌就能用魔法的世界。探索古老的廢墟、拿到稀有的卡片，並使用巧妙的魔法組合擊敗你的敵人，並打造一副可以拯救世界的傳奇法術牌組。

games.name: Survivors of the Dawn
games.short_description: A roguelite horde-survival bullet heaven. Become THE final bullet against alien chaos! Die, evolve again, explore terminals, unlock weapon item power-ups and synergize out of dawn.

games.name: FATE: Reawakened
games.short_description: Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your FATE awaits!

games.name: DAIMON BLADES
games.short_description: From the creators of E.Y.E: Divine Cybermancy, a cult cyberpunk RPG. Daimon Blades is a brutal first person slasher that combines the depth of action RPGs and replayability of roguelites. Launch expeditions solo or up to 4 players, and survive the many horrors of the Daimon Realm.

games.name: LET IT DIE: INFERNO
games.short_description: ──覺悟吧，悍不畏死的冒險家啊── 大災厄後突然出現的巨大洞穴「地獄門」。 在時空扭曲、異形融合體蠢動的深處，沉眠著足以支配世界的秘寶『死神之眼』。 你，是名為「侵略者」的不死冒險家。 戰勝來自死神的挑戰，從地獄深處抓住屬於你的未來！

games.name: Dead Cells
games.short_description: 死亡細胞是以類銀河戰士惡魔城為基礎所設計的Rogue-lite動作平台遊戲。探險變化無窮的浩瀚城堡吧！當然...必須擁有守護2座城堡的守護者與進行2D魂味戰鬥的能力。遊戲中並無檢查點，請不斷地殺戮、死亡和學習！

games.name: Noita
games.short_description: Noita is a magical action roguelite set in a world where every pixel is physically simulated. Fight, explore, melt, burn, freeze and evaporate your way through the procedurally generated world using spells you've created yourself.

games.name: UFO 50
games.short_description: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs. Our goal is to combine a familiar 8-bit aesthetic with new ideas and modern game design.

games.name: (the) Gnorp Apologue
games.short_description: (the) Gnorp Apologue is the journey of the gnorps as you guide them towards their goal of delightfully excessive wealth accumulation.

games.name: Seraph's Last Stand
games.short_description: Create insane builds and break the game in all possible ways to get your name into the leaderboards! Every round you get stronger, but so does the enemies...

games.name: 黎明前20分鐘
games.short_description: 快圍剿巢穴裡不斷增生的克魯甦魔物！升級武器，選擇你的專屬職業，策略組合，一把20分鐘的Roguelike體驗，直接射爆刷爆爽爆！ ！你還可以選擇10分鐘模式！

games.name: Death Skid Marks
games.short_description: Death Skid Marks is a rogue-like car combat game about what so many of us have experienced: a road trip to a music gig… only in this game, things get violent. The game uniquely blends top down arcade action and RPG mechanics.

games.name: Tallowmere
games.short_description: Raise your shield. Indulge Lady Tallowmere and her lovingly violent dungeons. New rooms are created every time you play. How deep can you delve?

games.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
games.short_description: 在白天管理你的墓地，埋葬和火化屍體，維護墓穴，滿足訪客的要求，種植作物，經營商店並解鎖升級。當你建設防禦並為生存而戰時，面對無情的殭屍群！

games.name: Aces & Adventures
games.short_description: Aces & Adventures is a deckbuilding RPG with poker-powered combat. Craft your deck, combining poker hands with powerful ability cards. Journey through 13 fully-voiced campaigns to save the Life Tree, or tackle procedurally-generated runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

games.name: Nosferatu: The Wrath of Malachi
games.short_description: It is a misty evening in the year of our lord 1912. The Pattersons, a poor but proud aristocratic family of the British nobility, and some of their closest friends, arrive at the castle Malachi residence of a wealthy Romanian Count.

games.name: EMPTY SHELL
games.short_description: EMPTY SHELL will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a Japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a "recovery operation" without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

games.name: 异端尖叉
games.short_description: 親愛的應聘者，我們誠邀您擔任地獄經理一職。您我們的卡組構建電腦系統來建造地獄之塔，鎮壓冥界的魔物大軍。祝您好運！

games.name: 瘋狂寵物秀
games.short_description: 《瘋狂寵物秀》是一款火爆的Roguelite清版射擊游戲。你將扮演各種各樣的變異動物，在一個古怪的電視節目中使用五花八門的武器擊敗對手。選擇你的最愛的小動物，帶上最好的裝備，爲了名聲和贊助款大殺四方吧！

games.name: Kelipot / 形骸骑士
games.short_description: 神秘的瘟疫，突然降臨在古老的塞勒菲斯，當白虎雙子深陷其中，他們將如何選擇？平台動作Roguelite遊戲《Kelipot》到來！豐富的劇情、逐幀繪制的動畫以及手繪2D風格的場景，探尋其中並找到瘋狂世界之下的真相吧！

games.name: Curse of the Dead Gods
games.short_description: 為了尋找無人知曉的財富、永恆的生命與超越凡人的神力，你來到了這處遭受詛咒的神廟，一座彷彿永無止盡的迷宮，遍布無底深淵、致命陷阱和駭人怪物。

games.name: King Arthur: Legion IX
games.short_description: Dive into a unique blend of turn-based tactics and character-centric RPGs. Lead the skilled Roman tribune Gaius Julius Mento as he navigates through the dark fantasy realm of Avalon.

games.name: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
games.short_description: 《Carmageddon》重磅回歸，帶來殘暴的輕度Rogue遊戲，掀起一波混亂的載具戰鬥。調整升級，並對末日後的殭屍群展開毀滅攻勢。延續經典，重新打造，絕不手下留情。

games.name: 東方虹龍洞 ～ Unconnected Marketeers.
games.short_description: 買う、売る、貰う、手放す いつから人間は所有権を自由に扱えると勘違いしたのか レインボーでイマモリアルなシューティング幻想！

games.name: 箭箭剑 Arrow a Row
games.short_description: Arrow a row is a game in which you shoot arrows (of course) in a row! or maybe two rows! (maybe three?) Choose your power-ups and defeat the Boss.

games.name: Alien Shooter
games.short_description: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

games.name: FATE
games.short_description: Play (or Re-play) This Classic Dungeon Crawler!During the golden days of action RPGs, FATE was a powerhouse, winning runner-up for PC Magazine’s Role-Playing Game of the year. Popular enough to spawn 3 sequels, this was one of the premier dungeon crawlers of its time.

games.name: Duelists of Eden
games.short_description: Build a deck and battle online in real-time action with rollback netcode!

games.name: 點老救世記 - dotAGE
games.short_description: Village elder, help us! The Apocalypse is approaching, and we need your guidance to survive. Assign your workers and build a thriving village against the pending doom. DotAGE is the merciless survival roguelite turn-based city builder. Will you fulfill the Prophecy?

games.name: ROGUE LIGHT DECK BUILDER
games.short_description: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.

games.name: Muck
games.short_description: Muck is a survival-roguelike. Collect resources, find items & build a base to survive for as long as you can.

games.name: Patch Quest
games.short_description: Patch Quest 是唯一一款結合了 Roguelike 和銀河戰士惡魔城元素的遊戲，玩家可以騎乘遊戲中的任何怪獸來享受冒險的樂趣！拼接而成的迷宮將不斷變化，準備好使出渾身解數，透過跳躍、滑行、掘進、撕咬、爬行、索網攀爬和爆破等各種方式去探索精彩世界。想生存下去，您需要讓自然之力為自己所用！

games.name: Spelunky 2
games.short_description: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new. Meet the next generation of explorers as they find themselves on the Moon, searching for treasure and missing family.

games.name: Monstrum
games.short_description: Monstrum takes the traditional survival horror formula and remixes it completely with procedurally generated levels, permadeath, and AI driven predators, ensuring that nowhere on its derelict cargo ship is ever truly safe.

games.name: Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale
games.short_description: Krumit's Tale, the second game in the Meteorfall universe, is a new take on the deckbuilding roguelike genre. Use your cards to clear dungeons, then upgrade your deck with new cards and perks to press forward. The fate of the world is in your hands.

games.name: Children of Morta
games.short_description: Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

games.name: Time Wasters
games.short_description: Time Wasters是一款太空射擊的子彈天堂遊戲。裝備和升級武器，消滅成群的敵人，並收集Time & Space Cubes，使時間線變得對你有利。

games.name: The Dungeon Beneath
games.short_description: The Dungeon Beneath is a tactical rogue-like autobattler. Gather your party and descend into the dungeon, battling your way through room after room of nefarious enemies. Collect powerful artifacts and equipment to create an endless variety of strategies.

games.name: Shadow Corridor 2 雨ノ四葩
games.short_description: 在一片漆黑中不停迷路！但感覺卻超級有趣！沉睡在黑暗中的寬廣迴廊會在每次遊玩時變更形狀。碰上那些可怕的徘迴者就只能拼命的逃。活用各具特色的道具、研究蘊含特殊力量的歌牌組合，並冒險在黑暗中尋找出口吧！

games.name: 《聯盟外傳：狙魔者™》
games.short_description: 《聯盟外傳：狙魔者™》是一款基於《英雄聯盟》故事背景的動作角色扮演遊戲，由打造過《Moonlighter》的 Digital Sun 團隊研發。你將扮演賽勒斯，一個從多年囚禁中獲得解放的法師。揮舞曾束縛著你的鎖鏈，從狙魔者的暴政中解放蒂瑪西亞。

games.name: Blazing Beaks
games.short_description: Roguelite - where too much greediness can be fatal. A colorful world with armed birds blazing their way through piles of mutants, monsters and creepy creatures. Lots of mysteries to unravel, secrets to discover and levels to explore.

games.name: Across the Obelisk
games.short_description: 在多人合作的 Roguelite 牌組構築遊戲中啟程，每個選擇在此都很重要！打造出力量驚人的牌組。可獨自一人或與最多三名朋友踏上旅程。在《勇闖巨岩塔》中規劃隊伍走向榮耀之路，展開深奧的策略戰鬥，對抗強大的敵人，接受使命，拯救瑟那錫亞王國！

games.name: 幽冥之王
games.short_description: 《幽冥之王》是一款輕量版肉鴿（Roguelite）的回合制戰術遊戲，牌庫組合千變萬化。你將扮演一名亡靈之主，組建你的骷髏牌庫，召喚骸骨大軍和其它鬼怪，將村鎮和城市從生靈的褻瀆中解放出來。

games.name: One Deck Dungeon
games.short_description: The hit roguelike adventure that captures all the fun of a dungeon crawl in a single deck of cards!

games.name: Help Will Come Tomorrow
games.short_description: In an uninhabitable Siberian wilderness, in a wake of October Revolution, a group of passengers survives the mysterious catastrophe of Trans-Siberian railway train. They must endure in a harsh ice-clad climate until rescue arrives. Facing many dangers, their own weaknesses and, their own prejudice.

games.name: Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival
games.short_description: 探索地牢、與成群的怪物搏鬥，並在遼闊的地圖上生存。這就是 Ocean Keeper 一 款具有塔防元素的動作随机生成遊戲。在洞穴中開採資源，每個洞穴都是獨一無二的。自訂您的機甲蜘蛛、升級不同的武器，並面對不會讓您有任何機會的巨大老闆！

games.name: HoloCure - Save the Fans!
games.short_description: Play as your favorite Vtubers from Hololive! Fight, explore, and clear your way through armies of fans and save them from their mind-control in this unofficial free fan-game.

games.name: Mini Motorways
games.short_description: Mini Motorways 是關於在城市發展中設計道路網的策略模擬遊戲。按部就班地建設交通網絡，創造繁華的大都市。重新設計您的道路並放置高速公路，讓每個人都能到達目的地。你能讓城市運轉多久？

games.name: Roboquest
games.short_description: 機器人尋寶是一款快節奏的FPS Rogue-lite遊戲，背景設定在一個焦土般的未來世界。您是一個重啟的守護者，隨時準備踢一些金屬屁股吧！ 您可以與朋友一起或獨自一人戰鬥，在不斷變化的環境中消滅大量致命的機器人。

games.name: 饑荒聯機版
games.short_description: 《饑荒聯機版》是原生態生存遊戲《饑荒》的多人聯機獨立資料片。

games.name: Akane
games.short_description: 2121 A.D, with no escape options, Akane prepares for her final battle in the rain-soaked neon streets of Mega-Tokyo. Akane is an arena arcade slasher. Take out as many yakuza as possible, slashing and shooting in a one-hit-one-kill fight to the death.

games.name: .Forty-Five
games.short_description: A perfect mix of card game, rogue-lite, and pure wild west mayhem. Explore an ever-changing map, collect cards, and battle enemies. Cards are Bullets and are loaded into the revolver to gun down enemies. Experience .Forty-Five's innovative gameplay for free!

games.name: 魔法工藝 Magicraft
games.short_description: 《魔法工藝》是一款Roguelike遊戲，利用各種各樣的法術搭配出難以想像的法術效果，超高自由度的構建就連開發者也無法窮盡。

games.name: 孤狼 OTXO
games.short_description: 在這款殘酷的快節奏黑暗風格roguelite遊戲中，你將進入一座令人匪夷所思的抽象風格宅邸去營救一位心愛之人，遊戲中包含大量需要精準操控的激烈槍戰以及扭曲時空的慢動作鏡頭。面對你內心的惡魔，去揭開這座宅邸的祕密吧。

games.name: Swords and Sandals Classic Collection
games.short_description: "Gladiator, gladiator, gladiator, Swords and Sandals, Gladiatorrrrr!"You grew up playing the legendary Swords and Sandals turn based combat game series. These games have been played over half a billion times. Swords and Sandals is nostalgia, Swords and Sandals is life.

games.name: Spiritfall
games.short_description: 《Spiritfall》靈感取自平台格鬥遊戲，是款快節奏的輕度Rogue動作遊戲。運用變幻莫測的神聖力量，把大批敵人連劈帶砍，重擊撞牆。

games.name: Vault of the Void
games.short_description: 《虛空穹牢》是一款快節奏的Roguelike牌組構築遊戲。掌控全局，運籌制勝。隨著遊戲深入靈活更改牌組，打造出最致命的連擊招式。用虛空石升級並自定義卡牌，為它注入新的力量，助你擊敗虛空及其爪牙。

games.name: Invisible, Inc.
games.short_description: 指挥 Invisible（隐形公司）的特工执行任务，潜入世界上最危险的大型企业。每一项任务都有极高风险和超高回报，处处讲求隐秘、精确和团队协作，而稍有不慎，你麾下的特工便可能命丧当场。

games.name: Forestrike — 預視武宗
games.short_description: 《Forestrike — 預視武宗》是一款武術 Roguelite 遊戲。每一次死亡，都是讓你更接近戰前制勝的一步。善用「預見」這項能力，在實戰前反覆推演各種可能，直到掌握通往最終榮耀的道路——那就是在沒有使用「預見」的情況下贏得勝利。

games.name: 湮滅線 (Oblivion Override)
games.short_description: 純粹，快節奏，頗具難度的橫版動作遊戲，你將探索地下飽受戰爭蹂躪的廢土設施，體驗26+種截然不同動作設計的近戰兵器，練習自己的戰鬥風格；遊戲繼承了類惡魔城遊戲與Roguelike的經典設計，但徹底解放了玩家的位移能力。閃避，衝刺，奔行在不斷進化的地城牆壁間與敵人激鬥起舞。

games.name: Word Play
games.short_description: Spell words, pick perks, score points, and survive until the end. Every round is different. How far can you make it?

games.name: Organ Trail: Director's Cut
games.short_description: Organ Trail is a retro zombie survival game. Travel westward in a station wagon with 4 of your friends, scavenging for supplies and fending off the undead. Members of your party might die of dysentery or you might have to put them down yourself when they get bit.
dev: The Men Who Wear Many Hats
pub: The Men Who Wear Many Hats

games.name: ShapeHero Factory 塗鴉英雄工廠
games.short_description: 塗鴉你的英雄軍團，守衛魔法世界！在《塗鴉英雄工廠》中，一場小小戰爭即將打響！你將通過組合各式圖形，生產出可愛的小英雄，他們會在戰鬥中自動出擊。而你的任務則是打造出“最優工廠”，讓這些小英雄們如潮水般湧現，重新封印“大災厄”！

games.name: 金色的光芒
games.short_description: Eat weapons, be scared and question your own mind in this Survival-Horror FPS Prop Hunt Roguelike about meat. Walls are watching you!

games.name: 斯諾德維爾之戰 (Wildfrost)
games.short_description: 與各大元素戰鬥，盡在戰術Roguelike遊戲《斯諾德維爾之戰》！穿越冰封雪原，收集強力卡牌，驅逐永恆寒冬……

games.name: Gladiator Guild Manager
games.short_description: A strategic autobattler sim where you build a team of gladiators, compete in arenas, plan fight tactics, and form alliances. Combine fighters, beasts, and mages, develop and equip them to optimize your well-oiled fighting machine, dominate the championships, and leave your mark on the world.

games.name: Hades
games.short_description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion, Transistor, and Pyre.

games.name: Slay the Spire
games.short_description: 我們將卡牌遊戲與 Roguelike 遊戲融為一體，製作出了這款最棒的單機牌組構築遊戲。打造出獨一無二的牌組、遇見無數離奇的生物、發現威力強大的遺物、去屠戮這座高塔吧！

games.name: Star of Providence
games.short_description: Star of Providence is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Explore a large, abandoned facility in search of incredible power, fighting dangerous foes and gaining new weapons and upgrades as you progress.

games.name: 黃老餅夢遊驚奇
games.short_description: “黃遊”是丸霸無雙的新作，是一款無探索只刷怪的Roguelite平台動作遊戲。這裡有多種奇怪的敵人和場景，豐富有深度的武器和裝備，獨特的快節奏“大坐”能力，另外還充滿了各種沒有用的細節。高端大氣，沁人心脾。(支持控制器)

games.name: Nuclear Throne
games.short_description: 《Nuclear Throne》是一款以末世为背景的俯视角肉鸽射击游戏。这可不是那种“人类存亡之战”的末世。在这里，人类早已灭绝，世界沦为变种与怪物的乐园。你能否成功登上核能王座？

games.name: Halls of Torment 苦痛殿堂
games.short_description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

games.name: Warsim: The Realm of Aslona
games.short_description: Warsim is a deep, rich text based kingdom ruling sim unlike anything else, complete with charming ASCII graphics. Navigate the millions of different procedurally generated races, events and areas with a huge emphasis on player choice. Don't let its look fool you, there is depth in every direction.

games.name: Dwarf Fortress
games.short_description: 史上最具深度與複雜性的世界模擬器。傳奇遊戲《矮人要塞》現已登陸Steam！在這個由程序生成，擁有自洽生態、動態歷史與百萬細節的幻想宇宙中，構築一座要塞，努力幫助矮人文明生存下去。

games.name: The Binding of Isaac
games.short_description: Now 20% More Evil with the Free Halloween update!

games.name: Beecarbonize
games.short_description: Do you have what it takes to save the planet? Beecarbonize is an environmental card strategy game with climate change as your opponent.

games.name: Cat God Ranch
games.short_description: 帶領上百隻“睿智”小動物給貓神大人上貢！！ 7個動物家族，100+動物，10+貓神，100+道具，各種動物組合等你探索！

games.name: 東方光耀夜 ~ Lost Branch of Legend
games.short_description: 歡迎來到永遠亭，使用不同顏色的法力構建你心目中的卡組，對陣能力各異的幻想鄉少女，追回珍奇的月之秘寶。 還有，請享受變幻莫測的Roguelike與華麗的彈幕！

games.name: PAC-MAN 256
games.short_description: PAC-MAN 256 is the maze that never ends. But the Glitch is coming for you…

games.name: 超時空方舟
games.short_description: 超時空方舟是一款混合了組隊RPG、卡牌構築、Roguelike要素於一體的單機遊戲。通過招募擁有特殊能力的隊員並學習各種技能，組成最強的隊伍，最終拯救扭曲的世界。

games.name: Death Must Die
games.short_description: Descend the nether in search of Death himself! Choose from God-given powers to slay his hordes of minions. Unlock new heroes, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite hack and slash survivors game.

games.name: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok
games.short_description: 《北歐之燼：諸神黃昏倖存者》(Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok) 是一款驚險刺激的北歐風格 Roguelite 倖存者遊戲。面對潮水般蜂擁而至的怪群，您只能奮力求生。

games.name: For The King
games.short_description: For The King是一款結合桌遊和 roguelike 類型元素的跨越領域戰略型 RPG 遊戲。可以在線和單機進行單人或多人合作的遊戲體驗。

games.name: Colt Canyon
games.short_description: 在充斥敵人的山谷射殺出一條血路！山谷埋藏著寶藏和武器，也不乏阻礙和各種嗜血的壞蛋！《Colt Canyon》是款別具風格的像素藝術射擊遊戲，蘊含 roguelike 元素和即時戰鬥。你必須拯救被殘酷盜匪綁架的夥伴。

games.name: Astronarch
games.short_description: A fusion of roguelikes and auto-battlers like never before seen. Recruit a party of mysterious heroes, navigate deadly lands, collect an arsenal of magical items, and vanquish a new evil threatening the realm!

games.name: 青天井
games.short_description: 《青天井》是一款以麻將為主題的卡牌roguelike遊戲。 踏入「青天井」，使用源自世界各地麻將風格的牌組打造出屬於自己的獨特構築。 克服一個又一個心魔，抵達井底並揭露塵封的真相。

games.name: 小小侠客模拟器
games.short_description: 《小小侠客模拟器》是一款以古代武侠世界为背景的 Roguelike 回合制策略游戏。玩家将通过上百种武学招式和计略构筑独特流派，应对上百个随机事件和多种敌人的挑战。游戏注重策略性和多样性，每次冒险都将为您带来不同的体验。

games.name: 侍神大亂戰
games.short_description: 《侍神大亂戰Samurai Bringer》是隨著每個階段而產生變化的遊戲。 對抗來自戰國時代的眾多武士和妖怪，提升戰技，向討伐八岐大蛇為目標進發的和風Roguelite動作遊戲。

games.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2
games.short_description: 本作是廣受好評的遊戲《Vermintide》的續作。這款遊戲將以震撼的視覺效果和開創性的近戰動作遊戲方式，將第一人稱視角合作遊戲推向新的高度。馬上加入戰鬥吧！

games.name: HELLCARD
games.short_description: 《地獄卡牌》是一款既可單人遊玩又可多人聯機的卡牌遊戲，搶先體驗階段即擁有300張規模的卡池並支持聯機。你需要合理利用與怪物的距離及各卡牌的特性。招募AI控制的同伴，或是攜手其他玩家，與他們一起合作對抗地獄魔軍和大魔王本尊吧。

games.name: 武林求生
games.short_description: 在這款輕肉鴿（roguelite）生存遊戲中成為一名武術大師吧，遊戲風格深受80年代經典動作電影啟發。運用拳腳的同時，利用周圍環境助你打退成波的惡徒。掌握強大連招，精進武藝技巧，還有記好了——手邊的一切都可以成為武器！

games.name: Be My Horde
games.short_description: Be My Horde is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.

games.name: RUNGORE
games.short_description: Card game mechanics - check. Real time battles - check. Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

games.name: Sunless Skies: Sovereign Edition
games.short_description: SAIL THE STARS. BETRAY YOUR QUEEN. MURDER A SUN. Sunless Skies is a Gothic Horror roleplay game with a focus on exploration and exquisite storytelling.

games.name: King Arthur: Knight's Tale
games.short_description: A unique hybrid between turn-based tactical games and traditional, character-centric RPGs. Knight's Tale is a modern retelling of a classic Arthurian mythology story filtered through the dark fantasy tropes, a twist on the traditional tales of chivalry.

games.name: 降妖散記
games.short_description: 《降妖散記》是一款國風卡組構建Roguelike 遊戲。上天無道，妖孽橫行。在一次次與妖怪的對決中收集不同的招式卡牌，輔之以修煉合適的心法／丹術／蠱術，找到自己的道路，試著為被妖怪蹂躪的世人帶來一絲希望。

games.name: Swords and Sandals Immortals
games.short_description: Gladiator! Grab your sword, equip your sandals and take on the world in multiplayer Swords and Sandals! Brutal turn-based combat where gladiators can lose limbs, wield guitars and yell so loudly enemy heads will fall off. This is the most fun you'll ever have in the arena!

games.name: Dead Age
games.short_description: Survive the zombie apocalypse with a “Final Fantasy” turn-based combat and permanent death! Manage survivors, craft materials, and make difficult decisions. Defend your camp against hordes of the undead to prevail in this non-linear rogue-lite (comparable to FTL). Innovative Indie Survival-RPG!

games.name: 塑战核心
games.short_description: 《Battle Shapers》是一款標榜高速戰鬥的科幻風第一人稱Roguelite遊戲。在遊戲中，玩家將射擊和粉碎墮落的機器人大軍。玩家可以從冷酷無情的電馭之王身上竊取其強大的武器、能力和改變遊戲規則的力量。

games.name: 海山：崑崙鏡
games.short_description: 扮演神秘劍客，使用20把形態各異的寶劍和90多種絢麗劍招。穿梭不同的時空，修練功法和收集法寶，擊敗從封印中逃脫至人間的邪祟妖魔。

games.name: Citywars Tower Defense
games.short_description: Citywars TD 是一款可愛的多人第三人稱生存塔防。 建造塔樓、收集資源、製作工具、升級武器、升級建築物、與朋友一起擴展你的城市，並在下一波怪物到來之前在壓力下工作。

games.name: Streets of Rogue
games.short_description: Fight, sneak, and hack your way through randomly generated cities. It's like Nuclear Throne meets Deus Ex, mixed with the anarchy of GTA. Rogue-lite meets immersive sim, and goes completely insane.

games.name: Enter the Gungeon
games.short_description: 挺進地牢是彈幕+地牢探險的遊戲。

games.name: Mortal Sin
games.short_description: Mortal Sin is a chaotic, blood-soaked roguelike where skill is power, and overconfidence is death. Carve through procedurally generated nightmares with brutal melee and flashy, satisfying combos.

games.name: 瘟疫清零计划 Project Zero
games.short_description: 这是一款3D俯视角的Roguelike射击游戏。 通过选择不同的天赋，玩家将Build出一个超强幸存者。 从而可以更好地击杀丧尸，并且活下来。 最终，玩家将会背负结束这场瘟疫的使命，为“清零”而战吧！

games.name: Soulstone Survivors
games.short_description: 挑戰虛空領主，擊殺眾多爪牙，收集靈魂石，成為神祇吧！在這款動作肉鴿遊戲中，玩家可以學習神秘咒語、鍛造強大武器、解鎖諸多角色，探索別具一格的組合技，最終征服虛空。

games.name: Sky Rogue
games.short_description: Sky Rogue is a fwooshy rogue-lite action flight simulator! Blow things up over land, sea, and air, on an infinite number of procedurally-generated islands. Go toe-to-toe with enemy aces or assault giant flying aircraft carriers, but watch out for volleys of missiles; when you die, you're dead.

games.name: 無盡愛麗絲
games.short_description: 《無盡愛麗絲》擁有 Roguelite 隨機要素和輕 RPG 養成，玩家選擇不同戰鬥風格的角色進行冒險，擊敗敵人並探索地圖蒐集強化要素，透過不同隨機要素的組成來強化自身，可以單人獨自闖關也可以最多 4 人合作挑戰。

games.name: LONESTAR
games.short_description: 孤星獵人是一款Roguelike強策略玩法的飛船對決遊戲。作為一名宇宙賞金獵人，你將抓捕散布於星際間的在逃罪犯，通過「對波」這一獨特的方式贏得戰鬥，收穫懸賞獎勵與假期時光。尋找宇宙寶物，自由搭配飛船部件，開啟傳說級天賦，面對最難搞的罪犯，成為星際傳奇！

games.name: Dungeonmans
games.short_description: Crush monsters and get loots in the classic turn-based style of deep dungeons and high adventure! Grow the Dungeonmans Academy, a bastion of learning that expands as you play. Serious gameplay with a light-hearted atmosphere, combining the feel of history's great RPGs and dice-slinging adventures around the tabletop.

games.name: Fights in Tight Spaces
games.short_description: 充實牌組、控制空間，利用周圍環境來擊敗勁敵。你必須訓練新卡牌、升級舊卡牌，找到完美組合來擊敗對手，發揮不度演變新增的各種能力，摧毀世界各地的犯罪組織。
賞玩屢獲殊榮的地牢三消遊戲。每次遊戲你都會變得更強，直到獲得自由。 立即下載，開啟你的冒險之旅。

games.name: Gordian Quest
games.short_description: 这是一场史诗般的Roguelite冒险，结合了角色扮演、战棋战术和牌组构筑的最佳体验。你将组建英雄的队伍，带领他们完成艰巨的任务。帮助英雄们与彼此建立羁绊并获得新的组合技能，你能握紧手中的曙光，刺破世界中心的黑暗，驱散笼罩大地的诅咒吗？

games.name: 妖談：百鬼夜行
games.short_description: 你無意中打破了你家儲藏間那本神秘書的封印。這本神話書有一股巨大的魔力，輔助使用者可以打敗任何妖怪，並記錄下他們的名字，從而控制他們。這種神聖的力量太強大了，驚動了所有附近的妖怪。在他們攻打過來時，你必須找到自己的方法去戰勝他們取得勝利。

games.name: Bomber Crew
games.short_description: Chocks away! Bomber Crew is a strategic simulation game, where picking the right crew and keeping your bomber in tip top shape is the difference between completing your mission or losing it all! USAAF DLC NOW AVAILABLE! FLY THE ICONIC AMERICAN BOMBER!

games.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch
games.short_description: 《鐵錘守衛英雄傳》是壹款Rogue-lite砍殺類動作冒險遊戲，使用風格各異的英雄探索不同的關卡，積累金幣以及寶石並將其運用在城鎮升級之中，以此來強化妳的英雄，迎接更深層次的戰鬥以及探索！當妳遇到困難之時，多達四人的組隊聯機將為妳提供最強有力的幫助以及截然不同的遊戲樂趣！

games.name: Lost Castle / 失落城堡
games.short_description: 《失落城堡》是一款包含了rogue-like隨機元素的動作冒險類遊戲，嘗試用隨機拾取的裝備，道具和寶物挑戰盤踞城堡的敵人，遊戲支持線上及本地最多4位元玩家進行連線。

games.name: Nevergrind Online
games.short_description: Nevergrind Online is the ultimate dungeon-crawl multiplayer blobber RPG focused on treasure hunting and slaying monsters! Create your hero and start climbing the ladder in normal mode—or, for those seeking the ultimate challenge, hardcore mode! No microtransactions ever!

games.name: Ziggurat
games.short_description: Dungeon-Crawling First Person Shooting at its finest! Fast-paced combat! Dozens of perks, spells and enemies! Level ups! Random Dungeons! Traps! Badass bosses! Carrots!

games.name: Labyrinthine
games.short_description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

games.name: 骰子闖魔城
games.short_description: 在這款回合制肉鴿地牢中，你前進唯一的方式就是扔骰子，是萬能骰還是回血骰，是幸運女神的眷顧還是極致的策略之巔？你必須最大化骰子的使用效果，以擴大優勢並控制戰場，搭配最強陣容，收集強大道具。當然，闖魔城僅憑那點運氣可遠遠不夠，投擲骰子，戰勝怪物吧！

games.name: SUNLESS SEA
games.short_description: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Take the helm of your steamship and set sail for the unknown! Sunless Sea is a game of discovery, loneliness and frequent death, set in the award-winning Victorian Gothic universe of Fallen London.

games.name: 凜冬前線 / FrostBound
games.short_description: 凜冬前線 / FrostBound 是一款以無盡寒冬為背景的肉鴿卡牌遊戲。透過 500 多張卡牌組成的龐大卡池來建設您的駐地，規劃資源，抵禦洶湧而來的敵潮，並終結這場無盡的寒冬。

games.name: Revita
games.short_description: In this fast paced twin-stick roguelite platformer, you play as an unnamed child ascending an ominous clocktower in pursuit of their lost memories. Harvest and sacrifice souls to grow your power in order to challenge procedural encounter rooms and intimidating bosses!

games.name: Tower of Guns
games.short_description: Tower of Guns is a fast paced first-person-shooter for the twitch gamer... with a few randomized elements to keep it fresh with each playthrough. It's a short burst "Lunch Break FPS"... not unlike Binding of Isaac mixed with Doom 2. Tower of Guns was made by a guy named Joe (with his brother Mike composing the music).

games.name: Badlands Crew - Drive, Command, Conquer
games.short_description: 創造、改裝和指揮您的戰車，征服狂妄的敵方派系；拯救在毀天滅地的末日後，四散在法外惡地中的無辜倖存者。您有能力建造、進化、戰鬥，在末日廢土生存下去嗎？

games.name: Boneraiser Minions
games.short_description: Amass an army of undead to fight endless waves of heroes intent to end your boneraising ways! In this gothic auto-battler rogue-lite Survivor-like, use the bones of slain heroes to raise your minions, collect relics and spells, and unlock meta upgrades, all to survive King Gigald's crusade!

games.name: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE
games.short_description: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a "recovery operation" without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

games.name: Dungreed
games.short_description: Dungreed是加入了Roguelike元素的2D橫向動作遊戲。在悠閒寧靜的村莊中突然出現的地宫，破壞了村莊並把所有村民吸了進去。您是王國為了解決該事端而派遣至村莊的冒險家。請進入地宫克服各種難關，並解救村民重建村莊吧！

games.name: 暖雪 Warm Snow
games.short_description: 'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

games.name: Loop Hero
games.short_description: 巫妖將世界陷進了永恆的迴圈裡，讓所有居民遭受無盡的混亂。使用一副不斷擴充的神秘卡片在每一位勇敢英雄的獨特遠征迴圈裡擺上敵人、建築物與地形。在不同職業英雄的戰鬥中回收並裝備強大的戰利品，同時擴充生存者的營地以加強對每一輪迴冒險的支援。

games.name: Rogue Legacy 2
games.short_description: 如果將《盜賊遺產》和續作全部裝在一起，就會得到《盜賊遺產2》。每次死去，你的孩子都會繼承你。你的女兒可能是色盲遊俠，你的兒子可能是愛好和平的大廚。無論是哪一個，都將被徵召。

games.name: 20XX
games.short_description: 20XX is a roguelike action platformer that you can play with a friend. Jump and shoot your way through ever-changing levels, collect awesome new powers, and battle mighty bosses in the name of saving the human race maybe!

games.name: Risk of Rain Returns
games.short_description: 精心设计、精美重置而且带来了更多全新玩法：《Risk of Rain》 将以前所未有的全新面貌重新归来！深入标志性的探索游戏世界，见证琳琅满目的独特战利品组合， 除此以外游戏中还将加入全新幸存者、焕然一新的多人游戏模式以及《Risk of Rain 2》粉丝们最热爱的内容 以及更多！

games.name: Duskers
games.short_description: Pilot drones into derelict spaceships to find the means to survive and piece together how the universe became a giant graveyard.

games.name: Curious Expedition 2
games.short_description: 《奇妙探險隊2》是一款以空想的19世紀晚期為劇情背景的回合制roguelike敘事遊戲，將隨機生成的世界與引人入勝的劇情元素巧妙結合，讓你每次遊玩時都能獲得獨一無二的史詩級冒險體驗。

games.name: Just King
games.short_description: Just King is an action auto-battler with roguelike elements. Assemble your party to venture into different lands fighting fearsome kings and their deadly armies. Use your loot to hire and upgrade mighty heroes... or the bard.

games.name: Bardbarian
games.short_description: You play as Brad the barbarian, who is awoken to the sounds of his town under siege. Today is different though; Brad has grown tired of fighting all the time. The usual grind for XP has grown dull, and he has decided to pursue his dreams of making music instead of shedding blood.

games.name: Delver
games.short_description: Delve into the shifting dungeons on your hunt for the Yithidian orb, but getting it might just be the easy part. Delver is a single player first-person action roguelike dungeon crawler, just like you wished they used to make.

games.name: Void Crew
games.short_description: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 6 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

games.name: 亡靈巫師
games.short_description: A necromancer simulator. Assemble the dead using different body parts while upgrading your tower, combine the abilities of the different fantastic races to fight your way through the hordes of enemies and overrun the ’chosen ones’. To tell the truth, the dead are pretty, uhm, dumb.

games.name: Hand of Fate 2
games.short_description: 一位新的英雄前來挑戰「命運之手2」的莊家了！通過無數百玩不厭的任務，征服這款虛擬桌面遊戲吧！解鎖新的卡牌，寫下你自己的冒險之旅，然後在殘酷的實時戰鬥中擊敗你的敵人吧！

games.name: 歸家異途
games.short_description: 歸家異途（Home Behind）是一款扮演難民的輕度rogue-like遊戲：醞釀已久的內戰終於爆發，寧靜祥和的家園被亂軍付之一炬。親人失散，生死存亡間，你能否挺過了 與疾病，克服旅途中的艱難險阻，生存，前進，直至抵達歐洲？

games.name: Древние Ящеры Против Русов: Битва за Гиперборею
games.short_description: They have launched an active invasion on our lands in late September this year, so let us break free of the slavic hand that held us by our balls for many ages! Rally all of our reptile militia, we will end this all together! LIZARDS, WE WILL NEVER BE SLAVES BUT WE WILL BE CONQUERORS!

games.name: Star Renegades
games.short_description: 《星際反叛軍》是跨次元Roguelite戰略角色扮演遊戲。智取一個個獨特的對手，提升英雄之間的親密度，終結生生不息的邪惡勢力！

games.name: 月圓之夜
games.short_description: 《月圓之夜》是壹款獨立單機卡牌遊戲，探索，冒險，隨機事件，隨機劇情將會導致不同的結局。七大職業，每個職業有專屬的卡組，專屬的流派，100種獨具特色的怪物，揭秘黑森林的秘密。

games.name: 你有餅嗎？
games.short_description: 你有餅嗎？有，我的大餅可以卷一切！一款讓你手忙腳亂卻停不下來的Roguelike烹飪構築遊戲。滿足刁鑽的食客，討好難纏的雞校長——就算你的餅裡有扳手和椰子殼。

games.name: FTL: Faster Than Light
games.short_description: 這款「太空船模擬 roguelike-like」的遊戲讓您可以帶著您的船和船員，在隨機生成的宇宙中經歷一段充滿榮耀與慘痛敗北的冒險。

games.name: 欺詐之地
games.short_description: 『欺詐之地』是壹款卡牌組建的rogue-like遊戲，妳可以在遊戲中協商、戰鬥、行竊或是說服他人來達到自己的目的。每個決定都至關重要，不管是接受什麽任務、跟誰交朋友、還是收集哪些卡牌。

games.name: Skul: The Hero Slayer
games.short_description: Skul: The Hero Slayer為2D Rogue-lite動作平台遊戲，負責護衛魔王城的小骷髏「孤骨」為了拯救被人類抓走的魔王，開始獨自與勇士、冒險家及帝國軍進行對抗。

games.name: 租戶賭財運
games.short_description: 《租戶賭財運》是款Rogue風格的牌組構築遊戲。玩家將用老虎機賺取房租，一舉擊潰資本主義。本遊戲未有真實貨幣的賭博或微交易。

games.name: Rampage Knights
games.short_description: Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'em up game mixed up with randomized dungeon crawling and exploration, which you can play alone or with a friend online.

games.name: 苦痛之環 Ring of Pain
games.short_description: 《苦痛之環》為Roguelike探索類卡牌遊戲，踏上意想不到的旅程，與各式各樣的事物相遇。在這個環形世界裡，你必須格外謹慎，踏錯一步就有可能走上絕路。你會選擇搜刮財寶，還是去偷襲駭人的怪物？

games.name: Rogue Glitch Ultra
games.short_description: A roguelite action platformer in a vibrant glitch-ridden world. Amass a huge arsenal from over 150 weapon options and face hordes of enemies and tough boss fights. Jump into multiplayer (up to 4 player co-op online or local) to collect, unlock, and upgrade for endless replayability.

games.name: The Escapists
games.short_description: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

games.name: 恐怖的世界
games.short_description: 一款與怪異戰鬥，跨越冷血無情的重重選擇，如同地獄般的Roguelite RPG遊戲。本作是獻給伊藤潤二以及H.P.洛夫克拉夫特的1-bit情書。每次遊玩都會有所不同的噩夢般的邂逅，將化作解明不可解事件的鑰匙。在謎團的前方，等待著你的究竟是……

games.name: 挂机神话
games.short_description: 挂爆电费，休闲摸鱼，偷懒耍滑！现代修真为皮；刷宝养成为骨；擦边玩梗为神。宅度与中二度突破天际，在游戏库内随时出击杀掉那些无聊的时间。其将为放置游戏中最妖艳的奇葩；其名为 挂 机 神 话 ！

games.name: Immortal Redneck
games.short_description: Immortal Redneck is a FPS set in Egypt with rogue-lite elements. Frantic gameplay, twitch controls and an arcade-style feel meet randomly generated dungeons, a complete skill tree, permanent death and 9 classes with different traits.

games.name: 咒運魔骰
games.short_description: 《咒運魔骰》是一款徹頭徹尾的類 rogue 的策略型回合制遊戲！玩家要從 350 種以上的強大咒語中輪抽組出完美組合，擊潰 70 種以上的獨特關卡。 面對殘酷的抉擇、應對不可思議的困境，並且向毀滅世界的恐怖存在展開反擊。

games.name: 災厄逆刃
games.short_description: 災厄逆刃是一款快節奏自由移動的平台動作輕地牢類游戲。刀刀見血的高強度戰鬥、足不沾地的快節奏空戰、鮮亮有特點的像素畫風，您將扮演人類最後的希望——卡伊菈，沉著冷靜、智勇雙全，相信您可以用手中的利刃來逆轉整個地球的命運。

games.name: 中国式网游
games.short_description: 《中国式网游》是一款真实的单机“网络游戏”，游戏完全缝合了免费网游中所有的氪金玩法，然后通过模拟的方式，让你深度体验到氪金大佬的快乐，这可能是你玩过的最“花钱“的单机游戏。

games.name: 天外武林 (Traveler of Wuxia)
games.short_description: 《天外武林》是一款以卡牌構築為基礎的Rogue-lite武俠遊戲，融合精彩的武俠劇情與豐富的卡牌組合。由玩家扮演的少年英雄，穿越到一個未知的武林世界，通過卡牌的連攜套路來施展絕技，與同伴協力，共同應對江湖中的挑戰。
dev: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司
pub: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司

games.name: Despot's Game: Dystopian Battle Simulator
games.short_description: Despot’s Game 是一款是一款硬派的 roguelike 策略遊戲。組建一支隊伍並藉由他們來幹掉敵人……和其他玩家！

games.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
games.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

games.name: ADOM (Ancient Domains Of Mystery)
