games.short_description: ADOM (Ancient Domains Of Mystery) is one of the most successful roguelike games ever created, boasting a brilliant mix of story, RPG, exploration, and intensely strategic & flexible combat. The Steam version adds various features like achievements, difficulty level customization & play modes.

games.name: Sword of the Stars: The Pit
games.short_description: A fun, fast, light-hearted, turn-based RPG, where the tradition of old school dungeon-diving games meets the sci-fi Sword of the Stars universe!

games.name: Othercide
games.short_description: 身為人類最後的希望，你將帶領軍隊，利用原創的動態時間軸系統，在精彩動作與反擊交織的繁複之舞中戰鬥。

games.name: Heavy Bullets
games.short_description: Heavy Bullets is a randomized FPS dungeon crawler where players make their way through a colorful maze, while protecting themselves from aggressive creatures and malfunctioning security devices. The goal lies at the end of the 8th level, where they must reset the security mainframe to restore order and reap the rewards.

games.name: The Last Stand: Aftermath
games.short_description: From the creators of The Last Stand: Union City and Dead Zone comes an all-new singleplayer rogue-lite action adventure. After you become infected by the zombie virus, you set out to explore the post-apocalypse and find hope for your fellow survivors. You can still make a difference. Don't give up.

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu : Beyond The Dome
饑荒
games.short_description: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

games.name: COMPOUND
games.short_description: COMPOUND is a randomized rogue-lite, free-roaming shooter for VR veterans. Duck and dodge around enemy fire in a tough-as-nails retro FPS with multiple locomotion options. Download the demo below!

games.name: DICEOMANCER
games.short_description: DICEOMANCER is a roguelike deck-building game. Though you long for a peaceful life, you're forced to embark on an adventure. In this world of swords, magic, and guns, make good use of your dice and deck to find a way back to tranquility! What can the dice be used for? To change... anything.
dev: 超厚皮猪猪 Ultra Piggy Studio

games.name: Nova Drift
games.short_description: Nova Drift 萃取出 ARPG 中的機制深度與策略，加入到經典的太空作戰街機遊戲之中。　你將操作一台無限演化的生物力學飛船，面對千奇百怪而致命的敵機軍團，並乘著垂死恆星的波動深入虛空之中。

games.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer
games.short_description: 「《節奏地牢》是一款獲獎的硬派節奏類Rogue遊戲。隨著音樂移動，並跟著節拍進行猛攻。玩家必須按節奏移動，穿越隨機生成的地牢，同時與跳舞的骷髏、僵屍、龍等進行戰鬥，與此同時隨著屢獲殊榮的丹尼·巴拉諾夫斯基（Danny Baranowsky）的原聲帶搖擺起來！你甚至可以在本地合作模式中與朋友組隊！

games.name: Windowkill
games.short_description: Windowkill是一款遊戲視窗會不斷向你靠近的雙搖杆射擊遊戲。為此，你需要在敵人與擁有自己獨立視窗的boss的環伺間通過射擊遊戲視窗邊框來為自己打出一番天地。

games.name: Crawl
games.short_description: Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!

games.name: Heat Signature
games.short_description: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.

games.name: SNKRX
games.short_description: SNKRX is an arcade shooter roguelite where you control a snake of heroes that automatically attack nearby enemies. Combine different heroes to unlock class bonuses and create unique builds, and steer your unstoppable party as they ravage through endless waves of enemies.

games.name: One Way Heroics
games.short_description: Across all dimensions, the only constant is Darkness! A procedurally generated RPG-roguelike journey across the multiverse! In One Way Heroics, you take on the role of an intrepid adventurer who must travel across the land and face the Demon Lord before a mysterious darkness engulfs everything.

games.name: ROBOBEAT
games.short_description: 隨著節奏扣下板機！在節奏射擊遊戲《ROBOBEAT》中，您將扮演名叫艾斯的賞金獵人來執行任務，抓捕叛亂機器人弗雷澤於其變幻莫測的巢穴中。利用遊戲內置的自訂音樂編輯器，隨著您的節拍牆上奔跑、滑行和射擊，突破弗雷澤的機器人大軍！

games.name: Nightmare Reaper
games.short_description: Blast through a cursed nightmare solo or with up to 3 friends. A retro-inspired FPS where looter shooter weapons meets boomer shooter chaos and rogue-lite elements.

games.name: 不可思議的幻想鄉TOD -RELOADED-
games.short_description: 內容充實讓妳百玩不厭的魔性上癮迷宮迷宮探索RPG——不思議幻想鄉系列最新作《不思議幻想鄉TOD-RELOADED》登陸Steam！ 從初學者到高手都能輕松掌握的操作方式和淺明易懂的遊戲系統讓妳玩到過癮。

games.name: Spelunky
games.short_description: Spelunky is a unique platformer with randomized levels that offer a challenging new experience each time you play. Journey deep underground and explore fantastic places filled with all manner of monsters, traps, and treasure.

games.name: Jupiter Hell
games.short_description: 硬核Roguelike。 回合制射擊。 死亡即結束。 向黃金VHS時代的科幻經典致敬。 DRL的接班人。 只有你和你的武器對抗成群的恐怖和怪物。 隨著重金屬的節奏，給予他們地獄般的打擊。.

games.name: Wizard of Legend
games.short_description: Wizard of Legend is a no-nonsense, action-packed take on wizardry that emphasizes precise movements and smart comboing of spells in a rogue-like dungeon crawler that features over a hundred unique spells and relics!

games.name: UnderMine
games.short_description: An action-adventure roguelike with a bit of RPG tossed in. Adventure deep into the UnderMine and discover powerful relics, deadly enemies, hidden secrets, and a few friends to help along the way.

games.name: Goobies
games.short_description: Battle thousands of blobs in this roguelike auto-shooter. Travel from island to island, defeat bosses, collect and upgrade items to become more powerful and discover lag-inducing combos in an endless blobbath.

games.name: Juicy Realm
games.short_description: 一款滿世界打奇異水果敵人的動作遊戲，在這個世界裡，動物跟植物的界限已被打破，一場食物鏈的顛覆拉開了序幕。人類不得不在第一個發現異化植物的區域建立前哨站並開始調查，軍方也準備了數目眾多的強大武器，由你帶領一支先遣軍開始了一場曠日持久的拉鋸戰。

games.name: Inkbound
games.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Play solo or co-op, create powerful builds, and save the Atheneum.

games.name: We Need To Go Deeper
games.short_description: DIVE. DISCOVER. DIE. Crew a submarine with friends in We Need To Go Deeper - a 2-4-player cooperative submarine roguelike set in a Verne-inspired undersea universe.

games.name: Iratus: Lord of the Dead
games.short_description: 《Iratus:Lord of the Dead》是一款類 Rogue回合制戰術 RPG 遊戲，設定在一個黑暗的幻想世界中。帶領一支亡靈軍團，幫助憤怒的死靈法師到達地面世界並將死亡帶入凡間！

games.name: Deadly Days
games.short_description: Deadly Days is a unique strategic rogue-lite in the zombie apocalypse. Manage and protect a group of survivors and help them to stop the catastrophe. Discover and use a large number of wild and crazy objects, even wilder and crazier survivors, special abilities, and deadly weapons.

games.name: 游牧生存
games.short_description: Battle against hordes of enemies, conquer Boss encounters, and explore various character and skill combinations in this time-based auto-attacking Roguelite in your quest to become stronger and defeat the most menacing of creatures that lay in wait at the end of each run.

games.name: Rogue Tower
games.short_description: Rogue Tower is a tower defense game with roguelike elements and a continuously expanding path which you can influence. Unlock, build, upgrade, expand, defend.

games.name: Receiver
games.short_description: Receiver was created for the 7-day FPS challenge to explore gun handling mechanics, randomized levels, and unordered storytelling. Armed only with a handgun and an audio cassette player, you must uncover the secrets of the Mindkill in a building complex infested with automated turrets and hovering shock drones.

games.name: Geometry Arena
games.short_description: A free-form arena-shooter Roguelite with heavy emphasis on building an overpowered character! You play as a little shape that shoots other shapes! Strengthen your character by mixing and matching mods and upgrades, and experiment with a limitless rune upgrade system!

games.name: OMFG: One Million Fatal Guns
games.short_description: OMFG: One Million Fatal Guns kicks back into action in this fast-paced, over-the-top, roguelike, first person shooter. Shoot your way through a robot-hijacked space station, collecting more and more powerful guns as you go. There are over 30 million differently named guns at your disposal!

games.name: 終點站：僵屍幸存者
games.short_description: 《終點站：僵屍幸存者》是一款設定在僵屍末日背景下的2D回合制生存類roguelike遊戲。 每一次旅程都是獨一無二的，每一個决定都可能意味著生與死之間的抉擇。 你能否勇敢地面對饑餓、寒冷和僵屍，到達終點並找到救贖呢？

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Legion Rising
games.short_description: SYNTHETIK是一個Rogue-Lite的射擊遊戲。在遊戲中世界正被機器肆虐，玩家需要從第一層開始戰鬥，擊倒源源不絕的機器軍隊。從遊戲中你可感受到不同級別的槍戰，你可通過實驗研究強力的物品和修改器來強化自己。你有信心能打敗位於頂層的「末日之心」嗎?

games.name: 伊甸之路
games.short_description: 組合強大的卡組，施放各樣的法術。與各類強大的敵人交戰，收集各種法術物品。結交新朋友，挑戰各路強敵，向伊甸進軍！

games.name: Rogue Legacy
games.short_description: Rogue Legacy is a genealogical rogue-"LITE" where anyone can be a hero. Each time you die, your child will succeed you. Every child is unique. One child might be colorblind, another might be a dwarf with vertigo. But that's OK, because no one is perfect, and you don't have to be to succeed.

games.name: Zombieville USA 3D
games.short_description: Zombieville USA 3D is a stylized arcade shooter combining retro gameplay with strikingly polished visuals. Fight through an endless undead horde in the bleak hellscape of suburbia! Choose your weapons, grab a friend, and see how long you can survive.

games.name: 東方華彩亂戰2
games.short_description: 東方華彩亂戰2，是一款全新的地下城Rogue清版射擊遊戲。玩家將操作個性不同的自機探索隨機生成的地圖房間、敵人，挑戰未知的BOSS，享受彈幕割草和養成的快感。遊戲提供簡單的通關模式，和具有挑戰性的定制模式，無論是普通的玩家還是尋求刺激的玩家都適合遊玩！DISCORD：https://discord.gg/CpncDhZ

games.name: Legend of Keepers: Prologue
games.short_description: 《守护者传奇》是一款融合了Rogue元素的地下城防守游戏。你被地下城公司聘为地下城守护者，你的工作只有一个：守护地下城！

games.name: Super Auto Pets
games.short_description: Build the strongest team of pets and tussle with your friends!

games.name: Uplink
games.short_description: Uplink lets you play as a freelance hacker tackling risky contracts for corporations. Break into systems, steal data, sabotage rivals, and upgrade your gear. Support factions or go rogue in this immersive, strategy-driven hacking simulation game where your choices shape the outcome.

games.name: NEO Scavenger
games.short_description: NEO Scavenger is a game where you must survive in the wasteland long enough to figure out who you are. Each turn, you must decide where to go, how to scavenge for supplies, and how to deal with anything and anyone you encounter.

games.name: Angvik
games.short_description: Angvik is a platform action game set in a joyful but unforgiving land.

games.name: A Legionary's Life
games.short_description: A Legionary's Life lets you play as a Roman soldier during the years of the Second Punic War and beyond. Rise up through the ranks and win prestigious awards or just focus on making it home in one piece; it's up to you.

games.name: Crown Trick / 不思议的皇冠
games.short_description: 《不思議的皇冠》是一款策略回合Rogue類RPG游戲。游戲用純手繪的美術風格開啟一段耐玩有趣的奇妙冒險——探索多種風格的地下城，挑戰充滿危險的敵人與BOSS，經歷死亡與成長的輪回，對抗無盡深淵。

games.name: Sundered®: Eldritch Edition
games.short_description: 《Sundered》是一款手繪風渾沌類銀河戰士惡魔城遊戲。面對遠古驚魂力量的誘惑，抵抗或接受的選擇操之在你。體驗以 H.P. Lovecraft 著作為靈感的多變世界，對抗駭人的成群怪物。《Sundered》是《Jotun》創作者的又一力作，以極富挑戰性且獨特的手法演繹經典遊戲類型，而且提供本機合作模式！

games.name: Phantom Abyss
games.short_description: 《幻影深淵》是一款非同步多人遊戲，它將玩家扔進一個由程序產生的神殿中，要他們取回隱藏在致命房間中的神聖遺物。」

games.name: Quest Hunter
games.short_description: 使命獵人(Quest Hunter)是一款等距動作角色扮演遊戲，妳的選擇將推動遊戲的進程。尋找寶藏，解決謎題，武裝角色，升級並打倒BOSS。妳可以自己或者和朋友在沙發上玩，也可以同時最多四人在線遊玩。

games.name: The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse
Downwell
games.short_description: 井下探險是一款有趣的遊戲，講述了一個年輕人僅僅在他槍靴的保護下，下井冒險尋找不為人知的寶藏的故事。

games.name: Monster Train
games.short_description: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.

games.name: Wildermyth
games.short_description: Wildermyth follows heroes over their whole careers, from their pitchfork days to their powerful primes, and on into old age and memory. It’s a party-based procedural storytelling RPG where tactical combat and story decisions will alter your world and reshape your cast of characters.

games.name: 槍火重生
games.short_description: 《槍火重生》是一款融合了第一人稱射擊、Roguelite隨機要素和RPG策略選擇的冒險闖關遊戲。玩家在遊戲裡可以操縱不同能力的英雄組建多種機體的玩法，使用隨機掉落的武器在隨機性關卡中進行冒險挑戰。可以單人暢玩，也可以最多四人組隊挑戰。

games.name: 鬥技場的阿利娜
games.short_description: 「Slay The Spire 殺戮尖塔」+「Into the Breach」= 牌組構築 x 戰棋策略 也就是 《鬥技場的阿利娜》！ 玩家扮演一名為生存而戰的奴隸，在鬥技場中互相殘殺以娛樂嗜血觀眾。 Roguelike牌組構築 結合 六角形戰棋，讓策略不再拘限於只能攻擊或防禦，有效的閃避、擊退，創造出更多的生存機會吧！

games.name: BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE
games.short_description: BPM is a rhythm-action FPS rogue-like where you must shoot, jump and dodge to the beat of an epic rock soundtrack. Delve into a randomly generated dungeon where one missed note can lead to your death. Gain game-changing abilities and loot powerful weaponry to defeat your ancient enemy: Nidhogg.

games.name: Thea: The Awakening
games.short_description: Thea: The Awakening is a turn-based strategic survival game inspired by the Slavic mythology and set in a procedural dark fantasy world infused with non-linear story and unique combat system.

games.name: Bounty of One
games.short_description: Fallen hero of the Wild West, you’re wanted and in disgrace! Grab your guns, survive endless hordes of bounty hunters and fight to clear your name! Bounty of One is a fast-paced casual roguelite bullet hell for 1 to 4 players. Dash, Dodge, Shoot, Repeat!

games.name: Project Warlock
games.short_description: Project Warlock is a first-person shooter that fans of Doom, Hexen, and Wolfenstein cannot miss. It serves you an exploding cocktail of bullets, spells, and monsters. Battle through 60 levels of non-stop action, packed with bloodthirsty enemies and challenging bosses.

games.name: Neon Abyss
games.short_description: 霓虹深淵是一個狂熱的 roguelike 平臺動作遊戲。在這個遊戲匯中，您會加入哈迪斯創建的“死神小隊”，在奔跑與射擊中深入深淵。遊戲擁有無窮無盡的物品協同效果，獨特的地牢演化系統，保證每次進入都會有全新的挑戰。做好準備，地獄就在前方！

games.name: Trials of Fire
games.short_description: A Tactical, Deck-Building Roguelite. Choose 3 Heroes and adventure into a post-Cataclysmic wasteland. Engage enemies in a unique meld of card-play and tactical, positional combat. Level up and scavenge what you can to customise your decks and build a party to take on any challenge!

games.name: Star Traders: Frontiers
games.short_description: You are the captain of a starship venturing through a massive open universe. Customize your crew and take command at the helm of your very own ship as you explore a galaxy torn apart by internal strife, alien threats, and political intrigue.

games.name: Knock on the Coffin Lid
games.short_description: Investigate your own death, find ways to break free from a time loop, choose a hero who will ascend to the throne and rule the Northern gate! The fates of whole nations of the land of Midian depend on your choices.

games.name: Metal Unit
games.short_description: Metal Unit是一款Roguelite動作平台遊戲。 主人公喬安娜爲了抓住成爲背叛者的姐姐執行任務。身著M-Unit裝甲，對抗外星人和怪獸揭示人類的所有真相吧！

games.name: ALTF4
games.short_description: [3D第三人稱永久死亡轉輪遊戲]嘗試克服各種障礙，直到最後。

games.name: Dungeons of Dredmor
games.short_description: Test your luck and cunning in this exciting RPG as you craft, cast, and pillage your way through Lord Dredmor's Dungeons.

games.name: Rogue : Genesia
games.short_description: 在無窮無盡的怪物浪潮中殺出一條血路！在《羅格：救世傳說》中化身無所畏懼的殺戮者，這是一場無休止的屠殺盛宴！拿起你的武器，斬殺一切擋路的敵人，拯救無數世界！（中文已上線，持續打磨中！）

games.name: Hand of Fate
games.short_description: Deckbuilding comes to life in Hand of Fate! An infinitely replayable series of quests - earn new cards, build your deck, then try to defeat it! In a cabin at the end of the world, the game of life and death is played. Draw your cards, play your hand, and discover your fate.

games.name: Vagante
games.short_description: Vagante is an action-packed platformer that features permanent death and procedurally generated levels. Play cooperatively with friends both locally and online, or adventure solo in this challenging roguelike-inspired game.

games.name: Void Bastards
games.short_description: Inspired by BioShock and System Shock 2, Void Bastards is a revolutionary new strategy-shooter that will test your wits as well as exercise your aim. Can you lead the misfit prisoners of the Void Ark through the derelict spaceships and myriad dangers of the Sargasso Nebula?

games.name: Crying Suns
games.short_description: Crying Suns is a tactical rogue-lite that puts you in the role of a space fleet commander as you explore a mysteriously fallen empire. In this story rich experience inspired by Dune and Foundation, each successful run will uncover the truth about the Empire... and yourself as well.

games.name: Dungeon of the ENDLESS™
games.short_description: Dungeon of the ENDLESS™ is a Rogue-Like Dungeon-Defense game, in which the player and their team of heroes must protect the generator of their crashed ship while exploring an ever-expanding dungeon, all while facing waves of monsters and special events as they try to find their way out...

games.name: Caveblazers
games.short_description: 洞窟開拓者是一款奇幻設定下的Rogue類平台動作遊戲。每一次遊戲都是獨一無二的體驗，玩家可以在隨機生成的線性流程關卡中探索大量的物品武器裝備。遊戲發生在一

games.name: Seek Girl:Fog Ⅰ
games.short_description: 《Seek Girl: Fog I》是一款策略冒險類游戲,你將在神秘迷霧中解救被困女孩。 王國森林突然出現的迷霧將女孩們困在其中，神秘的力量不斷侵蝕著王國。 你是一位勇士被國王招募去解救迷失的女孩，隨著在迷霧中的探險會慢慢解開迷霧秘密和隱藏在背後巨大的陰謀。

games.name: The Legend of Bum-Bo
games.short_description: A puzzle based deck building rogue-like prequel to The Binding of Isaac... Made of cardboard!

games.name: Risk of Rain (2013)
games.short_description: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. Fight on a mysterious planet with randomly spawning enemies and bosses, either alone or with 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Rise to Ruins
games.short_description: A brutal godlike village sim that melds the god game, management, and tower defense genres! Fight off hoards of monsters at night, and expand your village in the day time. Inspired by games like Black and White, Rimworld, and Dwarf Fortress but not quite like any of them.

games.name: 歸家異途2
games.short_description: 歸家異途2是一款Roguelike角色扮演遊戲：十年前的斯卡利亞，籠罩在一片反抗獨裁政府的革命戰火中。你將組織並領導一支東拼西湊的遊擊隊，在獨裁者控制的西部地區艱難前行，穿過絕望與廝殺，並最終開闢出屬於自己的革命道路。

games.name: Magicite
games.short_description: Explore, craft, and survive in this Multiplayer RPG Platformer with permanent death! Featuring many Rogue-like elements, Magicite randomly generates each underground dungeon for you and your friends to delve deep into.

games.name: Replicat
games.short_description: 這是一款 Roguelike 卡牌構築翻翻樂遊戲，您可以使用離譜的連攜效果、影響策略的道具和個性十足的貓咪卡牌來打破卡牌配對的傳統規則。​

games.name: Aliens After Ava
games.short_description: You are Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion. Fight back as you dodge, jump, roll, and use advanced technology to navigate your escape across terrain and extraterrestrial foes!

games.name: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue
games.short_description: 黑槍神悟空是一款TPS+ROGUE遊戲，在遊戲中玩家將扮演孫悟空，使用三頭六臂和六把大砲大鬧美軍基地並救出師傅。

games.name: 奪魄機兵
games.short_description: 《奪魄機兵》是一款類肉鴿俯視角射擊遊戲，但是玩家角色不存在…？！你需要奪取敵方機體的控制權，在快節奏的亂戰中成為最後的贏家。在舊宿體報廢後，你可以迅速切換至新宿體，繼續展開攻勢。

games.name: Betrayal At Club Low
games.short_description: Tonight you're on a rescue mission, infiltrating a nightclub that was once a coffin factory. Will you succeed? Will you fail? Or will your night take an unexpected detour? Roll the Pizza Dice and find out!

games.name: 你的小鸡鸡
games.short_description: A co-op voice-controlled action game where yelling is the combat system. Team up, scream into your mics, and unleash absurd sound-powered attacks. Coordinate, panic, or just shout nonsense until the enemies—and your friends—totally melt down.

games.name: 將軍 對決：序章
games.short_description: Fight the army of the Shogun in this free version of Shogun Showdown, a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!

games.name: The World is Your Weapon
games.short_description: 不管是房屋，村民，水井，陷阱，怪物（！？），你周圍的任何東西都可以拿來當成武器！遊戲裡面出現的所有東西都能當武器使用，歡迎來嘗試前所未有的新潮動作RPG遊戲唷。遊戲中總共有300多種武器，快來收集武器堆滿你的武器圖鑑。

games.name: The Testing Chamber
games.short_description: For every action, there is a reaction... For every choice, a result... Dive deep into your subconscious as you wander the halls of The Testing Chamber & join hundreds of thousands of other players in one of the biggest & most successful social experiments ever performed.

games.name: Endless Dark
games.short_description: An existential horror game in which you are tasked with keeping a sleeper colony ship intact. No enemies or NPCs share the ship with you - only creaking metal echoes and endless dark. Overcome random events, system failures, and the downward spiral of your sanity to see your mission through.

games.name: Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator
games.short_description: From the creators that brought you The Test Trilogy & many other experiences, comes Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator. Will you survive in the new world? Or will you become just another victim to looters, bandits, or worst of all... The Voracious Dead. There's only one way to find out...

games.name: 1 Trait Escape
games.short_description: An action rogue-lite set in the comedic 1 Trait Danger universe. Fight your way through swarms of enemies and epic bosses with minigames sprinkled in-between. Grow stronger every time you fail until you are able to escape back to Earth.

games.name: Shigatari
games.short_description: Shigatari is a samurai role-playing game with historical artwork.

games.name: Gobby McGobblenutz Presents - The Questionably Quirky Quiz Show
games.short_description: Are you Quirky enough to win The Questionably Quirky Quiz Show with Gobby McGobblenutz, and permanently enter your name into the Hall of Legends for other players around the world to see how incredibly awesome you are?! Well then... What are you waiting for?!

games.name: Kitty's Last Adventure
games.short_description: Cute Survivor where you play as Kitty the cat aboard her flying cat-saucer🛸 created by her distraught human.

games.name: Blood Rush
games.short_description: BLOOD RUSH is a fast paced, skill based FPS, mixed with roguelites elements. Upgrade yourself, buy unique guns, drain miracles from relics and destroy anyone or anything standing on your way!

games.name: Super House of Dead Ninjas
games.short_description: 扮演另人畏懼的鮮紅忍者，備有眾多致命的忍者武器和招式，向下潛入看似無盡的高塔。這款 2D 動作平台遊戲是以 Megadev 和 Adult Swim Games 的熱門 Flash 遊戲為基礎，使用忍術來隨機產生高塔，因此每次的冒險都是全新的體驗！遊戲特色：原生支援控制器重回無盡之塔，充滿邪惡詛咒的堡壘！隨機產生關卡讓遊戲有高度重玩性180 間自定房間，其中 50 間是為了這個遊戲版本所製作大量的武器和物品解鎖升級，有數樣物品是第一次登場（例如火焰噴射器和球棒）獵殺八隻可怕的魔王和 49 種狡詐的敵人，包含致命的爆炸蘑菇Transdimensional Leakage：全新的高塔等著您探索透過 Ninjinity Engine...

games.name: Cell Command
games.short_description: TURN-BASED TACTICS meets SNAKE: A new roguelike in the Genome Guardian universe. SPLICE DNA to create new units, enhance their genetics, and take on the Abyss virus once more in a variety of different modes & match types.

games.name: 護林猿神
games.short_description: 《護林猿神》是一款動作要素十足的像素地牢冒險。腐化力量在不斷侵蝕叢林家園，阿猿挺身而出，探索千變萬化的叢林地牢，收集多樣的武器、遺物、法術和附魔，消滅前來進犯的魔怪強敵，最終拯救世界，百戰成神！

games.name: Ponchoman
games.short_description: Kill the creatures and upgrade your weapon to survive as much as you can.

games.name: Slay the Alice
games.short_description: A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.

games.name: BLOODSAINT
games.short_description: "BLOODSAINT is not a remaster of a 94's retro-hardcore minigame about a cleric performing a ritual for a ruthless synthetic deity, but pretty close."

games.name: Deified
games.short_description: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

games.name: 坤坤輪盤
games.short_description: 完蛋！坤坤不堪被小黑子羞辱，轉而向牢大學習籃球技術，而牢大的考驗是必須尋找會爆炸的籃球。Rougelite+俄羅斯輪盤賭，但使用的是威力更大的加農炮，存活並拿走所有獎金。

games.name: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure
games.short_description: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure is a fast-paced 2d shooting game with a random story. You control a group of three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail. The game consists of short scenes that are sequenced together in a semi-random way to tell a crazy adventure story.

games.name: Paper Animal Adventure
games.short_description: Paper Animal Adventure is a cute roguelike game where you can explore a colorful world, fight scary enemies, and relax with your friends at the campfire! Will you be the one to seal the timelines and find the missing king?

games.name: Feng Shui Meowjong
games.short_description: 當貓meme與肉鴿麻將出現碰撞、全新的喵牌就此誕生…！ 《風水喵將》是一款以肉鴿為核心玩法，融合了貓咪meme、風水元素的全新輕肉鴿益智遊戲。透過神秘寶物與策略性的配牌構築、你可以獲得新奇古怪的配牌和巨大的分數乘算等超爽感受！一起來掌控風水之力，向最高分數挑戰吧！

games.name: Ogre Chambers 2222
games.short_description: 在不斷變化的競技場中對抗外星食人魔，在這款 Roguelike 彈幕射擊遊戲中努力生存 💥 改裝你的武器，明智地選擇升級方向，並精通太空船操控，征服食人魔密室（OGRE CHAMBERS）！

games.name: This Is No Cave
games.short_description: 一款極簡畫風的太空點擊跑酷遊戲。只用滑鼠就能玩！透過噴射推進器與抓鉤，在層層關卡中極速穿梭，靈活運用奇異的外星動植物來推進旅程。支援單人或最多本地四人同玩！

games.name: Until You Fall
games.short_description: 在這款VR動作游戲的劍鬥中，幻想與合成波將相互碰撞。這款砍殺類 Roguelite 遊戲讓您在令人驚嘆的霓虹環境中展開戰鬥，擊倒充滿魔力的怪物，藉此提升自己的實力。戰鬥、倒下、起身再戰！

games.name: 皇帝游戏：天下-皇游天下
games.short_description: 《皇帝游戏》是一款将皇帝扮演与卡牌构筑相结合的roguelike游戏，在这款游戏中，在这里，您将穿越时空化身千古帝王，亲自执掌乾坤，打造您独一无二的能臣良将班底，亲自排兵布阵，合纵连横。运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外。是宵衣旰食开创盛世，还是酒池肉林沦为昏君，都在您的一念之间！

games.name: 夕日航路
games.short_description: 雇傭船員，分配組合，選擇目標，《夕日航路》是一款簡單又富有深度的策略經營模擬類roguelite遊戲。通過一系列簡單的選擇，在新大陸的微妙的平衡下賺得利益，並在有意無意中影響世界的走向。

games.name: GUNFIELD
games.short_description: GUNFIELD – A game that combines the genres: shoot 'em up, roguelite. Choose the perfect weapon combinations and upgrade your ship to destroy hordes of enemies and giant bosses, using strategy and a powerful arsenal.

games.name: BattleCap
games.short_description: Dive into an exhilarating maritime battle for 1 to 4 players! Assemble warships with a variety of bottle caps, allowing the warships to transform and break, experiencing flexible physics that brings a refreshing maritime battle! Fight monsters together, or engage in a battle with your friends.

games.name: Galactic Glitch: Prologue
games.short_description: Galactic Glitch 不僅是動作Roguelike太空射擊遊戲，更有驚人的物理效果！你可以抓起岩石或敵人飛彈，甚至直接拋出敵人。利用彈性牆壁來反擊，玩轉物理規律，一步步擊潰敵人。現在就免費體驗序幕！

games.name: astragali
games.short_description: A die (sg.: die or dice; pl.: dice) is a small, throwable object with marked sides that can rest in multiple positions. Dice are used for generating random values, commonly as part of tabletop games, including dice games, board games, role-playing games, and games of chance.

games.name: 中医模拟器
games.short_description: 《中医模拟器》是一款独特的个人制作游戏，风格和市面绝大多游戏不同，定位是帮助中医爱好者或学生更有兴趣和效率学习中医，并且帮助中医0基础玩家入门。 可以加群 494811550（学习群），697138589（已满），302219333（第2群已满），欢迎参加讨论。

games.name: SNAKE FARM
games.short_description: A top-down action roguelike about buying snakes, fighting them, selling their oil, and buying more snakes. Upgrade your weapons, get stronger snakes to fight, and chase down a high score with only ten days to live.

games.name: Lost Flame
games.short_description: Lost Flame is a modern roguelike game featuring unique and challenging turn-based combat. Find your way in the ruined kingdom of Hiraeth while fighting against legendary warriors of the past and spawn of the unfathomable Abysm.

games.name: Barrel Roll
games.short_description: Barrel Roll is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminals as you can.

games.name: Masks of the Void: Origins
games.short_description: 你不需要武器。你就是武器。將岩石自大地撕裂而出，砸向你的敵人。面具會在每一輪中重塑你的力量。虛空正逼近你的家園。讓它後悔。

games.name: Mushroom Musume
games.short_description: Raise a mushroom from a spore into a fine young woman, then discover the twists and turns her life may take in this creepy-cute fairytale life simulation game.

games.name: Beat Invaders
games.short_description: Beat Invaders is a Vertical Shoot 'Em Up Roguelite - Fight your way through enemy fleets, unlock skills, items, ships, and upgrade them in the next run. Enjoy the smooth neon visuals matching the pushing EDM soundtrack - The perfect game to unwind.

games.name: Froguelike
games.short_description: Your choices matter in Froguelike where you play as a frog on a mission to eat all the bugs. Level up, choose new tongues and upgrades, become unstoppable and run straight into the swarm! Unlock all frogs, tongues, items and chapters to become the most powerful frog in the pond.

games.name: Knights Within
games.short_description: Knights Within is a hack&slash horde shooter with roguelite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Either solo or with friends, can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?

games.name: Pewt 'em Up!
games.short_description: Pewt 'em Up! is a retro inspired arcade space shoot 'em up with lots of upgrades, achievements, extras and more.

games.name: Tower Networking Inc.
games.short_description: An internet service provider simulation game. Design and build network connectivity and services to clients in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower. Configure and maintain equipment to ensure you meet the requirements of tower dwellers. Manage your spending for expansion and daily operations.

games.name: Tumbleweed Destiny
games.short_description: The somewhat hateful and slightly charming tumbleweed is the star of the game. This game is a tumbleweed life simulator that depicts the fate of tumbleweeds in my own imagination.

games.name: Relic Hunters Zero: Remix
games.short_description: Relic Hunters Zero: Remix is a remaster of the FREE 1 million player hit game about blasting evil space ducks and turtles with tiny cute guns. It’s fast, it’s tactical, and feels deliciously smooth to play. Unlock new weapons, characters and relics to defeat the Ducan Commander!

games.name: Jupiter Hell Classic
games.short_description: Jupiter Hell Classic is a old-school true Roguelike shooter with turn-based tactics, permadeath, procedural levels, and 90s sci-fi carnage in its purest form. Rip and Tear!

games.name: Abalon: Roguelike Tactics CCG
games.short_description: 《召喚命途 》是一款融合了傳統回合制戰鬥和戰略卡牌戰鬥的Roguelike冒險遊戲。遊戲的背景設定是一片叫做多元宇宙的幻想之地，你的任務是引導召喚師完成危險的任務，尋找隱藏的秘密、強大的卡牌和變異的兔子。

games.name: 地牢亡球
games.short_description: 🏆🏀💀 戰術、恐怖與達陣。回合製隨機遊戲與街機死亡運動相結合，讓您在每個地牢中體驗不同的獨特殘酷挑戰。你是否能在地牢亡球的試煉中倖存下來並贏回屬於您的自由嗎？

games.name: 美術危機
games.short_description: 畫筆與顏料的戰爭？在《美術危機》這款Roguelike射擊遊戲裏，拿起你的畫筆，打爆蜂擁而來的敵人！顏料是你的武器，亦是你的敵人，畫布就是你們的戰場！使出渾身解數，以一敵衆，擊敗一波波顏料怪物，創造藝術傑作！不要在中途倒下，衝出重圍，與世界名畫對決吧！記住，你的目標是站上巔峯！

games.name: 青蛙農場：倖存者
games.short_description: 強盜們正在洗劫你的農場，作為農場守衛者你必須挺身而出。拿起身邊各類道具作為武器，在海量蟲群的包圍之下扭轉戰局，在激烈戰鬥的間隙也能在農場中開墾耕地，在後院的池塘中釣魚盡享收穫的喜悅。

games.name: Circadian Dice
games.short_description: Circadian Dice is a game inspired by single-player deck-building games, but instead of upgrading a deck, you build up a set of dice! Use 10 different heroes and 60 game-warping relics to take on 13 hand-crafted scenarios, in runs that take 10-30 minutes. Lots of secrets and unlocks to discover!

games.name: ロボット少女は夢を見る-RobotBattleChampionship-
games.short_description: This game is an RPG game that follows the growth of a robot girl who has lost her memories. Players can aim for victory in the robot battle tournament, the main objective, and also enjoy interactions with both humans and robots.

games.name: Schism
games.short_description: Schism is a challenging action roguelike RPG with deep synergies and high broken build potential. The combination of robust stat systems, fully moddable guns, deity worship, intense frequency-switching bullet hell combat, and difficult bosses make for a unique and highly replayable experience.

games.name: Earl vs. the Mutants
games.short_description: 在這款推進式駕駛 Rogue-lite 遊戲中扮演變種終結者厄爾。縱橫末日荒野世界，碾壓成群結隊的變種怪物以完成拯救人類的任務。

games.name: Orb Tower
games.short_description: A Roguelike Bubble Puzzler! Choose your school of magic and reach the top of the tower! Chill pick up and play feel and nostalgic pixel art and music. Get your staff and prepare to shoot orbastical spells !

games.name: PARA♰BELLUM ~ 魔弹帕菈
games.short_description: Necromancer's army is gathering! But he can't afford Necronomicon Prime so his army can only use free medieval equipment set... We believe that one battle sister can solve them well. Go Forth, Sister Para, Blast your enemy in this survivor-like shooter game!
pub: 马家沟红旗农机合作社

games.name: Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue
games.short_description: Begin your monster-taming journey in Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue. Fight, collect, upgrade and evolve Kādomon to build your ultimate team in this prologue version of Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers. Experience the brand-new features, mechanics and Kādomon for the first time.

games.name: Legend of the Outlaw Mage
games.short_description: Become the Outlaw Mage, wreaking havoc as you pursue the one who wronged you, casting and blasting your way in this Cowboy-Fantasy-themed 3rd-Person Action RPG.

games.name: Six Ages 2: Lights Going Out
games.short_description: Survive as the last horse riders as the world ends and myths die. Plan ahead and manage your clan’s relationships with the remaining gods and their followers in this standalone survival storybook. Immerse yourself in the land of magic also seen in King of Dragon Pass.

games.name: Golden Krone Hotel
games.short_description: Golden Krone Hotel is a gothic horror roguelike. Fight vampires with sunlight or become a vampire yourself and sneak in the shadows. Combines classic turn-based combat with dynamic lighting, an innovative potion system, and fast paced gameplay.

games.name: Fights in Tight Spaces (Prologue)
games.short_description: Play the first mission of Fights in Tight Spaces for free! A stylish blend of deck-building, turn-based tactics, and thrilling fight sequences in action-movie settings. Learn to balance your hand, momentum, and positioning to overcome the odds to defeat your adversaries. Full game OUT NOW.

games.name: HAZAMA_QUEEN
games.short_description: In the year 202X, the world is "YAMI"...! To save the world, go to hell and kill all the demons. Yes, just like ordering a Frappuccino at a cool cafe!

games.name: 银河守卫战 Galaxy Defense War
games.short_description: 《銀河守衛戰》是一款肉鴿塔防遊戲，需要在隨機掉落的英雄和裝備中，選取合適的銀河準則搭配出具有戰力的隊伍，抵抗外星入侵者。

games.name: Metal as Phuk
games.short_description: Metal as Phuk is a Mature, Turn-Based, Crude Comedy RPG that has one goal and one goal only: To Make You Laugh! Play as Chael, the last Paladin of the Metal Order, as he embarks on his journey to stop The Dark Bards before they can summon A'Marthius, a MONSTROUS Demon D-Bag!

games.name: Deep Space Exploitation
games.short_description: Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics, fully destructible asteroids, and a story of survival under an exploitative corporation. Use your equipment wisely, upgrade your ship, and make difficult decisions to secure your future!

games.name: Chessplosion
games.short_description: Chessplosion is an arcade action puzzle game where you drop chess piece bombs to create chain reactions and trap opponents. Defeat enemies and bosses in Adventure Mode and the roguelike-inspired Dungeon Mode, break targets with limited bombs in Puzzle Mode, or fight friends and AI in Battle Mode.

games.name: Tinyfolks
games.short_description: Train your folks, defeat monsters and upgrade your town!

games.name: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue
games.short_description: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is the proof of concept for the upcoming procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s Southeast Asia. In this prologue chapter, you'll get to experience combat, exploration, and the opening story of the game.

games.name: Flamebreak
games.short_description: Flamebreak is a roguelite action RPG featuring a unique blend of twinstick meets MOBA arena combat. Each procedurally generated run presents new challenges while your randomized hero's race, weapon, and skills inspire new playstyles and character builds.

games.name: AshenForest
games.short_description: AshenForest is a roguelite action RPG focused on boss-rush. To purify the ashen forest that is causing the plague, you must fight against all the monsters lurking in the forest.

games.name: 節奏魔女 舞動的骷髏
games.short_description: 【音游節奏 × 類倖存者肉鴿，93%超高好評爽游！】動次打次，割草無雙！作為愛美的死靈法師西蓓兒，你需要踩着動感的節拍，指揮骷髏大軍，在這個酷炫的彈幕地獄中，一邊抖腿一邊收割成群的怪物！

games.name: Card Hog
games.short_description: Card Hog is a pig-based dungeon crawler with roguelike and deck building elements. Take the role of an adventurous hog and interact with more than 100 cards of dangerous enemies, powerful weapons and exciting spells!

games.name: Million Depth
games.short_description: 攻入地下超100萬層的“深層下落動作策略遊戲”。打造自己的原創武器，攻克極具戰略性的時停戰鬥吧！

games.name: Boosted Survivors
games.short_description: Survive waves! Choose new abilities! Modify your hero in any way you like! Craft a powerful masterpiece, or a horrible concoction of awful ideas! Discover secrets! Sandbox your way to victory! Boost! Survive! Boosted Survivors!

games.name: 宇宙魔彈哥卓普
games.short_description: 給爽做加法！這是一款追求最純粹爽感的Rougelike遊戲，成為一枚無堅不摧的外星武器，收集聖物，積攢能量，變形水滴入侵太陽系，將無知的人類艦隊毀滅殆盡吧！

games.name: The Caribbean Sail
games.short_description: Name your crew, purchase supplies, sail the world, harpoon fish, plunder your enemies, die horribly, unlock a new Captain and do it all over again!

games.name: Frostrain
games.short_description: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.

games.name: Halls of Torment: Prelude
games.short_description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

games.name: Deformed
games.short_description: 单人恐怖游戏，设定在地下实验室。消灭怪物并逃脱。

games.name: Cento
games.short_description: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

games.name: 輪作法 Crop Rotation
games.short_description: 《輪作法》是一款農業主題的卡片抽選遊戲。卡片會自動打出，讓你可以專注於建立卡組和卡片的協同效果。

games.name: Fidel Dungeon Rescue
games.short_description: Fidel 是一款地牢解密遊戲，你需要穿過怪物，寶藏和魔法機關，從它們中間尋找最佳路徑前往下一層。每局遊戲僅需數分鐘時間，但遊戲體驗充滿驚喜，每一局遊戲你都會運用許多技巧。另外，遊戲主角是只狗。

games.name: Templar Battleforce
games.short_description: An addictive mix of strategic combat and army building, with the precision of an RPG. Design your squad members' exact build of equipment and talents to create unique fireteam combinations. Step into the pilot suit of a Leviathan mech, lead the Templar Knights in turn-based tactical warfare.

games.name: Super Raft Boat Classic
games.short_description: The world's been flooded, and all you have is your Super Raft Boat. Can you reach The Final Island?

games.name: Kingsway
games.short_description: Kingsway is the #1 operating system for daily tasks such as skeleton smashing and loot-organizing. Trouble sorting through all your potions and swords? Don't worry! Kingsway can help you manage, and with an easy to use interface you'll have time leftover for a peaceful stroll through the underworld.

games.name: Temp Zero
games.short_description: 《Temp Zero》是一款極簡風格的Roguelike遊戲，融合了激烈的動作和音樂型彈幕射擊。去打敗按照音樂節奏發起攻擊的敵人、選擇加成、打倒終極Boss並解鎖新武器、新法術和新音樂吧！

games.name: ダンジョンアーティファクト
games.short_description: DUNGEON ARTIFACT is a title that fuses authentic card game mechanics with the deep complexity of roguelike deck-building. Freely combine over 400 different cards to unleash the ultimate combos!

games.name: Trash of the Titans
games.short_description: It's turn-based fantasy tactics with trash animals. Defend your trash from invading rats, and eat your trash to upgrade your team. Think your way out of ruin by using the shape of each level to your advantage. Be creative, and try to not die.

games.name: DIG - Deep In Galaxies
games.short_description: 在这款动作平台游戏中解放银河系吧！穿越未知的星球，肆意跳跃、摇摆、挖掘和射击。毁灭领主军队，击败外星敌人。每次战斗后都能获得奖励，丰富你不断扩大的专属武器库。

games.name: Ardor
games.short_description: A hex-grid puzzle-tactics card game. Outwit and outlive your enemies, while upgrading your deck. A lightweight game of bite-sized encounters.

games.name: Merge Maestro
games.short_description: 在這款 Rogue-like 合併構築遊戲中，結合數百種來自表情符號的獨特棋子！發掘更多創意組合，搭配棋子與威能來打造獨特策略，擊敗這款結合了 Rogue-like、益智元素的挑戰性遊戲！

games.name: FLATHEAD
games.short_description: Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.

games.name: Motordoom
games.short_description: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports roguelite horde shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

games.name: Elite Exorcist Miko
games.short_description: A bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring hololive’s Sakura Miko! hololive has been possessed by evil spirits! Combine melee and ranged combat with a variety of items to fight your friends and set them free!

games.name: Rogue Fable III
games.short_description: Rogue Fable III is a traditional rogue-like game which combines the depth, complexity, and challenge of the genre classics with a shorter, more tightly focused game length.

games.name: Duriano
games.short_description: 杜里亞諾 是一款 羅格萊特 類型的俯視角競技場動作遊戲，玩家將扮演來自北歐的勇敢榴槤英雄，手持武器與北歐神話中的眾神展開激烈戰鬥。透過武器、榴槤英雄、神之路徑與道具的多重組合，玩家能打造強大的構築，最終征服烈焰巨人。

games.name: Pyrene
games.short_description: Defeat hellish monsters and rebuild your home in Pyrene, a fast paced roguelike dungeon-crawler. Play with different heroes & spells, collect powerful relics to upgrade your deck while uncovering the mysteries behind your village’s destruction.

games.name: Renowned Explorers: International Society
games.short_description: In this strategic rogue-like you become a famous expedition leader in the 19th century. You form your own crew with the skills and personality to discover legendary treasures, while exploring randomized locations and stories on every new adventure.

games.name: The Wind and Wilting Blossom
games.short_description: Navigate the war-torn lands of an alternate history Heian Japan battling yokai hordes in challenging turn-based combat. Encounter hundreds of story events, level-up your party, and unlock new allies and weapons. Die, learn from your mistakes, and try again.

games.name: Dwarf Journey
games.short_description: Dwarf Journey is an action roguelite platformer with randomly generated levels. Defeat enemies, level up, assemble your rune build and collect minerals to forge better equipment on an epic journey in search of immortality.

games.name: 挂机手游模拟器
games.short_description: 想体验热门挂机手游的爽感，又不想真氪金？来《挂机手游模拟器》！ 无需真金白银，不充值也能感受战力狂飙、全屏掉落的氪金快感 。 开局输入 VIP666、VIP777 等兑换码，直接领豪华礼包，让你一路爽到底！ 挂机刷宝、召唤英灵、收集图鉴、制作裝備、解锁阵法、研究科技、扫荡地图、竞争资源！

games.name: Rogue Fable IV
games.short_description: Storm the lair of the immortal wizard Yendor in this fast paced, turn based, traditional rogue-like. The massive scope, deep mechanics and challenging gameplay that define the genre distilled into dense and highly varied one hour runs.

games.name: Draft of Darkness
games.short_description: Draft of Darkness is a survival horror RPG with deck building and roguelike dungeon exploration. Recruit allies, synergize their decks to create powerful card combos. Manage your limited resources and explore procedurally generated maps to determine the story's outcome.

games.name: Computer Sillow
games.short_description: A Clicker Game, with less waiting around and more green dogs!

games.name: Talented
games.short_description: Slay waves of spooky enemies for 20 nights to survive 'The Demonic Conveyor Belt'. Talented is an arcade roguelite with randomly generated skill trees. Choose your upgrades and abilities wisely and you might just make it out alive. Are you truly Talented?

games.name: Space Beast Terror Fright
games.short_description: S.B.T.F. is a very hard arcade-style / rogue-like / perma-death first person shooter. You play as Marines who must brave dark, claustrophobic and terrifyingly intense Space Beast infested spacecraft in order to extract critical data and lucrative upgrades. Can you make it out alive?

games.name: Maru Expedition: We can fly
games.short_description: 接住從天而降的夥伴，主宰戰場！ 操控飛行器接住角色後，將自動攻擊敵人。 搭配各具特色的角色與技能連攜，打造屬於你的戰略風格。 隨著強化與成長，戰鬥方式將不斷進化，一場爽快的街機動作遊戲等你來挑戰！

games.name: Rift Wizard
games.short_description: Rift Wizard is a tough as nails fantasy roguelike featuring challenging turn based combat and deep open ended character building. Craft your spellbook from over 100 unique spells and abilities and fight your way through a series of procedurally generated challenges to defeat your nemesis.

games.name: Space Cycle
games.short_description: 你將扮演空間護衛官，與各大勢力爭奪空間資源，升級你的防禦設施，對抗敵方的持續騷擾！超過50種獨特單位，豐富的策略玩法，帶你體驗緊張的即時塔防戰鬥！

games.name: Dreadhalls
games.short_description: You are trapped deep inside a massive dungeon. Explore it, survive it and find a way to escape. Your only weapons will be stealth, your own courage, and a faint light. Dreadhalls is an intense and scary experience, not for the faint of heart. You have been warned!

games.name: Berserk Mode
games.short_description: Berserk Mode is a visceral time-attack fantasy rogue-lite. Become the Berserker and wade into a dungeon battlefield swarming with monsters. Unleash the absurd power of your Beast in a storm of blood and gibs. Prepare to enter Berserk Mode.

games.name: Lost Potato
games.short_description: Lost Potato 是一款俯瞰視角的極簡 roguelite 遊戲，無法直接對敵人造成傷害，必須運用把敵人推向尖刺、反彈子彈等方式幫助一顆小馬鈴薯在充滿食人部落的叢林中找出生路。

games.name: Book of Demons
games.short_description: 砍殺遊戲類型在這款遊戲中呈現最純粹的一面，而且非常地引人著迷。在老舊大教堂底下的地城中斬殺黑暗大軍，從大惡魔手中拯救受盡折磨痛苦的紙世界。

games.name: Skelly Selest
games.short_description: Skelly Selest is a score-attack hack slash dash run 'n' gun-athon. Venture into the procedurally generated perdition depths of Hell to purge the evil taint of the Deamonica Netherlords and their fiendly followers.

games.name: Sorry We're Open
games.short_description: Sorry, We're Open is a Supermarket Management Horror RPG. As the new Manager of your local supermarket, you'll need to make the hard decisions to keep the store running. Remember, your store's reputation and your employees' livelihoods are in your hands.

games.name: Airships: Lost Flotilla
games.short_description: Airships: Lost Flotilla is a steampunk autoshooter where you fight your way through waves of enemies on your way to a safe harbour. Destroy your foes, harvest wreckage, and upgrade your ship.

games.name: Angelstruck
games.short_description: Angelstruck is a 2D roguelite shooter where you demolish the forces of Heaven as you attempt to reach the pearly gates. Overcharge your holy rifle, and min-max your way into insane game-breaking builds. Unlock permanent capabilities and powerful screen-destroying weapons that feed on kills.

games.name: Ants Took My Eyeball
games.short_description: Ants Took My Eyeball is a 2D action platformer roguelite. Descend into an ever-changing ant hill, fight your way through hordes of insects with a variety of weapons, face formidable bosses and ultimately find your stolen eyeball.

games.name: Angvik 2
games.short_description: Angvik 2 is an action roguelike platformer with a unique style. Explore a variety of character builds as you navigate randomized levels, offering new challenges and surprises with each adventure.

games.name: MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE
games.short_description: Craft. Shoot. Die. Repeat. Forge absurdly powerful guns and fight through the belly of a metal alien monstrosity in this VR FPS roguelite follow up to MOTHERGUNSHIP. Wanna build a rocket-firing-shotgun or a toxic spike-ball-launcher? Unleash your inner mad scientist, then take on the MOTHERGUNSHIP.

games.name: Rush Rover
games.short_description: 暴走機甲是一款2D點數風格的射擊遊戲。與同類型的遊戲相比，這款遊戲的射擊體驗更接近於傳統STG（打飛機）射擊遊戲。爽快火爆的戰鬥、各具特色的武器設定、多樣化的敵人、Roguelike隨機元素、極具挑戰的BOSS戰鬥、動感的low比特晶片音樂風格遊戲原聲

games.name: SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition
games.short_description: SanctuaryRPG: Black Edition is a humorous and strategic turn-based dungeon crawling ASCII adventure. Drawing heavy inspiration from both Roguelikes and Japanese RPGs, the game offers a robust action-RPG inspired combat system.

games.name: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick
games.short_description: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick is a Crude Comedy RPG that has one goal and one goal only: To make you laugh! Play as Quiver Dick, a legendary storyteller and former badass, as he embarks on one of many downright crazy and entirely messed up adventures!

games.name: Ghost 1.0
games.short_description: A mysterious agent, capable of becoming a digital ghost, sneaks aboard the Nakamura Space Station. This is where the fun begins: the station is well-protected with its heavy defences, never-ending arsenal of weapons, and mysterious artifacts. It will all have to be destroyed.

games.name: Rift Wizard 2
games.short_description: Rift Wizard 2 is a tough as nails traditional roguelike wizard simulator. You play as an immortal amnesiac wizard who must journey through the cosmos to defeat his nemesis. Each run, you'll build a unique repertoire of spells, passive skills, and magical artifacts.

games.name: Mad Adventures
games.short_description: Work together or betray each other! Unlock lobby-wide upgrades. Survive a 4-day expedition to reach the final boss. A Multiplayer 3D Platformer with a sprinkle of Roguelike and Battle Royale!

games.name: 魔物娘競技場
games.short_description: 養成×骰子×卡牌三合一！輕松＆可愛的牌組搆筑Roguelite動作RPG！你該專注的是成長？戰斗？還是去商店？

games.name: Roll
games.short_description: Roll Dice. Get Dopamine. Roll is a highly replayable, deeply strategic, and ultra satisfying dicebuilding game!

games.name: 30XX
games.short_description: 在《30XX》，你可以感受到平臺跳躍遊戲最原始獨特的魅力。隨機的Roguelike元素讓每一局的體驗變得神秘莫測且讓人興奮！多個角色選擇，讓你和你的朋友都能置身其中！自由的關卡編輯器，讓大家都來感受你創造的世界！ 戰鬥吧，你已經錯過了一千年的時光！這次可別再錯過了……

games.name: xd1
games.short_description: Come on animatronic, save the tulpa dubai! A xd1 roguelike game where you have to save the tulpa dubai. Big adventures & stories! Chapter 1 & 2, for free.

games.name: Siralim 2
games.short_description: Siralim 2 is an old-school monster catching RPG. Summon and customize hundreds of creatures to fight for you as you battle your way through endless dungeons. Find rare treasure and use it to upgrade your castle, empower your creatures, craft powerful artifacts, learn new spells, and much more.

games.name: RUNGORE: Beginner Experience
games.short_description: Card game mechanics - check. Real time battles - check. Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

games.name: Soulbind: Prologue
games.short_description: Soulbind: Prologue is an action platformer in the Roguelike genre. The hero is a common skeleton and an outsider. But there is one special feature - you can replace your body parts with parts of your opponents' bodies. Learn the backstory and start your journey in the world of Allaar.

games.name: Dungeon Scavenger
games.short_description: Dungeon Scavenger is a unique turn-based old school dungeon crawler that sets you on a challenging path of exploration. Select a hero to keep the threat of the dungeon and demon realms away from the town's people with an innovative combat system. Can you save the town from the danger below?

games.name: 薔薇的夜宴2 藍玉石
games.short_description: 《薔薇的夜宴2 藍玉石》是一款卡組構築型roguelike遊戲。化身主人公亞莉亞，想盡辦法在魔物肆虐的學園中存活下來吧。

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
games.short_description: Face the varied challenges of the Machine God Zir in ARENA, a standalone expansion for Synthetik: Legion Rising! Leverage the next level in gun-play and experiment with powerful tech in varied action packed Arenas!

games.name: Legend Creatures(传奇生物)
games.short_description: Legendary creature is an independent game with rich playing methods such as roguelike + self-propelled chess + strategy. You can collect all kinds of magic creatures with various talents and skills, and can also evolve to a higher level.

games.name: Monsters' Den: Book of Dread
games.short_description: Enter the Monsters' Den, a place of endless adventure, battle and reward! Lead your party of four heroes through each level of the ever-changing dungeon, fighting in turn-based battles and hunting for that elusive rare loot. The web-game classic comes to Steam!

games.name: Гвалт
games.short_description: Collect words, find powerful combinations of boosters, and achieve the highest score! In this dynamic word game, you will find dozens of artifacts, unusual upgrades, and colorful characters who are ready to raise a ruckus!

games.name: Impaler Gold
games.short_description: Impaler Gold is a fast-paced minimalistic arena shooter - now expanded and improved. Summon spikes to slay monsters, build barriers, and propel yourself into the air. Challenge yourself in this highly replayable rogue-lite shooter inspired by the classics.

games.name: XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX
games.short_description: A paranoid cybercriminal tries to regain control over an underground marketplace stolen by his former coworkers. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills to get rid of hitmen sent by your enemies in a race with worsening mental state and terrifying hallucinations.

games.name: TROUBLE JUICE
games.short_description: Trouble Juice is a Side Scrolling Shooter Roguelike set in a TV show tournament that is broadcasted across the universe. Use your character's special abilities, and unlock prizes in the Achievement Bingo. Become the ultimate champion and earn your place in the galaxy's hall of fame!

games.name: 倒轉方舟
games.short_description: 戰棋+圍棋要素+Roguelite=《倒轉方舟》。 這是一款具有特色玩法的日式戰棋遊戲，除了應用普攻和技能卡牌將敵人擊敗，也能透過圍住敵人的方式直接消滅敵人！ 玩家需在眾多隨機事件和能力分歧中做出抉擇，想辦法在末日的自相殘殺遊戲中存活下去….

games.name: The Witch's Cauldron
games.short_description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

games.name: 幻日夜羽 - 蜃景努瑪梓 -
games.short_description: 《幻日夜羽》是《Love Live!》系列第二部 《Love Live!Sunshine!!》的官方衍生作品。 《幻日夜羽 - 蜃景努瑪梓 -》是以該世界為舞臺背景的一款卡牌收集養成類游戲。 每次進入都會大不一樣的鏡中世界。 無數個選擇的彼方，夜羽將會面臨的未來是......? 在另一個努瑪梓的舞臺，屬於夜羽的嶄新故事即將上演！

games.name: TowerClimb
games.short_description: TowerClimb is a difficult and rewarding procedurally generated platformer with roguelike elements. Enormous and mysterious towers of ancient unknown origin stand above humanity, extending to the heavens. Struggle forward as a weak human, driven by an iron will to reach the top.

games.name: Oh, Bugger!
games.short_description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!

games.name: Tournament Ark
games.short_description: A heavily anime-inspired deck builder. You play as one of the participants in the Tournament Ark, a combat tournament held on an interdimensional boat. Pick the right moves, choose the correct passive abilities for your build and combine the right cards to become the champion!

games.name: Ziggurat 2
games.short_description: Ziggurat is back, and now it's even better! Use powerful weapons and spells to break through hordes of enemies and explore labyrinthine dungeons in this hectic roguelite FPS, while you improve your skills and discover new equipment.

games.name: Vivid Knight
games.short_description: "Vivid Knight" is a "party-building roguelike" game in which you collect friends who have been turned into jewels and fight by combining their abilities! Explore the ever-changing dungeon and harness the gems you have gathered to challenge the labyrinth!

games.name: 病毒識別：拯救系統
games.short_description: 在這被病毒深度感染的電腦作業系統中，成為桌面滑鼠的終極化身！在這款爽快的動作Roguelike遊戲中，穿梭於如地牢般的資料夾系統，掃蕩病毒，並透過EXE應用程式不斷升級變強！

games.name: TYRONE vs COPS VR
games.short_description: Sip lean and shoot cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America... Fully reimagined for VR!

games.name: Hammerwatch
games.short_description: A hack and slash action adventure, set in a fantasy pixel art environment. Play solo or co-op in this adventure from bottom to top of Castle Hammerwatch. Kill hordes of enemies with varied looks and features through four unique environments with traps, hidden secrets and puzzles.

games.name: Dungeon Dreams
games.short_description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Customize your characters, take open-ended quests and write your own story in the town of Ecallia. A game with town building, dating and life sim elements, but also a randomly generated Dungeon with lots of companions and loot!

games.name: Cosmodread
games.short_description: Cosmodread is a VR survival horror roguelike about escaping a dying spaceship filled with nightmares. Stranded in a hostile universe, you must explore, survive, and find your way back to the safety of Earth.

games.name: 欧皇VS非酋
games.short_description: All About Luck is a roguelike auto battler where luck is everything. Build your formation by gacha and test your fortune. No P2W, no grinding — just pulls, rolls, and fate. Crush the boss with god-tier pulls, then ask your friends: Still not cleared it?

games.name: 通神榜
games.short_description: 眾英雄機緣巧合下共聚桃花林，四季流轉，危機暗藏。等待他們的是成功逃脫還是……《通神榜》是一款快速戰鬥、生存rogue遊戲，你可以選擇各異的角色，在海量技能中組合特色的神通、發現獨特的流派構築，不斷變得更強，每一局都是新體驗！

games.name: 魔法迷域
games.short_description: 魔法迷域是卡牌构筑+Roguelike+战旗
dev: 武汉幻狮科技有限公司
pub: 武汉幻狮科技有限公司

games.name: Wally and the FANTASTIC PREDATORS
games.short_description: Your best friend wants to cheer you up, so he tries his best to make a dungeon for you to explore. Explore his wholesome, weird-as-heck, scrappy rogue-lite oozing with charm and humor for 1-2 Players.

games.name: The Monster Breeder
games.short_description: Turn-based fantasy gladiatorial game with monster breeding. Crossbreed various species to create monster hybrids for gladiatorial combat. Manipulate creatures’ traits with surgery, magic, and alchemy. Manage your enterprise, craft items and upgrade your base. Fight in the arena for gold and glory!

games.name: Kill The Music
games.short_description: Kill The Music is a Rhythm Action Roguelite about defeating hordes of enemies with musical instruments.

games.name: Super Crate Box
games.short_description: Vlambeer's SUPER CRATE BOX is coming to bring back the glory of the golden arcade age, when all that really mattered was getting on that high score list. Grab your baseball cap and loosen your pants, it's time to fight endless hordes of enemies and collect every weapon crate you can.

games.name: Fairyside
games.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike shoot-em-up with lots of bullet hell featuring cute pixel art, visual novel interludes, and story-driven gameplay. Join Shirley in her journey to learn magic and survive Redwood Academy!

games.name: 绿洲计划
games.short_description: Be the light.
pub: 上海翎迹网络科技有限公司

games.name: WitchHand
games.short_description: You're a witch, leading your coven into new, unfriendly lands. Use the cards you find to build and expand your civilization. Befriend the local covens or use their bones to fuel your spells. Gather your familiars, the witching hour is nigh.

games.name: Nimble Quest
games.short_description: Nimble Quest! Lead a conga line of heroes to glory against hordes of enemies across an endless number of stages. How many enemies can you defeat? Steer your unstoppable (seriously, you can’t stop) party as they cut a path of destruction through levels filled with different enemies and power-ups.

games.name: Neophyte
games.short_description: A mini topdown action roguelike with chaotic spell-slinging hack-n-slash combat. Collect spells, choose perks and discover powerful synergies to become an unstoppable monster-slaying wizard.

games.name: Arcadium - Space Odyssey
games.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite set in a procedurally generated universe. Land on planets to harvest resources, craft hundreds of game-breaking builds, and unleash them on relentless waves of aliens. Every run unveils a new universe: endless challenges, endless discoveries.

games.name: Crawl Tactics
games.short_description: Crawl Tactics combines classic turn-based tactics with roguelike progression. In Dungeon Mode, face challenging, ever-changing encounters as you explore procedurally generated maps. In Quest Mode, develop your village, train your mercenaries, and defend against growing enemy invasions.

games.name: Slay the Minotaur
games.short_description: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

games.name: 生嚿叉燒好過生你
games.short_description: 你將會扮演一塊壞了的叉燒，在陰間展開一場無厘頭超低能勁搞笑大癲全配音地獄式非工業用無添加眼碌碌反高潮多重結局高清無碼免運費無炭用䟴䟴腳經濟實惠非主流已讀不回壞腸胃超級無敵超過一百個Steam成就鬼咁多玩法的大冒險！ 這塊叉燒最後能投個好胎嗎？還是只能投個怪胎呢？全看你了~

games.name: Gacha Fever
games.short_description: Gacha Fever is a suvivors like in a cute and colorful universe. You will fight waves of monsters with various weapons, from the machine gun to the magical girl wand and the Bubble Tea Canon ! Just be careful of the area !

games.name: Super Psycho Baseball
games.short_description: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure Remastered Edition
games.short_description: Turn monster girls into your "Friends" and embark on an adventure together! This is a rogue-like game inspired by "Mystery Dungeon," where the terrain changes every time you challenge it.

games.name: MORSE
games.short_description: Vanquish the Kaiser's Imperial Fleet using timing, tactics and telegraphy in MORSE, a minimalist strategy game that teaches you the secret language of Morse code. Can you change the world with the push of a button?

games.name: DOG WITCH
games.short_description: 《汪！巫！录！Dog Witch》是一款卡牌肉鴿遊戲，你可以用魔法骰子來施展咒語。透過組合超過 150 種不同的物品來創造層出不窮的戰略、完美的協同增效合擊，並召喚僕從以對付無窮無盡的敵人，他們古怪到難以置信，讓你忍不住將尾巴搖個不停！

games.name: Shape Shifter: Formations
games.short_description: Shape Shifter: Formations is an action twin-stick shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you must destroy hordes of geometric enemies alone or with a friend. Select your ship and combine a large variety of weapons, abilities and infinitely stacking upgrades to craft your own unique build.

games.name: Witching Stone
games.short_description: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

games.name: 《鏟子騎士：袖珍地牢》
games.short_description: 與鏟子騎士一起縱身投入袖珍地牢深處，與其他遊戲完全不同的是，這是個充滿動作的解謎探險綜合遊戲！

games.name: Archvale
games.short_description: Take up your weapon in this RPG bullet-hell world and embark on a journey to right wrongs from long ago. Only you can defeat the evil forces of the Undying guardians and reunite the world with the fabled Archvale.

games.name: Pogo Rogue
games.short_description: Bounce to the top in this skill based, roguelite action-platformer! Collect powerful items, pick unique weapons, and fight off a variety of enemies while navigating around with a fun, difficult, and unique movement system. Are you up for the challenge?

games.name: UBERMOSH:OMEGA
games.short_description: UBERMOSH:OMEGA, the apex of Walter Machado's Cult Classic series UBERMOSH.

games.name: Pigeons Attack
games.short_description: Pigeons Attack是一名自上而下的射手，其目標是盡可能長時間地保持鴿子群的生存。 使用放置在關卡附近的升級和武器。 解鎖新角色，地圖和魔法符文。 單獨或與朋友一起幫助打擊這種入侵！

games.name: Mage and Monsters
games.short_description: Create an army and use spells while it fights for you. Mage & Monsters is an active auto battler, where you must choose wisely between upgrading the might of your army, or increasing the power of your spells.

games.name: Doomsday Hunters
games.short_description: Shoot stuff in a perfect pixel world, combine items, build guns, die every time! Roguelite twin-stick shooter where magic and post-apocalyptic future technologies collide. Defeat evil lord Dracula and save everyone!

games.name: Starward Rogue
games.short_description: Starward Rogue is a bullet hell twin-stick shooter. Blast your way through the Megalith, a rogue-lite labyrinth lodged in the side of a star. Customize your mech with a huge variety of weapons, perks, and upgrades. Steel yourself for the dangers that lurk in the depths of the dungeon.

games.name: WazHack
games.short_description: Time moves forward only when you do in the dungeons of WazHack. Think your way out of problems instead of just spamming 'attack' and 'drink healing potion'.

games.name: 变量2
games.short_description: After two years of precipitation, we re-made this variable sequel after thinking about it! Variable 2 is a unique stand-alone tower defense game. We have enriched the building and elements of tower defense, and the experience in the game can be changed according to your ideas!

games.name: CounterAttack: Uprising
games.short_description: CounterAttack: Uprising is a side scrolling space shooter (shmup). Team up or fight solo, 1 - 4 player local or up to 8 players online cross-platform coop, unlock upgrades, use powerful ultimate abilities, enhance your ship the way you want, and save the Earth from annihilation.

games.name: Ruff Ghanor
games.short_description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, strategize, and create powerful synergies as you progress to face your destiny.

games.name: Relapse
games.short_description: 這是一款Roguelike式的卡組構築遊戲。收集超240個不同的技能，通過升級和附魔對其進行強化，並將它們與上百個物品自由搭配，協同夥伴的特殊能力，創造出無數的組合來打敗你的對手吧！

games.name: Space Gladiators
games.short_description: 有想過成為太空馬鈴薯嗎? 機會來了!外星鬥士是個2D手繪魂類游戲。操控不同俘虜逃出星球監獄，擊敗上百隻外星人並重獲自由!

games.name: Super Algebrawl
games.short_description: Add up, multiply, clone, and divide your party members to beat the monsters on your path!

games.name: Switchcars
games.short_description: In a science experiment gone wrong, there's only one way to survive - traverse dynamic environments in over 1300 realistic vehicles, as fast as possible.

games.name: Raining Blood: Hellfire
games.short_description: Inspired by the iconic Call of Duty Zombies experience, Raining Blood Hellfire 1.0 is an intense survival bullet hell where chaos reigns and every round is a brutal battle for life — and absolute power. Kill, upgrade, explore, die, repeat.

games.name: 末日狂歡人外島
games.short_description: 你能在末日降臨前成功約會嗎？《末日狂歡人外島》是一款約會模擬RPG，融合了動態生成敘事和輕度卡牌戰鬥，遊戲支持1-4人遊玩。遊戲以幽默搞怪的方式上演一場史無前例的戀愛狂歡。遊戲共有130種不同結局和12位可追求的單身人士，保證每場約會都是全新體驗！

games.name: Monster Girl Manager
games.short_description: Summon, consult, and train procedurally generated monster girls in this dungeon roguelite. Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of different monster types as you prepare the ultimate team to defeat dangerous enemies and collect powerful artifacts. (Game is SFW)

games.name: Grim Quest - Old School RPG
games.short_description: 融合地下城爬行、回合制戰鬥與Roguelike機制的黑暗奇幻RPG，搭配手繪美術與深度文字敘事。兼具單人桌遊戰役與選擇你的冒險的雙重體驗，無論短暫探索或通宵暢玩皆可盡興。

games.name: Don't Die, Collect Loot
games.short_description: 是時候在這款街機 Roguelite 角色扮演遊戲中變得無比強大，力量不受任何限制！引導你的英雄穿越無限的復古幻想世界，獲得戰利品，獲得升級，並在終極力量幻想中撕裂成群的敵人時不斷增強他們的力量！

games.name: Ghost Signal: A Stellaris Game
games.short_description: Ghost Signal is a VR action roguelite set in the Stellaris universe, where you captain your ship to battle a multitude of alien species. Partake in dynamic space wars, encounter planet sized creatures, gather valuable loot to conduct research, and more. No journey is the same.

games.name: Leaf Blower Man: This Game Blows!
games.short_description: Blow leaves at 6am on a Sunday and earn points by annoying all the neighbors. But beware - unexpected challenges await on your journey to rid the world of leaves!

games.name: 闇鍋人狼
games.short_description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

games.name: Spell Disk
games.short_description: 在這款 rogue-lite 動作遊戲中,創造獨特的協同法術組合,打敗無數怪物和頭目。

games.name: Pocket Rogues
games.short_description: Pocket Rogues is a dynamic 2D-Roguelike with elements of Action-RPG, played entirely in real time. Raid endless dungeons, upgrade your Guild’s Fortress, and develop your own heroes!

games.name: Automon
games.short_description: Fast-paced auto-battler. Fight, capture and upgrade Automons, build a diverse party, battle bad Bosses and become the Automon Champion!

games.name: Tower Fortress
games.short_description: A mysterious tower has risen! It emits plumes of noxious green smoke from its summit making people sick. Strange creatures infest the tower but if nobody tries to ascend it we will all be doomed! Are you that hero?.....

games.name: Winter Falling: Battle Tactics
games.short_description: Lead troops in tense tactical battles, just you and your brain against the dying world. Can you save it? Manage a mercenary company, scavenge supplies, build an army. Go on a quest! Burn down a village or two... Explore the rich medieval fantasy world in a mix of LOTR, Warhammer, FTL and Total War.

games.name: Alluris
games.short_description: Prepare to embark on a journey like no other in Alluris. Play as a reluctant hero or villain to save the world… or just save a colony of bears from some lumberjacks. However you play, you’re sure to walk away with a few crazy stories about your adventure.

games.name: Crush the Industry
games.short_description: Work your way to the top of a cutthroat game studio in this retro roguelike deckbuilder! Crush the Industry features strategic combat with a unique twist and deep replayability.

games.name: Gravebound
games.short_description: Survive as long as you can through the waves of magic guardians, level up to heighten your own magical abilities, and unlock game changing weapon upgrades and new arenas as you explore Dark Willow Crypt! Will you escape, or are you bound for the grave...

games.name: 場外人生
games.short_description: 一個孤單的人，培養自我，增進事業，買房築巢，尋找伴侶，結婚生子，擴張勢力，建立國家，最終橫跨星海，啟動時光機器......，所謂幽默而真實的沙盒人生模擬器(つд⊂)。

games.name: Dead Signal
games.short_description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

games.name: 魔王終局
games.short_description: 作為魔王，帶領你的爪牙，擊退那些貪婪的冒險者！超過一百種隨從，六十種魔物，各種戰鬥套路等待你的探索！一鍵自動戰鬥！

games.name: UBERMOSH:SANTICIDE
games.short_description: SANTICIDE is the sixth volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH. A must buy for arcade and top-down enthusiasts.

games.name: FATE: The Cursed King
games.short_description: Are you ready for the FATE-IEST of the FATE games? Welcome to the final chapter in the classic, action RPG series! FATE: The Cursed King has new weapons, spells, armor and AI-controlled allies! Wait, what?! Allies?? That’s right. This FATE game IS A PARTY. Woo! Party system!

games.name: 東方霊麟棋 ~ Crafts of the Lucky Beast
games.short_description: Touhou Rinrinki ~ Crafts of the Luck Beast is a Touhou Doujin Card-Strategy Game. Using cards across different seasons, join forces with duelists of unique abilities, face various opponents from all over Gensoukyo, and uncover the truth behind the Card Duel Incident!

games.name: The Creature of Chaos
games.short_description: Frantic FPS game with very procedural levels

games.name: INTO EVIL
games.short_description: 火線邁阿密x黑暗靈魂的混合體。巨劍、惡魔、迷你槍；最多支援4名玩家。你應該還沒準備好

games.name: 黑帆賭局
games.short_description: 《黑帆賭局》帶你踏上一場未知的航程，融合卡牌構築與快艇骰子玩法。 在幽暗的船艙中擲骰，命運翻轉，每一步都引向船長遺留的「寶藏」… 但每一次投擲，究竟是接近財富，還是墜入更深的恐懼？

games.name: Isle of Swaps
games.short_description: Grab your cards, it's time to swap! Battle your school pals in this roguelite deckbuilder where you'll trade for new cards when you win defeat them and rip open booster packs looking for rare cards. Conquer everyones dungeon decks to become Critter Champion of the Playground!

games.name: Elewar: Fused Survivors
games.short_description: Use your elemental powers to defeat terrifying monsters, while slowly becoming a godlike magician. Packed with challenging events, deep ARPG-like systems and a hardcore difficulty! 18+ classes, 25+ spells, 300+ unlocks, 140+ upgrades, over 50 random events and much more!

games.name: Lost For Swords
games.short_description: 《尋劍迷途》是一款Roguelite爬塔卡牌遊戲。層層高塔均由卡牌構成，卡組中的每張牌都將影響房間格局。來撿起散落在地的一次性利器護甲、卷軸藥水，征服這個世界中的所有怪物，還有發牌員！

games.name: Biters & Bullets: Prologue
games.short_description: Battle and survive hordes of monsters in this high octane casual game with rogue-lite elements. Defeat bosses, hot-wire cars and stack powerups. How long will you survive?

games.name: Eldritch
games.short_description: Eldritch is the original imsim roguelike: a first-person action game inspired by roguelikes, immersive sims, and H. P. Lovecraft.

games.name: Bloody Rally Show
games.short_description: Welcome to Bloody Rally Show - a head-on smash between frenetic top-down arcade racing and hyperviolent reality TV. You must drift, boost, and blast to keep the viewers entertained and your paymasters happy. Go full throttle and drive to survive! Includes local multiplayer mayhem for up to 4 players

games.name: Dredgers
games.short_description: Based on traditional rogue-likes, Dredgers is a real-time dungeon crawler where you can play as 30 different races, each having their own stats and skills. With the unique class system you can mix and match classes as you desire, anything from an Archer-Knight to a Berserker-Summoner-Priest is possible!

games.name: 发糖模拟器
games.short_description: Fhtagn Simulator is a Cthulhu Roulette Deckbuilder. Set up card slots on roulette to maximize card's value. Collect evil creatures, spells, items and environment to build your deck. Your ultimate mission is to sacrifice spirit collected by cards to unseal the ancient gods that have come to earth!

games.name: Mineral Defense
games.short_description: Mineral Defense combines tower defense with roguelite elements and procedural generation. Build paths, unlock upgrades, and unleash powerful synergies to conquer evolving challenges in an ever-expanding world.

games.name: Dark Bestiary
games.short_description: 黑暗獸集是一個有RPG元素的回合制戰略遊戲。和其他的RPG遊戲有所不同的是，本遊戲的核心並不是深刻的故事，反而是持續而激動人心的戰鬥。所以，你將會有機會探索異常豐富的戰鬥系統，挖掘你角色真正的潛力。

games.name: 常世之塔
games.short_description: 闖進不可思議之塔。高難度的自動產生迷宮，以精美點陣圖美術繪制的2D迷宮每隔24小時候就會改變，在每天改變面貌的塔中跨越萬千屍體以無盡之頂塔為目標來刻下自己活著的證明！

games.name: Slipstream: Rogue Space
games.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike about teamwork, survival...and cute animals in space! Play with a few friends or join a streamer's crew of dozens as you work together to battle aliens across the vast Rogue Space.

games.name: Terraformers: First Steps on Mars
games.short_description: 《煥然異星：序章》是《煥然異星》的免費獨立版本，在序章中玩家需要面臨諸多挑戰，在這顆紅色星球上建立第人類的第一個殖民地。

games.name: Conquest of Elysium 4
games.short_description: Conquest of Elysium 4 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

games.name: 大家的幻想鄉·S
games.short_description: 《大家的幻想乡单机版》是一款卡牌对战养成游戏。 玩家扮演博丽神神社的新助手，帮助博丽神社获得信仰，以维持博丽神社正常运行。 玩家需要尽量完成各种委托，与幻想乡的各方势力搞好关系，以应对随时都可能发生的异变。

games.name: I wanna be The Cat
games.short_description: I wanna be the Cat is a challenging roguelite platformer inspired by I wanna be the Guy fangames.Fight against famous videogame characters turned into cats and try to claim "THE CAT" as the ultimate title.

games.name: 節拍衝擊
games.short_description: 與大魔王作戰、解鎖大量物品，逃出 MIDI 宇宙吧。這是一個充滿病毒的時空，音樂在這裡化為強大力量。MIDI 宇宙中各式各樣的能力可以組合出數百種不同的遊戲風格。一切的核心就是你的歌曲：一個不停循環的節拍，可完全改變遊戲節奏。每一局遊戲都不相同，背景音樂也各異... 這一切都由你來創造。

games.name: 阿爾法聯盟HD
games.short_description: 阿爾法聯盟HD是一款免費的單一英雄自走棋遊戲。 在阿爾法聯盟中沒有複雜的陣型與裝備合成，扮演你最喜歡的英雄，以Roguelike的方式搭配12種各有特色的戰鬥流派，並且在遊戲中與其他7個玩家或機器人對戰來獲得勝利。

games.name: Pixel Dungeon
games.short_description: Pixel Dungeon is an exciting and extremely popular roguelike (more than 2 million mobile installs!). Explore the depths of Pixel Dungeon, collect useful items and fight fierce monsters to find the Amulet of Yendor - the ultimate artefact of this game world!

games.name: Geometry Arena 2
games.short_description: Geometry Arena 2 distills RPG depth and Roguelite elements into a unique loop of [ Meta-Progression + Endless Challenges ]. Mix and match Weapons, Bodies, Modules, and Pets to craft your game-breaking builds! Minimalist lines, vibrant colors!

games.name: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!
games.short_description: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove! is a mash-up of the very best features of the classic console games with a ton of fresh improvements! Explore Earth as funky aliens from planet Funkotron trying to find your missing ship pieces to get back home in this casual co-op roguelike.

games.name: 傳送地下城
games.short_description: 在《傳送地下城》這款支持4人合作的橫版Roguelite的冒險闖關遊戲中，玩家作為一名冒險者，你將和你的好友們勇敢的在這傳送門世界尋找最後的傳送門，打敗強大的敵人拯救世界。

games.name: Battle Bands: Rock & Roll Deckbuilder
games.short_description: Get the band together and take on the world in this battle of the bands, deckbuilding card game set in the fantasy land of Riff City. Play solo or with friends to conquer offbeat bosses in a coop campaign. Wits and a sick riff are key to becoming a rock legend.

games.name: Dead Pixels
games.short_description: A toxic waste spill finds its way into the water supply, causing the recently deceased to rise from their graves. Now it's up to you to blast your way through the hordes of undead if you're going to escape the city. On the way to your rescue, you'll search stores and houses for supplies, and trade with other survivors.

games.name: QuiVr
games.short_description: QuiVr is the defining archery experience, made from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Grab your bow, arrows, and some friends to fight the enemy onslaught.

games.name: Phantomancer
games.short_description: Phantomancer is a deck-building roguelike where you summon phantoms to fight. Defeat the monsters threatening humanity and uncover the story of two sisters.

games.name: A Robot Named Fight!
games.short_description: A Robot Named Fight is a Metroidvania roguelike focused on exploration and item collection. Explore a different, procedurally-generated labyrinth each time you play and discover randomized power-ups to traverse obstacles, find secrets and explode meat beasts.

games.name: Escape The Mad Empire
