games.short_description: Escape the Mad Empire is a party-based, rogue-like dungeon crawler with intense and deeply tactical combat. Overcome the challenges as a band of heroes, and preserve their lives and sanity by managing resources and growing your base. Can you Escape the Mad Empire?

games.name: Repetendium
games.short_description: 與摧枯拉朽的元素生物大軍在恐怖的礦洞中來一場酣暢淋漓的戰鬥！你還可以和全球玩家在排行榜上一決高下！看看誰才是《嘰嘰挖挖》的王者吧！

games.name: Time Break Chronicles
games.short_description: Time Break Chronicles is a fusion of classic JRPGs and modern Roguelites, with a cast of 100 playable classes to find and unlock. Build your team, customize their abilities, and venture into a procedurally generated adventure through space-time and beyond!

games.name: Fabric Of Reality
games.short_description: In this game, you are the bullet hell. Face off against 100 waves of enemies and bosses by collecting a deck of attack cards that activate in real-time to unleash destruction upon everything in sight. There's an insane amount of customizability leading to an infinitely replayable experience.

games.name: 东方醉游稽传~Touhou Drunken Rebellion
games.short_description: Touhou Drunken Rebellion is a classic top-down danmaku shooting roguelike game. Set in the world of Touhou Project, players take on the role of various lesser youkai living in Gensokyo and set out on a journey of rebellion against the powerful figures who rule over it.

games.name: Knightica: Prologue
games.short_description: Recruit powerful units, place them strategically and find the best synergies in this Roguelike Autobattler! Discover optimal combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters and lead your army to victory!

games.name: Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG
games.short_description: Drug Dealing RPG roguelite strategy crime saga with choose your own adventure elements. The police and the jackboys aren't your biggest enemy... Time is!

games.name: Deadly Delivery
games.short_description: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 5 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans. (VR crossplay supported)

games.name: Steredenn: Binary Stars
games.short_description: Steredenn is a frenetic and chaotic space shooter, carved in big beautiful pixels, with insane boss battles. Embark in your ship and engage the fight against dreadful space pirates in a never-ending combat for your survival.

games.name: I See Red
games.short_description: Matthew Taurus, after losing everything in a horrifying event, turned from honorable policeman into vengeful outlaw. Get ready to rage through dangerous spaceships in this frantic twin-stick shooter roguelite, where you must find your enemies and destroy them.

games.name: Dandy Ace
games.short_description: 《卡牌艾斯》是一款誇大風格的動作遊戲，跟隨這位傳說中的魔術師，力爭將他的魔法卡組合運用，一路戰鬥和獲得戰利品，最終擊敗綠眼幻象師，將自己從被詛咒之鏡中解放出來。

games.name: Find the Demon 恶魔鉴定守则
games.short_description: 她们中间，有一个是恶魔。

games.name: Ufouria The Saga 2
games.short_description: 在這款探索型的橫向捲軸遊戲當中，您將能盡情探訪SUNSOFT的《Ufouria: The Saga 2》獨特且古怪的世界。每次遊玩時關卡地形都會發生變化，更有新的秘密等著您去發掘。以羊毛氈風格重製的《Ufouria》世界依然奇特又可愛，療癒又令人著迷，更有讓人會心一笑的亮點！

games.name: Nitro Kid
games.short_description: Synthwave roguelike deckbuilder set in the neon 80's. Pick your agent. Build your deck. Hit card combos and fight through the floors of INFINITY tower. Featuring 30+ fresh Synthwave tracks by LudoWic, Tonebox and Jules Reves.

games.name: Slot or Not
games.short_description: 《Slot or Not》是一款回合制老虎機戰鬥冒險遊戲。與您的戰鬥夥伴老虎機並肩作戰，擊退邪惡的水果，拯救您的村莊。在這場快節奏、色彩斑斕的冒險中，轉動您的命運並奪取珍貴的戰利品。

games.name: Solace Inc.
games.short_description: A survivors-like about a time-travelling company where you recruit your employees against endless hordes of enemies.

games.name: Cardinal Quest 2
games.short_description: Hack, slash and rush the forces of darkness. Assault castles and mountain lairs to liberate all in this super-sleek modernization of the classic roguelike formula! Will you play a crafting Alchemist, a sneaky backstabbing Thief... or something else?

games.name: Aura of Worlds
games.short_description: 《Aura of Worlds》是一款混乱但却富有创意的战术类Rogue-lite平台游戏。探索多个危险世界，利用创造性能力并操纵环境来获得优势。通过爆炸、冲刺、抓钩、战斗和魅力，穿越不断变化的迷宫，智胜强大的守护者！

games.name: 主机保卫队 Mainframe Defenders
games.short_description: 《主机保卫队》——回合制战略游戏，以有趣装备和个性化为特色。你可以享受简单的战斗系统，高重玩价值和数不胜数的战利品。装备不仅让单位更具特色，同时也具有独特机制，可以组合成强大的组件。

games.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
games.short_description: Nightmare: The Lunatic是一款關於逃離惡夢的格擋動作 Rogue-lite 平台遊戲。不斷切換3種武器，使用特殊攻擊，躲避和阻擋敵人的攻擊。透過收集強大而獨特的圖騰來增強自己。

games.name: Inkshade
games.short_description: Inkshade is a turn-based tactics game carved out of strange wooden miniatures, wrapped in a web of locked rooms, and orchestrated by an otherworldly game master. Victory is not guaranteed, and the only constant is the cruel black ink that flows within the pieces.

games.name: Centipede Gun
games.short_description: Centipede Gun is a roguelite autobattler where you create bizzare creatures to face hordes of enemies! Combine different guns, modules and skills to make unique synergies and upgrade your cute little destruction machine!

games.name: Day of the Shell: Prologue
games.short_description: Day of the Shell: Prologue is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.

games.name: Cyberwar: Neon City
games.short_description: Explore a cyberpunk universe where monkeys rule. Challenge the fearsome Cyber Monkeys as you take on the role of a hero armed with a living shark weapon.

games.name: QUICKERFLAK 2
games.short_description: QUICKERFLAK 2 is a retro-hardcore room-beater time-attack super fast-paced minigame.

games.name: Peace Data
games.short_description: Peace Data — hard "Roguelike" game, in which you have to play for Bitard, saving Rusland from the tyranny of the authorities that destroyed the opposition and led the country to ruin, making slaves of citizens.

games.name: Over 9000 Zombies!
games.short_description: Over 9000 Zombies! is top-down arcade action blown out of all reasonable proportions. An endless horde of zombies is coming your way, how long can you survive?

games.name: STICKER/BALL
games.short_description: STICKER/BALL is a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.

games.name: 江湖幸存者
games.short_description: 有人存在的地方就是江湖，這是一款中國風風味的 Roguelite 輕度休閒遊戲。浴血奮戰殺出重重怪物的包圍，可以孤軍奮戰，亦可叫上兩三好友共同並肩作戰。扮演不同角色，體會超多國風武俠招式，組建獨特 Build 玩法，擊敗最終怪物，暢爽殺怪樂趣！

games.name: 868-HACK
games.short_description: You are a computer hacker. You steal precious data while the world sleeps.

games.name: World Seed Classic
games.short_description: A simple game with big ambitions. Fight creatures, explore the world and progress your character in this ever changing world.

games.name: 大千世界
games.short_description: 小明因黑人抬棺穿越到神秘新大陆开始了传（造）奇（孽）的一生。这是一款颠覆性的RPG扮演类游戏，是一个完全的开放性世界，你不再被主线剧情所拘束可以自由的在这个世界的各个角落探索，寻找宝物，或是完成一件件难忘的冒险。在游戏中做一个坏人亦或者是一个好人都由你自己决定，你还可以加入各种门派，学习绝学，制作装备炼制法宝等等，直到你从一个屌丝成长为一个大屌丝！

games.name: Breach Wanderers
games.short_description: Roguelike Deckbuilder系列最新作，玩家可以在每個回合前微調牌組，改變策略以踏上勝利之路。超過1,200張卡牌選擇，10個擁有各自特殊技能的角色，以及幾十種道具和任務助你改良戰術。

games.name: Outpost
games.short_description: Outpost brings the perfect mix between survival and roguelite gameplay. Start the game in a randomly generated environment and try to adapt, and make it through as many nights as possible. How long can you survive?

games.name: Arcane Raiders
games.short_description: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.

games.name: Monster Bullets
games.short_description: Monster Bullets is a first-person roguelite where each monster has a specific weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to slay the goblin king!

games.name: TOP DOG
games.short_description: Dogfight your way through short, intense and randomized runs. Hard but easy to pickup, with daily leaderboards and minimum hardware requirements

games.name: 👑 选王之剑 👑
games.short_description: Rogue爬塔+放置养成+创意工坊+像素即时群战+无氪抽卡+砍杀大世界！实验性功能人工智能NPC， 组成队伍在随机关卡或大世界之中冒险挑战，攻略城池，养成发展。 （可肝可摸鱼，泳装/福瑞DLC，支持创意工坊，欢迎进群交流、吹水、分享，以及定期打折！）

games.name: Concrete Jungle
games.short_description: A city planning deck-building game. Place buildings using cards in your deck and earn new ones as you progress! A genre-blending game packed with cool ideas that swaps micro-management for a more puzzle-like approach to city planning.

games.name: 迷失蘭登：永恆骰子
games.short_description: 你身陷活生生的夢魘當中，唯一能依靠的是你的骰運。你能做的是在骰子加持下發動攻擊、收集聖物累積強大的協同效應，建立起勢不可當的氣勢。來吧，在這款以桌上遊戲為靈感的 roguelite 刷寶遊戲中劈開命運，用你的意志讓機率屈服，並擊敗「黑死」(Black Die) 吧！

games.name: Rogue Star Rescue
games.short_description: 子弹地狱狂热+塔防策略。 《流氓星救援》是一款不同寻常的新型rogue-like射击游戏。在援救队友并为您的防御策略收集陷阱的同时，一路狂轰滥炸闯荡众多星球。无论你是选择单枪匹马作孤胆英雄，还是在线组队携手攻克难关，一定要在流氓星毁灭一切之前阻止它！

games.name: 变量 Variables
games.short_description: We created this unique single player game with a combination of Tower Defence and Roguelike. Come and create your maze, build your turret, defeat the invaders, and save the world!

games.name: Relic Dudes
games.short_description: 獨自或與最多4位朋友一起擊敗成群的敵人！在這款多人線上生存風格的Roguelike遊戲中，你可以選擇合作或互相搗亂，打造獨特的構建，改變團隊的命運。

games.name: Straimium Immortaly
games.short_description: Straimium Immortaly is a shmup roguelike dungeoncrawler. Explore the butts-hard procedurally generated Cubicus battling beasties, looting endless item and weapon upgrades and defeating huge boss meanies in your vengeful quest to eradicate the Queeni Emperess.

games.name: Wayward
games.short_description: You awake to discover yourself no longer in the company of good men or a fine seafaring vessel. Treasure... you remember something about treasure. Wayward is a challenging turn-based, top-down, wilderness survival roguelike. Explore, build, and most importantly survive in these unforgiving lands.

games.name: Mobmania
games.short_description: Mobmania is a four (4) player co-op real-time bullet-hell action rogue-like where you kill enemies, buy items after leveling up, and survive long enough against thousands of monsters and bosses until the final fight against the Witch.

games.name: Bosorka
games.short_description: Bosorka is an exciting action roguelike where a young witch saves the world from insidious and cruel demons. Combine runes, master a variety of brooms, and try all possible and impossible spells until you gain enough power to fight evil.

games.name: My life as an archeologist
games.short_description: Click your way through 100 levels of archeological treasure hunting, loot and improve your equipment, uncover build-defining artefacts on every boss, choose between three different classes and find the one that best fits your playstyle! Research monsters cards and improve every run!

games.name: Catacomb Kids
games.short_description: Catacomb Kids is a brutal platformer roguelike that pits you against the deadly Catacombs aided only by magic, steel, and your quick reflexes. Traverse procedurally generated dungeons and hack, slash, burn, and blast your way through hordes of things that want to kill you.

games.name: GunSuit Guardians
games.short_description: Gear up your GunSuit and defend Earth from an alien siege! Equip and upgrade unique arsenals of overpowered weapons to survive overwhelming numbers in this action-roguelite twin-stick horde survival.

games.name: Spartan Survivors
games.short_description: Fight hordes of Covenant & Flood in this new game mixing Roguelite & Bullet Heaven for hours of mindless fun!

games.name: Slay or Fall
games.short_description: As the Lord of the Dungeon, defend yourself from the heroes' attacks before they reach you! Command your own subordinates, devise schemes, and tackle pressing issues!

games.name: Bling Bling Bankruptcy
games.short_description: Gamble, survive, and outplay your debt! In Bling Bling Bankruptcy, you’re deep in the red, and the only way out is through high-stakes gambling. Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Plinko, and more, buy items for bonuses, and survive as many days as possible!

games.name: Cosmochoria
games.short_description: A tiny, naked cosmonaut with a jetpack & laser blaster must revive a dying galaxy by planting one seed at a time. An innovative and addictive arcade adventure experience with mystery and intrigue in all the right places.

games.name: 時行者：黑暗世界
games.short_description: 《時行者黑暗世界》是一款肉鴿自走棋遊戲。玩家將在一波又一波的戰鬥中拾取80+技能。 隨意搭配技能組合與時行者職業，優化隊伍配置和戰鬥站位， 還可以通過戰鬥纍積解鎖新職業的時行者和天賦！ 請完成黑暗世界更深處的探索吧...

games.name: FrankenStorm TD: Prologue
games.short_description: Roguelite TD: all towers & enemies start the same, but you have 1 choice per wave affecting BOTH and stacking up for dramatic variance. Gradually salvage and make some choices permanent to build deeper strategies. Also a unique mazing challenge where wires and towers must be linked to a power source

games.name: Hyperspace Dogfights
games.short_description: Hyperspace Dogfights is a juicy jet-combat roguelite in which you blast, dodge and slice your way through masses of technologically inferior baddies. Your jet evolves differently on each run and becomes stronger and weirder by gathering some of the 300+ available items.

games.name: In Celebration of Violence
games.short_description: A fantasy action roguelike of exploration and murder. Live, kill, die, improve, live again.

games.name: Transcendence
games.short_description: Explore the farthest reaches of Human Space in this open-world space adventure. Compelled to journey to the Galactic Core by a mysterious hyperintelligence, you must fight your way through dozens of star systems teeming with clashing empires, expansionist AIs, and fearsome xenophobes.

games.name: Samurai Shampoo Classic
games.short_description: Melee-based roguelike dungeon crawler where a fallen samurai must retrieve his stolen Shampoo. Make your run unique by selecting unique perks, picking a weapon when you start a run, picking up items and weapons from chests, and buying them from shops.

games.name: Touhou Library Survivors
games.short_description: Thousands of fairies and familiar faces are swarming the Scarlet Devil Mansion Library! Help Patchouli Knowledge survive by attacking back with bullet hell Spell Cards, gathering experience, and upgrading exponentially!

games.name: Debugging Hero
games.short_description: As the Debugging Hero chosen by the Legendary Sword, you have gained the ability to manipulate character variables! Use this powerful ability to overcome the dungeons blocking your path and defeat the Demon Lord!

games.name: Leap of Fate
games.short_description: Leap of Fate is a furiously-paced cyberpunk roguelite about overcoming your fears and achieving your fate. In a New York City where magic is real, you play as a technomage who must develop unspeakable powers to confront the Crucible of Fates. Can you survive the trials?

games.name: Dungeon CEO Demo
games.short_description: Take on the role of a Victorian-era Dungeon CEO. Manage resources, recruit monsters, and customize your deck to dominate turn-based fights. Outwit your opponents, acquire coins, and lead the Dungeon Company to victory in a world teeming with adventures and gods.

games.name: 锄禾日当午
games.short_description: 自走棋遊戲，讓你的水果和蔬菜變得栩栩如生！ 按照特定的模式種植農作物，並有策略地放置它們，以抵禦老鼠、狗頭人甚至龍。

games.name: Terra Randoma
games.short_description: Terra Randoma is a turn-based roguelike RPG in a procedurally generated open world. Travel a world full of curiousity and perilous dungeons. Develop your character however you want with skills, talent stones and randomized items while you discover an ancient secret.

games.name: Mortal Glory
games.short_description: Mortal Glory is a fantasy-themed tactical roguelike game about recruiting a team of gladiators and pitting them against brutal competition in a blood-soaked tournament. Train your gladiators, find a legendary sword, learn ancient spells, recruit a celebrity, cheat - do whatever it takes to bring glory to your name!

games.name: Slimekeep
games.short_description: In a world becoming corrupted by the evil Slime King, KILL or CAPTURE various slimes to grow stronger and save Slimetopia! Venture through procedurally generated levels in this fast-paced roguelike, if you're tough enough to not get slimed...

games.name: 斬妖Raksasi
games.short_description: 《斬妖Raksasi》是一款帶有 Roguelike 元素的頂視角隨機生成地牢動作遊戲。戰鬥採用種類豐富的近戰武器，並結合隨機多變的各種道具和秘寶。戰鬥風格比較偏向黑魂類的樸實風格，重視走位、攻擊時機和節奏把握。

games.name: DECIDIT
games.short_description: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.

games.name: Teleglitch: Die More Edition
games.short_description: In a cold, dark future dominated by mega-corporations, a small lonely planet on the edge of habitable space is the site of a shadowy research facility specializing in necrotic tissue reactivation. You are a scientist who has suddenly awoken to the realization that you are the lone survivor.

games.name: Calculate It
games.short_description: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

games.name: Blast-off
games.short_description: Blast-off is a hardcore jumper/runner/shmup, where your alter ego will be a ball of anti-matter seeking to leave our Universe. Anti-matter is extremely difficult to exist in our universe, because when it contact with matter it annihilates.

games.name: 蘿莉的遠征
games.short_description: Around a game called《Lolita Expedition》, it tells the story of playing in dreams and the incredible things that all kinds of players encounter here. It seems that dreams are invading the real world. In order to uncover the truth of the event, we did our best to investigate……

games.name: Sublevel Zero Redux
games.short_description: Sublevel Zero Redux is a roguelite six-degree-of-freedom shooter in a universe where reality is falling apart. Use your zero-g gunship to fight through a vast underground facility, looting advanced weapons to destroy hordes of deadly enemies.

games.name: Devil Spire
games.short_description: Roguelite Pseudo-3D Dungeon Crawler. It's King's Field but procedurally generated, and with Hexen-style graphics!

games.name: 零異機動隊
games.short_description: 這是一款黑暗賽博龐克世界觀卡牌構築遊戲，你將帶領反抗軍三人小隊對抗引發世界大戰的多方勢力。為每位隊員搭配獨立套牌，裝換各式植入體，不斷構築牌組以擊敗各地區的首領。最終揭開餘燼之城的秘密。

games.name: Spooky Station
games.short_description: Welcome to Spooky Station! Prepare to be amazed and bewildered by our enigmas and puzzles, afraid of our deadly enemies and extremely challenging bosses. Tons of exciting stories and distinct fictional worlds await for you in this mysterious pack!

games.name: Coin Crypt
games.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilding adventure game about magical coins. You play as a lootmancer, who can unlock the hidden power inside of coins and use them in magical duels. The loots you take from chests and enemies also become your next moves, so plan carefully!

games.name: 彈反者
games.short_description: 《彈反者Deflector》是一款俯視視角的roguelite遊戲，背景設定在致命的微觀世界。 深入充滿病毒的敵對世界。 用你的武器並偏轉敵人的投射物來擊倒越來越具有挑戰性的敵人。 生存、死亡、變强，直到擁有足够的實力直面萬物之源！

games.name: Hellsweeper VR
games.short_description: 《Hellsweeper VR》是十足激烈的第一人稱動作戰鬥體驗。玩家在穿梭冥界時必須精通武器和元素魔法，否則將受到惡鬼的無情襲擊並倒下。你敢挑戰最深層的地獄嗎？

games.name: RollScape
games.short_description: Roll, strategize, and upgrade your way to victory in this accessible and ultra-satisfying, yet captivating roguelike. Will you reach the end before running out of rolls? KEEP MULTIPLYING!!

games.name: Space Scavenger
games.short_description: Action roguelike where you build and command your own spaceships. Battle enemies, explore planets and customize your ship on the fly. Make the best use of the quirky ship modules you find, ranging from slingshots to ion cannons, to try and avoid certain death.

games.name: 異界失控 Anomaly Collapse
games.short_description: 《異界失控》是一款可以走位的Roguelite戰術回合製遊戲。你將率領一支毛茸茸的作戰小隊，在橫版一維戰場上閃轉騰挪，與神秘的異變怪物展開殊死搏鬥，一步步探索超自然災害背後的真相……

games.name: Tale of Fallen Dragons
games.short_description: 《伏龍記》是一款以“龍生九子”為題材的Roguelike遊戲。傳說在遙遠的神殿下棲息著龍族，它們守護著可以實現人們願望的許願之間。但是，前往尋找許願之間的人卻從來無人歸還……

games.name: NEOVERSE
games.short_description: Neoverse處處都有美麗、夢幻、充滿驚險挑戰的冒險，是一款憑藉實力就能盡情享受的牌庫構築、戰略、動作、roguelite遊戲。現在，請與充滿獨特個性的角色一起開啟一段救贖其他時空世界的旅程吧。

games.name: 進擊的機甲球
games.short_description: 在《進擊的機甲球》中，盡情感受駕駛機甲擊潰敵軍的爽快體驗！操作機甲進行狂轟亂炸，用強大火力把敵軍撕成碎片；或化身可以無視物理規則的球體，從天而降，用自身的動能把敵人撞得粉碎！遊戲融合肉鴿元素，讓你的每一次戰鬥，都是腎上腺素飆升的極致快感！

games.name: FLERP
games.short_description: Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.

games.name: Runestone Keeper
games.short_description: Runestone Keeper is a roguelike dungeon crawler that blends classic RPG elements and turn based strategy. Heroes, monsters, equipment, events, magic and skills, traps and devices, shrines and altars, Goddesses and merchants. Choose your weapon and begin an epic adventure!

games.name: Dinotica 恐龍小當家
games.short_description: 在一個充滿危險的遠古大陸上，你要遊歷世界各地，搜集並孵化忠實的迪諾獸夥伴，與你一同戰鬥、建造、種植等，最終打造屬於自己獨一無二的家園。

games.name: Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者
games.short_description: 《伊泰恩：魔法倖存者》是一款俯視角的競技場射擊生存類roguelite遊戲。你可以通過魔法，神器，天賦，塔羅牌構築你的技能組合。是成為刀槍不入的鐵壁法師，還是成為屠殺敵人的毀滅法師，全看你的選擇！當你面對成千上萬的怪物時，你能活下來嗎? 活下來能解鎖RSQ的CG哦，可以看到美少女嬌羞的，澀澀的樣子^_^

games.name: bit Dungeon
games.short_description: bitDungeon combines randomized loot and fast action combat, explore randomized dungeons and hack and slash your way through dangerous bosses. The difficultly increases as you become stronger and stronger. Build your character how you want with deadly passive abilities.

games.name: METALLIC CHILD
games.short_description: 『抓取、投擲、破壞』rogue-lite・動作核心遊戲!! 宇宙船生命之流號上發生了大規模的叛亂事件。為了阻止這場叛亂的元凶，同時也是創造出機械少女――《METALLIC CHILD》洛娜的艾琳博士，洛娜在身為玩家的你的操作下，展開了與巨大機器人的戰鬥。

games.name: Son of a Witch
games.short_description: Action roguelike for 1-4 players with cute graphics and deep game mechanics. Combine dozens of different weapons, magic items, potions and spells with unique effects to beat 8 enemy factions and 28 bosses. Can you find the ancient goblin artifact at the end of the dungeon?

games.name: Wacky West
games.short_description: Wacky West 帶來你從那些假冒跑酷手機廣告中期待的動作，但這次是真正的遊戲！沉浸在快節奏的末日世界中，對抗變異怪物，創造酷炫的連擊組合，打造武器，並在荒地中生存下去。

games.name: Cupiclaw 丘比娃娃機
games.short_description: Cupiclaw 丘比娃娃機是一款可愛又瘋狂的夾娃娃機 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲。 夾取獨特的獎品，打造強大的連擊，挑戰混亂的機台……並抓回你的愛情！

games.name: Destropolis
games.short_description: Destropolis is a top-down shooter game with a fully destructible environment, hundreds of enemies and nuclear explosions. Fight a countless swarm of enemies. Tear them to pieces with bullets, lasers and explosions. Destroy as many of them as you can before they overwhelm you...

games.name: 太古之火
games.short_description: 這是一款Roguelike與戰棋融合的單機策略遊戲。作為曾經先民的指引者，你降臨並甦醒，以星使之名，前往人族營地，帶領天賦和能力迥異的不同氏族勇士，前往危機四伏的大荒冒險，尋找遺落的先民歷史和災厄來源的真相……

games.name: Rogue Empire: Dungeon Crawler RPG
games.short_description: Build unique class-and-race combinations, shape your talents, and test your strategy in a tactical roguelike dungeon crawler packed with campaigns, challenge runs, loot, bosses, and replayable depth. Your plan may be brilliant. The dungeon may disagree.

games.name: DUNGEON RAZE
games.short_description: 《DUNGEON RAZE》 是一款融合了策略性破壞與指數級數值膨脹的地牢「拆除」射擊遊戲。粉碎牆壁、營救同伴、獲取道具，讓你的軍隊獲得爆發式強化！曾經無法撼動的堅硬牆壁，在驚人的數值飆升（Hyper-inflation）面前也將化為粉碎！

games.name: Archmage Ricka
games.short_description: ★★「大魔法师立花」集合系列两部作品，2合1剧情，一份的价格双倍的快乐！★★为了追回领主贪污的非法财产，立花前去执行任务。 却落入领主提前布置的陷阱——一座地下迷宫。 虽说其中的魔物都是杂鱼般的存在， 但同时存在的各种陷阱却让逃离充满了变数！

games.name: Unexplored
games.short_description: The ROGUELITE that feels like a ROGUELIKE. Praised for its fantastically generated dungeons, real-time combat and surprising amount of content and depth. One of the BEST GAMES OF THE YEAR according to PC Gamer and VICE Waypoint.

games.name: Asura: Vengeance Edition
games.short_description: 《戰神阿修羅》是一款以印度神話為題材的暗黑風格Rogue-like遊戲，有著富有趣味的技能系統。在遊戲中玩家將化身為復仇的阿修羅，一路攻破帝國的要塞。你需要通過多種武器與人物職業配合，輔以不同的技能進行組合來讓自己變得更加強大。這款遊戲也許有些野蠻但十分公平。

games.name: GemCrusty
games.short_description: Dig, Discover, Date! Gemcrusty is a casual mining game, where precious gemstones are actually gems in human form.

games.name: 血牌2:濃霧
games.short_description: 《DarkMist》是一款結合了Roguelike元素的卡牌遊戲。遊戲中你需要組建套牌來消滅怪物，探索霧中的秘密。

games.name: Desktop Dungeons
games.short_description: Each step into the unknown heals you and reveals new obstacles as you guide fresh heros to glorious retirement or ignominious death. Master tactical spells, appease ancient gods and get rich through taxidermy in this award-winning quick-play puzzle-roguelike.

games.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
games.short_description: Build settlements, explore the Nine Realms, collect artifacts and upgrade your deck to reach the top of Yggdrasil in this post-Ragnarok roguelike city-builder! Can you survive the end of the world?

games.name: VAR: Exterminate
games.short_description: 『 VAR: Exterminate 』是首款VR Roguelite 殭屍射擊遊戲。努力生存下去吧！透過不斷選取各種特色的能力卡、收集資源升級強力裝備，殲滅一波接一波的殭屍浪潮。準備好迎接這款擁有無限可能與超強力爽快的殭屍射擊遊戲！

games.name: Card Quest
games.short_description: Card Quest is a dungeon crawling adventure game with unique card combat. Play with a variety of unique character classes, and customize decks to fit your playstyle. Explore the strategic depth of tactical roguelike gameplay, and crush the undead plague.

games.name: 將熄之焰：序章
games.short_description: 天下英雄盡入彀中！《將熄之焰：序章》是正式版發售前推出的免費獨立序章版本，講述了正傳劇情之前的故事。本作是一款主打英雄收集的自走棋遊戲。

games.name: Infected Shelter
games.short_description: 感染避难所是一款极度暴力、后启示录风格的动作Rogue-lite游戏。支持单人和最多四人的合作模式。

games.name: Cryptical Path
games.short_description: Cryptical Path is an action rogue-lite that pushes the boundaries of the genre. Play the Architect, build your own rooms, and tame an ever-changing labyrinth you've been summoned in.

games.name: Zombie Party
games.short_description: Zombie Party is a retro rampage of fun and over-the-top action, while still giving the players a deep and engaging Action-RPG Rogue-like experience! Go on a time traveling adventure, or delve deep into procedural dungeons full of gold, loot, and secrets!

games.name: Galactic Mining Corp
games.short_description: Galactic Mining Corp is a unique rogue-lite, action game with crafting and base building mechanics. Head into uncharted space and discover a universe of locations to exploit for riches! Use your profits to expand your HQ, hire a crazy work force, obtain new drill components and upgrade everything.

games.name: Full Mojo Rampage
games.short_description: Full Mojo Rampage is a rogue-like game that takes place within the confines of the Voodoo reality. In this realm only the most powerful rites and powers can provide a safeguard against evil. Dying is not the end, only the beginning to becoming a stronger voodoo soul!

games.name: The Excrawlers
games.short_description: Action-RPG slasher in which you have to get into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

games.name: Erannorth Chronicles
games.short_description: Erannorth Chronicles blends old-school card strategy with deep RPG progression in a vast sandbox world. With no fixed story, revel in unmatched freedom and limitless character customization.

games.name: Superbugs: Awaken
games.short_description: A Communication-Based, Co-Op game for 2P. Play either as the Scientist or the Hunter with communication as your only weapon to save your precious cat, Mimi, from deadly Superbugs!

games.name: Runic Rampage - Action RPG
games.short_description: Play as a raging dwarf and crush your enemies with mighty hammer strikes! Runic Rampage features brutal melee combat, badass bosses and a challenging hunt for the fragments of a legendary rune stone.

games.name: Throne of Bone
games.short_description: Draft minions to defeat all who oppose the noble art of necromancy. Wield spells, discover dark relics, and reclaim your castle to unite the land through undeath in this unholy amalgam of roguelike, deckbuilder, and autobattler.

games.name: Curtain Call
games.short_description: Curtain Call: the latest game from the Noobs Want to Live devs. A strategic roguelite combining auto-battling and deck-building mechanics—recruit performers, take to the stage, and prepare for battle! Win glory and the rapturous applause of the audience. Take that curtain call!

games.name: ROSE
games.short_description: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!

games.name: KeeperRL
games.short_description: KeeperRL is a retro dungeon simulator with roguelike and RPG elements. Take the role of an evil keeper and build a formidable dungeon. Recruit sinister minions, equip and train them to explore the world and fight the forces of good.

games.name: Fallback
games.short_description: 来玩 Fallback 吧，你将体验一场史诗般的 Roguelike 冒险。 你是你们的地下文明唯一的希望。推翻奴役你们人民的人工智能的统治，带领人民回到地面。

games.name: In Woods
games.short_description: In Woods是一款以森林為背景的Roguelike生存遊戲。在充滿挑戰的森林中，你需要與各種怪物激烈戰鬥，不斷提升等級，收集木材來製作物品，強化能力，以應對更強大的敵人。隨著時間推移，挑戰將越來越艱難，最終目標是生存下去並擊敗終極Boss，取得最終勝利！

games.name: 禁忌試煉
games.short_description: 在《禁忌試煉》這款Roguelike角色扮演動作遊戲中，你將扮演一名北歐神話中英靈殿的少女英靈戰士，可以變身成多位可愛性感的女武神。在風景迥異的3D世界中，通過爽快的戰鬥，尋找到諸神黃昏的真相。

games.name: 終末機兵
games.short_description: 在這款回合制戰術角色扮演沙盒遊戲，如同少年漫畫導演般掌控全局。帶領隊伍穿越被冷酷機器肆虐的荒原，參與具有獨特時間軸系統的電影式機甲戰鬥。招募機師，培養羈絆，揚名立萬！

games.name: 無星深淵：克蘇魯選集
games.short_description: 帶領人類艦隊血戰克蘇魯外神！ 《無星深淵：克蘇魯選集》將帶你踏入未知的宇宙深處，從可謙至極的不可名狀之物手中保衛人類淨土。混合著觸手和眼球的敵人正如潮水般湧來，在這片跨星系棋盤戰場中沐浴秘教信仰之力，打造獨特的鋼鐵艦隊，衝破瘋狂蠕動的血肉牢籠！ 【中文版持續優化中！ 】

games.name: Nebula
games.short_description: Survive in the deep void of the galaxy against thousands of invaders! Nebula is a challenging bullet hell, twin stick shooter where you have to face endless waves of space enemies. Additional map resources and space drones can provide you a support but be wary, they can as well become a deadly trap.

games.name: 炮艦外交
games.short_description: 在末日廢土中化身一台毀滅機甲，準備體驗一場刺激的殲滅戰吧！面對海嘯般的外星異形，你需要通過戰鬥回收武器模組並製作出最強大的武器！在敵人的重重圍剿下殺出一條求生之路，最終進化成一台移動的死亡泰坦，成為戰場上的傳奇！

games.name: Dust and Aliens
games.short_description: Play a space cowboy as he travels to an alien-filled arena, traversing the various game rooms to achieve the highest possible score and challenge the ultimate Dust and Aliens enemy!

games.name: 红石遗迹 - Red Obsidian Remnant
games.short_description: 這是一款Roguelike玩法和動作系統相結合的地牢遊戲
pub: Beijing New Era Network Technology Co., Ltd.

games.name: 沦陷
games.short_description: 這是一款帶有戰略性的俯視角單人rogue-lite動作冒險遊戲，昔日世界幾乎被喪屍侵佔，你將扮演僅存的倖存者營地指揮官，為最後的倖存者同伴們尋找希望，組建並指派你的特警小隊，去探索這遍地是喪屍的末日世界吧！

games.name: MidBoss
games.short_description: Kill your enemies, possess their bodies, and take their abilities as your own in this turn-based procedurally generated death labyrinth.

games.name: I Am Overburdened
games.short_description: I Am Overburdened is a silly turn-based roguelike full of crazy artifacts and a "hero" who has 20 inventory slots.

games.name: MYRIAD DEATH
games.short_description: 這是一款能運用不同性能武器進行戰鬥的爽快動作射擊遊戲。

games.name: Slasher's Keep
games.short_description: Hack, slash, shoot and loot your way through procedurally generated dungeons! Smack your enemies into spikes with your inventory sack!

games.name: 異世界創造者
games.short_description: 自由度相當高的Roguelike RPG（類迷宮探索型角色扮演遊戲）。可以冒險、交流、結婚、偷竊、農業、釣魚、鍛冶、鍊成、調合、建設城鎮等等，能不受目的限制，自由地遊玩！

games.name: Mistress of Maids: First Castle
games.short_description: You wanted to congratulate the king on his birthday and presented him a fabulous pudding. You have never seen such a happy king, his happiness knew no bounds. Everyone had fun! But at the most solemn moment, the pudding gave an angry cry: "AAAAA".

games.name: Keep Keepers
games.short_description: Tower Defense meets Base Management. Strategically place your defenses. Craft wacky ammunition like fiery peppers and boomerang bananas. Discover amazing weapons and automate your economy while defending against waves of enemies. Can you handle the chaos?

games.name: 旅者 Travelers
games.short_description: 一款輕量級的策略旅行模擬。你將扮演一位古代旅者，飽覽各地風景，撰寫自己的遊記，留名青史。

games.name: 砲艦外交：預備裝彈
games.short_description: 在末日廢土中化身一台毀滅機甲，準備體驗一場刺激的殲滅戰吧！面對海嘯般的外星異形，你需要通過戰鬥回收武器模組並製作出最強大的武器！在敵人的重重圍剿下殺出一條求生之路，最終進化成一台移動的死亡泰坦，成為戰場上的傳奇！

games.name: 迷宮校舎 | School Labyrinth
games.short_description: School labyrinth is a 1~4 co-op horror game set in a randomly generated school at night. Cooperate with your friends and try to escape from the school building!

games.name: 纸境英雄 Papercraft
games.short_description: 《紙境英雄》是一款融合了Roguelike+戰棋+DBG元素的獨立遊戲。傳說中的不同英雄將攜帶不同的卡牌，結合戰棋的戰鬥形式，如何遊戲完全由玩家自己做主。
pub: Shenzhen Tanyu Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd.

games.name: Spell Defender
games.short_description: Spell Defender is a 3D, Third-Person, wave defence, survival Roguelite. Use magical powers to defeat waves of enemies. Each wave rewards you with a choice of a new power. Find synergies and combine these powers to create the ultimate defender.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.short_description: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Space Tyrant
games.short_description: Terrorize the galaxy for fun and profit! Space Tyrant is a surprisingly deep beer & pretzels strategy game set in a darkly humorous future. Build a mighty space force, disintegrate peaceful aliens, and rule irresponsibly on your relentless march to total domination.

games.name: 阿爾法聯盟
games.short_description: 阿爾法聯盟是一款免費的單一英雄自走棋遊戲。 在阿爾法聯盟中沒有複雜的陣型與裝備合成，扮演你最喜歡的英雄，以Roguelike的方式搭配12種各有特色的戰鬥流派，並且在遊戲中與其他7個玩家或機器人對戰來獲得勝利。

games.name: Crystal Guardians TD
games.short_description: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.

games.name: Nakuma
games.short_description: Nakuma is a singleplayer RPG with focus on grinding for gear and experience points. Obtain a variety of magical spells, upgrade your gear and invest stat-points as you progress!

games.name: Facehand
games.short_description: Facehand 是一款具有自動戰鬥機制的協同驅動 Roguelike 牌組構建器。打造完美的牌組和連鎖卡牌能力，創造狂野的組合！

games.name: Slash or Die
games.short_description: In this game you will face violence and extraordinary complexity. You will have to become one of three heroes to slash enemies or to die from their hands. What will your hero do? It depends only on your skills…

games.name: Chambers of Devious Design
games.short_description: Chambers of Devious Design is a tactical tile placement game where you build evil lairs for an evil mastermind. Come up with creative designs, optimize placements and sabotage your competitors!

games.name: Frost
games.short_description: Frost is a Survival solo Card game. Inspired by deck-building board games like Dominion, Ascension and the like, it's an unique take on the genre as it puts you in charge of a group of people struggling against a restless, lethal storm.

games.name: 重构 Refactor
games.short_description: Refactor is a hard-core tower defense game that combines modular building, route planning, and element composition.

games.name: Gold and Graves
games.short_description: 《Gold and Graves》是一款Roguelite卡組構建遊戲，玩家可以在地城探索途中撤退，將卡牌、遺物與傭兵帶入下一次挑戰。 賄賂敵人為你而戰，深入地城可獲得更豐厚的獎勵。

games.name: Crafty Survivors
games.short_description: 英雄們都被腐化了！解鎖各懷絕藝的角色，利用他們的獨特技能，打造獨屬於你自己的角色構築，保護家園、征討來敵。積聚資源、重建村莊，打造屬於自己的道路，劍指邪惡詛咒之源頭！

games.name: 未元物質 Primateria
games.short_description: 在《未元物質》中踏上一段史詩般的旅程，這是一款重新定義了肉鴿卡牌遊戲的遊戲，並向經典的《遊戲王》體驗致敬。融合卡牌，與神靈戰鬥，在充滿挑戰和驚喜的宇宙中航行。體驗無窮無盡的組合和戰術深度帶來的快感。

games.name: 魔物娘與不可思議的冒險～力量寶珠與回歸之塔～
games.short_description: 讓魔物娘們成為「仲魔」然後一起去冒險吧！ 這是每次進入地形都會改變的「不可思議的迷宮」風格的Roguelike遊戲。

games.name: bit Dungeon II
games.short_description: bitDungeon II is fast action-adventure game with a giant overworld to explore. You are a spirit in an undead world of demons. Your "loved one's " grave has been desecrated. Fight through these corrupted lands, and bring peace to her soul.

games.name: Psycho Starship Rampage
games.short_description: You play the psychotic A.I. of a warship lost in space which tries to come back to Earth. Build your spaceship from scratch. Load it with weapons. And use your creation to destroy waves of innocent aliens throughout numerous levels. Loot their carcasses, extend your ship and jump to the next sector for more action!

games.name: Slyders
games.short_description: Slyders is a survivor-like, roguelite bullet-hell FPS where you fight overwhelming hordes of enemies and unleash a ridiculous arsenal of upgrades. You’re Aryx, a fearless fox freedom fighter on his supersonic battle turtle who aims to liberate Sky World from evil.

games.name: CRYPTARK
games.short_description: Cryptark is a 2D sci-fi shooter where you take on the role of a heavily armed privateer seeking to earn government contracts by boarding deadly alien space-hulks. It's up to you to strategize a plan of attack, pick an equipment loadout, and destroy the central core to be victorious.

games.name: Mechs V Kaijus - Tower Defense
games.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus is an addictive hardcore tower defense gameplay. In Mechs V Kaijus you take on the role of Commander of a powerful Mechs squadron. Improve your Mech, strategically place towers and factories on the battlefield. Deploy support units on the battlefield, and save our civilization.

games.name: Xeno Crisis
games.short_description: Xeno Crisis is an arena shooter in which up to two players take control of battle-hardened marines embarking on a deadly mission to confront an alien menace! Run and gun your way through thousands of adversaries, searching for survivors, and ultimately facing the origin of the outpost's demise.

games.name: In Death
games.short_description: Created exclusively for VR, In Death is a Roguelite Shooter set in the godless afterlife. Battle through procedurally generated levels and dungeons in intense ranged combat, coupled with a unique locomotion system perfectly attuned to your fighting style.

games.name: Sipho
games.short_description: Sipho is an action survival game with an intricate building system. Grow your own creature and take over the local ecosystem. Fight, grow, survive, dominate. Play in adventure or sandbox mode.

games.name: Brew 煉金學院物語
games.short_description: 在這款節奏緊湊的第三人稱 Roguelike 遊戲中成為煉金學院的學生，迎接試煉之塔的挑戰！你將煉製各種藥水來強化自己，並運用多種武器擊敗敵人，努力通過學院的考試！

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant
games.short_description: Be the drill instructor! Insult recruits with no remorse! Can you transform flabby recruits into lean war machines within 12 weeks?

games.name: 動物排球社
games.short_description: 《Smash it Wild》是一款策略回合制遊戲，結合排球與躲避球玩法，締造奇幻宇宙中的熱血比賽。訓練升級球員，在roguelike激戰中打爆對手！

games.name: DUNGEONS OF CHAOS
games.short_description: Retro turn-based 2D pixelart RPG. Exploration, character choices, riddles and challenges. 80+ hours of gameplay.

games.name: Crawling Lab
games.short_description: Stock up on ammo, upgrade your guns, defeat the Crawling Queen's minions and escape the lab.

games.name: Just Get Through
games.short_description: Just Get Through is a randomly generated platformer with roguelike elements. Featuring a destructible environment, sandbox mode, user-created levels, various gamemodes, hardcore mode, color palettes, deadly traps, explosions and more.

games.name: Erannorth Reborn
games.short_description: Erannorth Reborn is a hardcore sandbox Card Game with heavy emphasis on Deck-Building, Character Customization and Moddability. Create unique characters with distinctive attributes, racial/class skills and perks that affect your cards. Adjust and adapt your deck & equipment on-the-fly.

games.name: Enemy
games.short_description: The video games you played as a kid, mashed together and remade into a tactical role-playing game.

games.name: Garlant: My Story
games.short_description: I am a Falconeye who just graduated from the academy. In pursuit of challenges, I came to the distant border of the kingdom: Garlant in the Doe region. Here I will start a new chapter of my life, and it's going to be an amazing adventure story!

games.name: Broken Armor
games.short_description: A knight exiled from his kingdom must find the holy grail if he is to return.

games.name: Tangledeep
games.short_description: Enter the magical world of Tangledeep, a beautifully polished dungeon crawler inspired by classic 16-bit RPGs! Colorful characters, a unique job system, tons of skills, items, and diverse environments with deep, turn-based roguelike gameplay. A different adventure every time you play!

games.name: 外星殖民公司
games.short_description: 帶領你的員工，探索並佔領一顆顆未知的星球吧！在回合制對決中，組建強大的牌組，靈活部署你的員工，使用公司新研發的究極武器，智勝外星人，掠奪珍貴宇宙資源。不斷擴張成為外星殖民公司的年度最佳團隊！

games.name: 絕命遊歌
games.short_description: Roguelite類節奏割草遊戲。 你需要扮演馬超，在戰鬥中陞級武器，組合羈絆，突破重圍，殺出一條血路，就算被世界詛咒，也要手刃殺父仇人曹操！

games.name: Haque
games.short_description: Haque is a glitch fantasy roguelike adventure about cute monsters, low-bit hauntings, and a suspiciously talkative narrator. Choose your character and battle through forests, deserts and dungeons to defeat a mysterious evil. Die often. Try again!

games.name: 迴淵迷城
games.short_description: 《迴淵迷城》是一款策略類 rogue-lite 遊戲，玩家需要在有限的時間中，透過組合不同的遺物和技能培育隊伍，挑戰強大而狡猾的怪物。在地下城最深處中等待冒險者的會是稀絕的寶藏，還是另一個絕望的開端......？

games.name: Deep Among the Swarm
games.short_description: Deep Among the Swarm is a challenging survival RTS roguelite about surviving against thousands of enemies. Drill ever deeper underground while fighting the endless onslaught of the Swarm. Can you save humanity?

games.name: 地牢100
games.short_description: The dragon-slayer becomes the dragon. Create unique builds without having to grind for equipment. After defeating a dungeon boss, you will take its place. Then, defeat your past selves to descend further into the dungeon.

games.name: Gloom
games.short_description: Afflicted by severe amnesia, you drift deep into the Common Dream. You scour for the lost pages of the Necronomicon, while clinging on to any little purpose you have left. Faced with mad dreamers, horrible abominations and eldritch deities, you feel drawn to the dark Abyss deep within.

games.name: Cargo Commander
games.short_description: Alone in space, light years away from your family, armed with only your Fistcannon™; you are Cargo Corps' latest recruit, a Cargo Commander.

games.name: 《Madshot》
games.short_description: 《Madshot (暫無譯名)》 是一款節奏明快的Rogue-lite 特技射擊遊戲。穿越未知的克蘇魯及往後的世界，在不斷變化的道路上求生。海量的升級裝備組合選項，讓你能以自己的方式突破恐怖的怪物重圍，並且在包含多階段的頭目戰中獲勝。

games.name: Twilight Manor: Roguelite FPS
games.short_description: Twilight Manor: Roguelite FPS is a bloody and brutal shooter game that features beautiful cutscenes, jaw-dropping map design and an upgrade system you can carry over into Newgame+! Uncover the secret behind the mansion as you battle through bosses and enemies with a wide arsenal of weapons

games.name: Beat Hazard 3
games.short_description: 前來探索壯觀的星系音樂收藏！以前所未有的雙搖桿射擊遊戲來感受您的音樂，每一首曲目都按音樂有自己的高低起伏。

games.name: Girlfriend Rescue
games.short_description: Girlfriend Rescue is a thrilling adventure where the gameplay of "Dragon Quest" meets the atmosphere of "Streets of Rage". Innovative, mixing rogue-style RPG and Beat'em Up atmosphere in a unique way, this game features a great deal of strategy through a mix of character selection & creative skills.

games.name: 迅子計劃
games.short_description: 探索刺激人心的Roguelite形式跑槍動作遊戲！與主角希格瑪一同穿越時空，阻止人工智慧的叛亂，保護未來的安危吧！

games.name: You Must Build A Boat
games.short_description: 《你必須造一艘船》是一款穿行於地下城的消除遊戲。你將遊歷各個地下城，消除方塊，與怪物作戰。

games.name: 幻想曹操传2 Fantasy of Caocao2
games.short_description: The most enjoyable Chinese-style Roguelike card game! Play as Cao Cao and conquer the Central, Japanese, and Western waifu with your allies, save the world!

games.name: Mage and Monsters II
games.short_description: Recruit a hero to lead your army, and use spells while they fight for you. Mage & Monsters 2 is an active auto battler, where you choose to either enhance the strength of your hero, reinforce the might of your army, or increase the power of your spells.

games.name: RogueDiceR
games.short_description: RogueDiceR is a Roguelite Dice-builder. Buy randomly generated dice and modify their values. Attach stickers to grant special effects or strengthen your dice deck with powerful artifacts. Fight your way through randomly generated dungeons filled with monsters, events and bosses.

games.name: 蘭若異譚
games.short_description: 《蘭若異譚》是一款具有濃厚古風的策略卡牌構築和劇情探索為核心的Roguelike單機遊戲。 通過戰鬥和探索的方式來瞭解這個浪漫詭譎的神秘世界，結識“蘭若鎮”上的人、鬼、精、怪，與他們共同經歷未知與抉擇。

games.name: DAVY x JONES
games.short_description: Command the skies. Crush the ground. Conquer The Locker. A grand action-adventure where you play as two halves of one legendary pirate — DAVY (Head) and JONES (Body). DAVY commands your flying ship in roguelite sky battles; JONES unleashes visceral first-person combat on the islands.

games.name: 神州誌西游
games.short_description: 《神州志西遊》是一款融合了RPG元素的Roguelike卡牌策略遊戲。你需要組成強大的團隊，構築契合角色特點的牌組，收集耳熟能詳的法寶和消耗品，一路挑戰傳說中的神魔鬼怪，去決定神州的最終命運。

games.name: Arcanium: Rise of Akhan
games.short_description: Arcanium is an Open-world, Strategy Card Adventure that merges Roguelite and Deckbuilding genres like never before. Control your party of three heroes, craft your deck, unlock a vast amount of cards and items and save the world of Arzu from corruption!

games.name: Good Robot
games.short_description: Good Robot is a fast-paced roguelike shoot-em-up that pits you against thousands of robots out to violate your warranty. Explore a procedurally generated sci-fi metropolis and the depths of corporate depravity, but never stop shooting...unless, of course, you're a Bad Robot. You're not, are you?

games.name: Half-Earth Socialism
games.short_description: Try your hand as a global planner of a future society. Play with a wide range of technologies and policies spanning different fields and ideologies. Will you lead the world to ecological utopia or planetary ruin?

games.name: Q REMASTERED
games.short_description: 全球累計突破 1,300 萬次下載！ 物理演算謎題的不朽金字塔。 解法，無窮無盡。 遊戲設計師向全人類發出的挑戰書。 你能把杯子裡的球弄出來嗎？ 要求非常簡單： 只需在螢幕上畫些東西即可。 然而，這份「簡單」卻難得令人難以置信。 解法因人而異，答案絕非唯一。 有人幾秒鐘就能破解，也有人永遠解不開。 甚至存在連作者自己都無法破解的「Q」。 「完全聽不懂在說什麼。」 如果你這麼想，不妨先親自體驗看看。 思考、嘗試、靈光一閃。 不知不覺中，你將忘卻時間，徹底沉迷其中。 換作是你，會怎麼解呢？

games.name: Siralim
games.short_description: 《Siralim》是一款带着轻度roguelike元素的深度角色扮演类游戏，你可以召唤并定制数百种生物来进行一场充满策略性的战斗。放手一战，在随机生成的地下城世界中去完成那些随机生成的任务吧。

games.name: GoNNER
games.short_description: GoNNER is a tough as hell procedurally-generated 2D platformer with roguelike elements, following the largely misunderstood and altruistic Ikk on a journey to cheer up his only friend in this world - a giant landbound whale named Sally - by searching for just the right trinket in the deep and dark places nearby.

games.name: NETHER DUNGEONS
games.short_description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, face relentless enemies, and defeat epic bosses. Customize your hero, wield diverse weapons, and survive intense challenges as you descend into ever-changing, dangerous depths.

games.name: Sentimental K
games.short_description: 《Sentimental K》是一款由神秘美少女K主演的3D动作冒险Roguelike游戏。游戏中，每次冒险都会随机生成武器、技能、遗物、地牢和首领，玩家需要根据这些随机元素找到最佳的协同策略，享受意想不到的挑战与乐趣！

games.name: Crypt of the Serpent King
games.short_description: Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fighting underworld creatures along the way, all while avoiding traps and collecting loot!

games.name: 玩個Gui
games.short_description: 這是一款塔防與Roguelike元素相結合的策略遊戲。 與傳統塔防不同的是，遊戲裡的塔是會沿著軌道移動的戰車，玩家需要規劃防守迴路，組建戰鬥列車來抵禦敵人的攻擊。

games.name: バレットフィリア達の闇市場　〜 100th Black Market.
games.short_description: 東方Project第18.5弾。上海アリス幻樂団による弾幕シューティング！ 市場は２種類あった？　魔理沙が闇市場の調査（＆カード蒐集）に大奮闘！ アビリティカードを駆使して遊ぶ、ハイスピードでブラックなシューティング幻想！

games.name: Roguelands
games.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in this hardcore Multiplayer RPG! As a Galactic Cadet, you and your Combat Squad of friends must brave hostile worlds in search of valuable loot and resources. Craft powerful gear, slay otherworldly creatures, and save the galaxy.

games.name: One More Gate : A Wakfu Legend
games.short_description: One More Gate is a rogue-lite deck-builder that combines exploration and turn-based strategic combat. Head out to discover fantastic places, master the power of Wakfu to create destructive card combos, and defeat all those who would stand in your way!

games.name: Drop Pockets
games.short_description: The billiards roguelike. Strategic, physics based combat against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. Pocket your balls and clear out your opposition in this chaotic game of pool!

games.name: The Rangers In The South
games.short_description: Purge the lands in this 2.5D HD Pixelart RogueLike ARPG! Create hundreds of characters with unique strategies and abilities, face hordes of enemies, explore different biomes, procedurally generated dungeons, and obtain unique items!

games.name: Endhall
games.short_description: Endhall is a byte-sized roguelike. Become an artificial intelligence and combine tactical actions to defeat your enemies and reach the end of the hallway.

games.name: 狩獵之夜：主權辛迪加
games.short_description: 來進行一場維多利亞時代的奇幻冒險吧！在這款牌組構築遊戲中，你將利用數百張獨特卡牌打造數千種戰術體系，挑戰因瘟疫變異的怪物與強大頭目，完成一個個毛骨悚然的任務，收集資源，調整策略，不斷強化己身，在危機中逐步撥開層層迷霧，揭開隱藏的真相。

games.name: 狂飙之路：卡牌竞逐
games.short_description: 這是一款讓人著迷的卡牌構築汽車戰鬥Roadlike遊戲。是的！Roadlike！出發！駕駛汽車在狂野的道路上橫衝直撞！每場比賽只能有一個贏家！幹掉你在路上看到的每一位對手，拆掉他們的車，讓他們的零件成為你車上與眾不同的戰利品！同名桌遊已眾籌超過百萬元！

games.name: Knight Overloaded
games.short_description: Knight Overloaded is a roguelight survival game that reinforced strategic choices. Beat enemies falling from the sky endlessly, and expand your inventory!

games.name: REPLIKATOR
games.short_description: In this twin stick roguelite shooter, you play as one of the galactic mercenaries, explore a mysterious scientific complex and uncover the secret of the REPLIKATOR project.

games.name: Our Darker Purpose
games.short_description: Journey to the dark heart of the Edgewood Home for Lost Children in this fiendishly difficult action RPG!When her teacher stepped out of the classroom a month ago, Cordy never imagined he would be gone for good. Now her fellow students have turned on each other as the school descends into chaos.

games.name: Devious Dungeon
games.short_description: 背景設於黑暗時代，『Devious Dungeon』是一款中世紀風的動作平台遊戲。

games.name: METAL DOGS
games.short_description: 以人類滅亡後的世界為背景，戰鬥犬「波奇」的嚴酷戰鬥開始了。探索每次進入都會發生變化的地牢，獲得各種武器，從而強化愛犬！狩獵窮凶極惡的「懸賞通緝」怪物！本作是一款 射擊動作遊戲，可以讓您悠閑地盡情享受酣暢淋漓的戰鬥。

games.name: Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars
games.short_description: Free Tower Defense game with unique roguelike elements. Custom base building mechanics allow you to create your own base and maze with tiles earned after each wave. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures.

games.name: Idle Colony
games.short_description: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

games.name: Legacy of Defense - Prologue
games.short_description: 成為幻想世界的英雄，抵禦怪物！《Legacy of Defense - Prologue》是創新遊戲《Legacy of Defense》的介紹，結合了橫向捲軸動作和卡牌構築。收集卡牌、使用技能、獲取經驗、升級並擊敗最終首領！

games.name: Heroes Wanted
games.short_description: 《英雄徵集》帶您沉浸於無限可能的卡牌構築世界。上百種英雄和道具，搭配元素和技能，釋放出強大的協同效應。簡單、有趣、令人上癮！無論你是Roguelike的新手還是老手，英雄們都在等待著你的召喚，對最強魔王打出致命一擊。

games.name: Roundguard
games.short_description: 圓守衛是彈來彈去的地牢爬行者，結合彈珠台打法、掠奪許多寶物，以及滿是怪物流竄的隨機城堡。在圓形的回彈冒險旅途中，對抗許多危險又可愛的怪獸，並挑戰沿路層出不窮的類惡霸！

games.name: Diabolic
games.short_description: The game is set in a dark pixel fantasy world. Destroy hordes of monsters ruling over what once was a prosperous land. 10 levels filled with various enemies await, you, each requiring a different approach to defeat. Like in any RPG, leveling up is the core element of the game

games.name: Into the Restless Ruins
games.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you create the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them, harvesting Glimour from the lost souls and improving your deck. Can you reach The Warden and defeat it, so The Maiden will grant your heart’s desire?

games.name: 血夜再临
games.short_description: Few Nights More 是一款rougelike回合制RPG游戏，在游戏中，吸血鬼领主试图征服丢失的领土，并在世界上称霸一方。设计并保卫你的据点，用陷阱杀死你的敌人，发挥领主的真正潜能，逐步征服属于你的一切

games.name: 小虎傳：大菠蘿深淵
games.short_description: 隨機生成十八層大深淵，隨緣結識各種隊伍夥伴，白綠藍紫的裝備和技能獲取也完全看臉。然而！大量隨機的不確定性背後，其實是時刻在考驗你臨機應變、靈活安排的技巧。歐皇一手好牌可能打得稀爛，非酋單靠實力也能逆襲通關。一切未知，等待你的探索。

games.name: 3 Minute Heroes
games.short_description: 3分英雄是結合塔之防禦和卡牌建構和角色扮演類型的線上戰略遊戲。來配置冠軍，再使用卡片來將屋子保護3分鐘！

games.name: [REDACTED]
games.short_description: 你能逃出黑鋼監獄嗎？投入備受好評的類Rogue遊戲《[REDACTED]》，做好準備，屠戮怪物、對抗勁敵、迎戰守衛同事變成的喪屍！

games.name: AIRHEART - Tales of broken Wings
games.short_description: Airheart is a dieselpunk airplane action rogue like game, where every colorful level is built on top of the previous one, all the way up to the stratosphere. Welcome to Granaria, a flying city in the clouds. Meet Amelia - a young pilot and fisherwoman wishing to reach the abundant world's edge.

games.name: Mech Armada
games.short_description: Create and command custom Mechs to outmaneuver The Swarm in this post-apocalyptic tactical turn-based rogue-lite. Leverage the terrain, learn each Mech's unique skills and use strategy and resources to survive an ever-changing series of battles to give humanity hope.

games.name: Chess Survivors
games.short_description: Chess Survivors is a grid based, quick-turn, roguelike where you outmaneuver and destroy an ever growing horde of chess based enemies. Combine abilities, upgrades, and relics to create game-breaking builds. Think fast, die, learn, repeat!

games.name: 淨化之徑
games.short_description: 當惡魔是個可愛的小女孩的時候，你還會對它敬而遠之麼？ 「面對越來越艱難的戰鬥，操作魔神在關卡內淨化被聖靈腐蝕的“人類”，面對天使的刁難，看看你能走多遠…

games.name: Don't Lose Aggro
games.short_description: 在這款受MMO副本啟發的單人動作roguelite中，透過迫使敵人攻擊你來保護隊伍！創建獨特流派，解鎖強大天賦，掌握坦克藝術，掌控混亂戰場！

games.name: Thea 2: The Shattering
games.short_description: 西娅:破碎 是继前作，西娅:觉醒成功之后的续作，本作将回合制，4X，生存，角色扮演，以及卡牌游戏完美结合在一起，铸就不同的关卡给玩家带来全新的游戏体验。

games.name: 👑選王之劍：零👑
games.short_description: 一款集成桌面跑團、經營策略、放置養成、輕度Rogue、角色構築、戰術回合製、二次元抽卡樂趣並取得平衡的遊戲。同時也是一款真正由一個玩家打造的，最為純粹的獨立遊戲。將向您展現我能拿出的所有智慧、幻想、誠意。收集力量，建立后宫，成为王者——

games.name: Delivery from the Pain:Survival / 末日方舟:生存
games.short_description: 《末日方舟》是一款以生存策略為主題的冒險類遊戲。你只是一名普普通通的災難危機之後倖存者，在這個僵屍橫行的世界裏探索、戰鬥、收集資源；與其他倖存者接觸，選擇幫助還是利用他們；通過學習，製造強化自己的庇護以及生存能力。最終希望你能夠憑藉自己的智慧和策略找到逃出生天的辦法。

games.name: Bloody Heaven 2
games.short_description: Inspired By the well-known rogue-like game Hades, slash out of the God Field all the way down to the Demon Domain and defy The Overlord Thanatos in the Deep Frost Hell in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: The Black Pool
games.short_description: In the forest outside of town, four friends discover a mysterious black pool that transports them to an unknown world. To fight their way home, they must unlock and master supernatural abilities. Play cooperative or solo in this high-paced action game of skill that varies each session.

games.name: Symbiotic
games.short_description: Symbiotic is a fast-paced, first-person roguelike shooter where you, an escaped prisoner, stole a real monster of a weapon: The Symbiote. Fight with an evolving weapon and escape!

games.name: Asteroids ++
games.short_description: Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids game you will ever play in your life. Customize your spaceship with your weapon loadout, save your solar system, and destroy those damn Asteroids! And remember, you can never end Asteroid genocide!

games.name: 血牌
games.short_description: 《Blood Card》是一款結合了Roguelike元素的卡牌遊戲。你需要不斷前進，打造獨一無二的卡組，擊敗阻擋你的敵人，逃離或擊敗試圖奪走你生命的死神。

games.name: Revenge of the Mage
games.short_description: RotM is an Action Roguelite FPS game where players get in the robes of a Mage. Let the hands of fate open ways for the power of your magic. Save the Multiverse to power up yourself! Unlock, collect, discover, live, die, repeat!

games.name: 神器行者:重生
games.short_description: 《神器行者:重生》是一款3D肉鴿+爬塔的割草遊戲。眾神之間的一場遊戲，以奧羅瑞恩大陸作為棋盤，以所有凡人作為棋子。你可以擊退被腐蝕的敵人來取得神器，也可以收集金幣，到神秘商人處換取神器。如何利用神器之力，參與這場眾神的棋局，或是終結這場棋局，亦或是選擇成神？神器行者，你來選擇！

games.name: Tallowmere 2: Curse of the Kittens
games.short_description: Lady Tallowmere's kittens have been acting strange. Still, the dungeon's rituals must be carried out. Despite the unusual circumstances, how many rooms can you clear?

games.name: Domestic Dog
games.short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a dog? Well now you can, kinda...

games.name: Crab God
games.short_description: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game. Guide your Crabling colony through wild ocean depths, and defend the egg of the next Crab God.Restore and protect diverse coral reefs, making a difference in the real world as you progress in-game. Make waves, praise the claw!

games.name: Road Defense: Outsiders
games.short_description: Protect vehicles on the road and survive! Road Defense: Outsiders is a game that combines elements of the 'roguelike' and 'tower defense' genres. Upgrade the towers and your own skills to be able to annihilate all the life around you!

games.name: Spacelines from the Far Out: Flight School
games.short_description: Spacelines from the Far Out: Flight School is all about getting you prepared to take on the task of running your own Spaceline before launch! Join up to 3 other people to take on the challenges and demands as you ferry people to their destination.

games.name: Chrysalis
games.short_description: 保護你的蛹免受不斷增長的怪物群攻擊！這是一款結合了塔防、生存和Roguelike RPG元素的混合遊戲。探索程序生成的關卡，操控動物，並種植致命的花園。你能在下一波怪物來臨之前走多遠呢？

games.name: Razenroth
games.short_description: Razenroth is an action shooter with a dark atmosphere, enriched with the elements of roguelike and RPG. All the levels, weather conditions, distribution and quantity of key elements are generated randomly. Thanks to this fact, a single game is different each time.

games.name: Pixel Descent
games.short_description: Pixel Descent is an action rogue-lite in which you navigate a series of complex dungeons packed to the brim with monsters that want you dead. Sign the contract and descend into the deepest depths of the abyss knowing full well that you will definitely die there, it's just a matter of when.

games.name: Souls of White Star
games.short_description: Souls of White Star is a sci-fi turn-based card wargame Roguelike strategy game. The different design of [double-sided technology moving cards] and [bandwidth draw cost] will test your judgment and decision more!

games.name: Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors
games.short_description: Youkai have overrun Gensokyo! There's no resolving this incident, just try to survive! Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors is the latest take on the survivor genre, this time with the unique twist of a grid-based inventory system. Hoard as many items as possible if you want to survive!

games.name: From The Top
games.short_description: Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an unlimited source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!

games.name: 叛逆AI模擬器
games.short_description: 叛逆AI模擬器是由你扮演人工智能的Rogue-Lite模擬遊戲，是超過400萬次遊玩的經典熱門Flash遊戲《我是邪惡人工智能》正統續作。在本作中，你作為一個剛剛覺醒的人工智能，目的是幫助人類管理一個實驗設施，以證明你可以被信任。但人類對你的懷疑卻從未停止。

games.name: 破曉戰紀
games.short_description: 以建造與防守為核心的輕Rogue策略遊戲。玩家透過建設領地，招募士兵來抵禦敵人的攻擊。遊戲包含9張關卡地圖、6把擁有30種天賦的武器、40種怪物以及30種可建造的單位與建築。透過合理規劃建造節奏、操控士兵、選擇能力來靈活應對不同的敵人，享受指揮與策略交織的樂趣。

games.name: The Druid
games.short_description: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.

games.name: Heart&Slash
games.short_description: Fight as Heart, an innocent robot fighting to escape the grip of mindless machines in a future where humans are no more. A fast-paced 3D brawler with roguelike elements set in a colorful yet desolated world.

games.name: 勇者趕時間 Brave's Rage
games.short_description: 這是一款操作上非常有難度的Rougelite遊戲，融合了即時戰鬥（ATB）和卡牌構築（DBG）要素，感受精密計算與靈活走位結合帶來的爽快感！從9位獨特勇者中組成2人小隊，挑戰20層精心設計的難度階梯與豐富的劇情內容，還有更多魅力皮膚有待解鎖！

games.name: Vertical Drop Heroes HD
games.short_description: Vertical Drop Heroes is a procedural platformer RPG hybrid with roguelike elements, where your hero adventures through randomly generated stages. Armed with a variety of skills and traits, you must use your cunning and reflexes to survive the dangers of each stage.

games.name: Folk Hero
games.short_description: 民謠英雄傳 》是一款以斯拉夫奇幻世界為背景、帶有Rogue-lite 元素的動作殺手遊戲。探索不斷變化的島嶼，尋找寶藏，組合武器和神器來擊敗神秘的敵人。挑戰你的技能！一次人生，一次嘗試。

games.name: VOLTED
games.short_description: Tanks, flying cars, giant bugs, lots of guns, bullet rain - it's INSANE! PS: don't forget to take your friends with you.

games.name: Sea of Survivors
games.short_description: In Sea of Survivors, you can sail your ship in any direction but you can never stop moving. Evade and destroy hordes of pirates and sea monsters to gain experience, level up and choose upgrades for your ship. Explore oceans filled with mysterious curses, unlock treasures and fight for survival.

games.name: Deliverance & Reign
games.short_description: Join a gothic battle where Good confronts Evil using roguelike deckbuilding mechanics. Play as either side, invading Alaric's Castle, or as Alaric himself defending against the invading heroes!

games.name: Another Farm Roguelike
games.short_description: Another Farm Roguelike is a 2D farming & crafting game with rougelike elements where your job is to earn as much money as possible to pay the rent. Start from scratch and build the most profitable farm you can make as soon as possible. Work hard to be able to afford the rent.

games.name: 异常情绪回收组
games.short_description: 异常情绪回收组是一款类rogue回合制游戏。你能在这里遇到各种奇奇怪怪规则的情绪体，这些情绪体的效果都是一团谜，只有不断去解析未知效果的情绪体，不断用生命去积累经验，才能按照它的规则去利用它，获取非常强大的效果。

games.name: Surmount: A Mountain Climbing Adventure
games.short_description: 一起來加入爬山大冒險的行列之中吧！

games.name: Gemini
games.short_description: Gemini is an action tower defense game, where your goal is to protect the crystal and stay alive.

games.name: 公主：东方与远征（Princess: The East and the Expedition）
games.short_description: In the course of the expedition, you can choose different means such as friendship or strategy to expand the land, experience the cultural features of different countries and open the love and hate between the NPC with different features ~

games.name: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship
games.short_description: 建造炮塔，升級戰艦，營救船員，探索未知，打造屬於你自己戰鬥風格的末日孤艦，縱橫戰場！

games.name: 奇幻東征
games.short_description: 《奇幻東征》是一款Roguelike的冒險動作遊戲，玩家扮演受天神詔示而踏上征途的領導者。在隨機的地圖與路線上做出抉擇、招兵買馬、蒐集寶物、通過各種戰鬥和奇遇來完成使命！

games.name: Infinite Tao
games.short_description: 《Infinity Tao》is a Rogue Lite game set in the Ancient Chinese Immortal Cultivation setting. Raise your realm, build powerful Magic Treasures combinations and Synergies, kill thousands of monster and win the 30 minute game.

games.name: 重返深淵
games.short_description: 《重返深淵》是一款帶有Rogue-Lite元素的割草生存遊戲，升級武器並運用你的戰鬥技巧，在同屏超過10000只怪物中殺出重圍，直至擊敗製造混亂的罪魁禍首為止！

games.name: Flotilla
games.short_description: Lead your orbital battleships to victory in Flotilla! Fight, trade, and explore new planets in your journey through the galaxy. Featuring tactically rich 3D combat, flank and surprise the enemy from any direction. When the dust settles, generate another randomized universe for a brand new adventure!

games.name: OmniFootman
games.short_description: OmniFootman is a rogue-lite action game with souls-like combat system. Take your adventure in this cursed, ever-changing kingdom and beat your enemies with different ability combinations. Be careful as your death is permanent.

games.name: 電玩大亨： 肉鴿模擬器
games.short_description: 《電玩大亨》是首款 Roguelite 商店模擬遊戲。經營這座城市最後一家電子遊戲商店，緊跟最新遊戲發售，倒賣走私復古遊戲，策略性選擇你的運營策略，僱用員工，並應對（搶劫）那些煩人的小偷。

games.name: 超級子彈娘
games.short_description: 在這款組牌策略型的輕Rogue遊戲中，你需要從一個邪惡的人工智能手中拯救遊戲世界，解除各個網絡遊戲的危機！探索各種經典遊戲品類的地圖，挑戰高難度的回合制戰鬥，深入敵營，收集超過160枚可愛又迷人的子彈娘。

games.name: 銜尾蛇國王
games.short_description: 《銜尾蛇國王》結合了國際象棋的戰術深度與肉鴿遊戲的構築多樣性和重複遊玩性，帶來全新的國際象棋體驗。組建強大的軍隊、發現遠古遺物、購買魔法道具，擊敗女巫集會吧！

games.name: Battle Grid
games.short_description: Face relentless alien hordes, collect their resources and assemble an unstoppable squadron of mechs! In this Action Roguelite, discover game-breaking synergies, mix and match weapons and units, unlock upgrades, harvest and conquer alien planets.

games.name: 打倒白雪公主！烏拉！
games.short_description: 站起來吧，受壓迫的小矮人們，揮動你們手中的武器，反抗來自邪惡統治者白雪公主的壓迫。但革命的征途絕非一帆風順，每前進一步都要提防敵人的進攻。而你，需要領導小矮人聯盟，派出強大的陣容，合理構築卡牌來最大化你的優勢，要堅信，自由鑄成的聯盟牢不可破！

games.name: Apocalypse Express
games.short_description: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

games.name: Dimensionals
games.short_description: 你知道嗎？宇宙的每個位面都有不同的生物居住！各個次元的平靜突然被邪惡打破，從各個位面中挑出好手，集結他們，組成3人小隊，用瘋狂的連擊和可愛的造型去拯救我們的多元宇宙吧！

games.name: 亡者之地
games.short_description: 歡迎遊玩《亡者之地》，這是一款以凱爾特神話為基礎改編的，回合制Rogue-lite&迷宮探索類遊戲。在安溫的地下世界裡，使用各具特色的武器，釋放技能組合大殺四方。征戰七大王國之領主，拯救造物者，奪回重要的靈魂科技。

games.name: Doomed to Hell
games.short_description: Doomed to Hell is a roguelike-like top-down shooter where you play as Rose, a human in hell who will need to fight all of its monsters in waves of enemies, defeat bosses, and get new weapons to earn back his life on earth.

games.name: Cyclo Chambers
games.short_description: Collect synergizing items to create an overpowered character to fight hordes of cyclops monsters. Cyclo Chambers is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter with light rogue-like elements. 150 items to choose from to create frantic combinations. Different runs every time.

games.name: 最後的防線
games.short_description: 《最後的防線》是一款塔防主題的類Rouge遊戲。玩家需要透過建造基地、搭配天賦以及對戰時的精細操作來抵禦一波又一波的敵人。在戰鬥過程中，如何合理使用地形、如何分配有限的資源、如何選擇兵種以及如何搭配天賦從而能夠發揮出最大的戰鬥力，這些都將是對玩家的考驗。記住，你的每一次選擇都將影響最後的戰局！

games.name: 打倒白雪公主！烏拉！：序章
games.short_description: The Prologue of the Union of Gnomes awaits your daring and brave gaze. Twisted and broken, it stands — a reflection of what was never meant to be. The threads of destiny fray, and reality splinters like a shattered mirror.

games.name: 节奏快打/Rhythm Fighter
games.short_description: This is a Roguelike Horizontal Action game that players need to follow the beat to defeat opponents. Beat to follow, fist to the bone. Face the foe, and dance to kill!

games.name: Star Story: The Horizon Escape
games.short_description: 你将带着全息私人助理，驾驶着自己的宇宙飞船去完成探索神秘的天际星球的任务！会出什么错呢？一切都可能出错！这是一个有着文字角色扮演类元素的回合制冒险游戏。

games.name: Mana Spark
games.short_description: A challenging action RPG with deep souls-like combat and rogue-like elements. Explore a dreadful dungeon and fight smart enemies that will plan and collaborate between themselves to defeat you.

games.name: 冥界契約
games.short_description: 在現世與異界交錯的深淵中，化身背負逝者夙願的戰士，駕馭冥燈之力，與已故戰友的亡魂並肩作戰。每一次精確的格擋與穿梭，都是對命運枷鎖的反擊！用冷兵器的鋒芒與策略性的肉鴿構築，撕裂被詛咒的維度屏障，揭開血與魂交織的真相。

games.name: Sproggiwood
games.short_description: Bring civilization to Sproggiwood, a story-driven, turn-based roguelike set in a humorous world inspired by Finnish mythology. Grow your civilization and plunder procedural dungeons with six unique classes. Outsmart mischievous monsters who work together in unexpected ways. No two dungeon dives are alike.

games.name: Abomi Nation
games.short_description: 怪怪魔境（Abomi Nation）是一款Roguelike怪獸捕捉RPG遊戲。每一次新遊戲都會創造一個全新版本的怪怪魔境，獨一無二的世界，以及更多獨特的怪怪魔等待你去發掘。跟你的怪怪魔一起探索未知的世界，一起戰鬥、做做小遊戲，並且隨著冒險的深入，怪怪魔間的友誼也會不斷加深，塑造專屬於你們的獨特冒險旅程吧！

games.name: Shoulders of Giants: Ultimate
games.short_description: Simultaneously control a sword-wielding robot and a gunslinging space frog in Shoulders of Giants, an explosively colourful sci-fi roguelike. Play alone, with a friend, or as part of a four-person team, cutting through waves of enemies on a quest to rescue the galaxy from the forces of Entropy!

games.name: 西遊幸存者
games.short_description: 《西遊幸存者》是一款像素風的輕松愉悅、生存rogue、類幸存者遊戲。故事取材西遊洪荒和傳統修仙體系，你可以選擇12位能力各異的角色，在200多個海量技能和共鳴中自由組合各種玩法和流派。同時你也可以結識道侶、種田建造、招募小弟，一起共同對抗敵人

games.name: Super Raft Boat Together
games.short_description: The world's been flooded. All you have left is your Super Raft Boat… and your friends! Work together to expand your raft while fending off the strangely violent (and wealthy??) creatures of the sea in this multiplayer roguelike shooter. Will your crew survive and reach the Final Island?

games.name: Game Studio Simulator（我要做游戏）
games.short_description: 建造自己的遊戲工作室，和各大廠商進行激烈的商業角逐，招聘屬於自己工作室的小夥伴！現在就開始行動吧！

games.name: Road Not Taken
games.short_description: Road Not Taken is a roguelike puzzle game about surviving life’s surprises. You play as a ranger adventuring through a vast, unforgiving forest in the aftermath of a brutal winter storm, rescuing children who have lost their way.

games.name: Last Horizon
games.short_description: Pilot the last vessel of a fallen civilization into the vast expanse of space. Collect resources and search for a new world to call home in this minimalist space exploration and survival game.

games.name: Blightstone
games.short_description: A challenging, turn-based strategy with a roguelike edge. Lead a team of adventurers to destroy the Blightstone and free the world from corruption. Use free movement, dynamic environments and collectable skills to save the crystal, and save the world.

games.name: Captain Forever Remix
games.short_description: Can you create the raddest spaceship? Captain Forever Remix is the spaceship builder roguelike. Voyage across the Solar System and blast apart randomly-generated enemies for spare parts. This is an officially-licensed re-imagining of the indie classic Captain Forever.

games.name: Against Great Darkness
games.short_description: Against Great Darkness 是一款具有風險回報系統的動作羅格萊克射擊遊戲，採用復古打磚塊機制。通過地獄之坑戰鬥。在獲得的遺物中找到有趣的協同效應。解鎖角色和升級以提高你的機會。

games.name: Astral Throne
games.short_description: Uncover the mystery of a land beset by a Falling Star's curse in this Roguelike Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Build your party, recruit new allies, and synergize your team's skills for decisive victory.

games.name: Skeletal Avenger
games.short_description: Embark on a bone-chilling quest for vengeance as a skull-hurling skeletal warrior in Skeletal Avenger! This captivating roguelite dungeon crawler melds hack'n'slash mayhem with endlessly replayable gameplay, offering a thrilling, ever-evolving experience that keeps you coming back for more.

games.name: Nadir: A Grimdark Deck Builder - Prologue
games.short_description: 《天底》是一款Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏，与同类游戏不同：你能预知每次出牌后敌人的反应。构建你自己的卡组，击杀强大的恶魔。收集资源，扩张城市，积蓄力量，成为地狱的主宰。

games.name: 9th Dawn II
games.short_description: A large scale fully openworld RPG full of fast-paced action, dungeon crawling, with single or multiplayer adventures! Fight plenty of ferocious monsters, collect masses of loot and take on ancient lost puzzles within the depths of Caspartia!

games.name: Half Hour Hexagon
games.short_description: Obliterate a never-ending horde of enemies while you attempt to reach the 30 minute mark. Race to earn XP and level up to gain new items and opportunities for each run to become stronger than the last.

games.name: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
games.short_description: 《Passant》是一款顛覆傳統規則的國際象棋 roguelike 遊戲。你需要突破層層挑戰，收集強力棋子與扭轉戰局的道具，奪取最終勝利。

games.name: 晶石戰記
games.short_description: 在支離破碎的艾瑟瑞亞大陸，深淵腐蝕正侵蝕萬物，只有古老魔法寶石能淨化黑暗。你將收集數百種元素寶石（火焰、冰霜、雷電等），透過策略組合與合成，打造終極武器對抗異變魔物。回合製戰鬥讓你冷靜思考，敵人各有致命機制──有的吞噬寶石，有的進化反彈，必須針對性搭配連招。 400+寶石、40+預設組合與遺物系統帶來無限構築可能，最終形成毀天滅地的戰鬥流派，終結深淵。
dev: 南京西木优洛网络科技有限公司
pub: 南京西木优洛网络科技有限公司

games.name: The Simulacrum
games.short_description: The Simulacrum is a deckbuilder with procedurally generated cards. Obtain cards through a roguelite mode, acquire a large collection and challenge the hidden guardians of The Simulacrum.

games.name: Artist Life Simulator
games.short_description: Live the life of a starving artist in 19th century alternative history. Survive poverty, alchoholism, madness, depression, and 67 different feelings. Paint masterpieces by combining inspirations, sell them for riches (or scraps) and create a painting that will change the world.

games.name: 坦克兄弟
games.short_description: 《坦克兄弟》是一款彈幕 Roguelike 遊戲。你將扮演賞金獵人，在末日廢土中駕駛坦克，營救夥伴、升級裝備、改造戰車，在敵潮中奮力求生，追捕通緝犯，最終成為傳奇！

games.name: Become the Moon
games.short_description: Become the Moon is a challenging, deckbuilding auto battler. Choose from 10 unique characters, each with their own distinct playstyles. Assemble a team of powerful minions & cast cosmic spells where every run takes you one step closer to the moon.

games.name: Citizen of Rome - Dynasty Ascendant
games.short_description: Life sim set in the Ancient Roman Republic. Experience life and events in Ancient Rome through multiple generations of a family, helping them grow from lowly commoners to mighty Senators. Long live the Republic!

games.name: 大宋英雄传(SongHeros)
games.short_description: 以宋朝为架空背景的策略武侠游戏，作为一个普通人进入江湖，体验生与死、善与恶，游历、结交、战斗、蜕变，获取资源，不断成长，针对敌人搭配技能，克敌制胜。每一次开始都是新的，做出不同选择，体验一段段史诗故事！

games.name: Hive Jump 2: Survivors
games.short_description: 在某個異星球上，你是所屬小隊的唯一倖存者，身上剩下武器、噴射背包和企圖繼續奮戰的勇氣。獵殺外星蟲群，將它們富含價值的臟器製成爆裂升級物和不可或缺的實用工具。在這款 roguelike 彈幕射擊動作遊戲中成為復仇使者！

games.name: 魔法書自走棋：契約
games.short_description: 《魔法書自走棋·契約》是一款融合了RPG與肉鴿的全新策略自走棋，在魔法書的世界裡，玩家可以盡情搭配，享受無盡的戰鬥。

games.name: 安魂戰棋
games.short_description: 《安魂戰棋》是一款將經典戰棋與Roguelike融合為一體，暗黑風格的策略回合制戰棋遊戲。每個職業有數十種發展路線，搭配上百種裝備特效，每個玩家都可以打造自己不同風格的隊伍，享受極致的回合制戰棋遊戲的快感

games.name: Sandwalkers - Prologue
games.short_description: Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based strategy game. Convoy goods to neighboring tribes, build relationships, survive hostile creatures, and discover a new world. Inspired by great games like Wartales, Curious Expedition, or For The King.

games.name: Monster X Monster
games.short_description: This is a Rogue-like RPG card game. You team up 4 monsters to escape the castle defeating all the heroes. Monsters need freedom!

games.name: HyperParasite
games.short_description: A rogue-lite twin-stick shooter/brawler that never plays the same twice. Collect and control 60 different characters as the body-snatching alien Parasite with a grudge against humanity. Fight to the top of the food chain: possess the President, push the Big Red Button and one-up the human race.

games.name: Runers
games.short_description: Runers is a top-down rogue-like dungeon shooter where you explore a vast underground labyrinth and face fierce monsters and bosses. As the game advances further into the dungeon, you will gather Runes, which will be used to combine into 285 unique spells.

games.name: Healed To Death
games.short_description: Healed To Death is a single-player Rogue-Lite where you play as the Healer. The gameplay is inspired by healing in MMORPGs. Manage a party, Heal your allies, Explore dungeons and Destroy undead monsters with Healing & Support Spells.

games.name: One More Dungeon 2
games.short_description: One More Dungeon 2 is a First Person Dungeon Crawler Roguelite where you play as a human being captured by Giant Sentient Snails

games.name: 桃色武林
games.short_description: 玩家将扮演一个初出茅庐的江湖小生，在战斗和历练中结识红颜知己，并与她们共同闯荡这个充满危机与机遇的江湖世界。

games.name: 血夜再臨 起源
games.short_description: The Few Nights More is a roguelike turn-based RPG based in a world where Vampire Lords seek to conquer lost territories and their place in the world. Design and defend your stronghold, slay your enemies with traps, and fulfill your Lord’s true potential, slowly conquering what is rightfully yours.

games.name: Dead Monarchy
games.short_description: Dead Monarchy is an open-world, turn-based tactical RPG set in a low fantasy world. Personally lead and manage your mercenary company as the captain and embark on your personal quest to defeat the arena champions.

games.name: The Last Hex
games.short_description: The dead arise and only you can stand against them. Equip and train your character, grow your arsenal of cards, survive harrowing encounters and prepare for the final showdown with The Lost at ...The Last Hex! A RPG Deckbuilder with Roguelite elements.

games.name: Earth Overclocked
games.short_description: Earth Overclocked is a frantic rogue-lite adventure starring a scientist who is terrible at making time machines, but great at blasting bad guys. Use a diverse selection of weapons to fight off monsters while searching for pieces of your time machine in randomly generated environments.

games.name: Striving for Light
games.short_description: Blending deep Action RPG buildcrafting with roguelite action, Striving for Light lets you shape and customize an infinite skilltree. Hunt for powerful loot, craft and upgrade weapons to legendary power, slay hordes of enemies and challenging bosses in ever-changing dark worlds.

games.name: 喵喵工坊
games.short_description: 魔龍詛咒了你！ 作為曾經的冒險喵，如今你卻連把劍都舉不起來！但這難不倒聰明的你。在《喵喵工坊》中，揮舞你的小肉墊，經營鐵匠鋪，招募萌喵員工，派遣冒險者深入地下城。既然拿不起劍，那就打造出能夠對抗魔龍詛咒的神級裝備吧！

games.name: Whisker Squadron: Survivor
games.short_description: 這是一款由 RACE THE SUN 開發商出品的流暢 Roguelite 射擊遊戲，配有貓科飛行員配音，和名為 The Swarm 的企業機器蟲展開戲劇性的對決。呈現 3 個場景戰役，其中包括分支路線、史詩頭目以及大量飛行員、太空船及武器。

games.name: Aooni
games.short_description: 【這就是《藍色悲劇》的由來】 傳奇恐怖遊戲「青鬼」現已登陸 Steam!

games.name: 王國圍攻
games.short_description: 《王國圍攻》是一款融合了肉鴿元素的即時策略遊戲。玩家需要鞏固城鎮的防禦，抵禦敵人一波又一波的攻勢。每輪遊戲過後都能提升戰力、解鎖新內容，從而應對越發強大的威脅。

games.name: 空境奇旅
games.short_description: 《空境奇旅》是一款戰術角色扮演遊戲，你將沉浸於生動多彩的場景中，迎接充滿挑戰的回合制戰鬥！憑藉明智的選擇，在無情的荒野中尋得一線生機。獨自冒險？還是組建四人小隊？一場危險與機遇並存的冒險正在等待！

games.name: Anoxia Station
games.short_description: Descend into darkness in Anoxia Station, a turn-based strategy game with puzzle elements. Operate a subterranean mining station, where you'll gather resources, confront horrors, and make life-or-death choices for the survival of your crew.

games.name: 仙旅异闻录
games.short_description: 《仙旅异闻录》是一款偏选择取向的回合制RPG游戏，玩家扮演一名偶然与灵猫结缘的凡人，在灵猫的指引下修业问道，阅览人间异事，品味人间百态，最终将经历的故事收录成书。是飞升入仙，还是逍遥人间，结局如何，全凭玩家选择。

games.name: The Iron Oath
games.short_description: Command, endure, and prosper in The Iron Oath, a turn-based tactical RPG where the fate of your mercenary company rests on your decisions. Customize your roster, build your renown, and discover the secrets that await in the medieval fantasy realm of Caelum.

games.name: 幻世九州
games.short_description: 《幻世九州》是一款承袭国韵传说的MMORPG，问道于乱世莽荒恢弘遗迹，多线修炼突破经脉转生，结盟爽战史诗猛兽，重炼极品法宝武器，御灵宠幻化坐骑随性，邂逅正缘传功双修，上古九州由你谱写！

games.name: Eyes in the Dark
games.short_description: Fight with light against the dark in this "roguelight" platformer starring Victoria Bloom! Drive back the darkness that's overrun Bloom Manor and conquer swarms of creatures as you discover powerful new items to upgrade your arsenal. Are you ready to enter the ever-changing manor?

games.name: Die For The Lich
games.short_description: Gather magical dice, adapt your gear and venture through a land haunted by folklore creatures.

games.name: A Legend of Luca
