games.short_description: A Legend of Luca is a VR FPS Rogue-Like! Every run you explore vast dungeons as a freed slave caught in a war between gods. Fight hordes of monsters in search of powerful upgrade combinations to kill a god and unlock new classes.

games.name: Time Survivors: Chapter 0
games.short_description: Free CHAPTER 0 for Time Survivors, the Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike ever. Slay hordes impersonating Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and other historic heroes with unique abilities! Collect resources, unlock secrets, and enhance gameplay through skill-tree meta-progression

games.name: The Storm Guard: Darkness is Coming
games.short_description: The Storm Guard is a challenging turn-based roguelike role-playing game inspired by the Night’s Watch in the Game of Thrones. You assume the role of the Lord Commander of the Storm Guard leading the order during difficult times. An ancient dragon and its minions have returned, threatening the realm of men.

games.name: Bounty Below
games.short_description: Bounty below is an idle adventure game about mining and smithing items. While your units are mining for you delve into the endless dungeon to gain even more ore!

games.name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate
籃下王朝：戰術大師
games.short_description: 用卡牌成為籃球王者，把自己的名字狠狠砸在名人堂之上！在《籃下王朝：戰術大師》中成為傳奇教練，帶領球隊一路過關斬將，闖入季後賽，獲得總冠軍！連續得分，招招致命，利用精心搭配的夢之卡組掌控賽場，打出無限高潮！從零開始親手打造冠軍之師，鑄就你的籃球王朝！

games.name: Mad Crown
games.short_description: Mad Crown是一款融合roguelike元素的策略冒險遊戲。身為探索者的你，為尋求傳說中的王冠，在隨機的遺跡中使用有限獲取的資源和縝密的策略與詭異的敵人作戰。等待你的，是不可預知的恐懼。

games.name: Resist the succubus—The end of the female Knight
Royal Revolt Survivors
games.short_description: Unleash chaos in an electrifying 1-4 player co-op where survival and action-roguelite collide! Battle through relentless enemy hordes with a powerful mix of melee and ranged combat, navigating varied and dynamic environments.

games.name: Eagle Island Twist
games.short_description: Eagle Island 是一款 Roguelite 動作平台遊戲，其戰鬥風格受到獵鷹的啟發。 透過程式生成的關卡進行有腳本的冒險，或使用包含新角色和復古主題迷你遊戲的手工製作的 TWIST 內容。

games.name: Dust & Neon
games.short_description: 《沙塵與霓虹》以後末日西部荒野為故事背景，是融入了 roguelite 元素的同類雙槍射擊遊戲中的佼佼者。

games.name: Feral Fury
games.short_description: Fast-paced twin stick shooter rogue-lite action

games.name: Worship
games.short_description: Convert followers to your world-ending cult in this Pikmin-inspired roguelike. Draw with blood to perform occult rituals, command a growing army of faithful and venture the world to corrupt it. The Old Ones have awakened and they await a vessel to prepare their arrival.

games.name: The Madness of Little Emma
games.short_description: The Madness of Little Emma is a difficult action platformer with roguelike elements. Featuring over 250 items with insane synergies, varied enemies, and numerous secrets and mysteries to discover.

games.name: Outnumbered
games.short_description: Outnumbered is a mass-enemy top-down shooter where bullet heaven meets bullet hell. Evolve your ship, master your loadout and turn the tide against hordes of enemies. You may be outnumbered, but you are far from outpowered.

games.name: Obsidian Prince
games.short_description: Fight through dungeons in a tactical, turn-based roguelike where choices have real consequences. Craft your backstory & inspiration decks & combine classes, skills & gear to create truly powerful heroes. Explore & rebuild Emalon in the campaign or top the highscore in a challenging roguelike mode.

games.name: 東方翠神廻廊 〜 Faith in the Goddess of Suwa.
Quest of Dungeons
games.short_description: Quest of Dungeons is a turn based dungeon crawler game featuring a good old 16-bit retro artistic look. By playing as either a Warrior, Wizard, Assassin or Shaman you have to traverse dungeons, defeat enemies and loot everything you can in order to survive.

games.name: Door in the Woods
games.short_description: This game is a venture into an alternative timeline in which graphics and sensible game design were never invented.

games.name: Reignbreaker
games.short_description: 在這款「中世紀龐克」單人動作遊戲中，開鎖工具與尖刺鐵鎧短兵相接。迎戰空群來襲的鎖式機兵，從腐敗的精英手中解放世界。洗劫他們的金庫、摧毀王國，化身成「王權破壞者」。

games.name: Wildkeepers Rising
games.short_description: Tame monsters! Slay waves of enemy hordes! Explore fantasy lands! Wildkeepers Rising is a whimsical action-RPG roguelite set in a beautiful hand-drawn world that combines the power curve of bullet heaven games with the compulsive fun of a creature collector.

games.name: 末日核心: 機甲幸存者
games.short_description: 核末日 100 年後，一座由 AI 維護的避難所和他的守衛機甲等待着人類幸存者的到來。避難所的反應堆能夠幫助人類改善生存環境，産生安全區。 玩家操控機甲，爲反應堆獲取燃料，對抗變異生物，完成任務，保護人類幸存者。

games.name: 無悼之境
games.short_description: 《無悼之境》是一款Roguelite動作冒險遊戲。死亡並非終點，而是全新冒險的開端。運用古老的死靈魔法，組建亡靈惡魔大軍，為封印《無悼之境》的裂縫而戰。

games.name: Nearly Dead - Live and Let Die
Whispers of the Eyeless
games.short_description: 在這款黑暗奇幻策略RPG中成為教派領袖，釋放神聖力量。你是反派角色——指揮信徒、在戰鬥中智取敵人，並在喚醒死之諸神——憤怒、慾望與瘋狂——的同時改變墮落城市的命運。

games.name: Attic Panic
games.short_description: Attic Panic is a 2-4 player top-down supernatural rogue-like shooter where you play as possessed toys that battle each other to entertain the Entity, which grants players unique powers and abilities at the end of each round.

games.name: The Banished Vault
games.short_description: A strategy game of exploration, endurance, and space travel on an interstellar gothic monastery. Explore solar systems, harvest resources, construct outposts, and face hazards in the challenging universe of The Banished Vault.

games.name: Blackjack Descent
games.short_description: You're locked in a room where your only chance of survival is to play blackjack against a sinister dealer. Every hand isn't just a gamble, it's a deal with fate. Fail to repay your debt on time, and you'll fall into darkness... or something far worse.

games.name: Desta: The Memories Between
games.short_description: Fall into a beautiful and puzzling dreamworld. Find your friends, unlock spectacular abilities and overcome the odds in a surreal tactical dodgeball adventure to uncover the mysteries of a broken world from the creators of Monument Valley.

games.name: Spells & Secrets
games.short_description: 在这个盗贼冒险中，您可以通过创造性地使用您的法术来解救格赖芬斯坦学院免受魔法生物的侵害。独自探索这个现代魔法世界，或者与朋友和家人一起在本地合作模式下进行游玩，自定义您的角色，解开谜团，寻找强大的神器。

games.name: 异能重组
games.short_description: [Powers Reconfiguration] is a turn-based roguelike game. In this game, you can seize your enemies' abilities, skills, and even followers lock, stock and barrel! Build your own power through plunder while disrupting your foes' abilities - now let's see who the real boss is!

games.name: 無盡迷宮：惡女末途
games.short_description: 這個事件起因於一位失踨的超級英雄，而惡黨女幹部寡婦則是唯一的嫌疑犯。寡婦到底隱瞞了什麼事情？亦或是…… 本作品是動作類型Roguelike，並在亂數生成迷宮中戰鬥冒險的遊戲。

games.name: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
games.short_description: 在這款奇幻風格的動作類Roguelite遊戲中扮演亞瑟王，手持破碎的石中劍展開任務之旅，拯救四散各處的卡美洛子民，消滅恐怖駭人的虛空巨人，並逃離星界。

games.name: Night Shippers
games.short_description: 你報名參加了在地獄裡送貨的工作。必須在日出前完成所有訂單——否則地獄之神將會永遠吞噬你。

games.name: Holy Shoot
games.short_description: Holy Shoot is a fast-paced roguelite action FPS set in a satirical version of Hell, packed with chaos, blessed heroes, and demonic bosses. Pick your hero, dive into hell, upgrade your build, and shoot your way through sin.

games.name: WARPZONE DRIFTER
games.short_description: Breakless drifter retro-hardcore arcade game, made by the same creator of the UBERMOSH series.

games.name: Godslayer Arena
games.short_description: Godslayer Arena is a roguelike fusion of autobattlers and action-rpgs. Combat is performed completely automatically. Understanding complex interactions between the spells, gems, and items you draft will be key to success. Break the game. Become overpowered.

games.name: Card Crawl
games.short_description: Card Crawl is a solitaire style Dungeon Crawler played with a deck of cards.

games.name: Striving for Light: Survival
games.short_description: Striving for Light: Survival brings the exploration of infinite expanding skill trees to the arena survival roguelite genre. Unlock new characters, weapons, skills and maps, slay hordes of monsters and take on massive boss fights.

games.name: Ascendant
games.short_description: Ascendant is the unforgiving beat 'em up in which you are a demigod invading a world controlled by your rivals. Choose your fate by discovering Blessings, equipping mighty weapons and spells, and learning to survive in this brutal realm. Only the most impressive warriors have a chance of victory.

games.name: 數字魅影：極限競賽
games.short_description: 數字魅影：極限競賽是一款融合風格畫賽博龐克風的3D Roguelite 動作砍殺遊戲。加入風靡全球的真人秀競技場，策略搭配驅動程序，為你的義體搭載定制化特殊功能，構築極致暢爽連招，與極具特色的智能機械交鋒，感受每一次擊打的超華麗動作戰鬥視覺效果！你還可以組隊參賽！

games.name: 西游-琉璃盏
games.short_description: This is a side scrolling action Rougelike game set in the three realms of humans, demons, ghosts, and gods. It tells the story of Lao Sha and other characters from Journey to the West before they learn from the classics

games.name: 王牌戰略：機甲新星
games.short_description: 一款融合Roguelike與牌庫構築的戰術遊戲。玩家可招募機甲駕駛員，在戰場上駕馭機甲、部署無人機、釋放技能，並在每場戰鬥中收集獨特的晶片和道具，完善你制霸戰場的構築。

games.name: Refence
games.short_description: Refence is a roguelite based idle defense game, where you can choose heroes and their traits, upgrade your castle, and manage resources to fend off enemies from the Demon Realm who are trying to attack your castle.

games.name: Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears
games.short_description: 《龍紀事：暗黑之淚》是一款運用各種英雄組合來挑戰地下城通關的戰略型RPG遊戲。 在這個被暗黑眼淚汙染的世界中，善用策略成長並利用各種英雄來對抗墮落之人，進一步克服即將到來的試煉吧。

games.name: Serious Sam: Tormental
games.short_description: Serious Sam: Tormental is a 3D rogue-lite top-down shooter where you blast your way through the tormented mind of demigod of destruction Mental, as he imagines worlds and monsters that stand on your path towards his inner ego. Let the showdown begin!

games.name: Seed of Heroes
games.short_description: Journey through the realms with your heroes party. Defeat hordes of enemies in a bullet heaven and reach Valhalla where you belong.

games.name: BroomSweeper
games.short_description: 《扫雷清洁工（BroomSweeper）》是一款扫雷解谜肉鸽游戏。在腾塔科技（TentaTeq） 公司逐层闯关，揭开潜藏的邪恶秘密。利用超过 100 种强力道具组合，击败灰兔怪（Dust Bunnies），拼尽全力保住你的夜班工作！ 🧹💥 准备好被扫吧！

games.name: Swords And Magic: Path Of Conquest
games.short_description: 劍與魔法：征服之路 是一款設定在奇幻世界中的即時自動戰鬥遊戲，具有團隊RPG元素！召集你的冒險者，組建你的團隊，挑戰地牢，獲取你應得的獎勵，並揭開世界的奧秘！

games.name: Mindbug Online
games.short_description: Mindbug redefines the card-battler genre, focusing on pure strategy and fast-paced excitement from the very first turn. Outsmart opponents with the groundbreaking Mindbug mechanic and rise through the new roguelike mode, discovering fresh powers, creatures, and combos each run.

games.name: Circle Empires 2
games.short_description: CIRCLE EMPIRES returns! Expand your empire, circle by circle, in this fast-paced follow-up to the hit RTS. Gather resources, build armies, and defeat bosses (or your friends) in a world that changes with every game. With unique units and biomes, it's an addictive battle of wits and tactics.

games.name: Brut@l
games.short_description: A modern re-imagining of the classic ASCII dungeon crawler. Choose your hero and descend into a procedurally generated world constructed entirely from ASCII letters. Can you survive?

games.name: Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth
games.short_description: 一起來種田吧！《Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth》是一款策略種田肉鴿遊戲。在這裡，你可以製作、建造、採集並管理資源，以賺取越來越高的房租。不需要無聊的跑圖，也沒有老套的戀愛劇情——所有操作都能用滑鼠輕鬆完成！

games.name: 球球大塔防
games.short_description: 《球球大塔防》是一款塔防主題的肉鴿割草遊戲。你不必通過頻繁地移動來躲避敵人，選擇你的防禦塔，裝備適合你的技能，並從各種升級和物品中進行選擇，打造獨屬於你的防禦堡壘，來抵禦一波又一波的敵人！

games.name: A Magical High School Girl / 魔法の女子高生
別讓猛鬼靠近我
games.short_description: 輕度肉鴿（Roguelite）生存射擊塔防遊戲，融合防守與構築玩法，在喪屍猛鬼的末日中守護基地，隨機技能組合+寶石合成進化，打造專屬Build。防守基地、擊退喪屍猛鬼，每局5分鐘快節奏戰鬥。幻靈協同、槍械進化、角色天賦三重養成，高重玩價值。輕度策略，硬核爽感，單局5分鐘，低門檻高上限，失敗快速重開，每一局都是全新體驗！

games.name: Zombasite
games.short_description: Zombasite is a zombie apocalypse action RPG set in a dynamic, evolving, fantasy world for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

games.name: 黃道信條
games.short_description: 自由構築卡組，對抗混沌敵人，宇宙需要你的守護！在《黃道信條》中，你將收集上百張卡牌，自由搭配、無限構築，打造獨一無二的戰術體系。面對混沌敵人入侵，用策略擊敗他們、挑戰極限，在浩瀚星辰之間書寫屬於你的傳奇！

games.name: In Game Adventure: Legend of Monsters
Ocean Keeper Co-op Drill Multiplayer
games.short_description: 潛入 Ocean Keeper —— 一款合作型 Roguelike 遊戲，四位礦工守護他們的 機甲蜘蛛，對抗無盡的怪物浪潮並開採資源。與朋友組隊，在每波之間升級裝備，在充滿寶藏的深海洞穴中努力生存……如果你能做到的話。

games.name: 絕地鴨衛
games.short_description: 《絕地鴨衛》是一款以末世廢土為背景、融合生物龐克元素的 2D 橫向平台動作 Roguelike 遊戲。 玩家將化身十餘位能力各異的「鴨衛」，以「擊破」為核心，體驗風格鮮明且硬派的戰鬥玩法——無論是近戰拼刀，還是遠程火力壓制，都能帶來截然不同的操作體驗。透過數百種技能與道具自由組合，構築豐富多變的流派，以意想不到的方式擊潰敵人。 在蟲族肆虐的末日世界中，逐步探索並揭開這場驚天災變背後隱藏的真相。

games.name: ITER-8
games.short_description: 歡迎來到地表，ITER 僱員 #8。開採浮空柱，升級武器，守衛基地，一路到達頂端……或者在任務中慘死。操控消耗品員工，在一次又一次壯麗的循環中，奮力推進任務的完成。

games.name: Unalive
games.short_description: Unalive is an action adventure roguelike game. Randomly generated laboratory rooms. Collect unique items to improve your abilities. Kill bosses and stay alive. You have only one chance!

games.name: Mining Survivors
games.short_description: Incremental Survivors-like in which you mine valuable resources whilst slaying hoards of enemies.

games.name: All Walls Must Fall - A Tech-Noir Tactics Game
games.short_description: All Walls Must Fall is a Tech-Noir Tactics game set in Berlin 2089, where the Cold War never ended.

games.name: 戰律 2
games.short_description: 澳蘭尼亞海岸風雲再起——某個野心勃勃的新陣營發現古代禁物，若不加以阻攔，後果不堪設想。為了榮耀，他們會有多麼不擇手段？率領新的指揮官，走上陸海空戰場，運籌帷幄，打贏回合制戰爭！

games.name: DragonFangZ - The Rose & Dungeon of Time
Voidship: The Long Journey
games.short_description: Design your battleship and fight your way through unforgiving space. This is a tale of a lone spaceship on a centuries-long mission. As the captain, you´ll make strategic decisions, explore unknown sectors, meet allies and enemies, gather resources, technology and crew. To battle stations!

games.name: 異世界冒險者公會
games.short_description: 《異世界冒險者公會》是一款養成冒險者並與他們一同展開冒險的SRPG Roguelite遊戲。 來自異世界的人們與怪物突然現身，帶來混亂與危機。 作為公會會長的你，必須培養冒險者，與他們攜手解決這些異常現象！

games.name: 吾皇萬歲
games.short_description: 《吾皇萬歲》是一款皇帝模擬遊戲。你將穿越到古代中國一個風雨飄搖的朝代，在帝國動盪中登基為帝。選賢舉能重振皇權威嚴，納妃育嗣延續帝王血脈，練兵征戰肅清氏族封君。是代代傳承打造開元盛世，還是淪為亡國之君？

games.name: 東京巫女：倖存者
games.short_description: 化身巫女拯救東京，抵御如潮水般湧來的敵人！超過100種法術元素任你自由組合，施展強力法術，感受殺出重圍的極致快感，解鎖多位性格迥異的美少女，一步步揭開隱藏在東京背後的秘密！

games.name: 深淵之影
games.short_description: 《深淵之影》是一款俯視角動作Roguelite遊戲。你將在遊戲裡扮演戰士/刺客/法師等角色，深入光影交錯的地牢世界，剷除那些肆虐家園的怪物。做好準備，走進眼前的深淵吧！

games.name: BOXHEAD:Immortal
games.short_description: A zombie virus, brought to BOXHEAD World by a meteorite that fell unexpectedly, continues to turn people into the zombies. To survive in this purgatorial world, you must unleash every bullet into the hordes of the zombies and use any explosive objects to drench every inch of the land in blood.

games.name: 殭屍要塞：末日搜打撤
games.short_description: 在末日廢土中爆殺萬千喪屍！在《喪屍要塞：末日搜打撤》的崩塌廢墟中飛速變強，撿垃圾也能爆出滿身神裝！是選擇八方彈射的火力風暴，還是連環爆炸的清除螢幕盛宴，亦或是用棒球棍猛擊喪屍魔丸？成為末日背包管理大師，在血與火的圍攻中殺出生天吧，出擊，屠殺，逆天改命！

games.name: These Doomed Isles
games.short_description: 在這款具有 roguelike 牌組建構機制的生存城市建造遊戲中，收穫卡牌以使陸地從海底升起、建造定居點並向入侵者猛烈開火。在策略回合機制的遊戲玩法中，從 3 位擁有獨特卡牌、遊玩風格及能力的神明中選擇，以帶領他們的文明走向勝利！

games.name: Original Journey
games.short_description: Original Journey is a 2D hand drawn, sci-fi action-adventure with a bold hand drawn art style. Join the Ato as they embark on a mission to save their home world. Only a mysterious power source discovered on a distant planet can save them but how far will the Ato go save themselves?

games.name: Firegirl: Hack 'n Splash Rescue DX
games.short_description: 遊戲主人公是一個剛開始職業生涯的年輕女消防員，她將帶上可靠的斧子，還有能同時作為助推器使用的高壓消防水管，去應對城市各處的緊急呼叫。消防女孩能救出所有被困在大火中的市民嗎？

games.name: Zafehouse Diaries 2
games.short_description: Zafehouse Diaries 2 is a game of survival, exploration and relationships. Every hour, designate tasks for your handful of characters - each with their own skills, motivations and prejudices - and try to outlast the zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Day of the Shell
games.short_description: 《Day of the Shell》是一款「一鍵一回合」的戰略Rogue-lite遊戲。進入被大水淹沒的破碎世界，帶著僅存的希望和手槍，在不同島嶼上挑戰敵人、安撫諸神。

games.name: Ash Warden
games.short_description: Survive waves of enemies in Ash Warden, an incremental tower defense where you slowly become overpowered. Unlock new abilities, fight against powerful bosses, and evolve into an unstoppable force against the endless Redgaze hordes.

games.name: 鐵甲少女
games.short_description: 生化人JK出擊殲滅黑心巨頭企業! （全過程都將線上直播的動作遊戲）

games.name: Rift Loopers
games.short_description: Survive the horrors of the multiverse, alone or with your comrades, as you battle against an onslaught of insectoid like creatures. Combine abilities in different ways each loop to overcome and return safely to your universe.

games.name: REMEDIUM: Sentinels
games.short_description: Become a Sentinel and face the plague in roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter set in the same world as REMEDIUM game. Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more powerful weapons and create unique builds to defend the plague survivors against the endless hordes of mutants!

games.name: Defensurvivor
games.short_description: DEFENSURVIVOR 是一款策略遊戲，玩家需要建造障礙物並放置和移動單位來阻擋僵屍。遊戲中有各種獨特特性的單位和通過組合獲得的強力高級單位。利用隨機提供的單位生存到最後！

games.name: Moventure
games.short_description: 100種動作，2個按鍵，0教學。 掌握隱藏在方向鍵與2個按鍵中的龐大動作組，在終極movelike高精度平台遊戲中征服100+關卡。

games.name: ArcRunner
games.short_description: 你將要在這個以遙遠未來為背景、風格類似 Rogue 且充滿賽博龐克瑰麗風光的太空站「弧光號」來回穿梭，重設失控的 AI。以強化克隆人的身分開始每個回合，拯救弧光號於水火之中。

games.name: Loot River
games.short_description: 在這款充滿挑戰性的地牢探索Roguelike遊戲中探索由程序生成的迷宮，本遊戲結合了緊張的戰鬥與空間塊變換的機制。將遠古遺跡的地塊滑動組合、與令人憎惡的殘暴魔物戰鬥、取得戰利品、提升等級、建立戰略、釋放強力法術，而後死亡，並且以全新之身醒來。

games.name: Skopje '83
games.short_description: Explore a city thrust into disarray by an unknown event and survive the hordes of mutated abominations that lurk at every corner. You’ll have to fight through enemies & bosses, scavenge loot and survive the hostile city.

games.name: Samawa Idle
games.short_description: Unleash the power of specialized towers to annihilate hordes of monsters in this idle game with roguelike elements. Collect gold, level up your towers, face powerful bosses, and refine your strategy with an evolving skill tree.

games.name: Struggle F.O
games.short_description: What the newly awakened girl saw was an unfamiliar world and unfamiliar creatures. And on her arm, there was a mysterious gadget that could speak. Somehow, the girl who could now communicate with all living creatures, starts to struggle with her allies to survive in this world!

games.name: RogueJack21
games.short_description: RogueJack21 是一款以二十一點為靈感的牌組構築遊戲，在這裡你可以構建並升級你的牌組，打造瘋狂的牌局，並將勝算轉向己方。在程式生成的賭場中激戰，並向那個奪走你一切、統治 Noir City 的無情黑幫 The House 展開復仇.

games.name: Nomad Idle
games.short_description: Face waves of enemies automatically and create builds by distributing stat points, leveling up equipment, choosing passive skills, summons and more. An idle game about killing hordes of enemies, becoming stronger, and exploring an unfolding storyline. A spin-off of Nomad Survival.

games.name: To the Core
dev: NHTV Breda University of Applied Sciences
pub: NHTV Breda University of Applied Sciences

games.name: GONNER2
games.short_description: 《GoNNER 》的续作，程序生成的平台游戏，节奏紧张，乱糟糟但又萌萌哒。你要走进深邃、阴暗而又混乱的地方，在意想不到的配色之中，击败稀奇古怪的头目，一次又一次地掉脑袋，帮助死亡赶走强占了她巢穴的神秘存在。

games.name: Far Beyond: A space odyssey VR
Void Tyrant
games.short_description: Collect an intergalactic bounty of eccentric allies and deadly weapons, explore vibrant planets, and engage in risky turn-based battles to restore the Eyes of Chronos and save the galaxy in this strategic roguelike deckbuilder!

games.name: Eclipse
games.short_description: Once upon a time gods sent you here. You’ve slept in a glass sarcophagus for hundrends of years. When people find themselves on the brink of extinction, you’ll have to wake up. Now, the time has come. Get up and save the medieval village from the monsters coming from the abandoned dungeons!

games.name: Toy Odyssey: The Lost and Found
破壞王者 / Lords of Ravage
games.short_description: 成為最終頭目！隨心所欲地玩，結合來自不同派系的追隨者，贏得壯觀的回合制戰鬥。擴張你的黑暗帝國，尋找能改變世界命運的強大神器。

games.name: Town Of The Dead Life 死寂之城
Epic Manager - Create Your Own Adventuring Agency!
Dragon Call
games.short_description: "Dragon Call" is a non P2W card game. In the ancient war, the demigods expelled the Dragon Legion, but the effects of the war will never disappear. For thousands of years, intruders often ravaged the land. Now the summoners rise, they can use the energy of the earth to summon various helpers.

games.name: Berserker Onslaught
games.short_description: "Berserker Onslaught" is an action roguelike infused with survival and loot-hunting elements. Face relentless waves of monsters, harness the blessings of the gods to strengthen yourself, repel evil forces, and return with bountiful rewards.

games.name: Sorcery Saga: Curse of the Great Curry God
The Unliving
games.short_description: 《The Unliving》是一款 Rogue-lite 動作角色扮演遊戲，您可以在這個黑暗世界中扮演恐怖的死靈法師喚醒亡靈！帶領您的亡靈軍隊永無休止地戰鬥，用毀滅性的魔咒將城市燒成灰燼、擊敗史詩級魔王，並讓敵人化為恐怖的奴僕。

games.name: Wyvern
games.short_description: Wyvern is a real-time, top-down 2D, graphical, massively multiplayer RPG. The game has thousands of maps and playable areas, hundreds of skills, spells and monsters, and all the features you would expect from a big fun RPG: Guilds, crafting, level editing, community features and more!

games.name: Samosbor
games.short_description: The player will take the role of a liquidator destroying the consequences of Samosbor in the narrow corridors of Gigakhrushchevka.

games.name: 《龍蝕》
games.short_description: 《龍蝕》是一款輕度Rogue遊戲，在牌組構築的玩法中融入了獨特的自動對戰元素。選擇你的訓練家後，就能和強大奇靈並肩作戰，對抗棘手敵人。你將培育並進化奇靈，打造致勝牌組，並發動強大組合技來制霸戰場。不過你可得當心，因為日蝕即將來臨！

games.name: Into the Pit
games.short_description: A fast-paced retro-FPS roguelite! As a member of a family of lore-hunting mystics you are summoned to a cursed village, drawn by rumors of a demonic portal. Dark magics have overwhelmed the village, It's up to you to rescue the survivors, grow your powers, and journey forth INTO THE PIT.

games.name: 希望之城 The City Of Hope
Ooglians
games.short_description: Ooglians are coming! Nothing excites an ooglian more than smashing machinery. Protect your machinery with more machinery which attracts even more ooglians. How unfortunate.

games.name: Malignant Survivors
games.short_description: 3D 生存風格的黑暗奇幻主題動作角色扮演遊戲。引爆數千個邪惡生物，找到優質戰利品，提升你的英雄以迎接更艱巨的挑戰。

games.name: Racine
games.short_description: 《根》是一款卡牌構建自動戰鬥的Roguelike遊戲。使用你的卡牌來提升你的英雄屬性或施放強大的法術。尋找一些神器和全新卡牌可發展屬於你自己的遊戲風格。

games.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground
Hieroglyphika
games.short_description: Open the gate to the egyptian underworld! Hieroglyphika is a roguelike game completely without text but with pictograms.

games.name: The Monarch: First Light
games.short_description: 您將成為淨化這片土地的救世主嗎？The Monarch是一款走道防禦遊戲，您將控制一位君主，擴張您的王國，通過策略管理黃金資源，招募多樣化的單位，並探索充滿神話威脅的世界來抵抗邪惡。

games.name: Deadnaut
games.short_description: Deadnaut is Screwfly Studios' second game and follow up to cult hit, Zafehouse: Diaries. Deadnauts, so named because they’re unlikely to return, must explore, investigate and fight their way through the derelict ships of dead civilisations. Every mission is unique and no two locations are the same.

games.name: Achievement Smiles
games.short_description: 陽光燦爛的笑容，開朗、迷人、謙虛、甜美，但狡猾的敵人卻不讓他休息。 你必須一次又一次地安撫壞人，避免好鳥的結局。 冒險的海洋和好心情正在等待著您。 包含 2500 項簡單成就！

games.name: Lost In The Open
games.short_description: 一場意外的暗殺陰謀讓您受傷，並逃過無人地帶。要在這個Roguelike低魔奇幻戰術RPG中生存，您必須進行戰略招募、拼死戰鬥並真誠悔過。

games.name: 3DRPG
games.short_description: 3DRPG is a voxelized old-school RPG where you explore a Randomly Generated world filled with random dungeons, towns and people! Every character in the game is recruitable. Hunt for prey or go fishing for food. Search for treasure in dungeons and fight monsters on the way!

games.name: Swords and Sandals 5 Redux: Maximus Edition
Re:Lord – Tales of Adventure
games.short_description: 《轉生為領主開始冒險吧》是一款融合自走棋、牌組構築與Rogue元素的策略遊戲。穿越到異世界，邂逅晨星王國的四位美少女領主，發展領地、招募士兵、探索伊利諾亞半島，踏上揭示世界真相的冒險之旅。

games.name: Fortress Fury
games.short_description: Fortress Fury is a survivor multiplayer tower defense roguelite. Endless hordes of enemies want to crush your tower! Buy weapons and upgrades to craft an array of overpowering builds. Will you be able to survive all waves and be the last tower?

games.name: Genesis Survivors
games.short_description: Welcome, hackers, you're being transferred to Eden City to defend its citizens against the alien threat! Eden Survivors is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter where players must defeat hordes of alien invaders until the extraction time.

games.name: 화투전 ~ flower fight ~
games.short_description: Combine numerous characters and cards to create your own party. Explore dungeons to collect cards and defeat enemies. Within dungeons, various foes await. Utilize cards efficiently to achieve victory. Enhance characters with rewards and develop your own strategy.

games.name: The Backrooms
games.short_description: The Backrooms is a first person survival horror game set in one of the most terrifying environments of the human psyche. Explore an ever evolving nightmare while running from terrifying creatures to stay alive.

games.name: 戰術踩地雷：肉鴿Plus
games.short_description: 當掃雷遇上Roguelite，用戰術思維掃清迷霧。基於經典掃雷，以Rogue-lite玩法賦予無限可能。卡牌、改造地塊、永久強化三重成長，掃雷爽局一鍵解壓。規劃你的經濟，組合強化套路，思考戰術打法，對抗複雜且致命的雷區陷阱。隨機生成關卡，無限挑戰，體驗新世代的掃雷Plus。

games.name: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade
Pandemic Train
games.short_description: In Pandemic Train you are in charge of the crew aboard a train roaming the postapocalyptic wasteland, ravaged by both war and a deadly plague. Your goal is to survive long enough to discover the cure… or die trying. Humanity’s fate is in your hands! Start your journey now!

games.name: rooMaze
games.short_description: rooMaze is a first person hardcore roguelike with voxel graphics and procedurally generated levels! All of this is powered by Unreal Engine 4. Don't let acute-angled cubes deceive you as behind a simple visual style lies the all-consuming hardcore.

games.name: 大宋烽煙
games.short_description: This Chinese martial arts sandbox game blends character growth, adventure, survival, and building. It offers varied regions, towns, factions, engaging NPC interactions, and branching narratives. The combat system is novel, focusing on troop arrangement and skill cards, with replayable talent points.

games.name: Freaky Awesome
games.short_description: Freaky Awesome 是壹款刺激的rogue-lite動作遊戲。在遊戲中妳要探索隨機生成的工廠，同奇奇怪怪的怪物作戰，躲避陷阱。吸收有毒排放物突變成各樣突變體，獲得各種新特性。想要生存下來就必須適用各種突變形態！

games.name: Deathless: Survivors
games.short_description: Embark on an online co-op Survival Roguelite adventure. Team up with friends, slash through endless waves of foes, conquer formidable bosses, fulfill quests, craft potent weapons, and unlock unique characters!

games.name: Shadow Ninja: Apocalypse
games.short_description: Fast 2D ninja action where every mistake costs everything. Run, dodge, attack and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Necromantic
games.short_description: Start out as a lowly freshman at Valorborn Academy and prove yourself to the school and other students – or don’t, and repeatedly fall to the legions of horrors that await in Necromantic. Study up to survive in this dark and dangerous fantasy Bullet Heaven ... solo or by online co-op.

games.name: 最后的仙门 The last Practice Sect
Out There: Oceans of Time
games.short_description: 《Out There：Oceans of Time》是一款太空探索遊戲，玩家將在廣闊無垠、生機勃勃的宇宙中掌控一項星際探索任務。

games.name: 攻城与召唤 Siege and Summons 【5分钟一局 策略竞技 】
超級大富翁 (Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?)
games.short_description: Put your general knowledge to the test in « Who wants to be a millionaire? », the official game!

games.name: Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos
games.short_description: Experience the sequel of the traditional roguelike dungeon-crawling classic. Enjoy unlimited replayability through endless procedurally generated dungeons, countless monsters, grafting, crafting and a vast amount of skill trees. Journey into the ever changing depths of the Caverns of Chaos.

games.name: 仙侠世界2
dev: 上海巨人网络科技有限公司
pub: 上海巨人网络科技有限公司

games.name: WarLeague
games.short_description: 我們將自走棋遊戲與RTS遊戲融爲一體，製作出了這款大軍團對戰的多人策略遊戲。搭配和組合你選擇的卡牌，把你的軍隊從無發展到千軍萬馬的爽感，然後碾壓的你對手，最終吃雞獲取勝利。

games.name: 喪屍卡牌
games.short_description: 《喪屍卡牌》是一款源於俄羅斯輪盤賭的卡牌末日生存遊戲，在喪屍肆虐的特拉維斯城展開你的冒險。通過卡牌戰鬥搜刮物資、建造營地，與其他倖存者勾心鬥角，活下去將成為你的唯一目標！

games.name: 無限神速斬　勇者鬥惡龍 達伊的大冒險
games.short_description: 用你的雙手，體驗勇者的記憶！ 累計發行超過4700萬部的名作《勇者鬥惡龍 達伊的大冒險》以動作RPG的形式登場！用你的雙手，去體驗勇者達伊的故事吧。

games.name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate
古代人生 Ancient Life
games.short_description: 古代人生是一款模擬古代人的一生的遊戲, 遊戲內含有各式可能在古代發生的事件數件種, 玩家可以選擇種田, 當官, 工匠, 做獵人, 做商人, 各式職業都有不同的體驗. 玩家還能在客棧中遇到各式人物, 當然還有與自己家人之間發生的各種故事. 要如何過完這一生, 完全取決於玩家的選擇.

games.name: The Dark Eye : Book of Heroes
